en.title: Aircond, Water Heater & Oven Points in KL and Selangor
en.excerpt: High-power appliances sharing general socket circuits is how breakers trip and cables overheat. Here is why airconds, water heaters and ovens each need a dedicated point with the right cable, breaker and isolator.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Aircond, Heater & Oven Point Installation | KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Dedicated 20A–32A appliance points with isolators and correct cable sizing for airconds, water heaters and ovens in KL & Selangor, from RM 220/point.
en.content:
**Question:** Why does my breaker trip when the water heater and oven run together?

**Answer:** Because they are almost certainly sharing a circuit that was never designed for both. An instant water heater draws well over 3 kW on its own; an oven or built-in hob pulls a similar load. Two such appliances on one general circuit overload the cable and breaker — the breaker trips by design, but the cable running hot behind your walls is the real risk. The fix is not a bigger breaker; it is giving each high-load appliance its own **dedicated point**: a separate cable run from the distribution board, with cable sized to the load, its own protective device, and an isolator within reach of the appliance.

This article covers the **aircond, water heater & oven point** sub-service under [electrical services](/services/electrical), starting from **RM 220 per point**. Related scopes: [new power point & switch installation](/services/electrical/new-power-point-and-switch-installation) for general sockets, [lighting points](/services/electrical/lighting-point-and-downlight-installation), and [DB box upgrade & rewiring](/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring) when your board has no capacity left. If your RCCB already trips, see [RCCB keeps tripping](/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) and [power tripping frequently](/problems/power-tripping-frequently). For older wiring overall, read [safe electrical wiring upgrades for old houses](/blog/safe-electrical-wiring-upgrade-old-house).

## Which Appliances Need a Dedicated Point

| Appliance | Why it needs its own circuit |
|---|---|
| Instant water heater | Highest constant draw in most homes; works adjacent to water daily |
| Storage water heater | Sustained heating load; older tanks often share circuits from decades ago |
| Air conditioner | Compressor start current plus continuous run load per unit |
| Built-in oven / induction hob | 2–3 kW sustained during cooking |
| Anything hard-wired | Fixed appliances belong on hard-wired dedicated points, not plug sockets |

The published scope covers heavy-load **20A–32A dedicated points** with the correct isolator and cable sizing per appliance — the cable, breaker and isolator are matched to each other and to the load, never mixed.

## What a Dedicated Point Installation Includes

1. **Load calculation** — the appliance's rated load determines cable size and breaker rating; the existing DB capacity is checked to confirm it can take another circuit.
2. **Cable run** — a new cable is pulled from the distribution board to the appliance location, concealed where the building allows.
3. **Protection device** — a dedicated MCB of the correct rating goes into the DB for that circuit, under the house's RCCB protection.
4. **Isolator** — a switch installed near the appliance (above the door or beside the unit) so it can be safely cut off for servicing without touching the board.
5. **Termination** — hard-wired connection or a dedicated outlet at the appliance end, per the appliance type.
6. **Testing** — circuit tested, breaker behaviour verified, and the run labelled at the DB.

Electrical work is carried out by wiremen registered with Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST), as published for the company's electrical service, with a **12-Month Electrical Workmanship Warranty**.

## Signs Your Home Is Missing Dedicated Points

- The breaker trips when two heat-producing appliances run at once.
- A water heater or aircond was "plugged in" by extending a general socket with an adapter.
- Extension cords or multi-plugs run permanently for a fixed appliance — why this is dangerous is covered in [the old-house wiring guide](/blog/safe-electrical-wiring-upgrade-old-house).
- The DB has no spare ways left, or old circuits have unclear labelling.
- New appliances trip the RCCB — see [RCCB tripping](/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) for how to read that symptom.

## Water Heater Points: Extra Care

A water heater is the one high-power appliance that also lives next to water every day, so its point gets extra attention:

- **Working RCCB protection** on the circuit, verified by test — the ~30 mA household RCCB is the last line of defence against electrocution.
- **Correct earthing**, actually verified at the point, not assumed.
- **Isolator within reach** so the heater can be isolated for descaling or element replacement.
- **Cable diameter matched to the heater rating** — undersized cable is the classic cause of warm socket plates behind showers.

## Cost Factors

The published rate starts at **RM 220 per point**; [electrical services](/services/electrical) start at **RM 280** overall. Final cost depends on:

- Cable run length and concealment difficulty.
- Appliance load rating — the heavier the load, the heavier (and costlier) the cable.
- Whether the DB has spare ways, or needs a [DB upgrade](/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring) first.
- Isolator type and termination (hard-wired vs dedicated outlet).
- Patching where cable channels are opened.

The [electrical installation cost estimator](/tools/electrical-installation-cost) gives a ballpark before a site check.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can a 13A socket run my instant water heater?
Most instant water heaters sold in Malaysia draw more than a 13A circuit should supply continuously, and warm-up plus variable draw makes shared socket circuits unreliable. Manufacturers specify a dedicated supply for a reason — follow the appliance's stated rating.

### My house is old — do I need rewiring or just new points?
It depends on the wiring condition. If the cables and DB are in good shape with spare capacity, adding dedicated points is enough. If the wiring is decades old with rubber or brittle insulation, see [safe electrical wiring upgrades for old houses](/blog/safe-electrical-wiring-upgrade-old-house) — rewiring may be the safer answer. A DB inspection settles the question.

### Does a new point include a new breaker at the DB?
Yes — each dedicated circuit gets its own protective device in the board, sized to the appliance and cable. Nothing is tapped off an existing circuit's breaker.

## Give Heavy Appliances Their Own Circuit

One appliance, one circuit, one breaker — that is the rule that stops nuisance trips and silent overheating. KL Servis Rumah installs dedicated appliance points across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

Send photos of your DB, the appliance location and its rating label — [WhatsApp the electrical team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quote%20for%20aircond%2C%20water%20heater%20and%20oven%20point.).

ms.title: Titik Aircond, Pemanas Air & Ketuhar di KL dan Selangor
ms.excerpt: Perkakas kuasa tinggi berkongsi litar soket am ialah cara pemutus trip dan kabel terlalu panas. Ketahui kenapa aircond, pemanas air dan ketuhar setiap satu memerlukan titik khusus dengan kabel, pemutus dan isolator yang betul.
ms.metaTitle: Titik Aircond, Pemanas Air & Ketuhar di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Titik perkakas khusus 20A–32A dengan isolator dan saiz kabel betul untuk aircond, pemanas air dan ketuhar di KL & Selangor, dari RM 220/titik.
ms.content:
**Soalan:** Kenapa pemutus saya trip apabila pemanas air dan ketuhar berfungsi serentak?

**Jawapan:** Kerana mereka hampir pasti berkongsi litar yang tidak pernah direka untuk kedua-duanya. Pemanas air segera menarik lebih daripada 3 kW sendirian; ketuhar atau dapur tanam menarik beban serupa. Dua perkakas sedemikian pada satu litar am membebankan kabel dan pemutus — pemutus trip mengikut reka bentuk, tetapi kabel yang menjadi panas di belakang dinding anda ialah risiko sebenar. Penyelesaiannya bukan pemutus lebih besar; ia memberi setiap perkakas beban tinggi **titik khususnya** sendiri: laluan kabel berasingan daripada papan agihan, dengan kabel disaizkan kepada beban, peranti perlindungan sendiri, dan isolator dalam capaian perkakas.

Artikel ini merangkumi sub-perkhidmatan **titik aircond, pemanas air & ketuhar** di bawah [perkhidmatan elektrik](/ms/services/electrical), bermula **RM 220 setiap titik**. Skop berkaitan: [pemasangan titik kuasa & suis baharu](/ms/services/electrical/new-power-point-and-switch-installation) untuk soket am, [titik lampu](/ms/services/electrical/lighting-point-and-downlight-installation), dan [naik taraf kotak DB & pendawaian semula](/ms/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring) apabila papan anda tiada kapasiti lagi. Jika RCCB anda sudah trip, lihat [RCCB kerap trip](/ms/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) dan [kuasa kerap trip](/ms/problems/power-tripping-frequently). Untuk pendawaian lama keseluruhan, baca [peningkatan pendawaian elektrik selamat rumah lama](/ms/blog/pendawaian-elektrik-selamat-rumah-lama).

## Perkakas Mana Yang Memerlukan Titik Khusus

| Perkakas | Kenapa ia memerlukan litar sendiri |
|---|---|
| Pemanas air segera | Tarikan berterusan tertinggi dalam kebanyakan rumah; berfungsi bersebelahan air setiap hari |
| Pemanas air simpanan | Beban pemanasan berterusan; tangki lama selalunya berkongsi litar dari beberapa dekad lalu |
| Penyaman udara | Arus mula pemampat ditambah beban larian berterusan setiap unit |
| Ketuhar tanam / dapur induksi | 2–3 kW berterusan semasa memasak |
| Apa-apa yang dawaikeras | Perkakas tetap patut berada pada titik khusus dawaikeras, bukan soket plag |

Skop diterbitkan merangkumi **titik khusus 20A–32A beban berat** dengan isolator betul dan saiz kabel setiap perkakas — kabel, pemutus dan isolator dipadankan antara satu sama lain dan kepada beban, tidak pernah dicampur.

## Apa Yang Termasuk Pemasangan Titik Khusus

1. **Pengiraan beban** — beban berkadar perkakas menentukan saiz kabel dan kadaran pemutus; kapasiti DB sedia ada disemak untuk mengesahkan ia boleh mengambil litar lain.
2. **Laluan kabel** — kabel baharu ditarik daripada papan agihan ke lokasi perkakas, tersembunyi di mana bangunan mengizinkan.
3. **Peranti perlindungan** — MCB khusus berkadaran betul masuk ke dalam DB untuk litar itu, di bawah perlindungan RCCB rumah.
4. **Isolator** — suis dipasang berhampiran perkakas (atas pintu atau sebelah unit) supaya ia boleh dipotong dengan selamat untuk servis tanpa menyentuh papan.
5. **Penamatan** — sambungan dawaikeras atau saluran keluar khusus di hujung perkakas, mengikut jenis perkakas.
6. **Pengujian** — litar diuji, tingkah laku pemutus disahkan, dan laluan dilabelkan pada DB.

Kerja elektrik dijalankan oleh pendawai berdaftar dengan Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST), seperti yang diterbitkan untuk perkhidmatan elektrik syarikat, dengan **Jaminan Kerja Elektrik 12 Bulan**.

## Tanda Rumah Anda Tiada Titik Khusus

- Pemutus trip apabila dua perkakas penghasil haba berfungsi serentak.
- Pemanas air atau aircond "dipalug masuk" dengan melanjutkan soket am dengan penyesuai.
- Kord pelanjutan atau multi-plag berjalan secara kekal untuk perkakas tetap — kenapa ini berbahaya diliputi dalam [panduan pendawaian rumah lama](/ms/blog/pendawaian-elektrik-selamat-rumah-lama).
- DB tiada laluan ganti lagi, atau litar lama mempunyai pelabelan tidak jelas.
- Perkakas baharu trip RCCB — lihat [RCCB trip](/ms/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) untuk cara membaca gejala itu.

## Titik Pemanas Air: Perhatian Tambahan

Pemanas air ialah satu-satunya perkakas kuasa tinggi yang juga hidup bersebelahan air setiap hari, jadi titiknya mendapat perhatian tambahan:

- **Perlindungan RCCB berfungsi** pada litar, disahkan dengan ujian — RCCB isi rumah ~30 mA ialah pertahanan terakhir terhadap renjatan.
- **Pembumian betul**, sebenarnya disahkan pada titik, bukan diandaikan.
- **Isolator dalam capaian** supaya pemanas boleh dipencilkan untuk nyahkerak atau penggantian elemen.
- **Diameter kabel dipadankan dengan kadaran pemanas** — kabel kurang saiz ialah punca klasik plat soket panas di belakang pancuran.

## Faktor Kos

Kadar diterbitkan bermula **RM 220 setiap titik**; [perkhidmatan elektrik](/ms/services/electrical) bermula **RM 280** keseluruhan. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Panjang laluan kabel dan kesukaran penyembunyian.
- Kadaran beban perkakas — semakin berat beban, semakin berat (dan mahal) kabelnya.
- Sama ada DB mempunyai laluan ganti, atau memerlukan [naik taraf DB](/ms/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring) dahulu.
- Jenis isolator dan penamatan (dawaikeras berbanding saluran keluar khusus).
- Tampalan di mana saluran kabel dibuka.

[Penganggar kos pemasangan elektrik](/ms/alatan/kos-pemasangan-elektrik) memberi anggaran kasar sebelum semakan tapak.

## Soalan Lazim

### Bolehkah soket 13A menjalankan pemanas air segera saya?
Kebanyakan pemanas air segera dijual di Malaysia menarik lebih daripada yang patut dibekalkan litar 13A secara berterusan, dan pemanasan ditambah tarikan berubah menjadikan litar soket kongsi tidak boleh dipercayai. Pengeluar menentukan bekalan khusus atas sebab tertentu — ikut kadaran dinyatakan perkakas.

### Rumah saya lama — perlukah saya pendawaian semula atau hanya titik baharu?
Ia bergantung pada keadaan pendawaian. Jika kabel dan DB dalam keadaan baik dengan kapasiti ganti, menambah titik khusus sudah memadai. Jika pendawaian berusia beberapa dekad dengan penebat getah atau rapuh, lihat [peningkatan pendawaian elektrik selamat rumah lama](/ms/blog/pendawaian-elektrik-selamat-rumah-lama) — pendawaian semula mungkin jawapan lebih selamat. Pemeriksaan DB menyelesaikan persoalan itu.

### Adakah titik baharu termasuk pemutus baharu pada DB?
Ya — setiap litar khusus mendapat peranti perlindungan sendiri dalam papan, disaizkan kepada perkakas dan kabel. Tiada apa yang disadap daripada pemutus litar sedia ada.

## Beri Perkakas Berat Litar Sendiri

Satu perkakas, satu litar, satu pemutus — itulah peraturan yang menghentikan trip gangguan dan pemanasan senyap. KL Servis Rumah memasang titik perkakas khusus di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor.

Hantar foto DB anda, lokasi perkakas dan label kadarannya — [WhatsApp pasukan elektrik](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlu%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20titik%20aircond%2C%20pemanas%20air%20dan%20ketuhar.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪空调、热水器与烤箱专用点位
zh.excerpt: 大功率电器共用普通插座回路，正是跳闸与电缆过热的根源。本文说明为什么空调、热水器与烤箱各自需要带正确电缆、断路器与隔离器的专用点位。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡空调热水器烤箱专用点位
zh.metaDesc: 空调、热水器与烤箱的 20A–32A 专用大功率点位，配隔离器与匹配电缆线径，服务吉隆坡与雪兰莪，从 RM 220/位起。
zh.content:
**问题：**为什么热水器和烤箱一起开就跳闸？

**答案：**因为它们几乎肯定在共用一条本不是为两台大功率设备设计的回路。即热式热水器自己就要耗电 3 kW 以上；烤箱或嵌入式灶具的负荷相当。两台这样的设备接一条普通回路，会让电缆和断路器过载——断路器按设计跳闸是保护，但墙内发热升温的电缆才是真正的风险。解决办法不是换更大的断路器，而是给每台大功率电器配**专用点位**：从配电箱单独拉一条电缆，线径匹配负荷，配独立的保护装置，外加电器伸手可及的隔离器。

本文介绍[电工服务](/zh/services/electrical)下的**空调、热水器与烤箱点位**子服务，从每位 **RM 220** 起。相关范围：[新增电源插座与开关](/zh/services/electrical/new-power-point-and-switch-installation)（普通插座）、[照明点位](/zh/services/electrical/lighting-point-and-downlight-installation)，以及配电箱无富余时的[配电箱升级与重布线](/zh/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring)。如果您的漏电开关已经在跳闸，参考[RCCB 频繁跳闸](/zh/problems/rccb-tripping-kl)与[家中电闸频繁跳闸](/zh/problems/power-tripping-frequently)。老房线路整体情况请阅读[老房电路安全升级指南](/zh/bo-ke/jiu-fang-an-quan-dian-qi-xian-lu-sheng-ji-zhi-nan)。

## 哪些电器需要专用点位

| 电器 | 为什么需要独立回路 |
|---|---|
| 即热式热水器 | 多数家庭最大的持续负载；每天紧邻水工作 |
| 储水式热水器 | 持续加热负荷；老水箱常常沿用几十年前的共用回路 |
| 空调 | 压缩机启动电流加上每台的持续运行负荷 |
| 嵌入式烤箱/电磁灶 | 烹饪时持续 2–3 kW |
| 任何硬接线设备 | 固定电器应接在硬接线的专用点位上，而不是插线板 |

已公布范围涵盖 **20A–32A 大功率专用点位**，按电器匹配隔离器与电缆线径——电缆、断路器与隔离器彼此之间及与负荷必须匹配，绝不能乱配。

## 专用点位安装包含什么

1. **负荷核算** —— 电器的额定功率决定电缆线径与断路器规格；并检查配电箱现有容量能否再增一条回路；
2. **布线** —— 从配电箱到电器位置拉一条新电缆，建筑条件允许处暗敷；
3. **保护装置** —— 该回路专用的额定正确的 MCB 装入配电箱，在全屋 RCCB 保护之下；
4. **隔离器** —— 在电器附近（门上方或机身旁）安装隔离开关，维修时不必动配电箱即可安全断电；
5. **端接** —— 按电器类型硬接线或装专用插座；
6. **测试** —— 回路测试、断路器动作验证，并在配电箱做好回路标识。

电气工程由注册的 Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST) 电工执行（公司电工服务的已公布信息），并附带 **12 个月电工工艺保修**。

## 家里缺少专用点位的信号

- 两台产热设备同开就跳闸；
- 热水器或空调是用排插从普通插座“转接”供电的；
- 固定电器长期靠延长线或排插供电——其危险性在[老房电路指南](/zh/bo-ke/jiu-fang-an-quan-dian-qi-xian-lu-sheng-ji-zhi-nan)中有说明；
- 配电箱没有备用回路位，或旧回路标识不清；
- 新装设备导致 RCCB 跳闸——该症状的解读见[RCCB 跳闸](/zh/problems/rccb-tripping-kl)。

## 热水器点位：格外用心

热水器是唯一又吃大功率、又天天紧邻水运行的设备，因此它的点位要格外注意：

- 回路必须带**验证过的 RCCB 漏电保护**——家用约 30 mA 的 RCCB 是防触电的最后防线；
- **接地必须实测**，不能想当然；
- **隔离器触手可及**，方便除垢或换加热体时断电；
- **电缆线径匹配热水器功率**——线径不足是花洒旁插座面板发热的典型原因。

## 费用因素

已公布价格从每位 **RM 220** 起；[电工服务](/zh/services/electrical)整体从 **RM 280** 起。最终费用取决于：

- 电缆走线长度与暗敷难度；
- 电器负荷等级——负荷越大，电缆越粗（越贵）；
- 配电箱是否有备用回路位，或需先做[配电箱升级](/zh/services/electrical/db-box-upgrade-and-rewiring)；
- 隔离器类型与端接方式（硬接线或专用插座）；
- 开槽走线后的修补。

[电工安装费用估算](/zh/gongju/电工安装费用)可在上门前做粗略预算。

## 常见问题

### 13A 插座能带我的即热式热水器吗？
马来西亚销售的大多数即热式热水器的持续耗电超过 13A 回路应长期承载的水平，预热加变载让共用插座回路不可靠。厂家指定专用供电是有道理的——请按电器的额定值执行。

### 房子很老——需要全屋重布线还是只加点位？
取决于线路状况。如果电缆与配电箱状况良好且有余量，加专用点位就够；如果线路已用了几十年、绝缘是橡胶质或已发脆，请阅读[老房电路安全升级](/zh/bo-ke/jiu-fang-an-quan-dian-qi-xian-lu-sheng-ji-zhi-nan)——重布线可能是更安全的答案。做一次配电箱检查即可定案。

### 新点位包含配电箱里的新断路器吗？
包含——每条专用回路在配电箱内都有自己的保护装置，规格匹配电器与电缆。不从任何现有回路的断路器上搭接。

## 让大功率电器各走各的路

一台设备、一条回路、一个断路器——这是杜绝无故跳闸与无声过热的规则。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪安装大功率电器专用点位。

发送您的配电箱照片、电器位置与铭牌参数——[WhatsApp 电工团队](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%A9%BA%E8%B0%83%E3%80%81%E7%83%AD%E6%B0%B4%E5%99%A8%E4%B8%8E%E7%83%A4%E7%AE%B1%E7%82%B9%E4%BD%8D%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Aluminium Sliding Window Installation in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Powder-coated aluminium sliding windows for KL & Selangor homes — correct sizing, proper flashing and monsoon-tested seals. From RM 320 per sq ft.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Aluminium Sliding Window Installation KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: New aluminium sliding windows in KL & Selangor. Powder-coated frames, tempered or laminated glass, proper flashing. From RM 320/sq ft, 12-month warranty.
en.content:
Aluminium sliding windows are the default in Klang Valley housing for good reason: they do not rot, they handle humidity, and they open without swinging into the room. What separates a good installation from a leaky one is not the brand of frame — it is sizing, flashing and how the opening was prepared.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah supplies and installs aluminium sliding windows from **RM 320 per sq ft** in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, using powder-coated frames from suppliers such as Akasia, Hua Ho or YKK AP with tempered or laminated glass to suit the opening. Work carries a **12-month leak-free and hardware warranty**.

If your existing window frame is sound and only the glass, rollers or seals have failed, repair is cheaper — see [window repair](/services/window-repair) and [glass replacement](/services/window-repair/glass-replacement).

## Replace the window, or repair it?

| Situation | Usual answer |
|---|---|
| Glass cracked, frame straight and sound | [Glass replacement](/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| Window sticks or drags when sliding | [Roller replacement](/services/window-repair/sliding-window-roller-replacement) |
| Handle or lock broken | [Handle and hinge repair](/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair) |
| Rain gets in but frame is straight | [Window seal replacement](/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| Frame corroded, twisted, or old timber/steel | New aluminium sliding window |
| Changing opening size or layout | New window plus masonry work |

If you are not sure which camp you are in, the fastest check is whether the frame is still square and the drainage slots are clear. Related problems: [sliding window stuck](/problems/sliding-window-stuck), [stuck window lock](/problems/stuck-window-lock), [rusting window grille](/problems/rusting-window-grille).

## What the RM 320 per sq ft start includes

- Site measurement of the structural opening, sill level and wall thickness.
- Powder-coated aluminium sliding frame and sashes.
- 5mm clear glass infill as standard for typical residential panels.
- Fixing, packing, flashing detail and weather sealing to the reveal.
- Removal and disposal of the old window sash where straightforward.
- Adjustment of rollers and locks, plus a water test on completion.
- 12-month warranty on installation seals and supplied hardware.

Tinted, laminated or thicker glass, mosquito netting, security grilles, colour upgrades, high-floor access and any masonry making-good are quoted separately.

## Glass and frame choices that actually matter

**Glass**
- **5mm clear** — the standard infill for typical residential sliding panels.
- **Tempered** — required where panels are large, low to the floor, or in high-traffic areas. Breaks into blunt granules.
- **Laminated** — an interlayer holds the glass together. Better for street-facing windows and noise.
- **Tinted / low-E** — reduces heat gain on west-facing rooms. Useful in KL afternoons, priced higher.

**Frame**
- Powder-coated finish holds up better than anodised in coastal and high-rain conditions.
- Heavier frame sections resist flexing on wide openings; wide spans should not use the thinnest residential profile.
- Ask what the frame section is on the quote, not just the brand name.

## How we install

1. **Measure** the structural opening in three places, check for out-of-square, note the sill fall and wall build-up.
2. **Quote** with frame section, glass type, panel configuration and any masonry work itemised.
3. **Fabricate** — aluminium frames typically take 3–5 working days; glass 5–7 working days.
4. **Remove** the old window carefully. Steel and timber frames often bring plaster with them; we allow for making-good.
5. **Install** — set the frame plumb and square, pack correctly, never force it into a distorted opening.
6. **Seal** — flashing and weather sealant on the outside, backer where the gap is wide, neat internal finish.
7. **Test** — slide, lock, check drainage slots, and water-test before handover.

## Cost

| Item | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Aluminium sliding window | From RM 320 / sq ft |
| Glass replacement (existing frame) | From RM 200 |
| Frameless shower screen | From RM 420 / panel |
| Glass office partition | From RM 220 / sq ft |
| Wall mirror installation | From RM 320 |

Cost varies with size, frame section, glass specification, floor level and whether masonry work is needed. For a quick range before booking a measurement, try the [window replacement estimator](/tools/window-replacement-estimator) or the [glass replacement calculator](/tools/glass-replacement-calculator).

## Condominium and high-rise notes

- Most management offices require a renovation permit and deposit before window work, even for like-for-like replacement.
- Facade uniformity rules often restrict frame colour and panel layout. Confirm before ordering.
- Material movement is usually limited to service lifts and specific hours.
- Debris removal and lift protection are commonly conditions of approval.

We ask about building rules during measurement so the fabrication order does not need to change later.

## Common mistakes

- Ordering from a rough tape measurement. Aluminium and glass cannot be trimmed after fabrication.
- Sealing over the frame drainage slots, so rainwater has nowhere to escape and backs up inside.
- No flashing at the head, so water tracks down behind the frame and stains the internal wall.
- Choosing the thinnest frame profile for a wide opening, then living with flex and rattle.
- Replacing a window when the leak is actually coming from the wall above. Check [wall dampness and efflorescence repair](/services/waterproofing/wall-dampness-and-efflorescence-repair).
- Removing a security grille without a plan to refit or replace it.

## Frequently asked questions

### How long does installation take?

Fabrication is typically 3–5 working days for the frame and 5–7 for glass. Installation of a standard residential window is usually completed in one visit.

### Can you match my existing window colour?

Common powder-coat colours are readily available. Exact matching of an aged finish is not always possible; we will show the closest standard option at measurement.

### Do I need tempered glass?

For large panels, panels close to floor level and areas where impact is likely, yes. For a typical small bedroom window, 5mm clear is standard. We advise per opening.

### Can you install mosquito netting or grilles at the same time?

Yes, if specified upfront so the frame is ordered with the right provision. Retrofitting later is possible but less neat.

### Will a new window stop my rain leak?

Only if the leak is coming through the window. If water is entering through the wall, sill or above the frame, that needs waterproofing rather than a new window. We identify the source at measurement.

## Book a window measurement

Whether you are replacing corroded steel windows, upgrading a whole floor of a terrace house, or fitting out a condo unit, KL Servis Rumah measures and installs across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. Send photos of the window from inside and outside — [request a sliding window quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20an%20aluminium%20sliding%20window%20quote.).

ms.title: Pemasangan Tingkap Gelangsar Aluminium di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Tingkap gelangsar aluminium powder-coated untuk rumah KL & Selangor — ukuran tepat, flashing betul dan pengedap tahan monsun. Dari RM 320 / kaki persegi.
ms.metaTitle: Pasang Tingkap Gelangsar Aluminium KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Tingkap gelangsar aluminium baharu di KL & Selangor. Bingkai powder-coated, kaca tempered atau laminated, flashing betul. Dari RM 320/kaki persegi.
ms.content:
Tingkap gelangsar aluminium jadi pilihan lazim di Lembah Klang atas sebab yang munasabah: tidak reput, tahan lembapan, dan tidak perlu ruang ayunan ke dalam bilik. Yang membezakan pemasangan baik dengan yang bocor bukan jenama bingkai — tetapi ukuran, flashing dan penyediaan bukaan.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah membekal dan memasang tingkap gelangsar aluminium dari **RM 320 / kaki persegi** di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, menggunakan bingkai powder-coated daripada pembekal seperti Akasia, Hua Ho atau YKK AP dengan kaca tempered atau laminated mengikut bukaan. Kerja dilindungi **jaminan bebas bocor dan perkakasan 12 bulan**.

Jika bingkai sedia ada masih kukuh dan hanya kaca, roller atau pengedap rosak, baik pulih lebih jimat — lihat [baik pulih tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair) dan [penggantian kaca](/ms/services/window-repair/glass-replacement).

## Ganti atau baik pulih?

| Keadaan | Jawapan lazim |
|---|---|
| Kaca retak, bingkai masih lurus | [Penggantian kaca](/ms/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| Tingkap sangkut atau berat ditolak | [Ganti roller](/ms/services/window-repair/sliding-window-roller-replacement) |
| Handle atau kunci rosak | [Baik pulih handle dan engsel](/ms/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair) |
| Hujan masuk tetapi bingkai masih lurus | [Ganti pengedap tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| Bingkai berkarat, bengkok, atau kayu/besi lama | Tingkap gelangsar aluminium baharu |
| Tukar saiz atau susun atur bukaan | Tingkap baharu dan kerja batu |

Masalah berkaitan: [tingkap gelangsar tersekat](/ms/problems/sliding-window-stuck), [kunci tingkap ketat](/ms/problems/stuck-window-lock), [grill tingkap berkarat](/ms/problems/rusting-window-grille).

## Apa yang termasuk pada RM 320 / kaki persegi

- Ukuran bukaan struktur, aras ambang dan ketebalan dinding.
- Bingkai dan sash gelangsar aluminium powder-coated.
- Kaca jernih 5mm sebagai standard untuk panel kediaman biasa.
- Pemasangan, packing, butiran flashing dan pengedap cuaca.
- Pembuangan sash lama jika mudah dikeluarkan.
- Pelarasan roller dan kunci serta ujian air selepas siap.
- Jaminan 12 bulan pada pengedap pemasangan dan perkakasan yang kami bekalkan.

Kaca tinted, laminated atau lebih tebal, jaring nyamuk, grill keselamatan, naik taraf warna, akses tingkat tinggi dan kerja simen dinyatakan berasingan.

## Pilihan kaca dan bingkai

**Kaca**
- **Jernih 5mm** — standard untuk panel gelangsar kediaman biasa.
- **Tempered** — perlu untuk panel besar, panel dekat lantai atau kawasan lalu lalang. Pecah menjadi butiran tumpul.
- **Laminated** — lapisan dalam memegang serpihan. Sesuai untuk tingkap menghadap jalan dan kawalan bunyi.
- **Tinted / low-E** — mengurangkan haba untuk bilik menghadap barat.

**Bingkai**
- Kemasan powder-coated lebih tahan berbanding anodised dalam keadaan hujan lebat dan udara masin.
- Keratan bingkai lebih tebal mengurangkan lenturan pada bukaan lebar.
- Tanya keratan bingkai dalam sebut harga, bukan sekadar nama jenama.

## Cara kami memasang

1. **Ukur** bukaan struktur di tiga tempat, semak kesipian, cerun ambang dan binaan dinding.
2. **Sebut harga** dengan keratan bingkai, jenis kaca, konfigurasi panel dan kerja batu diperincikan.
3. **Fabrikasi** — bingkai aluminium lazimnya 3–5 hari bekerja; kaca 5–7 hari bekerja.
4. **Tanggalkan** tingkap lama dengan berhati-hati. Bingkai besi dan kayu selalunya menarik plaster bersama.
5. **Pasang** — bingkai ditegakkan tegak dan segi empat tepat, dipacking betul, tidak dipaksa masuk.
6. **Seal** — flashing dan sealant cuaca di luar, backer jika jurang lebar, kemasan kemas di dalam.
7. **Uji** — gelangsar, kunci, semak lubang saliran dan ujian air sebelum serahan.

## Kos

| Item | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Tingkap gelangsar aluminium | Dari RM 320 / kaki persegi |
| Penggantian kaca (bingkai sedia ada) | Dari RM 200 |
| Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai | Dari RM 420 / panel |
| Partition pejabat kaca | Dari RM 220 / kaki persegi |
| Pemasangan cermin dinding | Dari RM 320 |

Untuk anggaran awal sebelum ukuran, cuba [penganggar ganti tingkap](/ms/alatan/ganti-tingkap) atau [kalkulator ganti kaca](/ms/alatan/ganti-kaca).

## Nota kondominium dan bangunan tinggi

- Kebanyakan pejabat pengurusan memerlukan permit renovasi dan deposit sebelum kerja tingkap.
- Peraturan keseragaman fasad selalunya mengehadkan warna bingkai dan susun atur panel.
- Pergerakan bahan biasanya terhad kepada lif servis dan waktu tertentu.
- Pembuangan sisa dan pelindung lif kerap menjadi syarat kelulusan.

## Kesilapan biasa

- Membuat tempahan berdasarkan ukuran kasar. Aluminium dan kaca tidak boleh dipotong selepas siap difabrikasi.
- Menutup lubang saliran bingkai dengan silikon, menyebabkan air hujan bertakung di dalam.
- Tiada flashing di bahagian atas, air menyusur di belakang bingkai dan meninggalkan kesan pada dinding dalam.
- Memilih profil bingkai paling nipis untuk bukaan lebar.
- Menukar tingkap sedangkan bocor datang dari dinding di atasnya — lihat [rawatan dinding lembap dan efflorescence](/ms/services/waterproofing/wall-dampness-and-efflorescence-repair).

## Soalan lazim

### Berapa lama proses pemasangan?

Fabrikasi lazimnya 3–5 hari bekerja untuk bingkai dan 5–7 hari untuk kaca. Pemasangan tingkap kediaman biasa selesai dalam satu lawatan.

### Boleh padankan warna tingkap sedia ada?

Warna powder-coat biasa mudah didapati. Padanan tepat dengan kemasan lama tidak selalu boleh; kami tunjuk pilihan standard terdekat semasa ukuran.

### Perlukah kaca tempered?

Untuk panel besar, panel dekat lantai dan kawasan berisiko impak, ya. Untuk tingkap bilik kecil biasa, kaca jernih 5mm adalah standard.

### Boleh pasang jaring nyamuk atau grill serentak?

Boleh, jika dinyatakan awal supaya bingkai ditempah dengan peruntukan yang betul.

### Adakah tingkap baharu akan hentikan bocor hujan?

Hanya jika bocor melalui tingkap. Jika air masuk melalui dinding atau ambang, ia memerlukan kerja kalis air. Kami kenal pasti punca semasa ukuran.

## Tempah ukuran tingkap

Hantar foto tingkap dari dalam dan luar — [minta sebut harga tingkap gelangsar](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20tingkap%20gelangsar%20aluminium.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪铝合金推拉窗安装
zh.excerpt: 适合吉隆坡与雪兰莪住宅的粉末喷涂铝合金推拉窗——尺寸精准、泛水处理到位、经得起雨季。每平方英尺 RM 320 起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡铝合金推拉窗安装与更换
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪铝合金推拉窗安装。粉末喷涂窗框、钢化或夹层玻璃、正确泛水处理。每平方英尺 RM 320 起，12 个月保修。
zh.content:
铝合金推拉窗在巴生谷住宅几乎是默认选择：不腐朽、耐潮湿、开启不占室内空间。装得好还是会漏，差别往往不在窗框品牌，而在尺寸、泛水处理和洞口准备。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪供应并安装铝合金推拉窗，**每平方英尺 RM 320** 起，采用 Akasia、Hua Ho 或 YKK AP 等供应商的粉末喷涂窗框，按洞口选配钢化或夹层玻璃，享 **12 个月防漏与五金保修**。

若现有窗框仍稳固，只是玻璃、滑轮或胶条老化，维修更省钱 — 见 [窗户维修](/zh/services/window-repair) 与 [玻璃更换](/zh/services/window-repair/glass-replacement)。

## 该换窗还是修窗

| 状况 | 常见答案 |
|---|---|
| 玻璃破裂、窗框仍平直 | [玻璃更换](/zh/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| 推拉卡顿、越推越重 | [滑轮更换](/zh/services/window-repair/sliding-window-roller-replacement) |
| 把手或窗锁损坏 | [把手与铰链维修](/zh/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair) |
| 下雨渗水但窗框仍平直 | [窗户密封条更换](/zh/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| 窗框锈蚀、变形，或旧木/铁窗 | 更换新铝合金推拉窗 |
| 要改洞口尺寸或格局 | 新窗加泥水工程 |

相关问题：[推拉窗卡住](/zh/problems/sliding-window-stuck)、[窗锁卡死](/zh/problems/stuck-window-lock)、[窗花生锈](/zh/problems/rusting-window-grille)。

## 每平方英尺 RM 320 起包含什么

- 结构洞口、窗台标高与墙体厚度测量。
- 粉末喷涂铝合金推拉窗框与窗扇。
- 一般住宅面板标配 5mm 清玻璃。
- 固定、垫塞、泛水处理与洞口周边防水密封。
- 容易拆除的旧窗扇拆卸与清运。
- 滑轮与窗锁调校，完工试水。
- 我方安装密封与所供五金享 12 个月保修。

有色玻璃、夹层玻璃、加厚玻璃、纱窗、防盗窗花、颜色升级、高楼作业与泥水修补另行报价。

## 玻璃与窗框怎么选

**玻璃**
- **5mm 清玻璃** — 一般住宅推拉面板的标准配置。
- **钢化玻璃** — 大面板、接近地面的面板或人流通道位置必须使用，破碎后呈钝颗粒。
- **夹层玻璃** — 中间胶片黏住碎片，适合临街窗与隔音需求。
- **有色 / low-E** — 减少西晒得热，吉隆坡午后有感，价格较高。

**窗框**
- 粉末喷涂在多雨与近海环境中比阳极氧化更耐用。
- 洞口宽时应选较厚型材，避免晃动。
- 报价上要看型材规格，不只是品牌名称。

## 安装流程

1. **量尺**：结构洞口测三处，检查是否方正、窗台坡度与墙体构造。
2. **报价**：型材规格、玻璃类型、开启方式与泥水工程逐项列明。
3. **制作**：铝框一般 3–5 个工作日，玻璃 5–7 个工作日。
4. **拆除**：旧铁窗与木窗常连带批荡脱落，我们预留修补。
5. **安装**：窗框垂直方正就位，正确垫塞，绝不硬塞进变形洞口。
6. **密封**：外侧做泛水与耐候胶，缝隙大时加填充条，室内收口整齐。
7. **测试**：推拉、上锁、检查排水孔，交付前试水。

## 费用

| 项目 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 铝合金推拉窗 | 每平方英尺 RM 320 起 |
| 玻璃更换（现有窗框） | RM 200 起 |
| 无框淋浴屏 | 每片 RM 420 起 |
| 玻璃办公隔断 | 每平方英尺 RM 220 起 |
| 墙镜安装 | RM 320 起 |

量尺前想先了解区间，可用 [窗户更换估价工具](/zh/gongju/窗户更换估价) 或 [玻璃更换费用计算器](/zh/gongju/玻璃更换费用)。

## 公寓与高层注意事项

- 多数管理处要求装修准证与押金，即使是同规格更换。
- 外立面统一规定常限制窗框颜色与分格方式，下单前先确认。
- 材料搬运通常限用货梯并有时间限制。
- 垃圾清运与电梯保护往往是批准条件。

## 常见错误

- 凭粗略尺寸下单。铝材与玻璃制作完成后无法再裁切。
- 用硅胶封住窗框排水孔，雨水积在框内反渗室内。
- 窗顶没有做泛水，水顺窗框背面下流，内墙发霉起皮。
- 宽洞口选最薄型材，长期晃动异响。
- 漏水其实来自上方墙体却去换窗 — 见 [墙体潮湿与白华处理](/zh/services/waterproofing/wall-dampness-and-efflorescence-repair)。

## 常见问题

### 整个流程要多久？

窗框制作一般 3–5 个工作日，玻璃 5–7 个工作日。一般住宅窗多在一次上门内完成安装。

### 能配现有窗框颜色吗？

常用粉末喷涂色号容易取得，但老化后的旧色未必能完全匹配，量尺时会提供最接近的标准色。

### 一定要用钢化玻璃吗？

大面板、接近地面的面板与易受撞击位置建议使用。普通小房间窗户以 5mm 清玻璃为标准。

### 可以同时装纱窗或防盗窗花吗？

可以，需事先说明，让窗框预留正确位置；事后加装虽可行但收口不够整齐。

### 换新窗就不会漏雨吗？

只有当漏水确实来自窗户时才有效。若水从墙体或窗台渗入，需要做防水工程。量尺时会先判断来源。

## 预约窗户量尺

发送窗户室内与室外照片 — [索取推拉窗报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我需要铝合金推拉窗报价。).

en.title: Autogate Motor Replacement & Service in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Autogate motor replacement swaps a failed motor for a new unit, reconfigures the control board and re-tests the safety sensors, starting from RM 950. Hinges, tracks and gate alignment are checked first — a new motor on a binding gate fails early.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Autogate Motor Replacement & Service in KL
en.metaDesc: Autogate motor replacement and servicing in KL & Selangor from RM 950 — new motor, control board reconfiguration, safety sensor re-test and load check.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** When an autogate motor fails, the published fix is replacement with a new unit, control board reconfiguration and a full safety sensor re-test, starting from **RM 950**. The gate's hinges or track are checked first — fitting a new motor onto a gate that drags guarantees a second failure.

This guide explains the [Autogate Motor Replacement & Service](/services/autogate/autogate-motor-replacement-and-service) scope under [autogate services](/services/autogate). Motor work is partly electrical and partly mechanical; the visit diagnoses both sides before money is spent on parts.

## Signs the Motor Is the Real Problem

- Gate does not move but the motor hums — the motor or its capacitor is usually spent.
- Gate stops mid-travel or reverses at random points.
- Gate moves noticeably slower than it used to, even after the track or hinges are cleaned.
- Control board relays click with no response at the arms.
- Motor housing smells burnt or was submerged after flooding.

Two common lookalikes are **not** motor faults: a dead remote (see [autogate remote not working](/problems/autogate-remote-not-working)) and a physically obstructed or misaligned gate (see [autogate not closing](/problems/autogate-not-closing)). On-site diagnosis separates these before a motor is condemned.

## Repair or Replace?

| Finding | Sensible outcome |
|---|---|
| Capacitor, relay, sensor or board fault on a healthy motor | component-level repair — cheaper and adequate. |
| Burnt windings, waterlogged motor, worn gears | motor replacement. |
| Obsolete model with no parts support | replacement with a supported unit. |
| Binding hinges/track with a good motor | mechanical rectification first; motor untouched. |

A competent technician states which of these your gate actually is — in writing — before you approve parts.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Gate type and weight** — single swing, double swing and sliding drives are rated differently; an undersized motor on a heavy leaf fails early.
- **Hinges, track and ground condition** — sagging posts and worn hinges load the motor; dropped ground levels catch sliding tracks.
- **Control board condition** — lightning and power surges are a frequent board killer; the board and motor are assessed together.
- **Safety sensors** — photocells that save a car door, or a child, from a closing leaf.
- **Backup release** — the manual release must work so you are never locked in or out during a power cut.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Diagnose motor versus board versus sensor versus mechanics.**
2. **Confirm the gate moves freely by hand** — mechanical binding is fixed before motor work.
3. **Remove the failed motor and fit the new unit** to the correct rating.
4. **Reconfigure the control board** — travel limits, auto-close timing and force settings.
5. **Re-test the safety sensors** and pair the remotes.
6. **Load-test complete open/close cycles** and hand over with the warranty terms in writing.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Replacing the motor while ignoring sagging hinges — the new unit inherits the same overload.
- Skipping the travel-limit and force calibration, so the leaf slams or crushes what it touches.
- Approving an unrated or oversized motor because it is in stock, not because it matches the gate.
- Never testing the manual release — discovered only during the next power trip.
- Accepting a verbal "warranty" instead of the published terms on paper.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: from RM 950** inclusive of the replacement unit, board reconfiguration and sensor re-test.
- Gate type (swing or sliding) and the motor rating your gate weight requires.
- Additional parts — arms, racks, brackets or a replacement control board.
- Sensor replacement where photocells are also faulty.

The parent service publishes a **12-Month Motor & Installation Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms — the exact coverage text is given with your quotation.

## Safety and Maintenance

Every job ends with the safety sensor re-test precisely because an uncorrected gate can injure. Between services, keep the track swept of leaves and gravel, lubricate hinges as advised, trim plant growth away from photocells, and listen for slower travel — it is the earliest, cheapest warning. The [autogate installation guide](/blog/auto-gate-installation-guide-malaysia) covers selection basics if replacement becomes an opportunity to upgrade the drive type.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can only one motor be replaced on a double-leaf gate?
Yes, in most cases. The remaining motor is load-tested and the two are matched in travel timing; if the survivor is equally worn, the honest advice covers both — then it is your decision.

### How long does motor replacement take?
A straightforward swap with matching parts is typically completed in a single visit of a few hours, including calibration and sensor re-tests.

### Is a burnt board always replaced with the motor?
Not automatically. The board is tested; healthy boards are kept and reconfigured, while damaged ones are quoted openly as a separate part.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send the gate type, a short video of the symptom, and the motor brand if visible. KL Servis Rumah replaces and services autogate motors across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor — diagnosing the gate first, not just swapping boxes.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quotation%20for%20Autogate%20Motor%20Replacement%20and%20Service.).

ms.excerpt: Penggantian motor autogate menukar unit rosak dengan motor baharu, mengkonfigurasi semula papan kawalan dan menguji semula sensor keselamatan, bermula RM 950. Engsel, trek dan penjajaran pagar diperiksa dahulu — motor baharu pada pagar yang tersekat akan cepat rosak.

ms.metaDesc: Penggantian dan servis motor autogate di KL & Selangor dari RM 950 — motor baharu, konfigurasi papan kawalan, ujian sensor keselamatan dan ujian beban.
ms.content:
**Jawapan ringkas:** Apabila motor autogate rosak, penyelesaian yang diterbitkan ialah penggantian dengan unit baharu, konfigurasi semula papan kawalan dan ujian penuh sensor keselamatan, bermula **RM 950**. Engsel atau trek pagar diperiksa dahulu — memasang motor baharu pada pagar yang meragut menjamin kegagalan kedua.

Panduan ini menerangkan skop [Penggantian & Servis Motor Autogate](/ms/services/autogate/autogate-motor-replacement-and-service) di bawah [perkhidmatan autogate](/ms/services/autogate). Kerja motor adalah sebahagian elektrikal dan sebahagian mekanikal; lawatan mendiagnosis kedua-dua belah sebelum wang dibelanjakan pada alat ganti.

## Tanda Motor Memang Masalah Sebenar

- Pagar tidak bergerak tetapi motor berdengung — motor atau kapasitornya biasanya sudah habis.
- Pagar berhenti di tengah laluan atau berundur pada titik rawak.
- Pagar bergerak jelas lebih perlahan berbanding dahulu, walaupun selepas trek atau engsel dibersihkan.
- Geganti papan kawalan mengklik tanpa sebarang respons pada lengan.
- Housing motor berbau hangus atau pernah tenggelam selepas banjir.

Dua penyebab serupa yang **bukan** kerosakan motor: remote kehabisan bateri (lihat [remot autogate tidak berfungsi](/ms/problems/autogate-remote-not-working)) dan pagar yang terhalang atau tersasar secara fizikal (lihat [autogate tidak menutup](/ms/problems/autogate-not-closing)). Diagnosis di tapak memisahkan ketiga-tiganya sebelum motor dipersalahkan.

## Baiki atau Ganti?

| Penemuan | Hasil munasabah |
|---|---|
| Kerosakan kapasitor, geganti, sensor atau papan pada motor sihat | pembaikan peringkat komponen — lebih murah dan memadai. |
| Gegelung hangus, motor kemasukan air, gear haus | penggantian motor. |
| Model lapuk tanpa sokongan alat ganti | penggantian dengan unit yang disokong. |
| Engsel/trek tersekat dengan motor baik | pembaikan mekanikal dahulu; motor tidak diusik. |

Juruteknik yang kompeten menyatakan kategori mana pagar anda sebenarnya — secara bertulis — sebelum anda meluluskan alat ganti.

## Perkara Diperiksa Sebelum Kerja

- **Jenis dan berat pagar** — pemacu hayun tunggal, hayun berkembar dan gelongsar berkadar berbeza; motor bersaiz kecil pada daun berat cepat rosak.
- **Engsel, trek dan keadaan tanah** — tiang kendur dan engsel haus membebankan motor; paras tanah yang menurun menyangkut trek gelongsor.
- **Keadaan papan kawalan** — kilat dan lonjakan kuasa adalah pembunuh papan yang kerap; papan dan motor dinilai bersama.
- **Sensor keselamatan** — fotosel yang menyelamatkan pintu kereta, atau kanak-kanak, daripada daun yang menutup.
- **Pelepasan sandar** — pelepasan manual mesti berfungsi supaya anda tidak terkunci di dalam atau di luar semasa gangguan kuasa.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Diagnosis motor lwn papan lwn sensor lwn mekanikal.**
2. **Sahkan pagar bergerak bebas dengan tangan** — kekangan mekanikal dibaiki sebelum kerja motor.
3. **Tanggalkan motor rosak dan pasang unit baharu** mengikut kadaran yang betul.
4. **Konfigurasikan semula papan kawalan** — had laluan, masa tutup auto dan tetapan daya.
5. **Uji semula sensor keselamatan** dan pasangkan semula remote.
6. **Ujian beban kitaran buka/tutup lengkap** dan serahkan dengan terma jaminan secara bertulis.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Menggantikan motor sambil mengabaikan engsel kendur — unit baharu mewarisi beban lampau yang sama.
- Melangkau penentukuran had laluan dan daya, menyebabkan daun menghentam atau meremuk apa yang disentuhnya.
- Meluluskan motor tiada kadaran atau berlebihan kerana ia ada stok, bukan kerana ia padan dengan pagar.
- Tidak pernah menguji pelepasan manual — baru disedari semasa gangguan kuasa berikutnya.
- Menerima "jaminan" lisan dan bukannya terma diterbitkan di atas kertas.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: dari RM 950** merangkumi unit pengganti, konfigurasi semula papan dan ujian semula sensor.
- Jenis pagar (hayun atau gelongsor) dan kadaran motor yang diperlukan oleh berat pagar anda.
- Alat ganti tambahan — lengan, rack, pendakap atau papan kawalan pengganti.
- Penggantian sensor apabila fotosel turut rosak.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Motor & Pemasangan 12 Bulan**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma yang dinyatakan — teks liputan tepat diberikan bersama sebut harga anda.

## Keselamatan dan Penjagaan

Setiap kerja diakhiri dengan ujian semula sensor keselamatan tepat kerana pagar yang tidak diperbetulkan boleh mencederakan. Antara servis, sapu trek daripada daun dan batu kerikil, griskan engsel seperti dinasihatkan, potong pertumbuhan pokok jauh daripada fotosel, dan dengarkan pergerakan yang makin perlahan — ia adalah amaran paling awal dan paling murah. [Panduan pemasangan autogate](/ms/blog/panduan-pemasangan-auto-gate-malaysia) merangkumi asas pemilihan jika penggantian menjadi peluang menaik taraf jenis pemacu.

## Soalan Lazim

### Bolehkah hanya satu motor diganti pada pagar dua daun?
Boleh, dalam kebanyakan kes. Motor yang tinggal diuji beban dan kedua-duanya dipadankan dalam masa laluan; jika yang tinggal sama haus, nasihat jujur merangkumi kedua-duanya — kemudian ia keputusan anda.

### Berapa lama penggantian motor mengambil masa?
Penukaran mudah dengan alat ganti sepadan biasanya siap dalam satu lawatan beberapa jam, termasuk penentukuran dan ujian semula sensor.

### Adakah papan hangus sentiasa diganti bersama motor?
Tidak secara automatik. Papan diuji; papan sihat dikekalkan dan dikonfigurasi semula, manakala yang rosak disebut harga secara terbuka sebagai alat ganti berasingan.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar jenis pagar, video pendek simptom, dan jenama motor jika kelihatan. KL Servis Rumah menggantikan dan menservis motor autogate di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor — mendiagnosis pagar dahulu, bukan sekadar menukar kotak.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hai%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20Penggantian%20dan%20Servis%20Motor%20Autogate.).

zh.title: 电动门电机更换与保养：吉隆坡与雪兰莪
zh.excerpt: 电动门电机更换会把故障电机换成新机组，重新配置控制板并重测安全传感器，RM 950 起。施工前先检查铰链、轨道与门体对齐——门体卡滞时装新电机，只会换来第二次故障。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪电动门电机更换保养
zh.metaDesc: 电动门电机更换与保养，RM 950 起——新电机、控制板重新配置、安全传感器重测与负载测试。先诊断门体，再换电机。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**电动门电机故障时，已公布的处理方式是更换新机组、重新配置控制板并完整重测安全传感器，**RM 950 起**。施工前先检查门体的铰链或轨道——在拖滞的门上装新电机，注定换来第二次故障。

本文说明[电动门电机更换与保养](/zh/services/autogate/autogate-motor-replacement-and-service)子服务，属于[电动门与自动门系统服务](/zh/services/autogate)。电机工程一半是电、一半是机械；上门会先把两面都诊断清楚，再花钱买配件。

## 哪些迹象说明问题真在电机

- 门不动但电机嗡嗡响——电机或其电容通常已耗尽。
- 门在行程中途停止，或在随机位置自行反转。
- 即便清洁了轨道或铰链，门仍明显比以前慢。
- 控制板继电器哒哒作响，驱动臂却毫无反应。
- 电机外壳有焦糊味，或曾在淹水后泡水。

另有两个常见"相似症状"**并非**电机故障：遥控器没电（见[电动门遥控器失灵](/zh/problems/autogate-remote-not-working)），以及门体被物理阻挡或错位（见[电动门关不上](/zh/problems/autogate-not-closing)）。现场诊断会先分清这三类，再决定是否该换电机。

## 该修还是该换？

| 检查结果 | 合理处置 |
|---|---|
| 电机健康，但电容、继电器、传感器或控制板故障 | 元件级维修——更省且足够。 |
| 绕组烧毁、电机进水、齿轮磨损 | 更换电机。 |
| 型号停产、无配件支持 | 更换为有配件支持的机组。 |
| 电机良好但铰链/轨道卡滞 | 先修机械，电机不动。 |

合格的技术员应明确写出您的门属于哪一类——书面写明——然后您再批准配件费用。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **门型与重量**——单开、双开与推拉驱动的额定规格不同；小功率电机配重门扇，寿命必然短。
- **铰链、轨道与地面状况**——门柱下沉、铰链磨损都会加重电机负载；地面沉降会卡推拉门轨道。
- **控制板状况**——雷击与电涌是控制板的常客杀手；控制板与电机一并评估。
- **安全传感器**——关门时，电眼保护的是车门，更是孩子。
- **手动释放**——必须确认可用，停电时才不至于把人锁在门内或门外。

## 常见施工流程

1. **诊断电机、控制板、传感器还是机械问题。**
2. **确认门体手动推拉顺畅**——机械卡滞先修，再动电机。
3. **拆下故障电机，按正确规格安装新机组**。
4. **重新配置控制板**——行程限位、自动关门时间与力度设置。
5. **重测安全传感器**并配对遥控器。
6. **完整开闭循环负载测试**，并连同书面保修条款交付。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 只换电机却无视下沉铰链——新电机继承同样的过载命运。
- 省略行程与力度校准，导致门扇撞击或挤压碰到的一切。
- 因为有现货就装一台规格不符或功率过大的电机，而非匹配门体的那台。
- 从不测试手动释放——直到下次跳电才发现问题。
- 接受口头"保修"，而不索取书面公布条款。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 950 起**，含更换机组、控制板重配与传感器重测。
- 门型（平开或推拉）及门重所需的电机规格。
- 附加配件——驱动臂、齿条、支架或更换控制板。
- 电眼同样需要更换时的传感器费用。

其主服务公布 **12 个月电机与安装保修**，按适用范围和条款执行——具体覆盖文本随报价一并提供。

## 安全与日常保养

每项工程都以安全传感器重测收尾，因为一扇失控的门可能伤人。两次保养之间：清扫轨道上的落叶碎石、按建议给铰链上油、修剪遮挡电眼的植物，并留意门速是否变慢——那是最早、最省钱的预警。如果更换电机恰逢升级驱动方式的契机，[电动门安装指南](/zh/bo-ke/ma-lai-xi-ya-zi-dong-men-an-zhuang-zhi-nan)涵盖了选型基础。

## 常见问题

### 双开门可以只换一台电机吗？
多数情况下可以。留下的电机会做负载测试，两台行程时间校准同步；若旧机同样磨损，也会如实告知并给出双向方案——选择权在您。

### 更换电机要多久？
配件匹配的 straightforward 更换通常在数小时内完成，含校准与传感器重测。

### 控制板烧毁就必须和电机一起换吗？
不会自动捆绑。控制板会先检测；健康的保留并重配，损坏的作为独立配件明码报价。

## 获取针对现场的报价

请提供门型、症状短视频，以及电机品牌（如可见）。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪更换与保养电动门电机——先诊断门，再换盒子。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%A8%E9%97%A8%E7%94%B5%E6%9C%BA%E6%9B%B4%E6%8D%A2%E4%B8%8E%E4%BF%9D%E5%85%BB%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Auto Gate Installation & Motor Repair in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Swing, sliding and folding autogate installation, motor replacement, control board repair and remote pairing across KL & Selangor. From RM 2,200.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Auto Gate Installation & Motor Repair KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Auto gate supply, installation, motor servicing & track repair in KL & Selangor. Swing, sliding & folding gates. Fast diagnosis from RM 2,200.
en.content:
A malfunctioning autogate traps your car inside the driveway or leaves your property exposed to security risks. In Malaysia's hot, humid climate with frequent afternoon thunderstorms, autogate systems face constant exposure to rain, lightning surges, and mechanical wear. Getting a reliable autogate setup depends on selecting the right motor type for your gate weight and having certified wiring with proper surge protection.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah supplies, installs, and repairs residential and light-commercial autogates across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, **starting from RM 2,200** for single swing systems, **RM 3,200** for double swing systems, and **RM 3,800** for sliding gates. Motor replacement and servicing start from **RM 950**. All new installations include a **12-month warranty** on motor units and workmanship.

## Common Autogate Configurations in Malaysia

Choosing the right motor depends on your gate design, driveway clearance, and driveway slope:

| Gate Type | Typical Mechanism | Best Suited For | Starting Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[Single Swing Autogate](/services/autogate/single-swing-autogate)** | Single DC/AC linear arm actuator | Terrace house side gates or single-leaf main gates | From RM 2,200 |
| **Double Swing Autogate** | Dual linear arm actuators | Standard double-leaf driveway gates | From RM 3,200 |
| **[Sliding Autogate](/services/autogate/sliding-autogate)** | Ground rack-and-pinion heavy duty motor | Wide driveways or short car porches with no swing room | From RM 3,800 |
| **Folding Autogate** | Articulated arm or trackless folding motor | Narrow driveways needing maximum parking clearance | From RM 2,800 |
| **Motor Replacement & Service** | Motor swap, board repair & track tuning | Existing systems with burned motors or faulty boards | From RM 950 |

## What Our Autogate Installation Includes

Every full autogate installation by KL Servis Rumah follows a standard technical procedure:

1. **On-Site Assessment & Sizing:** We measure your gate width, calculate weight distribution, and inspect post hinge bearings to ensure smooth manual operation before motor mounting.
2. **Dedicated Electrical Connection:** Proper 230V AC connection with an outdoor weatherproof isolator, RCBO breaker protection, and earthing to prevent control board lightning damage.
3. **Control Board & Receiver Setup:** Microprocessor control panel setup inside a weatherproof IP65 enclosure with surge suppression and backup battery (12V/7AH) for power outages.
4. **Safety Sensor Integration:** Infrared photocell safety beams mounted across the gate line to automatically stop or reverse the gate when vehicles, children, or pets cross the path.
5. **Remote & Keypad Pairing:** Supply and programming of 2 to 4 high-frequency wireless remote controls, plus manual emergency release keys in case of total electrical failure.
6. **Testing & Handover:** Cycle testing for soft-start, soft-stop slowdown speeds, anti-crush sensitivity, and manual release operation.

## Common Autogate Problems We Fix

If your existing autogate is acting up, we diagnose and resolve issues such as:

- **[Autogate not closing or opening](/problems/autogate-not-closing):** Often caused by misaligned safety sensors, blocked ground tracks, or damaged control board relays.
- **[Autogate remote not working](/problems/autogate-remote-not-working):** Receiver frequency drift, weak remote batteries, or lightning surge damage to the antenna receiver module.
- **Gate opening slowly or grinding loudly:** Worn motor arm internal gears, dry screw jack threads, or rusted roller bearings.
- **Motor running continuously:** Limit switch failure or board relay stuck in the closed circuit position.
- **Gate dragging on driveway:** Post hinge wear or pillar structural sagging requiring [welding repair](/services/welding).

## Autogate Pricing Guide in KL & Selangor

| Service Scope | What Is Included | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Single Swing Arm System | 1x DC arm motor, control panel, 2 remotes, 1 safety beam, backup battery, standard wiring | From RM 2,200 |
| Double Swing Arm System | 2x DC arm motors, sync control panel, 2 remotes, safety beam, backup battery, standard wiring | From RM 3,200 |
| Heavy-Duty Sliding System | 1x sliding motor (up to 800kg), steel gear racks (up to 16ft), 2 remotes, safety beam | From RM 3,800 |
| Motor Replacement Only | Replacement of failed motor unit, wiring adaptation, board re-tuning | From RM 950 |
| Control Panel Board Repair | Diagnostic testing, PCB replacement or relay repair, remote reprogramming | From RM 350 |
| Safety Photocell Beam Add-on | Pair of infrared safety beams with weatherproof conduit wiring | From RM 280 |

*Note: Final pricing depends on gate size, required trenching for cables, and electrical point availability. We provide an exact quote before starting work.*

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What happens to my autogate during a power outage (TNB blackout)?
All our autogate packages come with a 12V 7AH backup battery that powers 10 to 15 gate cycles during an outage. In addition, every motor arm includes a manual mechanical clutch key so you can unlock the motor and push the gate manually.

### Why does my autogate control board keep getting damaged after lightning?
Malaysia has one of the highest lightning strike densities in the world. Unprotected autogate boards connected to long outdoor cable runs absorb high-voltage transients. We install dedicated surge protectors and ensure proper grounding to safeguard the control board.

### Can you install an autogate on an old existing iron or wooden gate?
Yes, provided the gate structure is sound and hinges swing freely without excessive friction. If hinges or gate brackets are weak, our [welding and metal fabrication team](/services/welding) can reinforce the structure prior to motor mounting.

### How often should an autogate system be serviced?
We recommend an annual maintenance check to lubricate linear drive screws, clear debris from photocell lenses, test battery backup capacity, and inspect wire terminations for ant or insect infestation.

Di Malaysia dengan cuaca panas, hujan lebat serta kilat yang kerap, sistem autogate mudah mengalami kehausan mekanikal dan gangguan elektrik. Pemasangan autogate yang tahan lama memerlukan pemilihan motor yang tepat mengikut berat pintu pagar serta pendawaian elektrik yang selamat dengan perlindungan kilat.

2. **Pendawaian Elektrik Berasingan:** Pemasangan bekalan kuasa 230V AC bersama isolator kalis cuaca luaran dan pemutus litar RCBO bagi melindungi papan kawalan daripada lonjakan kilat.

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪自动门安装与马达维修服务
zh.excerpt: 平开门、移门与折叠自动门安装、马达更换、控制主板维修与遥控器配对，服务吉隆坡与雪兰莪。RM 2,200起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡自动门安装与马达维修 RM 2,200起
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪自动门安装、马达维修、轨道调校与遥控配置。平开门、移门与折叠门全套方案，RM 2,200起，12个月保修。
zh.content:
在马来西亚的多雨与多雷气候下，自动门（Autogate）是排屋与独立洋房不可或缺的安防与便利设施。然而，因常年曝晒淋雨、雷击浪涌或机械磨损，自动门容易出现无法开关、马达卡死、遥控失灵或主板烧毁等问题。选择高品质马达并配合规范的电路防雷安装，是确保自动门长久稳定运行的关键。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 为吉隆坡与雪兰莪地区提供专业的住宅与商用自动门供应、安装及维修服务。**单扇平开门系统 RM 2,200起**，**双扇平开门系统 RM 3,200起**，**平移滑门（Sliding）系统 RM 3,800起**，马达更换与故障检修 **RM 950起**。所有新安装系统均享有 **12个月马达与施工保修**。

## 马来西亚常见自动门系统类型

| 自动门类型 | 运作机构 | 适用场景 | 起步价格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[单扇平开自动门](/zh/services/autogate/single-swing-autogate)** | 单臂直流/交流线性马达 | 排屋侧门或单扇主庭院门 | RM 2,200起 |
| **双扇平开自动门** | 双臂同步线性马达 | 标准双扇外开或内开庭院大门 | RM 3,200起 |
| **[平移自动门 (Sliding)](/zh/services/autogate/sliding-autogate)** | 地面齿轮齿条重型滑门马达 | 车位进深有限、不便扇门旋转的宽阔车道 | RM 3,800起 |
| **折叠自动门 (Folding)** | 铰接臂或无轨折叠马达 | 紧凑型车库、追求最大通行净宽的门口 | RM 2,800起 |
| **马达更换与主板维修** | 马达替换、PCB维修与轨道调校 | 现有自动门马达烧毁、齿轮磨损或主板受损 | RM 950起 |

## 专业自动门安装标准流程

1. **现场勘测与门体评估：** 测量大门跨度与重量，检查铰链轴承开合是否顺畅无阻滞，确保门体结构适合电机驱动。
2. **独立专用电源布线：** 安装 230V AC 专用电路，配置户外防水隔离闸（Isolator）与 RCBO 漏电断路器，做好接地防雷保护。
3. **主控板与备用电池配置：** 采用 IP65 等级户外防水控制箱，内置微电脑控制主板、防雷浪涌吸收器以及 12V 7AH 停电应急备用电池。
4. **红外安全防夹光电眼：** 在立柱两侧安装红外传感器，当有行人、儿童或车辆通过时自动暂停或反向开门，防止夹伤或刮蹭。
5. **无线遥控器与应急钥匙：** 标配 2 至 4 个高频无线遥控器，并附带手动离合离合钥匙，断电或故障时可一键切换手动推拉。
6. **调校与验收测试：** 设定慢速启动（Soft-Start）与缓冲减速停止（Soft-Stop），微调遇阻反弹灵敏度并进行多次开合测试。

## 常见自动门故障检修

- **[自动门无法关闭或打开](/zh/problems/autogate-not-closing)：** 红外对射探头被落叶蜘蛛网遮挡、地面轨道异物卡阻或控制板继电器触点烧蚀。
- **[遥控器按了没反应](/zh/problems/autogate-remote-not-working)：** 遥控器电池耗尽、接收机天线模块受雷击损坏或频率漂移。
- **马达异响或运行极慢：** 机械臂内置齿轮磨损、丝杆缺少润滑脂或滚轮轴承生锈。
- **大门底部刮擦地面：** 门体铰链磨损下垂或立柱倾斜，需要进行[焊接与金属加固修复](/zh/services/welding)。

## 自动门服务价格参考

| 服务项目 | 包含内容 | 价格 |
|---|---|---|
| 单扇平开自动门全套 | 1套直流臂马达、控制箱、2个遥控、红外安全光眼、备用电池、标准布线 | RM 2,200起 |
| 双扇平开自动门全套 | 2套直流臂马达、同步控制箱、2个遥控、红外安全光眼、备用电池、标准布线 | RM 3,200起 |
| 重型平移自动门全套 | 1台重型滑门马达（承重达800kg）、钢制齿条（最长16尺）、2个遥控、安全光眼 | RM 3,800起 |
| 仅更换单台马达 | 拆除旧马达、安装全新马达机芯、调整支架与接线 | RM 950起 |
| 控制主板维修/更换 | 主板电路检修、更换防雷继电器板、重新配对遥控器 | RM 350起 |

## 常见问题解答 (FAQ)

### 家里停电时自动门还能打开吗？
所有新安装的自动门系统均配备 12V 7AH 蓄电池，停电期间可支持开合约 10 至 15 次。若电池电量耗尽，只需使用随附的机械离合钥匙解锁马达，即可轻松手动推开大门。

### 为什么马来西亚的自动门控制板容易被雷击损坏？
马来西亚属于热带多雷地区，户外埋地电缆易感应高压雷电浪涌。我们在电路前端配置专用浪涌保护器，并严格做好接地系统，大幅降低主板被雷击击穿的概率。

### 现有旧铁门或木门可以直接加装自动门吗？
只要现有大门结构牢固、铰链开合没有严重下垂或卡顿，都可以直接加装。若铰链出现晃动，我们的[铁艺焊接团队](/zh/services/welding)会在装马达前先行加固。

## 预约吉隆坡与雪兰莪自动门服务

需要安装全新自动门或紧急抢修故障马达？KL Servis Rumah 服务覆盖吉隆坡、八打灵再也、梳邦再也、蒲种、莎阿南、蕉赖、安邦等全雪隆地区。

欢迎通过 WhatsApp 发送大门照片或故障视频获取即时报价 — [联系我们的自动门专家](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20autogate%20service.)。

en.title: Bathroom Waterproofing Cost & Process Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Prevent water from leaking through bathroom floors and walls into the room below. Professional bathroom & wet area waterproofing across KL & Selangor, from RM 1,000.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Bathroom Waterproofing Methods: KL Planning Guide
en.metaDesc: Prevent water leaking through bathroom floors and walls. Professional bathroom & wet area waterproofing across KL & Selangor, from RM 1,000.
en.content:
Question: How do I stop water from leaking through my bathroom floor?

Answer: Waterproofing the bathroom floor and wet-area walls with a proper membrane before tiling is the correct way to stop water from seeping to the room below. If the tiles are already down and leaking, injection grouting or targeted repair may be needed.

A leaking bathroom causes damp ceilings below, mould, and damage to cabinets and walls. KL Servis Rumah provides professional bathroom and wet area waterproofing across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, from RM 1,000.

## What Is Wet Area Waterproofing?

It is the application of a waterproofing membrane or coating to bathroom floors and wet-area walls before tiling. This creates a watertight barrier that stops water from penetrating into the slab or adjacent walls.

## Where Waterproofing Is Needed

- **Bathroom floors** — the most important wet area.
- **Bathroom walls** — around showers, tubs, and splash zones.
- **Balconies and terraces** — exposed to rain.
- **Kitchens and laundry areas** — where water is used.
- **Wet bars** — in larger homes.

## When Do You Need Waterproofing?

- **New bathroom renovation** — before tiling, waterproofing should always be applied.
- **Leaking to the floor below** — water stains or damp on the ceiling beneath.
- **Mould on bathroom walls** — persistent moisture.
- **Old waterproofing that has failed** — after many years of use.

## The Waterproofing Process

1. **Surface preparation** — the floor and walls are cleaned, and cracks are repaired.
2. **Primer** — a primer is applied to help the membrane bond.
3. **Membrane application** — a waterproofing membrane or coating is applied to the required areas, including up the walls.
4. **Sealing corners and joints** — vulnerable points are sealed with waterproof tape or sealant.
5. **Testing** — the area is checked for coverage and readiness for tiling.

The work is usually done as part of a renovation before tiling, or as a targeted repair for an existing leak.

## How Much Does Bathroom Waterproofing Cost?

Bathroom & wet area waterproofing starts from **RM 1,000**. The final cost depends on:

- The size of the bathroom
- The waterproofing method and material
- Whether existing tiles need removal
- Any necessary pipe or joint repair first

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I waterproof my bathroom without removing tiles?

If tiles are already installed and leaking, removing them is usually needed for a proper new membrane. In some cases, injection grouting can stop a specific leak without removing tiles.

### How long does the membrane last?

A properly applied waterproofing membrane lasts many years. Its lifespan depends on material quality, installation, and the amount of use.

### Should waterproofing be done before or after tiling?

Before tiling. The membrane goes on the slab and walls first, then tiles are laid over it. This creates a continuous watertight barrier.

### Do you test the waterproofing?

Yes. We check coverage, sealing of corners and joints, and prepare the area correctly for tiling. Where possible, we verify the barrier is continuous before tiles go down.

## Get a Bathroom Waterproofing Quote

Whether you are renovating a bathroom or fixing a leak to the floor below, KL Servis Rumah provides professional bathroom and wet area waterproofing across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a free assessment — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20bathroom%20waterproofing.).

ms.title: Panduan Kos & Proses: Kalis Air Bilik Air & Kawasan Basah di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Cegah air daripada bocor melalui lantai dan dinding bilik air ke bilik di bawah. Kalis air bilik air & kawasan basah profesional di seluruh KL & Selangor, dari RM 1,000.
ms.metaTitle: Kos: Kalis Air Bilik Air & Kawasan Basah di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Cegah air bocor melalui lantai dan dinding bilik air. Kalis air bilik air & kawasan basah profesional di seluruh KL & Selangor, dari RM 1,000.
ms.content:
Soalan: Bagaimana menghentikan air daripada bocor melalui lantai bilik air?

Jawapan: Mengkalis air lantai bilik air dan dinding kawasan basah dengan membran yang betul sebelum pemasangan jubin ialah cara yang betul untuk menghentikan air daripada meresap ke bilik di bawah. Jika jubin sudah dipasang dan bocor, grouting suntikan atau pembaikan bersasar mungkin diperlukan.

Bilik air bocor menyebabkan siling lembap di bawah, kulat, dan kerosakan pada kabinet dan dinding. KL Servis Rumah menyediakan kalis air bilik air dan kawasan basah profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, dari RM 1,000.

## Apa Itu Kalis Air Kawasan Basah?

Ia adalah aplikasi membran atau salutan kalis air pada lantai bilik air dan dinding kawasan basah sebelum pemasangan jubin. Ini mewujudkan penghalang kalis air yang menghentikan air daripada menembusi papak atau dinding bersebelahan.

## Di Mana Kalis Air Diperlukan

- **Lantai bilik air** — kawasan basah paling penting.
- **Dinding bilik air** — sekitar pancuran, tab, dan kawasan percikan.
- **Balkoni dan teres** — terdedah kepada hujan.
- **Dapur dan kawasan dobi** — di mana air digunakan.
- **Bar basah** — di rumah lebih besar.

## Bila Anda Perlu Kalis Air

- **Pengubahsuaian bilik air baharu** — sebelum pemasangan jubin, kalis air sentiasa perlu disapu.
- **Bocor ke lantai di bawah** — kesan air atau lembap di siling di bawah.
- **Kulat di dinding bilik air** — kelembapan berterusan.
- **Kalis air lama telah gagal** — selepas bertahun-tahun digunakan.

## Proses Kalis Air

1. **Persediaan permukaan** — lantai dan dinding dibersihkan, dan retak dibaiki.
2. **Primer** — primer disapu untuk membantu membran melekat.
3. **Aplikasi membran** — membran atau salutan kalis air disapu pada kawasan yang diperlukan, termasuk naik ke dinding.
4. **Penyekatan sudut dan sambungan** — titik terdedah disekat dengan pita atau sealant kalis air.
5. **Ujian** — kawasan diperiksa untuk liputan dan kesediaan untuk pemasangan jubin.

Kerja biasanya dilakukan sebagai sebahagian daripada pengubahsuaian sebelum pemasangan jubin, atau sebagai pembaikan bersasar untuk bocor sedia ada.

## Berapa Kos Kalis Air Bilik Air?

Kalis air bilik air & kawasan basah bermula dari **RM 1,000**. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Saiz bilik air
- Kaedah dan bahan kalis air
- Sama ada jubin sedia ada perlu dibuang
- Sebarang pembaikan paip atau sambungan yang diperlukan dahulu

## Soalan Lazim

### Bolehkah saya kalis air bilik air tanpa membuang jubin?

Jika jubin sudah dipasang dan bocor, membuangnya biasanya diperlukan untuk membran baharu yang betul. Dalam sesetengah kes, grouting suntikan boleh menghentikan bocor tertentu tanpa membuang jubin.

### Berapa lama membran bertahan?

Membran kalis air yang disapu dengan betul bertahan bertahun-tahun. Jangka hayatnya bergantung pada kualiti bahan, pemasangan, dan jumlah penggunaan.

### Patutkah kalis air dilakukan sebelum atau selepas pemasangan jubin?

Sebelum pemasangan jubin. Membran disapu pada papak dan dinding dahulu, kemudian jubin diletakkan di atasnya. Ini mewujudkan penghalang kalis air yang berterusan.

### Adakah anda menguji kalis air?

Ya. Kami memeriksa liputan, penyekatan sudut dan sambungan, dan menyediakan kawasan dengan betul untuk pemasangan jubin. Di mana boleh, kami mengesahkan penghalang berterusan sebelum jubin diletakkan.

Sama ada anda mengubah suai bilik air atau membaiki bocor ke lantai di bawah, KL Servis Rumah menyediakan kalis air bilik air dan kawasan basah profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor.
