zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪地砖铺贴：费用与流程指南（2026）
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪地砖铺贴每平方英尺RM 14起——基层准备、自流平、布局规划、正确瓷砖胶和勾缝，打造平整耐用的地面。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪地砖铺贴费用
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪专业地砖铺贴每平方英尺RM 14起——基层准备、自流平、正确瓷砖胶、勾缝与整洁收尾，KL Servis Rumah完成。
zh.content:
在吉隆坡或雪兰莪铺贴地砖，标准300×300mm至600×600mm瓷砖每平方英尺RM 14起，包含基层处理、瓷砖胶、勾缝和清洁。KL Servis Rumah 为住宅、办公室和商店铺贴通体砖、抛光砖、陶瓷砖和天然石材。

地面是家中最辛苦工作的表面。如果铺在不平整的基层上或用错瓷砖胶，瓷砖一年内就会开裂、空鼓或翘起。本指南介绍专业地砖施工包含哪些内容，以及什么影响费用。

## 地砖铺贴流程

1. **基层检查** — 施工师傅检查混凝土或旧砂浆是否平整、有无裂缝和潮气。任何明显的不平整都在铺砖前修正。
2. **找平** — 需要时浇筑自流平水泥，打造平整基底。这对大规格瓷砖最重要，因为它们连微小坡度都会显现。
3. **布局规划** — 全屋干铺规划起点和切割位置。切割放在最不显眼的边缘，并检查布局是否会出现难看的细条。
4. **涂胶** — 按瓷砖类型和尺寸选用正确瓷砖胶，用齿形刮刀施工。大而重的瓷砖可能需要背涂——地面和砖背都要上胶。
5. **铺贴** — 放置瓷砖并敲平，用十字卡保持砖缝均匀。大规格板用调平夹确保表面无高低差。
6. **养护** — 地面按瓷砖胶厂家建议时间养护后，再勾缝和通行。
7. **勾缝** — 填缝、处理砖缝并擦净。需要密封的瓷砖类型加涂密封剂。
8. **最终验收** — 逐块检查空鼓、高低差和砖缝均匀度。

## 选择合适的地砖

- **抛光砖** — 马来西亚家庭的最佳全能选择：坚硬、吸水率低，有木纹、石纹和素色等多种花色。
- **通体砖** — 颜色贯穿砖体的密实瓷砖；适合高人流区域和店铺。
- **陶瓷砖** — 卧室和低人流房间的经济之选，但比抛光砖软。
- **天然石材** — 大理石和花岗岩带来高级感，但需要密封和仔细保养。
- **大规格板（600×1200mm、800×1800mm）** — 砖缝少、外观现代无缝；需要非常平整的基层和专业操作。

**尺寸参考：** 600×600mm适合大多数房间；800×800mm及更大在开放式空间更显现代；马赛克和小砖用于特色区域，而非整屋地面。

## 什么影响费用

| 因素 | 对价格的影响 |
|---|---|
| 瓷砖尺寸和类型 | 大规格板和天然石材施工更贵 |
| 基层状况 | 不平整或开裂的基层需要先找平或修补 |
| 房间形状 | 转角越多、切割越多，人工越多 |
| 需要防水 | 湿区需要在铺砖前做防水层 |
| 拆除旧砖 | 敲除旧地面增加人工和处理成本 |

### 参考价格

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 标准地砖铺贴（300–600mm瓷砖） | 每平方英尺 RM 14 起 |
| 大规格板铺贴 | 每平方英尺 RM 26 起 |
| 自流平垫层 | 随工程报价 |
| 旧砖拆除 | 单独报价 |

## 常见问题

### 在马来西亚铺地砖多少钱？

标准瓷砖铺贴每平方英尺RM 14起。300平方英尺的客厅，人工约RM 4,200起，不含瓷砖。大规格板和天然石材更贵。

### 地砖工程需要多久？

典型客厅需要2–4天：第一天准备和找平，铺砖一到两天，然后勾缝和收尾。包含瓷砖胶和填缝剂养护时间。

### 可以在旧砖上直接铺新砖吗？

有时可以，但通常不建议。在旧砖上铺砖会抬高地面高度，可能造成门缝问题，且旧表面必须完好干净。多数情况下，拆除旧砖是更安全、更耐用的选择。

### 为什么有些地砖会空鼓？

空鼓通常意味着瓷砖胶覆盖不足或基层移动。敲击发出空洞声说明粘结已经失效。请参阅[地砖空鼓指南](/zh/problems/loose-hollow-tiles)了解处理方法。

### 你们既供砖又负责铺贴吗？

是的。我们可以提供瓷砖与铺贴一体报价，也可以铺贴您自行购买的瓷砖。如需供应，我们可以帮您挑选适合房间和预算的瓷砖。

## 预约地砖铺贴

KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地铺贴地砖，基层处理规范、使用专业系统，附12个月瓷砖粘接与填缝保修。WhatsApp联系我们获取报价——[给团队发消息](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E7%93%B7%E7%A0%96%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Frameless Shower Screen Installation in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Custom 10–12mm tempered frameless shower screens for KL & Selangor bathrooms, with drip-edge design and anti-leak seals. From RM 420 per panel.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Frameless Shower Screen Installation KL from RM 1,200
en.metaDesc: Custom frameless shower screens in KL & Selangor. 10–12mm tempered glass, concealed hinges, anti-leak seals. From RM 420/panel, 12-month warranty.
en.content:
A frameless screen is a single sheet of tempered glass held by a few brackets or hinges. There is no aluminium frame collecting mould, which is exactly why people want one — and also why the details around it (floor fall, drip edge, silicone) decide whether it stays dry.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah installs frameless shower screens from **RM 420 per panel** across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, using 10mm tempered glass for fixed panels up to about 1.5m and 12mm for doors or wider panels. Seals carry a **12-month leak-free and hardware warranty**.

If the glass is fine and only the silicone has failed, a re-seal is a smaller job — see [glass & aluminium services](/services/glass-aluminium). If water is coming through the floor rather than past the screen, that is [bathroom and wet area waterproofing](/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing).

## When a frameless screen is the right choice

- You are retiling or renovating the bathroom and can set the floor fall correctly.
- The existing shower curtain soaks the whole floor and you want the wet zone contained.
- The old framed screen is mouldy at every joint and you want fewer places for mould to live.
- You want the bathroom to look larger — frameless glass keeps the sightline open.
- You need a fixed panel only, not a door. A single fixed screen is the cheapest and most leak-resistant option.

A frameless screen is not a fix for a bathroom that already leaks downstairs. Check [bathroom leak from the upper floor](/problems/bathroom-leak-upper-floor) first.

## Frameless vs framed vs semi-frameless

| | Frameless | Semi-frameless | Framed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Glass | 10–12mm tempered | 8–10mm tempered | 6–8mm tempered |
| Look | Cleanest, most open | Middle ground | Most visible metal |
| Mould points | Fewest | Some | Most joints |
| Splash control | Good with correct drip edge | Good | Best (channels catch water) |
| Cost | Highest | Middle | Lowest |

Frameless is about appearance and cleanability. A framed screen with proper channels actually contains water more aggressively. If your bathroom is tiny, the shower head points at the opening, or the floor falls away from the drain, we will say so before you spend on frameless.

## Fixed panel, door, or door plus return?

- **Fixed panel** — one sheet, no moving parts, no hinges to sag, least likely to leak. Best value.
- **Hinged door** — needs 12mm glass, proper hinge selection and door swing clearance. Water tends to escape at the hinge side if the fall is wrong.
- **Door plus return panel** — full enclosure feel, more silicone joints, more cost.

## What the RM 420 start includes

- Site measurement of the opening, floor fall and drain position.
- 10mm tempered safety glass, factory cut and edge-polished, per fixed panel.
- Brackets or channel fixing, setting blocks and structural silicone.
- Drip-edge detail and sanitary-grade mould-resistant silicone.
- Alignment and a water test before handover.
- 12-month warranty on seals and hardware we supply.

12mm glass, hinged doors, hardware upgrades, notched cuts around tiles and any tile drilling into difficult substrates are itemised on the quote.

## How we install it

1. **Measure** the opening, and check floor slope, drain position, tile joints and the wall build-up behind the tile.
2. **Confirm the design** — glass thickness, fixing type, door swing, drip-edge position — in an itemised quote.
3. **Fabricate** — glass is cut, tempered and polished. Typically 5–7 working days. It cannot be trimmed after tempering.
4. **Install** — mark and drill carefully to avoid hidden pipes, fit brackets, seat the glass on setting blocks, and never force a panel into an out-of-square opening.
5. **Seal and test** — apply sanitary silicone, cure, then run the shower and check where water actually goes.

## Cost

| Item | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Frameless shower screen | From RM 420 / panel |
| Wall mirror installation | From RM 320 |
| Glass office partition | From RM 220 / sq ft |
| Glass replacement (existing window) | From RM 200 |

Price moves with glass thickness, panel size, hinge and bracket grade, notches and access. Condominium jobs sometimes need lift protection or management approval for material movement, which we confirm before scheduling.

## Why frameless screens leak (and how we prevent it)

Most "leaking" frameless screens are not failed glass. The usual causes:

- **Floor falls the wrong way.** Water runs out of the shower zone regardless of the glass. This must be fixed with tiling, not glass.
- **No drip edge.** Water follows the underside of the glass and drops on the dry side.
- **Gap set too tight or too wide** at the door. Both push water outwards.
- **Wrong silicone.** General-purpose silicone goes black and peels in a Malaysian bathroom.
- **Shower head aimed at the opening.** Simple to change, often overlooked.

We check all five during measurement, because the glass is rarely the problem.

## Common mistakes

- Buying a "standard size" screen online for a non-standard bathroom.
- Choosing 8mm for a hinged door to save cost, then dealing with flex and hinge stress.
- Drilling into tile without locating pipes behind it.
- Sealing both sides of the bottom edge, trapping water inside the joint instead of letting it drain back into the shower.
- Using the new screen as the fix for a leak that is actually coming from the floor membrane.

## Frequently asked questions

### 10mm or 12mm — which do I need?

10mm is enough for a single fixed panel up to about 1.5m wide. Frameless doors and wider panels should be 12mm. We confirm after measurement.

### Can you fit a screen on existing tiles?

Yes, if the tiles and wall behind them are sound. We check for hollow tiles, stud positions and hidden pipework before drilling. If tiles are already drummy, see [loose and hollow tiles](/problems/loose-hollow-tiles).

### Will a frameless screen keep the floor completely dry?

No screen makes a bathroom splash-proof. A correct drip edge, gap and silicone control normal splashing. If the floor fall is wrong, no glass will fix it.

### How long from measurement to installation?

Typically 5–7 working days for glass fabrication, then a single visit to install, subject to access and bathroom condition.

### Can you replace only the glass on my old frameless screen?

Often yes, if the brackets are still sound and the sizes are standard. We measure the existing panel and bracket positions before quoting.

## Book a shower screen measurement

If you are retiling, replacing a mouldy framed screen, or fitting a screen for the first time, KL Servis Rumah measures and installs across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp a photo of the bathroom with the drain visible — [request a shower screen quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20a%20frameless%20shower%20screen%20quote.).

ms.title: Pemasangan Skrin Pancuran Tanpa Bingkai di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai kaca tempered 10–12mm dipotong ikut bilik mandi anda, dengan drip-edge dan pengedap anti-bocor. Dari RM 420 / panel.
ms.metaTitle: Skrin Pancuran Tanpa Bingkai KL dari RM 1,200
ms.metaDesc: Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai custom di KL & Selangor. Kaca tempered 10–12mm, engsel tersembunyi, pengedap anti-bocor. Dari RM 420/panel.
ms.content:
Skrin tanpa bingkai ialah satu kepingan kaca tempered yang dipegang beberapa bracket atau engsel sahaja. Tiada bingkai aluminium untuk kulat berkumpul — itulah tarikannya. Tetapi ia juga bermakna butiran di sekelilingnya (cerun lantai, drip-edge, silikon) yang menentukan sama ada lantai kekal kering.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah memasang skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai dari **RM 420 / panel** di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, menggunakan kaca tempered 10mm untuk panel tetap sehingga kira-kira 1.5m dan 12mm untuk pintu atau panel lebih lebar. Pengedap dilindungi **jaminan bebas bocor dan perkakasan 12 bulan**.

Jika kaca masih elok dan hanya silikon rosak, kerja seal semula lebih kecil — lihat [perkhidmatan kaca & aluminium](/ms/services/glass-aluminium). Jika air menembusi lantai dan bukan melepasi skrin, itu kerja [kalis air bilik mandi](/ms/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing).

## Bila skrin tanpa bingkai pilihan yang betul

- Anda sedang menjubin semula atau mengubah suai bilik mandi dan boleh betulkan cerun lantai.
- Langsir mandi membasahi seluruh lantai dan anda mahu zon basah dikawal.
- Skrin berbingkai lama berkulat di setiap sambungan.
- Anda mahu bilik mandi nampak lebih luas.
- Anda hanya perlukan panel tetap, bukan pintu — pilihan paling jimat dan paling tahan bocor.

Skrin tanpa bingkai bukan penyelesaian untuk bilik mandi yang sudah bocor ke tingkat bawah. Semak dahulu [bocor bilik mandi dari tingkat atas](/ms/problems/bathroom-leak-upper-floor).

## Tanpa bingkai, separa berbingkai atau berbingkai?

| | Tanpa bingkai | Separa berbingkai | Berbingkai |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kaca | Tempered 10–12mm | Tempered 8–10mm | Tempered 6–8mm |
| Rupa | Paling bersih dan terbuka | Pertengahan | Paling banyak logam |
| Titik kulat | Paling sedikit | Sederhana | Paling banyak sambungan |
| Kawalan percikan | Baik jika drip-edge betul | Baik | Paling ketat |
| Kos | Paling tinggi | Sederhana | Paling rendah |

Skrin berbingkai dengan channel sebenarnya menahan air lebih agresif. Jika bilik mandi anda kecil atau cerun lantai bermasalah, kami akan beritahu sebelum anda belanja untuk frameless.

## Panel tetap, pintu, atau pintu dengan return

- **Panel tetap** — satu kepingan, tiada bahagian bergerak, paling kurang risiko bocor.
- **Pintu berengsel** — perlukan kaca 12mm, engsel sesuai dan ruang ayunan yang cukup.
- **Pintu dan panel return** — rasa enclosure penuh, lebih banyak sambungan silikon, lebih mahal.

## Apa yang termasuk pada harga RM 420

- Ukuran bukaan, cerun lantai dan kedudukan saliran.
- Kaca keselamatan tempered 10mm, dipotong dan digilap kilang, bagi setiap panel tetap.
- Bracket atau channel, setting block dan silikon struktur.
- Butiran drip-edge dan silikon sanitari tahan kulat.
- Penjajaran dan ujian air sebelum serahan.
- Jaminan 12 bulan pada pengedap dan perkakasan yang kami bekalkan.

Kaca 12mm, pintu berengsel, naik taraf perkakasan dan potongan khas dinyatakan berasingan dalam sebut harga.

## Cara kami memasang

1. **Ukur** bukaan dan semak cerun lantai, kedudukan saliran, sambungan jubin serta binaan dinding di belakang jubin.
2. **Sahkan reka bentuk** — ketebalan kaca, jenis pengikat, arah pintu, kedudukan drip-edge.
3. **Fabrikasi** — kaca dipotong, ditemper dan digilap. Lazimnya 5–7 hari bekerja. Tidak boleh dipotong selepas ditemper.
4. **Pasang** — tanda dan gerudi berhati-hati untuk elak paip tersembunyi, pasang bracket, dudukkan kaca atas setting block.
5. **Seal dan uji** — silikon sanitari, biarkan kering, kemudian buka pancuran dan perhatikan ke mana air sebenarnya pergi.

## Kos

| Item | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai | Dari RM 420 / panel |
| Pemasangan cermin dinding | Dari RM 320 |
| Partition pejabat kaca | Dari RM 220 / kaki persegi |
| Penggantian kaca (tingkap sedia ada) | Dari RM 200 |

## Kenapa skrin frameless bocor

Kebanyakan aduan bocor bukan disebabkan kaca:

- **Cerun lantai salah** — air keluar dari zon pancuran tanpa mengira kaca. Ini kerja jubin, bukan kaca.
- **Tiada drip-edge** — air menyusur bawah kaca dan menitis di sisi kering.
- **Jurang pintu terlalu rapat atau terlalu lebar** — kedua-duanya menolak air keluar.
- **Silikon salah jenis** — silikon serba guna cepat hitam dan tertanggal.
- **Kepala pancuran menghala ke bukaan** — mudah diubah, kerap terlepas pandang.

## Kesilapan biasa

- Membeli skrin "saiz standard" dalam talian untuk bilik mandi yang tidak standard.
- Memilih 8mm untuk pintu berengsel demi jimat, kemudian menghadapi lenturan.
- Menggerudi jubin tanpa mengesan paip di belakang.
- Menutup silikon pada kedua-dua belah tepi bawah, memerangkap air dalam sambungan.

## Soalan lazim

### 10mm atau 12mm?

10mm memadai untuk panel tetap tunggal sehingga kira-kira 1.5m lebar. Pintu tanpa bingkai dan panel lebih lebar sepatutnya 12mm.

### Boleh pasang atas jubin sedia ada?

Boleh, jika jubin dan dinding kukuh. Kami semak jubin berongga, kedudukan stud dan paip tersembunyi sebelum menggerudi. Jika jubin sudah berongga, lihat [jubin longgar dan berongga](/ms/problems/loose-hollow-tiles).

### Adakah lantai akan kekal kering sepenuhnya?

Tiada skrin menjadikan bilik mandi kalis percikan sepenuhnya. Drip-edge, jurang dan silikon yang betul mengawal percikan biasa.

### Berapa lama dari ukuran ke pemasangan?

Lazimnya 5–7 hari bekerja untuk fabrikasi kaca, kemudian satu lawatan pemasangan.

## Tempah ukuran skrin pancuran

WhatsApp foto bilik mandi dengan saliran kelihatan — [minta sebut harga skrin pancuran](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20skrin%20pancuran%20tanpa%20bingkai.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪无框淋浴屏安装
zh.excerpt: 按浴室尺寸定制的 10–12mm 钢化无框淋浴屏，配滴水边设计与防霉密封。每片 RM 420 起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪无框淋浴屏安装
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪定制无框淋浴屏。10–12mm 钢化玻璃、隐藏铰链、防漏密封。每片 RM 420 起，12 个月保修。
zh.content:
无框淋浴屏就是一整片钢化玻璃，仅由几个夹码或铰链固定。没有铝框积霉，这正是大家想要它的原因；但也因此，周边细节——地面坡度、滴水边、硅胶——才是决定地板干不干的关键。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪安装无框淋浴屏，**每片 RM 420** 起。1.5 米以内的固定屏用 10mm 钢化玻璃，门扇或更宽面板用 12mm。密封享 **12 个月防漏与五金保修**。

若玻璃完好、只是硅胶老化，重新打胶是更小的工程 — 见 [玻璃与铝业工程](/zh/services/glass-aluminium)。若水是从地面渗下去而不是越过屏体，那属于 [浴室防水](/zh/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing)。

## 什么情况适合做无框淋浴屏

- 正在重铺瓷砖或翻新浴室，可以把地面坡度做对。
- 浴帘挡不住水，整个地板都湿。
- 旧有框淋浴屏每条接缝都发霉。
- 希望浴室视觉上更通透。
- 只需要一片固定屏，不需要门扇——最省钱也最不容易漏。

如果楼下天花已经渗水，装淋浴屏解决不了问题。先看 [楼上浴室漏水](/zh/problems/bathroom-leak-upper-floor)。

## 无框、半框与有框对比

| | 无框 | 半框 | 有框 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 玻璃 | 10–12mm 钢化 | 8–10mm 钢化 | 6–8mm 钢化 |
| 外观 | 最通透 | 折中 | 金属边最明显 |
| 发霉点 | 最少 | 中等 | 接缝最多 |
| 挡水 | 滴水边做对就够用 | 良好 | 最强（有导水槽） |
| 价格 | 最高 | 中等 | 最低 |

无框主打观感与易清洁。真要挡水，有导水槽的有框屏其实更狠。浴室很小、花洒正对开口、或地面坡度反向时，我们会先说明再决定。

## 固定屏、门扇，还是门加侧屏

- **固定屏** — 一整片，无活动件，无铰链下垂，最不易漏，性价比最高。
- **铰链门** — 需要 12mm 玻璃、合适铰链与开门空间。坡度不对时，铰链侧最容易跑水。
- **门加返回侧屏** — 接近全封闭，硅胶接缝更多，造价更高。

## RM 420 起价包含什么

- 现场测量洞口、地面坡度与地漏位置。
- 每片固定屏的 10mm 钢化安全玻璃，工厂裁切磨边。
- 夹码或卡槽固定件、垫块与结构胶。
- 滴水边处理与防霉卫浴硅胶。
- 交付前的校正与试水。
- 我方提供的密封与五金享 12 个月保修。

12mm 玻璃、铰链门、五金升级、异形开孔与难钻基面会在报价中另列。

## 安装步骤

1. **量尺**：测量洞口，检查地面坡度、地漏位置、瓷砖接缝与墙体构造。
2. **确认设计**：玻璃厚度、固定方式、开门方向、滴水边位置，逐项写入报价。
3. **工厂制作**：裁切、钢化、磨边，通常 5–7 个工作日。钢化后不可再切。
4. **现场安装**：放线钻孔避开暗管，安装夹码，玻璃放在垫块上就位，绝不硬塞进不方正的洞口。
5. **打胶试水**：打卫浴硅胶，待固化后开花洒，实际观察水往哪里流。

## 费用

| 项目 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 无框淋浴屏 | 每片 RM 420 起 |
| 墙镜安装 | RM 320 起 |
| 玻璃办公隔断 | 每平方英尺 RM 220 起 |
| 玻璃更换（现有窗） | RM 200 起 |

## 无框淋浴屏为什么会漏

多数“漏水”与玻璃本身无关：

- **地面坡度反向** — 水自己往外流，换什么玻璃都没用，这要靠瓷砖处理。
- **没有滴水边** — 水顺玻璃底面爬行，滴在干区。
- **门缝过紧或过宽** — 两种都会把水往外挤。
- **硅胶选错** — 普通玻璃胶在马来西亚浴室很快发黑脱落。
- **花洒正对开口** — 改个角度就好，却常被忽略。

## 常见错误

- 为不标准的浴室在网上买“标准尺寸”淋浴屏。
- 为省钱在铰链门上用 8mm 玻璃，长期晃动。
- 钻瓷砖前不探测墙内水管。
- 底边两侧都打满胶，把水封在接缝里，反而排不回淋浴区。

## 常见问题

### 该用 10mm 还是 12mm？

宽度约 1.5 米以内的单块固定屏用 10mm 即可；无框门与更宽面板建议 12mm。量尺后确认。

### 现有瓷砖上可以装吗？

可以，前提是瓷砖与基层稳固。钻孔前会检查空鼓、龙骨位置与暗管。若瓷砖已空鼓，见 [瓷砖空鼓松动](/zh/problems/loose-hollow-tiles)。

### 装了之后地板会完全干吗？

没有任何淋浴屏能做到完全不溅水。正确的滴水边、缝隙与硅胶可以控制正常溅水。

### 量尺到安装要多久？

玻璃制作一般 5–7 个工作日，之后一次上门完成安装。

## 预约淋浴屏量尺

WhatsApp 发一张能看到地漏的浴室照片 — [索取淋浴屏报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我需要无框淋浴屏报价。).

en.title: Full Condo Re-Skim Package Cost Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: A full re-skim creates a consistent paint-ready surface when many walls are rough, patched or visibly uneven. The survey should separate areas needing only local repair from walls that justify full coating, while accounting for occupied-unit protection and condominium work rules.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Full Condo Re-Skim Package Cost Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Guide to full condo re-skim package in kl & selangor: suitability, site checks, installation steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for properties in KL and Selangor.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** A full re-skim creates a consistent paint-ready surface when many walls are rough, patched or visibly uneven. The survey should separate areas needing only local repair from walls that justify full coating, while accounting for occupied-unit protection and condominium work rules.

The assessment checks the substrate, moisture or movement, edge details and access before the repair method is agreed. This article explains the [Planning a Full Condo Wall Re-Skim](/services/skim-coat/full-condo-re-skim-package) scope under [skim coat services](/services/skim-coat), with a published starting price of **RM 4,200**.

## What Must Be Checked First

### Existing condition
Identify weak, loose, wet or contaminated areas rather than covering them.

### Interfaces
Check doors, drains, joints, walls, fittings and adjacent finishes.

### Materials
Match the repair system to the substrate and intended use.

### Access and protection
Plan dust control, curing time and protection of occupied areas.


## Practical Planning Notes

A quotation should define the measured work area or number of points, the preparation included, who supplies the finish product or equipment, and how concealed defects will be handled. Product names alone are not a complete specification: model, dimensions, colour or output, compatible accessories and installation method all affect the result. For **full condo re-skim package in kl & selangor**, the survey should record existing condition, interfaces, materials, and access and protection.

Sequence matters when several trades share the area. Complete leak repairs and wet work before sensitive finishes; coordinate framing, wiring, pipework and access panels before surfaces are closed; and protect completed work from following trades. A sample, layout drawing or one-point trial is useful when appearance, alignment, brightness, texture or control behaviour cannot be judged from a catalogue.

The handover should be functional, not visual only. The installer should inspect fixing or adhesion, edges and penetrations, operation under normal use, and any serviceable components. Keep the product model, colour or batch reference and care instructions. These records make future replacement or local repair more accurate.


## How the Work Is Carried Out

1. **Inspect** — Mark affected areas and identify the underlying cause.. Record the finding before materials are ordered.

2. **Prepare** — Remove unsound material and create a clean, stable substrate.. Protect adjacent finishes and keep the work area controlled.

3. **Repair** — Apply the specified compatible system at the required thickness.. Check alignment, coverage, support or connections as the work progresses.

4. **Finish** — Align edges, smooth or texture the surface as the design requires.. Do not conceal the stage until the responsible person has inspected it.

5. **Cure and inspect** — Keep traffic off until ready, then check adhesion and finish.. Test under normal use and record any care or cure-time restriction.


## Choosing the Right Approach

| Option | When it fits |
|---|---|

| Local repair | Suitable when damage is isolated and the surrounding finish remains sound. |

| Full treatment | Better when defects are widespread or a consistent new finish is required. |

| Investigate first | Necessary when moisture, structural movement or repeated failure is present. |


## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Covering a defect before stopping its cause.

- Skipping removal of loose or contaminated material.

- Using one product for every substrate and crack type.

- Rushing curing or reopening the area to traffic too early.


Do not bypass structural, electrical, waterproofing or product requirements to save preparation time. Stop work if hidden moisture, unsafe wiring, weak support or moving cracks are discovered; diagnose these conditions before covering them.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 4,200**
- **Published workmanship cover: 12-Month Smoothness & Adhesion Warranty**, subject to the published terms.

The final quotation depends on site condition, quantity or area, access, materials, preparation and any related repair identified during inspection. A starting rate is not a fixed total for every property.

For homes and commercial properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, access rules, working hours, lift protection and management approval can affect scheduling. Confirm these requirements before materials and labour are booked.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Can the work be limited to one area?
Yes when damage is genuinely isolated, although colour or texture matching may remain visible.


### How long before the area can be used?
It depends on the product, thickness and site conditions. Follow the stated cure window, not only whether the surface feels dry.


### Will the defect return?
A repair lasts only when its cause, substrate and movement are properly addressed. Active leaks or movement must be solved first.


## Get a Site-Specific Quotation

Send clear close-up and wide-angle photos so the affected area and surrounding conditions can be assessed. KL Servis Rumah can inspect the conditions and explain the suitable scope before work begins.

ms.excerpt: Skim semula penuh menghasilkan permukaan sekata sedia cat apabila banyak dinding kasar, bertampal atau tidak rata. Tinjauan perlu membezakan pembaikan setempat daripada dinding yang benar-benar perlu disalut penuh serta mengambil kira perlindungan unit dan peraturan kondominium.
ms.metaTitle: Kos: Pakej Skim Semula Kondominium di KL | KL Servis Rumah
ms.metaDesc: Panduan pakej skim semula kondominium di kl: semakan tapak, proses pemasangan, kesilapan lazim dan faktor sebut harga untuk rumah di KL dan Selangor.
ms.content:
**Jawapan ringkas:** Skim semula penuh menghasilkan permukaan sekata sedia cat apabila banyak dinding kasar, bertampal atau tidak rata. Tinjauan perlu membezakan pembaikan setempat daripada dinding yang benar-benar perlu disalut penuh serta mengambil kira perlindungan unit dan peraturan kondominium.

Penilaian menyemak substrat, lembapan atau pergerakan, perincian tepi dan akses sebelum kaedah dipersetujui. Artikel ini menerangkan skop [Merancang Skim Semula Dinding Seluruh Kondominium](/ms/services/skim-coat/full-condo-re-skim-package) di bawah [perkhidmatan skim coat](/ms/services/skim-coat), dengan harga permulaan diterbitkan **RM 4,200**.

## Perkara yang Mesti Disemak Dahulu

### Keadaan sedia ada
Kenal pasti kawasan lemah, longgar, basah atau tercemar, bukan menutupnya.

### Pertemuan bahan
Semak pintu, drain, joint, dinding, kelengkapan dan kemasan bersebelahan.

### Bahan
Padankan sistem pembaikan dengan substrat dan kegunaan.

### Akses dan perlindungan
Rancang kawalan habuk, masa matang dan perlindungan ruang dihuni.


## Nota Perancangan Praktikal

Sebut harga perlu menyatakan keluasan atau bilangan titik, persediaan yang termasuk, pihak yang membekalkan produk atau peralatan dan cara kecacatan tersembunyi diurus. Nama produk sahaja bukan spesifikasi lengkap: model, dimensi, warna atau output, aksesori serasi dan kaedah pemasangan mempengaruhi hasil. Untuk **pakej skim semula kondominium di kl**, tinjauan patut merekod keadaan sedia ada, pertemuan bahan, bahan, dan akses dan perlindungan.

Urutan kerja penting apabila beberapa tukang berkongsi ruang. Selesaikan kebocoran dan kerja basah sebelum kemasan sensitif; selaras rangka, pendawaian, paip dan panel akses sebelum permukaan ditutup; dan lindungi kerja siap daripada kerja seterusnya. Sampel, lukisan susun atur atau percubaan satu titik berguna apabila rupa, penjajaran, kecerahan, tekstur atau kawalan tidak boleh dinilai daripada katalog.

Serahan perlu menguji fungsi, bukan rupa sahaja. Periksa pengikat atau lekatan, tepi dan penembusan, operasi penggunaan biasa serta komponen yang perlu diservis. Simpan model produk, rujukan warna atau kelompok dan arahan penjagaan supaya penggantian atau pembaikan setempat pada masa depan lebih tepat.


## Cara Kerja Dilaksanakan

1. **Periksa** — Tanda kawasan terjejas dan kenal pasti punca.. Rekod dapatan sebelum bahan ditempah.

2. **Sedia** — Buang bahan tidak kukuh dan hasilkan substrat stabil.. Lindungi kemasan bersebelahan dan kawal kawasan kerja.

3. **Baiki** — Gunakan sistem serasi pada ketebalan diperlukan.. Semak penjajaran, liputan, sokongan atau sambungan ketika kerja berjalan.

4. **Kemaskan** — Selaraskan tepi dan kemasan mengikut reka bentuk.. Jangan tutup peringkat ini sebelum ia diperiksa.

5. **Matang dan periksa** — Halang trafik sehingga sedia, kemudian semak lekatan.. Uji dalam penggunaan biasa dan rekod sekatan penjagaan atau masa matang.


## Memilih Pendekatan yang Betul

| Pilihan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|

| Pembaikan setempat | Sesuai apabila kerosakan terpencil dan sekeliling masih kukuh. |

| Rawatan penuh | Lebih baik apabila kecacatan meluas atau kemasan seragam diperlukan. |

| Siasat dahulu | Perlu apabila ada lembapan, pergerakan struktur atau kegagalan berulang. |


## Kesilapan Lazim yang Perlu Dielakkan

- Menutup kecacatan sebelum menghentikan punca.

- Tidak membuang bahan longgar atau tercemar.

- Menggunakan satu produk untuk semua substrat dan retak.

- Mempercepat masa matang atau membuka trafik terlalu awal.


Jangan abaikan keperluan struktur, elektrik, kalis air atau produk untuk menjimatkan masa persediaan. Hentikan kerja jika ditemui lembapan tersembunyi, pendawaian tidak selamat, sokongan lemah atau retak bergerak; diagnosis sebelum menutupnya.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 4,200**
- **Perlindungan mutu kerja diterbitkan: Jaminan Kelicinan & Lekatan 12 Bulan**，tertakluk pada terma diterbitkan.

Sebut harga akhir bergantung pada keadaan tapak, kuantiti atau keluasan, akses, bahan, persediaan dan pembaikan berkaitan yang dikenal pasti. Kadar permulaan bukan jumlah tetap bagi setiap hartanah.

Bagi rumah dan premis komersial di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, peraturan akses, waktu kerja, perlindungan lif dan kelulusan pengurusan boleh mempengaruhi jadual. Sahkan keperluan ini sebelum bahan dan tenaga kerja ditempah.

## Soalan Lazim


### Bolehkah baiki satu kawasan sahaja?
Boleh jika kerosakan benar-benar terpencil, tetapi padanan warna atau tekstur mungkin kelihatan.


### Berapa lama sebelum boleh digunakan?
Bergantung pada produk, ketebalan dan keadaan tapak. Ikut tempoh matang, bukan sekadar permukaan terasa kering.


### Adakah kecacatan akan kembali?
Pembaikan tahan apabila punca, substrat dan pergerakan ditangani. Kebocoran atau pergerakan aktif mesti diselesaikan dahulu.


## Dapatkan Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar gambar dekat dan sudut luas supaya kawasan serta keadaan sekeliling boleh dinilai. KL Servis Rumah boleh memeriksa keadaan dan menerangkan skop sesuai sebelum kerja bermula.

zh.title: 吉隆坡公寓全屋重新批灰：费用与流程指南（2026）
zh.excerpt: 当多面墙粗糙、补丁明显或不平时，全屋重新批灰可形成一致的待漆基层。勘察应区分局部修补与真正需要整面施工的墙，同时考虑住户物品保护和公寓施工规定。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡公寓全屋重新批灰服务指南
zh.metaDesc: 了解规划公寓全屋墙面重新批灰：施工前检查、正确流程、方案比较、常见错误和报价因素，适用于吉隆坡与雪兰莪住宅及商业场所。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**当多面墙粗糙、补丁明显或不平时，全屋重新批灰可形成一致的待漆基层。勘察应区分局部修补与真正需要整面施工的墙，同时考虑住户物品保护和公寓施工规定。

确定方案前，应检查基层、潮气或位移、边缘细节和施工通道。本文说明[规划公寓全屋墙面重新批灰](/zh/services/skim-coat/full-condo-re-skim-package)子服务；它属于[批灰服务](/zh/services/skim-coat)，已公布起价为 **RM 4,200**。

## 施工前必须检查什么

### 现有状况
找出薄弱、松动、潮湿或污染范围，不能直接覆盖。

### 交接位置
检查门口、排水口、接缝、墙体、设备和相邻饰面。

### 材料
修复系统要匹配基层和实际用途。

### 通道与保护
规划粉尘控制、养护时间和已入住空间保护。


## 实用规划要点

报价应列明实测面积或点位数量、包含哪些基层准备、成品或设备由谁提供，以及发现隐藏缺陷时如何处理。只有产品名称并不构成完整规格；型号、尺寸、颜色或输出、兼容配件和安装方法都会影响结果。针对**吉隆坡公寓全屋重新批灰**，勘察记录应包括现有状况、交接位置、材料、通道与保护。

多个工种共用区域时，施工顺序很重要。漏水和湿作业应在敏感饰面之前完成；封闭表面前要协调骨架、线路、管路和检修口；完工面也要防止被后续工序损坏。如外观、对齐、亮度、纹理或控制效果无法从目录判断，应先制作样板、排版图或试装一个点位。

交付不能只看外观，还要检查固定或粘结、边缘与穿孔、正常使用下的功能，以及可维修部件。保存产品型号、颜色或批次编号和保养说明，有助于日后准确更换或局部维修。


## 标准施工步骤

1. **检查** — 标出受影响范围并找出根本原因。. 订购材料前记录勘察结果。

2. **基层处理** — 清除不牢材料，形成清洁稳定基层。. 保护相邻饰面并控制施工区域。

3. **修复** — 以规定厚度施工兼容系统。. 施工期间同步检查对齐、覆盖、支撑或连接。

4. **收面** — 按设计调整边缘、平整度或纹理。. 负责人检查前不要封闭这一工序。

5. **养护验收** — 养护完成前禁止通行，之后检查粘结与外观。. 按正常使用方式测试，并记录保养或养护限制。


## 如何选择合适方案

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|

| 局部维修 | 损坏确实集中且周围饰面仍牢固时适用。 |

| 整体处理 | 缺陷分布广或需要一致新表面时更合适。 |

| 先调查 | 存在潮气、结构位移或反复失效时必须先查原因。 |


## 应避免的常见错误

- 没有解决原因就把缺陷盖住。

- 跳过松动物或污染层的清除。

- 所有基层和裂缝都使用同一种产品。

- 缩短养护时间或过早恢复通行。


不要为了缩短准备时间而绕过结构、电气、防水或产品要求。如发现隐藏潮气、不安全线路、薄弱支撑或活动裂缝，应暂停并先诊断，不能直接覆盖。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价: RM 4,200**
- **已公布工艺保障: 12 个月平整度与粘结保修**（按已公布条款执行）。

最终报价取决于现场状况、数量或面积、施工通道、材料、基层处理，以及检查发现的相关维修。起价并不代表每个物业的固定总价。

吉隆坡与雪兰莪的住宅及商业场所可能有进场时段、电梯保护、施工时间和管理处批准要求，这些都会影响排期。预订材料和人手前应先确认。

## 常见问题


### 能只修一个区域吗？
如损坏确实局部，可以；但新旧颜色或纹理可能仍看得出。


### 多久后可以使用？
取决于产品、厚度和现场条件。应遵守养护时间，而不是只看表面是否干。


### 问题会再出现吗？
只有原因、基层和位移都妥善处理，修复才耐久；活动漏水或位移必须先解决。


## 获取针对现场的报价

发送清晰近照和广角照片，以便同时判断损坏范围和周围状况。 KL Servis Rumah 可在动工前检查现场并说明合适范围。

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92%E5%85%AC%E5%AF%93%E5%85%A8%E5%B1%8B%E5%A2%99%E9%9D%A2%E9%87%8D%E6%96%B0%E6%89%B9%E7%81%B0%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.metaDesc: Complete full house renovation in KL & Selangor — structural, finishes, plumbing, electrical, tiling, painting and cabinetry coordinated under one contract, from RM 22,000.
en.content:
A full house renovation is a large project that touches every part of your home — structure, plumbing, electrical, tiling, painting, and cabinetry. KL Servis Rumah provides coordinated full house renovation packages across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, from RM 22,000.

This guide explains what a full house renovation package includes and what to consider before you start.

## What a Full House Renovation Includes

A complete renovation package typically covers:

- **Planning and design** — scoping the work and layout.
- **Demolition and preparation** — removing old finishes and preparing surfaces.
- **Structural work** — walls, partitions, and openings as required.
- **Plumbing** — relocating or replacing pipes and fixtures.
- **Electrical** — wiring, points, and lighting.
- **Tiling and flooring** — floors and walls.
- **Painting** — interior finishes.
- **Cabinetry and carpentry** — kitchen, wardrobes, and built-ins.

## Key Considerations

- **Budget** — a full renovation is a major investment; define your budget clearly.
- **Timeline** — plan for a realistic duration, with allowances for contingencies.
- **Design** — decide on the layout and style before work begins to avoid changes.
- **Approvals** — check strata or authority requirements where relevant.
- **Coordination** — one responsible contractor coordinating all trades avoids delays.

## The Renovation Process

1. **Consultation and scope** — we discuss your goals, budget, and timeline.
2. **Site assessment** — we inspect the property and identify what is needed.
3. **Itemised quote** — you receive a detailed quote covering the works.
4. **Preparation** — approvals, materials, and scheduling are arranged.
5. **Execution** — the renovation is carried out by coordinated trades.
6. **Handover** — a final inspection and handover with you.

## How Much Does a Full Renovation Cost?

A full house renovation package starts from **RM 22,000**. The final cost depends on:

- Property size and number of rooms
- Scope of structural work
- Quality of finishes and fixtures
- Whether plumbing and electrical are being replaced

You receive a realistic quote after assessment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long does a full house renovation take?

It depends on the scope and size. A typical full renovation takes several weeks to a few months. We provide a timeline with your quote.

### Do I need to move out during renovation?

Often yes, for a full renovation. We will advise based on the scope — some projects can be done in stages with you staying.

### Can you work within a fixed budget?

Yes. We itemise the quote so you can adjust the scope to fit your budget before work begins.

### Do you handle design and approvals?

We help with scoping and design coordination and advise on approvals (including strata requirements for condos).

## Get a Full House Renovation Quote

If you are planning a full house renovation, get a clear, itemised quote before you commit. KL Servis Rumah provides coordinated renovation services across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a consultation — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20a%20full%20house%20renovation.).

- **Perobohan dan persediaan** — membuang kemasan lama dan menyediakan permukaan.
- **Kerja struktur** — dinding, sekatan, dan bukaan seperti diperlukan.
- **Paip** — memindahkan atau menggantikan paip dan kelengkapan.
- **Elektrik** — pendawaian, titik, dan lampu.
- **Jubin dan lantai** — lantai dan dinding.
- **Cat** — kemasan dalaman.
- **Kabinet dan pertukangan** — dapur, wardrobe, dan binaan dalam.

- **Bajet** — pengubahsuaian penuh ialah pelaburan besar; tentukan bajet dengan jelas.
- **Garis masa** — rancang tempoh yang realistik, dengan elaun untuk kontingensi.
- **Reka bentuk** — putuskan susun atur dan gaya sebelum kerja bermula untuk mengelakkan perubahan.
- **Kelulusan** — semak keperluan strata atau pihak berkuasa di mana berkaitan.
- **Koordinasi** — satu kontraktor bertanggungjawab menyelaras semua juruteknik mengelakkan kelewatan.

## Proses Pengubahsuaian

1. **Konsultasi dan skop** — kami membincangkan matlamat, bajet, dan garis masa anda.
2. **Penilaian tapak** — kami memeriksa hartanah dan mengenal pasti apa yang diperlukan.
3. **Sebut harga terperinci** — anda menerima sebut harga terperinci meliputi kerja.
4. **Persediaan** — kelulusan, bahan, dan penjadualan diuruskan.
5. **Pelaksanaan** — pengubahsuaian dijalankan oleh juruteknik yang diselaras.
6. **Serahan** — pemeriksaan akhir dan serahan dengan anda.

## Berapa Kos Pengubahsuaian Penuh?

Pakej pengubahsuaian rumah penuh bermula dari **RM 22,000**. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Saiz hartanah dan bilangan bilik
- Skop kerja struktur
- Kualiti kemasan dan kelengkapan
- Sama ada paip dan elektrik diganti

Anda menerima sebut harga yang realistik selepas penilaian.

## Soalan Lazim

Ia bergantung pada skop dan saiz. Pengubahsuaian penuh biasa mengambil beberapa minggu hingga beberapa bulan. Kami menyediakan garis masa dengan sebut harga anda.

Selalunya ya, untuk pengubahsuaian penuh. Kami akan menasihatkan berdasarkan skop — sesetengah projek boleh dilakukan secara berperingkat dengan anda tinggal.

### Bolehkah anda bekerja dalam bajet tetap?

Ya. Kami memperincikan sebut harga supaya anda boleh melaraskan skop untuk memenuhi bajet sebelum kerja bermula.

### Adakah anda mengendalikan reka bentuk dan kelulusan?

Kami membantu dengan skop dan koordinasi reka bentuk serta menasihatkan tentang kelulusan (termasuk keperluan strata untuk kondominium).

en.title: Full Torch-On Membrane Waterproofing in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Torch-on waterproofing is a heat-bonded bituminous membrane for flat concrete roofs. It is suitable when the slab and falls are stable, outlets work and the substrate can be safely prepared; it should not be used to hide active structural movement or trapped moisture.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Torch-On Membrane Waterproofing in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Practical guide to full torch-on membrane waterproofing: suitability, site checks, work steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for KL and Selangor properties.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** Torch-on waterproofing is a heat-bonded bituminous membrane for flat concrete roofs. It is suitable when the slab and falls are stable, outlets work and the substrate can be safely prepared; it should not be used to hide active structural movement or trapped moisture.

This guide explains the [Full Torch-On Membrane Waterproofing](/services/roof-repair/full-torch-on-membrane-waterproofing) scope under [roof repair services](/services/roof-repair). The published starting price is **RM 26 / sq ft**. A site-specific quotation should confirm measurements, preparation, materials, access and related repairs rather than treating the starting rate as a fixed total.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The service is appropriate when inspection confirms that the existing property and surrounding construction can support the proposed work. Visible symptoms alone do not prove the cause. In Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, occupied areas, parking or loading access, condominium management rules and permitted working hours may affect planning and scheduling.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Crack movement, hollow screed and previous coating adhesion.**
- **Falls, ponding depth and outlet capacity.**
- **Upstands, parapets, pipe penetrations and door thresholds.**
- **Safe flame use near services, timber and occupied spaces.**

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **Local patch** | a small puncture with sound surrounding membrane. |
| **Full membrane** | widespread ageing or a bare, suitable flat roof. |
| **Investigate first** | moving cracks, wet screed or persistent ponding. |

Choosing the least expensive option without checking its limits can cause repeat work. The quotation should explain why the selected approach suits the substrate, dimensions and intended use.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Survey and moisture-check the roof, outlets and details**.
2. **Remove loose systems and repair stable cracks or screed defects**.
3. **Prime the dry, clean substrate with the specified compatible primer**.
4. **Torch-bond the specified layers with staggered, fully sealed laps**.
5. **Finish upstands and outlets, inspect laps and protect the membrane**.

Preparation and sequencing matter. Existing defects, unstable supports, incompatible materials or damaged substrates should be corrected before they are concealed. Protect occupied rooms, common corridors and completed finishes throughout the work. At handover, test operation and inspect edges, fixings, joints and access points—not appearance alone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Applying membrane over a damp or dusty substrate.
- Stopping the membrane flat at a wall instead of forming an upstand.
- Reducing overlap width around outlets and corners.
- Using open flame without a fire plan and extinguisher.

A competent inspection should distinguish a serviceable component from a system that has reached the point of replacement. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written down, especially where concealed conditions cannot be confirmed until work opens the area.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 26 / sq ft**
- Measured roof area including upstands and wastage.
- Substrate removal, screed and crack preparation.
- Membrane specification, layers and surface protection.
- Access, flame controls and outlet detailing.

The parent service publishes a **10-Year Membrane & Workmanship Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms. Confirm in writing whether it applies to this exact work, materials supplied by the customer and pre-existing defects.

## Safety, Access and Maintenance

Do not bypass manufacturer instructions, building management requirements or safe access arrangements to save time. Keep product references and care instructions after handover. Routine cleaning and early attention to movement, moisture, corrosion or loose hardware usually make local repairs simpler.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is torch-on suitable over old tiles?
Not automatically. Bond and falls must be assessed; loose tiles, hollow bedding and trapped moisture usually require removal or another designed system.

### Does a new membrane fix ponding?
No. Membrane resists water entry, but inadequate falls and undersized or blocked outlets should be corrected before waterproofing.

### Why are upstands important?
They carry waterproofing above the expected water level at walls and penetrations, where many flat-roof leaks begin.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send wide-angle and close-up photos, approximate measurements, property type and the symptom or outcome required. KL Servis Rumah can assess the scope for properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor without assuming that every site needs the same solution.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quotation%20for%20Full%20Torch-On%20Membrane%20Waterproofing.).

Panduan ini menerangkan skop [Kalis Air Membran Torch-On Penuh](/ms/services/roof-repair/full-torch-on-membrane-waterproofing) di bawah [perkhidmatan pembaikan bumbung](/ms/services/roof-repair). Harga permulaan yang diterbitkan ialah **RM 26 / kaki persegi**. Sebut harga khusus tapak perlu mengesahkan ukuran, persediaan, bahan, akses dan pembaikan berkaitan; harga mula bukan jumlah tetap untuk semua rumah.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Servis ini sesuai apabila pemeriksaan mengesahkan hartanah dan binaan sekeliling boleh menerima kerja yang dicadangkan. Simptom yang nampak tidak semestinya membuktikan punca. Ruang yang didiami, akses parkir atau memunggah, peraturan pengurusan kondominium dan waktu kerja di KL dan Selangor boleh mempengaruhi perancangan.

## Semakan Sebelum Kerja

- **Pergerakan retak, screed kosong dan lekatan salutan lama.**
- **Cerun, kedalaman takungan dan kapasiti outlet.**
- **Upstand, parapet, penembusan paip dan ambang pintu.**
- **Penggunaan api selamat berhampiran servis, kayu dan ruang dihuni.**

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Tampalan setempat** | tusukan kecil dengan membran sekeliling kukuh. |
| **Membran penuh** | penuaan meluas atau bumbung rata kosong yang sesuai. |
| **Siasat dahulu** | retak bergerak, screed basah atau takungan berterusan. |

Pilihan termurah tidak semestinya menjimatkan jika hadnya tidak diperiksa. Sebut harga patut menerangkan sebab kaedah dipilih mengikut substrat, dimensi dan kegunaan.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Tinjau dan semak kelembapan bumbung, outlet dan perincian**.
2. **Buang sistem longgar dan baiki retak stabil atau kecacatan screed**.
3. **Sapu primer serasi pada substrat bersih dan kering**.
4. **Lekat lapisan dengan obor, overlap berselang dan tertutup penuh**.
5. **Siapkan upstand dan outlet, periksa overlap dan lindungi membran**.

Urutan dan persediaan penting. Kecacatan sedia ada, sokongan lemah, bahan tidak serasi atau substrat rosak perlu dibaiki sebelum ditutup. Lindungi ruang didiami, koridor bersama dan kemasan siap. Semasa serahan, uji fungsi serta periksa tepi, pengikat, sambungan dan titik akses—bukan rupa sahaja.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Memasang membran di atas substrat lembap atau berhabuk.
- Menghentikan membran rata di dinding tanpa upstand.
- Mengurangkan lebar overlap di outlet dan sudut.
- Menggunakan api terbuka tanpa pelan kebakaran dan pemadam.

Pemeriksaan yang baik membezakan komponen yang masih boleh dibaiki daripada sistem yang patut diganti. Minta andaian dan pengecualian ditulis, khususnya untuk keadaan tersembunyi yang hanya diketahui selepas kawasan dibuka.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 26 / kaki persegi**
- Keluasan termasuk upstand dan pembaziran.
- Pembuangan substrat, screed dan persediaan retak.
- Spesifikasi membran, lapisan dan perlindungan.
- Akses, kawalan api dan perincian outlet.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Membran & Kerja 10 Tahun**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma. Sahkan secara bertulis sama ada ia meliputi kerja ini, bahan pelanggan dan kecacatan sedia ada.

## Keselamatan, Akses dan Penjagaan

Jangan abaikan arahan pengeluar, syarat pengurusan bangunan atau akses selamat untuk menjimatkan masa. Simpan rujukan produk dan arahan penjagaan. Pembersihan berkala serta tindakan awal terhadap lembapan, pergerakan, karat atau hardware longgar memudahkan pembaikan setempat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Adakah torch-on sesuai di atas jubin lama?
Tidak semestinya. Lekatan dan cerun perlu dinilai; jubin longgar, alas kosong dan lembapan terperangkap biasanya perlu dibuang atau sistem lain.

### Adakah membran baharu membaiki air bertakung?
Tidak. Membran menahan air, tetapi cerun tidak cukup dan outlet kecil atau tersumbat perlu dibetulkan dahulu.

### Mengapa upstand penting?
Ia menaikkan kalis air melepasi aras air di dinding dan penembusan, lokasi biasa kebocoran bermula.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar foto sudut luas dan dekat, ukuran anggaran, jenis hartanah serta simptom atau hasil yang diperlukan. KL Servis Rumah boleh menilai skop di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor tanpa menganggap semua tapak memerlukan penyelesaian sama.
