**直接答案：**火烤防水是以热熔方式粘结在平面混凝土屋顶上的沥青卷材。基层与坡度稳定、排水口正常且表面可妥善处理时才适用；它不能用来掩盖活动结构裂缝或被困潮气。

本文说明[全烤贴式卷材防水](/zh/services/roof-repair/full-torch-on-membrane-waterproofing)子服务，属于[屋顶维修服务](/zh/services/roof-repair)。已公布起价为 **RM 26 / 平方英尺**。现场报价应明确尺寸、基层处理、材料、施工通道和相关维修；起价不是每个物业的固定总价。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

只有检查确认物业及周边构造能够承受拟议工程时，这项服务才适合；肉眼看到的症状不一定就是根因。吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的入住情况、停车与卸货通道、公寓管理规定及施工时段，都可能影响规划和排期。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **裂缝位移、找平层空鼓及旧涂层附着力。**
- **坡度、积水深度及排水口容量。**
- **翻边、女儿墙、管道穿孔及门槛。**
- **明火靠近管线、木材和已使用空间时的安全条件。**

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **局部补片** | 小范围穿孔且周边卷材完好。 |
| **整体卷材** | 大面积老化或适合施工的裸露平屋顶。 |
| **先查原因** | 活动裂缝、找平层潮湿或长期积水。 |

若不先了解限制，最便宜的方案可能造成重复施工。报价应说明选定方法为何适合现场基层、尺寸和实际用途。

## 常见施工流程

1. **勘察并检测屋面、排水口和细部的潮气**。
2. **清除松动物，修补稳定裂缝及找平层缺陷**。
3. **在清洁干燥基层涂刷指定兼容底涂**。
4. **热熔铺贴指定层数，错缝并完全封闭搭接**。
5. **处理翻边与排水口，检查搭接并保护卷材**。

基层准备和工序先后很重要。原有缺陷、薄弱支撑、不兼容材料或损坏基层，应在封闭前处理。施工期间保护已入住空间、公共走廊及已完成饰面。验收不能只看外观，还要测试功能，并检查边缘、固定件、接缝和检修点。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 在潮湿或多尘基层上铺贴。
- 卷材平停在墙脚而未做翻边。
- 排水口和转角处搭接不足。
- 无动火方案及灭火器便使用明火。

合适的检查应区分“仍可维修的部件”与“已应更换的系统”。对于只有拆开后才能确认的隐藏状况，应要求把报价假设和不包含项目写清楚。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 26 / 平方英尺**
- 实测面积、翻边及损耗。
- 旧层清除、找平及裂缝处理。
- 卷材规格、层数及保护层。
- 通道、动火控制及排水口细部。

其主服务公布 **10 年卷材与工艺保修**，具体按适用范围和条款执行。请书面确认是否涵盖本次工程、客户自购材料及原有缺陷。

## 安全、进场与保养

不要为了省时而绕过厂家说明、管理处规定或安全通道安排。完工后保留产品资料和护理说明。定期清洁，并及早处理潮气、位移、锈蚀或五金松动，通常能让局部维修更简单。

## 常见问题

### 旧瓷砖上能直接火烤卷材吗？
不一定。必须检查粘结与坡度；松动瓷砖、空鼓垫层和被困潮气通常需清除或改用经设计的系统。

### 新卷材能解决积水吗？
不能。卷材负责防水，但坡度不足、排水口过小或堵塞应在施工前纠正。

### 为什么翻边重要？
翻边把防水层提升至可能水位以上，墙脚和穿孔正是许多平屋顶渗漏的起点。

## 获取针对现场的报价

发送广角与近照、估算尺寸、物业类型，以及遇到的症状或希望达到的效果。KL Servis Rumah 可评估吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的实际范围，不会假定每个现场都需要同一方案。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%85%A8%E7%83%A4%E8%B4%B4%E5%BC%8F%E5%8D%B7%E6%9D%90%E9%98%B2%E6%B0%B4%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: IKEA & Taobao Furniture Assembly in KL and Selangor
en.excerpt: Flat-pack wardrobes that lean, bed frames that squeak and drawers that never close flush are all assembly issues, not product faults. Here is what professional assembly does differently — and what it costs in KL & Selangor.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: IKEA & Taobao Furniture Assembly in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Flat-pack wardrobes, beds, desks and cabinets assembled level and secure in KL & Selangor — wall anchoring, alignment and cleanup, from RM 120.
en.content:
**Question:** Is it worth paying a handyman to assemble flat-pack furniture?

**Answer:** For large or load-bearing pieces, usually yes. Flat-pack wardrobes, bed frames and tall cabinets fail not because of the product but because of assembly shortcuts: cam locks not fully seated, panels forced into misaligned dowels, hinges hung out of square, and — most dangerous of all — tall units never anchored to the wall. A professional assembles square and true the first time, anchors anti-tip hardware properly, and finishes in a fraction of the time a first-timer takes to decipher the manual.

This article covers the **furniture assembly (IKEA/Taobao)** sub-service under [handyman services](/services/handyman), starting from **RM 120**. Related scopes: [curtains, blinds & shelves hanging](/services/handyman/curtains-blinds-and-shelves-hanging) and [heavy TV wall mounting](/services/handyman/heavy-tv-wall-mounting). If your flat-pack project has already gone sideways, see the [IKEA furniture assembly help guide](/problems/ikea-furniture-assembly-help). For a quick cost idea, use the [furniture assembly estimator](/tools/furniture-assembly-estimator).

## Items Commonly Assembled

| Item | Typical assembly traps |
|---|---|
| Wardrobes (hinged and sliding) | Panels forced out of square; sliding tracks misaligned; doors never levelled |
| Bed frames and storage beds | Bolts under-torqued = squeaks; slat supports fitted wrong |
| Display and storage cabinets | Tipping risk if not anchored; glass shelves set before alignment |
| Office desks and workstations | Cable cut-outs and return units assembled mirror-reversed |
| Kitchen island carts and trolleys | Castors cross-threaded; drawers inverted |
| Shoe cabinets and bookshelves | Back panels skipped (they carry the racking strength) |

Taobao-bought items add their own challenges: manuals in Chinese only, hardware sorted poorly, and occasional missing or wrong fixings — a professional sorts, checks and sources small replacements instead of forcing wrong-fit parts.

## What Professional Assembly Includes

1. **Inventory check** — all panels and hardware counted against the parts list before starting; missing pieces flagged immediately.
2. **Assembly sequence** — frames built square, cam locks fully engaged, back panels and braces fitted (never skipped — they stop the wobble).
3. **Levelling and alignment** — doors and drawers adjusted to even gaps; sliding tracks set and tested.
4. **Wall anchoring** — anti-tip brackets on tall wardrobes, bookshelves and display cabinets, fixed to solid wall material. A heavy unit on a gypsum partition needs different anchors than one on brick — the mount is matched to your wall type.
5. **Placement and cleanup** — the finished piece is positioned and cardboard/packaging consolidated for disposal.

## Safety: The Anti-Tip Anchor Is Not Optional

Flat-pack tall furniture is a genuine hazard in homes with children. Unanchored wardrobes and shelves tip when drawers are climbed or doors are swung, and the injuries are serious. IKEA supplies anti-tip hardware with tall pieces for exactly this reason — and it only works when it is actually fixed into the wall with the right anchor:

- **Concrete/brick:** expansion plugs or masonry anchors.
- **Gypsum partition:** the anchor must find a stud or use rated cavity fasteners — see how TV mounting handles the same wall-type problem in the [TV wall mounting safety guide](/blog/tv-wall-mounting-safety-guide) and why [TVs fall off walls](/problems/tv-fell-off-wall) when anchors are wrong.

## Cost Factors

The furniture assembly sub-service starts at **RM 120**, and [handyman services](/services/handyman) start at **RM 280**. Final cost depends on:

- Item count and complexity — a PAX-sized wardrobe differs from a shoe rack.
- Sliding-door vs hinged mechanisms.
- Wall anchoring requirements and wall type.
- Assembly from scratch vs fixing a half-built piece.
- Replacement hardware needed for missing Taobao fixings.
- Carrying boxes up stairs or through condos with lift bookings.

The [furniture assembly estimator](/tools/furniture-assembly-estimator) and [handyman cost estimator](/tools/handyman-cost-estimator) give quick ballparks. The handyman service carries a published **30-Day Workmanship Safety Warranty**.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can you fix furniture I already half-assembled?
Yes. The usual approach is to partially disassemble, correct the misalignments (forced panels, skipped back panels, reversed parts), then re-assemble square. Salvage depends on whether particleboard cams or screw holes were damaged in the first attempt.

### Do I need to clear the room before assembly?
Not fully — just enough open floor space for the panels to lie flat during assembly (usually about the footprint of the finished piece plus walking space). Boxes should be in the room where the item will live; assembled wardrobes barely fit through door frames.

### Can you assemble brands other than IKEA and Taobao?
Yes — flat-pack assembly follows the same principles across brands sold in Malaysia, including furniture from Kaison, SSF, Ewin and online sellers. The parts-count-first process handles any manual language.

## Skip the Weekend of Frustration

Professional assembly means square doors, quiet beds and anchored wardrobes — done in hours, not days. KL Servis Rumah assembles IKEA, Taobao and other flat-pack furniture across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

Send the product links or photos of the boxes — [WhatsApp the handyman team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quote%20for%20IKEA%2FTaobao%20furniture%20assembly.).

ms.title: Pemasangan Perabot IKEA & Taobao di KL dan Selangor
ms.excerpt: Almari flat-pack yang senget, rangka katil yang berderit dan laci yang tidak pernah tutup rata semuanya isu pemasangan, bukan kesalahan produk. Ketahui apa yang dilakukan pemasangan profesional secara berbeza — dan kosnya di KL & Selangor.
ms.metaTitle: Pemasangan Perabot IKEA & Taobao di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Almari flat-pack, katil, meja dan kabinet dipasang rata dan kukuh di KL & Selangor — penjangkaran dinding, penjajaran dan pembersihan, dari RM 120.
ms.content:
**Soalan:** Berbaloikah membayar handyman untuk memasang perabot flat-pack?

**Jawapan:** Untuk barangan besar atau galas beban, selalunya ya. Almari flat-pack, rangka katil dan kabinet tinggi gagal bukan kerana produk tetapi kerana jalan pintas pemasangan: cam lock tidak duduk penuh, panel dipaksa ke dalam dowel tidak jajar, engsel digantung tidak siku, dan — paling berbahaya — unit tinggi tidak pernah dijangkarkan ke dinding. Profesional memasang siku dan betul kali pertama, menjangkarkan perkakasan anti-jatuh dengan betul, dan siap dalam sebahagian kecil masa yang diambil orang pertama kali mentafsir manual.

Artikel ini merangkumi sub-perkhidmatan **pemasangan perabot (IKEA/Taobao)** di bawah [perkhidmatan handyman](/ms/services/handyman), bermula **RM 120**. Skop berkaitan: [penggantungan langsir, bidai & rak](/ms/services/handyman/curtains-blinds-and-shelves-hanging) dan [pemasangan dinding TV berat](/ms/services/handyman/heavy-tv-wall-mounting). Jika projek flat-pack anda sudah tersasar, lihat [panduan bantuan pemasangan perabot IKEA](/ms/problems/ikea-furniture-assembly-help). Untuk idea kos pantas, gunakan [penganggar pemasangan perabot](/ms/alatan/pasang-perabot).

## Barangan Biasa Dipasang

| Barangan | Perangkap pemasangan tipikal |
|---|---|
| Almari (berengsel dan gelongsor) | Panel dipaksa tidak siku; trek gelongsor tidak jajar; pintu tidak pernah diratakan |
| Rangka katil dan katil storan | Bolt kurang ketat = derit; sokongan slat dipasang salah |
| Kabinet paparan dan storan | Risiko jatuh jika tidak dijangkar; para kaca dipasang sebelum penjajaran |
| Meja pejabat dan stesen kerja | Potongan kabel dan unit pulangan dipasang songsang |
| Troli pulau dapur | Castor tersilap benang; laci terbalik |
| Kabinet kasut dan rak buku | Panel belakang dilangkau (ia membawa kekuatan anti-goyang) |

Barangan belian Taobao menambah cabaran sendiri: manual dalam bahasa Cina sahaja, perkakasan disusun lemah, dan sekali-sekala pengikat hilang atau salah — profesional menyusun, menyemak dan mendapatkan pengganti kecil dan bukannya memaksa bahagian tidak sepadan.

## Apa Yang Termasuk Pemasangan Profesional

1. **Semakan inventori** — semua panel dan perkakasan dikira mengikut senarai bahagian sebelum bermula; bahagian hilang ditandakan serta-merta.
2. **Susunan pemasangan** — rangka dibina siku, cam lock dimasukkan penuh, panel belakang dan pendakap dipasang (jangan dilangkau — ia menghentikan goyangan).
3. **Pengarataan dan penjajaran** — pintu dan laci dilaraskan kepada jarak sekata; trek gelongsor ditetapkan dan diuji.
4. **Penjangkaran dinding** — pendakap anti-jatuh pada almari tinggi, rak buku dan kabinet paparan, dipasang pada bahan dinding pepejal. Unit berat pada partition gypsum memerlukan sauh berbeza daripada pada bata — pelekat dipadankan dengan jenis dinding anda.
5. **Penempatan dan pembersihan** — barangan siap diletakkan dan kadbod/pembungkusan disatukan untuk pelupusan.

## Keselamatan: Jangkar Anti-Jatuh Bukan Pilihan

Perabot tinggi flat-pack ialah bahaya sebenar dalam rumah dengan kanak-kanak. Almari dan rak tanpa jangkar jatuh apabila laci dipanjat atau pintu dihayun, dan kecederaannya serius. IKEA membekalkan perkakasan anti-jatuh dengan barangan tinggi atas sebab ini — dan ia hanya berfungsi apabila benar-benar dipasang ke dinding dengan sauh betul:

- **Konkrit/bata:** plag pengembangan atau sauh batu.
- **Partition gypsum:** sauh mesti mencari kagang atau menggunakan pengikat rongga berkadaran — lihat cara pemasangan TV mengendalikan masalah jenis dinding yang sama dalam [panduan keselamatan pemasangan TV dinding](/ms/blog/panduan-keselamatan-pemasangan-tv-dinding) dan kenapa [TV jatuh dari dinding](/ms/problems/tv-fell-off-wall) apabila sauh salah.

## Faktor Kos

Sub-perkhidmatan pemasangan perabot bermula **RM 120**, dan [perkhidmatan handyman](/ms/services/handyman) bermula **RM 280**. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Bilangan dan kerumitan barangan — almari seukuran PAX berbeza daripada rak kasut.
- Mekanisma pintu gelongsor berbanding berengsel.
- Keperluan penjangkaran dinding dan jenis dinding.
- Pemasangan dari awal berbanding membaiki barangan separa siap.
- Perkakasan pengganti diperlukan untuk pengikat Taobao hilang.
- Mengangkat kotak naik tangga atau melalui kondominium dengan tempahan lif.

[Penganggar pemasangan perabot](/ms/alatan/pasang-perabot) dan [penganggar kos handyman](/ms/alatan/kos-handyman) memberi anggaran kasar pantas. Perkhidmatan handyman membawa **Jaminan Keselamatan Kerja 30 Hari** yang diterbitkan.

## Soalan Lazim

### Bolehkah anda membaiki perabot yang saya sudah separa pasang?
Boleh. Pendekatan biasa ialah menanggalkan separa, membetulkan ketidakjajaran (panel dipaksa, panel belakang dilangkau, bahagian songsang), kemudian memasang semula siku. Keselamatan bergantung pada sama ada cam papan partikel atau lubang skru rosak dalam percubaan pertama.

### Perlukah saya mengosongkan bilik sebelum pemasangan?
Tidak sepenuhnya — cukup ruang lantai terbuka untuk panel berbaring rata semasa pemasangan (biasanya kira-kira tapak barangan siap ditambah ruang berjalan). Kotak hendaklah berada di bilik di mana barangan akan diletakkan; almari yang sudah siap hampir tidak muat melalui bingkai pintu.

### Bolehkah anda memasang jenama selain IKEA dan Taobao?
Boleh — pemasangan flat-pack mengikut prinsip yang sama merentasi jenama dijual di Malaysia, termasuk perabot daripada Kaison, SSF, Ewin dan penjual dalam talian. Proses kira-bahagian-dahulu mengendalikan sebarang bahasa manual.

## Langkau Hujung Minggu Yang Memualkan

Pemasangan profesional bermaksud pintu siku, katil senyap dan almari terjangkar — siap dalam beberapa jam, bukan berhari-hari. KL Servis Rumah memasang perabot flat-pack IKEA, Taobao dan lain-lain di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor.

Hantar pautan produk atau foto kotak — [WhatsApp pasukan handyman](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlu%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20pemasangan%20perabot%20IKEA%2FTaobao.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪 IKEA、淘宝家具组装
zh.excerpt: 平板衣柜装歪、床架异响、抽屉关不平——都是组装问题而非产品问题。本文说明专业组装的不同做法，以及在吉隆坡与雪兰莪的费用。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡IKEA淘宝家具组装服务
zh.metaDesc: 平板包装衣柜、床架、书桌与柜子的专业组装——水平校正、防倒墙锚与现场清理，服务吉隆坡与雪兰莪，从 RM 120 起。
zh.content:
**问题：**花钱请杂工组装平板家具值得吗？

**答案：**大件或承重的家具，通常是值得的。平板衣柜、床架和高柜出问题，大多不是产品差，而是组装走了捷径：偏心锁扣没拧到位、板件对着歪斜的榫头硬砸、合页装得不方正——最危险的是高柜从来不固定上墙。专业人员第一次就装得方正规整，防倒五金固定到位，用时只有新手啃说明书的几分之一。

本文介绍[家居杂工服务](/zh/services/handyman)下的**家具组装（IKEA/淘宝）**子服务，从 **RM 120** 起。相关服务：[窗帘、百叶窗与置物架安装](/zh/services/handyman/curtains-blinds-and-shelves-hanging)与[重型电视挂墙](/zh/services/handyman/heavy-tv-wall-mounting)。如果您的平板家具已经装到一半卡住了，请参考[IKEA 家具组装求助指南](/zh/problems/ikea-furniture-assembly-help)。快速估价可用[家具组装估价工具](/zh/gongju/家具组装估价)。

## 常组装的物品

| 物品 | 常见组装陷阱 |
|---|---|
| 衣柜（平开门与推拉门） | 板件硬装不方正；滑轨不在线上；门扇从不调平 |
| 床架与储物床 | 螺栓拧不紧＝异响；床板支架装错 |
| 展示柜与储物柜 | 不固定有倾倒风险；层板在调平前就摆上玻璃 |
| 办公桌与工作台 | 走线孔与副柜装成镜像反位 |
| 厨房中岛推车 | 轮子螺纹咬坏；抽屉装反 |
| 鞋柜与书架 | 背板跳过不装（背板正是防晃的关键） |

淘宝购买的家具另有挑战：说明书只有中文、五金分包混乱，偶尔缺件或错件——专业人员会先清点核对、配小五金补件，而不是硬装不匹配的零件。

## 专业组装包含什么

1. **清点核对** —— 开工前按零件清单点齐板件与五金，缺件立即指出；
2. **按序组装** —— 框体装得方正，偏心锁拧到位，背板与拉筋不跳过（正是它们防晃）；
3. **调平与校正** —— 门扇与抽屉调到缝隙均匀；滑轨定位并试运行；
4. **上墙固定** —— 高衣柜、书架与展示柜安装防倒支架，固定到坚实的墙体材料。厚重柜体装石膏板隔墙与装砖墙用不同锚栓——挂点按您的墙体类型匹配；
5. **就位与清理** —— 成品放到指定位置，纸箱包装归拢待弃。

## 安全：防倒固定不是可选项

家有儿童时，平板高家具是真正的隐患。未固定的衣柜和书架，孩子攀爬抽屉或荡门时就会倾倒，伤害后果严重。IKEA 给高件配防倒五金正是这个原因——而它只有用正确的锚栓真正固定到墙上才有效：

- **混凝土/砖墙：** 膨胀管或砌体锚栓；
- **石膏板隔墙：** 锚栓必须打进龙骨或使用级别合格的空腔锚——同样的墙体类型问题，可参照[电视挂墙安全指南](/zh/bo-ke/dian-shi-gua-qiang-an-zhuang-an-quan-zhi-nan)的做法，锚栓用错正是[电视从墙上坠落](/zh/problems/tv-fell-off-wall)的原因。

## 费用因素

家具组装子服务从 **RM 120** 起，[家居杂工服务](/zh/services/handyman)从 **RM 280** 起。最终费用取决于：

- 物品数量与复杂程度——PAX 级别的大衣柜与鞋架不同；
- 推拉门与平开门的机构差别；
- 上墙固定要求与墙体类型；
- 从零组装还是修正装了一半的家具；
- 淘宝缺件需补的替换五金；
- 搬箱上楼或公寓需预约货梯。

[家具组装估价](/zh/gongju/家具组装估价)与[杂工费用估价](/zh/gongju/杂工费用估价)可快速粗估。杂工服务附带已公布的 **30 天工艺安全保修**。

## 常见问题

### 装到一半的家具能帮我收尾吗？
可以。通常先局部拆开，修正错位（硬塞的板件、跳过的背板、装反的零件），再重新方正规整地装好。能否救回取决于第一次尝试是否损坏了刨花板锁扣或螺丝孔。

### 组装前需要把房间清空吗？
不用全清——留出足够板件平铺施工的地面即可（大约是成品占地面积加走道空间即可）。箱子应放在家具将要摆放的房间；组装好的衣柜基本过不了门框。

### 除了 IKEA 和淘宝，其他品牌能装吗？
可以——平板组装的原理在马来西亚销售的所有品牌间通用，包括 Kaison、SSF、Ewin 及网店家具。先清点零件的流程能应对任何语言的说明书。

## 省下折腾一整个周末

专业组装意味着方正的门、不响的床和固定上墙的衣柜——几小时完成，而不是折腾几天。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪组装 IKEA、淘宝及其他平板家具。

发送产品链接或箱子照片——[WhatsApp 杂工团队](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81IKEA%2F%E6%B7%98%E5%AE%9D%E5%AE%B6%E5%85%B7%E7%BB%84%E8%A3%85%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Glass & Aluminium Fabrication in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Shower screens, glass partitions, aluminium sliding windows and wall mirrors fabricated to size across KL & Selangor. From RM 320.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Glass & Aluminium Fabrication KL & Selangor | RM 320
en.metaDesc: Custom shower screens, glass partitions, aluminium windows and mirrors in KL & Selangor. Tempered safety glass, fabricated to size. From RM 320.
en.content:
Glass and aluminium work is measured work. Nothing comes off a shelf: the shower screen is cut to your bathroom, the window is fabricated to your opening, the partition is sized to your ceiling height. That is why quotes vary so much between contractors — and why an accurate site measurement matters more than the brochure.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah fabricates and installs glass and aluminium across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor from **RM 320**. Frameless shower screens start at **RM 420 per panel**, aluminium sliding windows at **RM 320 per sq ft**, glass office partitions at **RM 220 per sq ft**, and wall mirrors at **RM 320**. Shower screen seals carry a **12-month leak-free and hardware warranty**.

## What we fabricate and install

- **[Frameless shower screen](/services/glass-aluminium/frameless-shower-screen)** — 10–12mm tempered glass cut to your bathroom, with concealed hinges, drip-edge design and anti-leak seals. From RM 420 per panel.
- **[Aluminium sliding window](/services/glass-aluminium/aluminium-sliding-window)** — fabricated to your opening with 5mm clear or tinted glass, nylon rollers and weatherstrip. From RM 320 per sq ft.
- **[Glass office partition](/services/glass-aluminium/glass-office-partition)** — 10–12mm tempered partition with aluminium or frameless channel, door and hardware included. From RM 220 per sq ft.
- **[Wall mirror installation](/services/glass-aluminium/wall-mirror-installation)** — 5–6mm silver-backed mirror with concealed aluminium channel fixings for bathrooms, gyms and dressing rooms. From RM 320.

We also fit swing glass doors, top-hung awning windows, louvre windows and casement windows as part of the same fabrication scope.

## Fabrication vs repair — which one do you need?

New glass and aluminium is not always the answer. A large share of enquiries we receive are repairs on existing units.

| Your situation | The right scope |
|---|---|
| Glass cracked or shattered, frame is fine | [Glass replacement](/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| Rain comes in but glass is intact | [Window seal replacement](/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| Sash will not slide | [Sliding window stuck](/problems/sliding-window-stuck) |
| Frame corroded, warped or beyond adjustment | New aluminium fabrication |
| Shower screen leaks at the base or hinge | [Shower screen leaking](/problems/shower-screen-leaking) |
| No screen yet, or a full bathroom re-do | New frameless screen |

If the frame is sound, repair is usually cheaper and faster. We say so on site rather than quoting a replacement by default. General repair work sits under [window repair](/services/window-repair).

## Choosing glass: thickness, safety and tint

Glass selection is the single biggest driver of both safety and cost.

- **Tempered (toughened)** — heat-treated so it breaks into small blunt granules instead of shards. Mandatory thinking for shower screens, doors and partitions. We do not use ordinary annealed glass in wet or high-traffic areas.
- **Laminated** — two panes bonded with an interlayer; holds together when broken. Useful for overhead glass and areas where fall-through is a risk.
- **10mm** — sufficient for a single fixed shower panel up to about 1.5m wide.
- **12mm** — for frameless doors or panels wider than 1.5m, and for full-height partitions.
- **8mm** — acceptable on framed or sliding shower designs.
- **5mm clear or tinted** — standard for aluminium sliding window infill.

On tint: clear glass gives maximum daylight; grey, bronze or green tint reduces solar heat gain and is a common choice for west-facing elevations in Klang Valley; frosted (acid-etched or sandblasted) gives privacy while still passing light; reflective coating adds daytime one-way privacy. We can show physical samples before you commit.

## Aluminium profiles

We work with profiles from **Akasia, Hua Ho and YKK AP**, or custom powder-coated sections where a specific colour is required. Profile choice affects sash weight, glazing bead depth, weatherstrip type and how the frame handles wind-driven rain — not just the look.

Glass we specify comes from Malaysian certified manufacturers including **Malaysian Sheet Glass, TechnoGlas and Xinyi Glass**.

## How a glass and aluminium job runs

1. **Site measurement and design** — we measure the opening and record the constraints that matter: floor slope, drainage position, tile joints, plumbing behind the wall, ceiling height, wall condition.
2. **Quotation and lead time** — an itemised quote covering glass, frame, hardware and installation. Tempered glass fabrication typically takes 5–7 working days; aluminium frames 3–5 working days.
3. **Fabrication** — glass is cut, tempered and edge-polished at the factory. Aluminium is cut, mitred and powder-coated. Tempered glass cannot be trimmed after toughening, which is why measurement discipline matters.
4. **On-site installation** — frames anchored with appropriate fixings, glass seated on setting blocks with structural silicone, hardware fitted and adjusted.
5. **Sealing and water test** — for shower screens we run a water test to confirm the seal performs, then align hardware and hand over.

## What it costs

| Item | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Glass & aluminium works (general) | From RM 320 |
| Glass office partition | From RM 220 / sq ft |
| Aluminium sliding window | From RM 320 / sq ft |
| Wall mirror installation | From RM 320 |
| Frameless shower screen | From RM 420 / panel |

Final cost moves with glass thickness, panel size, hardware grade, powder-coat colour and access. High-rise installations that need lift protection, hoisting or management approval add time and are quoted after the site visit. For a rough replacement figure before you call, the [glass replacement calculator](/tools/glass-replacement-calculator) and [window replacement estimator](/tools/window-replacement-estimator) are free to use.

## What we check on site

- Floor slope and drain position in the bathroom — a screen fitted against the fall will always pool water.
- Whether the wall behind the tile is solid brick, block or stud, and where hidden pipes run.
- Squareness of the opening. Old terrace openings are rarely true, and a frame forced into a skewed opening will bind.
- Existing waterproofing condition. If the bathroom membrane has failed, a new screen will not stop the leak — see [bathroom and wet area waterproofing](/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing).
- Building management rules for facade changes on condominium windows and partitions.

## Common mistakes

- Ordering shower glass by tape measure without checking floor fall — the water runs the wrong way and the screen gets blamed.
- Choosing 8mm frameless for a wide door because it is cheaper, then living with flex and hinge stress.
- Sealing a screen with general-purpose silicone instead of sanitary-grade mould-resistant silicone.
- Fitting a new window without clearing the drainage weep holes, so rain backs up over the sill.
- Assuming a leaking window means new windows. Very often it is a perished seal or blocked weep hole.
- Skipping condominium management approval for facade-visible work, then being asked to remove it.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can my existing shower screen be re-sealed instead of replaced?

Often yes. If the glass and frame are sound and only the silicone has gone black, mouldy or detached, we can strip the old silicone, clean the substrate and re-apply sanitary-grade mould-resistant silicone. That is a much smaller job than a new screen.

### How long does tempered glass take to arrive?

Typically 5–7 working days for fabrication, and 3–5 working days for aluminium frames. Tempering is a factory heat process — it cannot be rushed, and the glass cannot be recut afterwards.

### Do you install glass I bought myself?

We can look at it, but tempered panels are made to a specific size with pre-drilled holes for specific hardware. If the cutouts do not match the hinges or the channel, the panel cannot be modified. We prefer to measure and fabricate as one scope so responsibility for fit sits in one place.

### Do you handle office partitions and shop fit-outs?

Yes. Full-height 10–12mm tempered partitions with aluminium or frameless U-channel, integrated swing or sliding doors, frosted film for privacy and acoustic laminated glass for meeting rooms.

### Is tinted glass worth it in Klang Valley?

For a west-facing living room or a room that overheats every afternoon, yes — tint reduces solar heat gain noticeably. For a north or south elevation, clear glass usually makes more sense so you keep the daylight.

## Get a measurement and quote

If you are planning a shower screen, new aluminium windows, a glass partition or a mirror wall, KL Servis Rumah measures and fabricates across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp a photo of the opening with a rough size — [request a glass & aluminium quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20a%20glass%20and%20aluminium%20quote.).

ms.title: Fabrikasi Kaca & Aluminium di Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Skrin pancuran, partition kaca, tingkap gelangsar aluminium dan cermin dinding difabrikasi ikut ukuran di KL & Selangor. Dari RM 320.
ms.metaTitle: Fabrikasi Kaca & Aluminium KL & Selangor RM 320
ms.metaDesc: Skrin pancuran, partition kaca, tingkap aluminium dan cermin custom di KL & Selangor. Kaca tempered, ukuran di tapak dan pemasangan kemas. Dari RM 320.
ms.content:
Kerja kaca dan aluminium ialah kerja ukuran. Tiada apa yang boleh diambil terus dari rak: skrin pancuran dipotong mengikut bilik mandi anda, tingkap difabrikasi mengikut bukaan anda, partition disaiz mengikut ketinggian siling. Itulah sebabnya sebut harga berbeza-beza antara kontraktor — dan mengapa ukuran tapak yang tepat lebih penting daripada katalog.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah memfabrikasi dan memasang kaca serta aluminium di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor bermula **RM 320**. Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai dari **RM 420 / panel**, tingkap gelangsar aluminium dari **RM 320 / kaki persegi**, partition pejabat kaca dari **RM 220 / kaki persegi**, dan cermin dinding dari **RM 320**. Pengedap skrin pancuran dilindungi **jaminan bebas bocor dan perkakasan 12 bulan**.

## Apa yang kami fabrikasi

- **[Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai](/ms/services/glass-aluminium/frameless-shower-screen)** — kaca tempered 10–12mm dipotong ikut bilik mandi anda, dengan engsel tersembunyi, drip-edge dan pengedap anti-bocor. Dari RM 420 / panel.
- **[Tingkap gelangsar aluminium](/ms/services/glass-aluminium/aluminium-sliding-window)** — difabrikasi ikut bukaan dengan kaca jernih atau tinted 5mm, roller nilon dan weatherstrip. Dari RM 320 / kaki persegi.
- **[Partition pejabat kaca](/ms/services/glass-aluminium/glass-office-partition)** — kaca tempered 10–12mm dengan channel aluminium atau frameless, termasuk pintu dan perkakasan. Dari RM 220 / kaki persegi.
- **[Pemasangan cermin dinding](/ms/services/glass-aluminium/wall-mirror-installation)** — cermin silver-backed 5–6mm dengan pengikat channel aluminium tersembunyi. Dari RM 320.

Kami turut memasang pintu kaca ayun, tingkap awning top-hung, tingkap louvre dan tingkap casement dalam skop fabrikasi yang sama.

## Fabrikasi baharu atau pembaikan?

Kaca baharu bukan selalu jawapannya. Banyak pertanyaan yang kami terima sebenarnya kerja baiki pada unit sedia ada.

| Keadaan anda | Skop yang betul |
|---|---|
| Kaca retak atau pecah, bingkai masih elok | [Penggantian kaca](/ms/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| Hujan masuk tetapi kaca elok | [Penggantian pengedap tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| Daun tingkap tidak boleh gelongsor | [Tingkap gelangsar tersekat](/ms/problems/sliding-window-stuck) |
| Bingkai berkarat, bengkok, tidak boleh dilaras | Fabrikasi aluminium baharu |
| Skrin pancuran bocor di bawah atau di engsel | [Skrin pancuran bocor](/ms/problems/shower-screen-leaking) |
| Belum ada skrin, atau ubah suai bilik mandi penuh | Skrin tanpa bingkai baharu |

Jika bingkai masih kukuh, pembaikan lazimnya lebih murah dan lebih cepat. Kami akan beritahu di tapak, bukan terus sebut harga gantian penuh. Kerja baiki umum ada di bawah [pembaikan tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair).

## Memilih kaca: ketebalan, keselamatan dan tint

- **Tempered** — dirawat haba supaya pecah menjadi granul kecil tumpul, bukan serpihan tajam. Wajib difikirkan untuk skrin pancuran, pintu dan partition.
- **Laminated** — dua lapisan kaca disatukan dengan interlayer; kekal bercantum apabila pecah.
- **10mm** — cukup untuk satu panel pancuran tetap sehingga kira-kira 1.5m lebar.
- **12mm** — untuk pintu tanpa bingkai atau panel melebihi 1.5m, dan partition setinggi siling.
- **8mm** — boleh diterima untuk reka bentuk berbingkai atau gelangsar.
- **5mm jernih atau tinted** — standard untuk isian tingkap gelangsar aluminium.

Kaca jernih memberi cahaya maksimum. Tint kelabu, gangsa atau hijau mengurangkan haba matahari — pilihan biasa untuk fasad menghadap barat di Lembah Klang. Kaca frosted memberi privasi sambil tetap melalukan cahaya. Kami boleh tunjuk sampel fizikal sebelum anda putuskan.

Profil aluminium yang kami guna termasuk **Akasia, Hua Ho dan YKK AP**, atau profil powder-coat tersuai jika warna khusus diperlukan.

## Cara kerja dijalankan

1. **Ukuran dan reka bentuk** — kami ukur bukaan dan rekod kekangan penting: cerun lantai, kedudukan saliran, sambungan jubin, paip tersembunyi, ketinggian siling.
2. **Sebut harga dan lead time** — kaca tempered lazimnya 5–7 hari bekerja untuk difabrikasi; bingkai aluminium 3–5 hari bekerja.
3. **Fabrikasi** — kaca dipotong, ditemper dan digilap tepi di kilang. Aluminium dipotong, dimitre dan di-powder-coat. Kaca tempered tidak boleh dipotong semula selepas dirawat.
4. **Pemasangan di tapak** — bingkai disauh, kaca didudukkan atas setting block dengan silikon struktur, perkakasan dipasang dan dilaras.
5. **Pengedapan dan ujian air** — untuk skrin pancuran kami jalankan ujian air sebelum serahan.

## Kos

| Item | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Kerja kaca & aluminium (umum) | Dari RM 320 |
| Partition pejabat kaca | Dari RM 220 / kaki persegi |
| Tingkap gelangsar aluminium | Dari RM 320 / kaki persegi |
| Pemasangan cermin dinding | Dari RM 320 |
| Skrin pancuran tanpa bingkai | Dari RM 420 / panel |

Kos akhir bergerak mengikut ketebalan kaca, saiz panel, gred perkakasan, warna powder-coat dan akses. Pemasangan bangunan tinggi yang memerlukan perlindungan lif atau kelulusan pengurusan disebut harga selepas lawatan tapak. Untuk anggaran awal, guna [kalkulator ganti kaca](/ms/alatan/ganti-kaca) atau [anggaran ganti tingkap](/ms/alatan/ganti-tingkap).

## Kesilapan biasa

- Menempah kaca pancuran tanpa memeriksa cerun lantai — air mengalir ke arah salah dan skrin yang dipersalahkan.
- Memilih frameless 8mm untuk pintu lebar kerana lebih murah, kemudian terpaksa hidup dengan lenturan dan tekanan pada engsel.
- Menggunakan silikon serba guna, bukan silikon sanitari tahan kulat.
- Memasang tingkap baharu tanpa membersihkan lubang saliran (weep hole), lalu air hujan melimpah ke ambang dalam.
- Menganggap tingkap bocor bermakna perlu tingkap baharu. Selalunya ia hanya pengedap reput atau weep hole tersumbat.

## Soalan lazim

### Boleh skrin pancuran sedia ada di-seal semula sahaja?

Selalunya boleh. Jika kaca dan bingkai masih elok dan hanya silikon yang hitam atau tertanggal, kami boleh buang silikon lama, bersihkan permukaan dan pasang silikon sanitari baharu.

### Berapa lama kaca tempered siap?

Lazimnya 5–7 hari bekerja untuk kaca, 3–5 hari bekerja untuk bingkai aluminium. Proses tempering ialah rawatan haba kilang dan tidak boleh dipercepatkan.

### Boleh pasang kaca yang saya beli sendiri?

Kami boleh lihat, tetapi panel tempered dibuat pada saiz tertentu dengan lubang untuk perkakasan tertentu. Jika potongan tidak sepadan, panel tidak boleh diubah suai. Kami lebih suka mengukur dan memfabrikasi sebagai satu skop.

### Adakah kaca tinted berbaloi di Lembah Klang?

Untuk ruang tamu menghadap barat atau bilik yang panas setiap petang, ya. Untuk fasad utara atau selatan, kaca jernih biasanya lebih masuk akal supaya cahaya tidak hilang.

## Dapatkan ukuran dan sebut harga

Jika anda merancang skrin pancuran, tingkap aluminium baharu, partition kaca atau dinding cermin, KL Servis Rumah mengukur dan memfabrikasi di seluruh KL dan Selangor. WhatsApp foto bukaan berserta ukuran kasar — [minta sebut harga kaca & aluminium](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20kaca%20dan%20aluminium.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪玻璃与铝业工程
zh.excerpt: 淋浴屏、玻璃隔断、铝合金推拉窗与墙镜，按尺寸定制制作，服务吉隆坡与雪兰莪。从 RM 320 起。
zh.metaTitle: 玻璃与铝业工程选材、测量与规划指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪定制淋浴屏、玻璃隔断、铝合金窗与墙镜。钢化安全玻璃，现场量尺制作。从 RM 320 起。
zh.content:
玻璃与铝业是量出来的工程。没有一件是现成的：淋浴屏按你的浴室裁切，窗户按你的洞口制作，隔断按你的层高定尺。这就是为什么不同承包商报价差别很大——也是为什么现场量尺比样本册重要得多。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪制作及安装玻璃与铝制品，**RM 320** 起。无框淋浴屏 **每片 RM 420** 起，铝合金推拉窗 **每平方英尺 RM 320** 起，玻璃办公隔断 **每平方英尺 RM 220** 起，墙镜 **RM 320** 起。淋浴屏密封享 **12 个月防漏与五金保修**。

## 我们制作的项目

- **[无框淋浴屏](/zh/services/glass-aluminium/frameless-shower-screen)** — 10–12mm 钢化玻璃按浴室裁切，配隐藏铰链、滴水边与防漏密封。每片 RM 420 起。
- **[铝合金推拉窗](/zh/services/glass-aluminium/aluminium-sliding-window)** — 按洞口制作，配 5mm 白玻或茶色玻、尼龙滑轮与密封毛条。每平方英尺 RM 320 起。
- **[玻璃办公隔断](/zh/services/glass-aluminium/glass-office-partition)** — 10–12mm 钢化玻璃，配铝框或无框卡槽，含门扇与五金。每平方英尺 RM 220 起。
- **[墙镜安装](/zh/services/glass-aluminium/wall-mirror-installation)** — 5–6mm 银镜，隐蔽铝槽固定，适合浴室、健身房与更衣间。RM 320 起。

我们同时安装平开玻璃门、上悬窗、百叶窗与外开窗。

## 新做还是维修？

换新玻璃不一定是答案。我们收到的询问中，有相当一部分其实是现有窗的维修。

| 你的情况 | 正确方案 |
|---|---|
| 玻璃裂或碎，窗框完好 | [玻璃更换](/zh/services/window-repair/glass-replacement) |
| 玻璃完好但下雨渗水 | [窗户密封条更换](/zh/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement) |
| 窗扇推不动 | [推拉窗卡住](/zh/problems/sliding-window-stuck) |
| 窗框锈蚀、变形、无法调整 | 重新制作铝窗 |
| 淋浴屏底部或铰链处漏水 | [淋浴屏漏水](/zh/problems/shower-screen-leaking) |
| 尚未安装淋浴屏，或整间浴室翻新 | 新做无框淋浴屏 |

窗框若仍稳固，维修通常更快也更省。我们会在现场直说，而不是默认报整套更换。一般维修属于 [窗户维修](/zh/services/window-repair)。

## 选玻璃：厚度、安全与镀色

- **钢化玻璃** — 经热处理，破碎时形成钝角小颗粒而非尖锐碎片。淋浴屏、玻璃门与隔断必须考虑。
- **夹胶玻璃** — 两片玻璃中间夹膜，破碎后仍黏在一起。
- **10mm** — 宽度约 1.5 米以内的单块固定淋浴屏够用。
- **12mm** — 无框门、超过 1.5 米的面板与通高隔断。
- **8mm** — 有框或推拉式淋浴设计可用。
- **5mm 白玻或茶色玻** — 铝合金推拉窗的标准配置。

白玻采光最好；灰、茶、绿色镀色玻璃可降低太阳热量，是巴生谷西晒立面的常见选择；磨砂玻璃在保留采光的同时提供私密性。量尺时可看实物样品。

铝型材可选 **Akasia、Hua Ho、YKK AP**，或按指定颜色定制粉末喷涂。

## 施工流程

1. **量尺与设计** — 测量洞口，记录地面坡度、地漏位置、瓷砖接缝、墙内水管与层高等关键限制。
2. **报价与工期** — 钢化玻璃制作通常 5–7 个工作日，铝框 3–5 个工作日。
3. **工厂制作** — 玻璃裁切、钢化、磨边；铝材裁切、拼角、喷涂。钢化后无法再切割，所以量尺必须精准。
4. **现场安装** — 框架牢固固定，玻璃以垫块与结构胶安放，安装并调校五金。
5. **密封与试水** — 淋浴屏做试水测试，确认密封后交付。

## 费用

| 项目 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 玻璃与铝业工程（一般） | RM 320 起 |
| 玻璃办公隔断 | 每平方英尺 RM 220 起 |
| 铝合金推拉窗 | 每平方英尺 RM 320 起 |
| 墙镜安装 | RM 320 起 |
| 无框淋浴屏 | 每片 RM 420 起 |

最终费用随玻璃厚度、面板尺寸、五金等级、喷涂颜色与施工条件变化。高层若需电梯保护或管理处批准，会在现场勘察后报价。粗略估算可先用 [玻璃更换费用](/zh/gongju/玻璃更换费用) 或 [窗户更换估价](/zh/gongju/窗户更换估价)。

## 常见错误

- 只凭卷尺订淋浴玻璃，不看地面坡度——水往反方向流，最后怪玻璃。
- 为省钱在宽门上用 8mm 无框玻璃，长期承受晃动与铰链应力。
- 用普通玻璃胶代替防霉卫浴专用硅胶。
- 装新窗却不清理排水孔，雨水回灌到室内窗台。
- 以为窗户漏水就要换整窗，其实多半是密封条老化或排水孔堵塞。

## 常见问题

### 现有淋浴屏可以只重新打胶吗？

多数情况可以。若玻璃与框架完好，只是硅胶发黑、发霉或脱开，我们可以铲除旧胶、清理基面，再打防霉卫浴硅胶。

### 钢化玻璃要等多久？

玻璃通常 5–7 个工作日，铝框 3–5 个工作日。钢化是工厂热处理工序，无法加急，且钢化后不能再裁切。

### 我自己买的玻璃可以帮忙安装吗？

可以先看，但钢化面板尺寸与开孔是为特定五金预留的。若孔位不符，成品无法修改。我们更建议由同一方量尺与制作，责任明确。

### 巴生谷值得用茶色玻璃吗？

西晒客厅或每天下午发热的房间值得。朝北或朝南的立面通常用白玻更合适，采光不会损失。

## 预约量尺与报价

如果你打算做淋浴屏、新铝窗、玻璃隔断或镜面墙，KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供量尺与制作。WhatsApp 发洞口照片和大致尺寸 — [索取玻璃与铝业报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我需要玻璃与铝业报价。).

en.title: Glass Office Partition in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: A glass office partition should be specified as a complete system: safety-glass type and thickness, panel sizes, channels, doors, hardware, manifestation markings, ceiling support, privacy and acoustic needs. Price per square foot alone does not define performance.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Glass Office Partition in KL & Selangor | KL Servis Rumah
en.metaDesc: Practical guide to glass office partition: suitability, site checks, work steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for KL and Selangor properties.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** A glass office partition should be specified as a complete system: safety-glass type and thickness, panel sizes, channels, doors, hardware, manifestation markings, ceiling support, privacy and acoustic needs. Price per square foot alone does not define performance.

This guide explains the [Glass Office Partition](/services/glass-aluminium/glass-office-partition) scope under [glass & aluminium services](/services/glass-aluminium). The published starting price is **RM 220 / sq ft**. A site-specific quotation should confirm measurements, preparation, materials, access and related repairs rather than treating the starting rate as a fixed total.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The service is appropriate when inspection confirms that the existing property and surrounding construction can support the proposed work. Visible symptoms alone do not prove the cause. In Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, occupied areas, parking or loading access, condominium management rules and permitted working hours may affect planning and scheduling.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Floor, wall and ceiling fixing substrates.**
- **Tempered or laminated glass and panel dimensions.**
- **Door swing, access control and escape circulation.**
- **Privacy film, acoustics, sprinklers and air-conditioning.**

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **Frameless tempered** | maximum visual openness with suitable channels. |
| **Framed glazed** | more defined modules and hardware support. |
| **Laminated/acoustic** | enhanced retention or sound performance is specified. |

Choosing the least expensive option without checking its limits can cause repeat work. The quotation should explain why the selected approach suits the substrate, dimensions and intended use.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Survey structure, services and management constraints**.
2. **Approve partition plan, elevations, glass and door schedule**.
3. **Fabricate glass only after all holes and edges are final**.
4. **Install channels, panels, doors and hardware with protection**.
5. **Align, clean, apply markings and test doors and access control**.

Preparation and sequencing matter. Existing defects, unstable supports, incompatible materials or damaged substrates should be corrected before they are concealed. Protect occupied rooms, common corridors and completed finishes throughout the work. At handover, test operation and inspect edges, fixings, joints and access points—not appearance alone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Fixing a head channel only to unsupported ceiling board.
- Ordering tempered glass before site dimensions are final.
- Omitting visible manifestation at eye level.
- Expecting ordinary gaps and doors to provide acoustic privacy.

A competent inspection should distinguish a serviceable component from a system that has reached the point of replacement. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written down, especially where concealed conditions cannot be confirmed until work opens the area.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 220 / sq ft**
- Partition area, height and panel sizes.
- Glass specification, framing and finish.
- Doors, locks, closers and access control.
- Film, acoustic details, access and approvals.

The parent service publishes a **12-Month Leak-Free & Hardware Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms. Confirm in writing whether it applies to this exact work, materials supplied by the customer and pre-existing defects.

## Safety, Access and Maintenance

Do not bypass manufacturer instructions, building management requirements or safe access arrangements to save time. Keep product references and care instructions after handover. Routine cleaning and early attention to movement, moisture, corrosion or loose hardware usually make local repairs simpler.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is tempered glass enough for every office?
Not automatically. Panel size, impact risk, retention, acoustics and approved design determine whether tempered or laminated glass is appropriate.

### Can glass be cut after tempering?
No. Holes, notches and final dimensions must be completed before the tempering process.

### Will a glass wall be soundproof?
Glass can improve separation, but acoustic performance depends on glass build-up, seals, doors, perimeter gaps, ceiling voids and flanking paths.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send wide-angle and close-up photos, approximate measurements, property type and the symptom or outcome required. KL Servis Rumah can assess the scope for properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor without assuming that every site needs the same solution.

Sebut harga khusus tapak perlu mengesahkan ukuran, persediaan, bahan, akses dan pembaikan berkaitan; harga mula bukan jumlah tetap untuk semua rumah.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Servis ini sesuai apabila pemeriksaan mengesahkan hartanah dan binaan sekeliling boleh menerima kerja yang dicadangkan. Simptom yang nampak tidak semestinya membuktikan punca. Ruang yang didiami, akses parkir atau memunggah, peraturan pengurusan kondominium dan waktu kerja di KL dan Selangor boleh mempengaruhi perancangan.

## Semakan Sebelum Kerja

- **Substrat pengikat lantai, dinding dan siling.**
- **Kaca tempered atau laminated dan dimensi panel.**
- **Bukaan pintu, access control dan laluan keluar.**
- **Filem privasi, akustik, sprinkler dan aircond.**

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Tempered tanpa bingkai** | rupa terbuka dengan channel sesuai. |
| **Kaca berbingkai** | modul jelas dan sokongan perkakasan. |
| **Laminated/akustik** | retensi atau bunyi dipertingkat diperlukan. |

Pilihan termurah tidak semestinya menjimatkan jika hadnya tidak diperiksa. Sebut harga patut menerangkan sebab kaedah dipilih mengikut substrat, dimensi dan kegunaan.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Tinjau struktur, servis dan syarat pengurusan**.
2. **Lulus pelan, elevasi, kaca dan jadual pintu**.
3. **Fabrikasi kaca selepas semua lubang dan tepi muktamad**.
4. **Pasang channel, panel, pintu dan hardware dengan perlindungan**.
5. **Laras, bersih, pasang tanda dan uji pintu serta access control**.

Urutan dan persediaan penting. Kecacatan sedia ada, sokongan lemah, bahan tidak serasi atau substrat rosak perlu dibaiki sebelum ditutup. Lindungi ruang didiami, koridor bersama dan kemasan siap. Semasa serahan, uji fungsi serta periksa tepi, pengikat, sambungan dan titik akses—bukan rupa sahaja.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Memasang head channel pada papan siling tanpa sokongan.
- Menempah tempered sebelum dimensi muktamad.
- Tidak memasang tanda visual pada paras mata.
- Mengharap jurang dan pintu biasa memberi privasi bunyi.

Pemeriksaan yang baik membezakan komponen yang masih boleh dibaiki daripada sistem yang patut diganti. Minta andaian dan pengecualian ditulis, khususnya untuk keadaan tersembunyi yang hanya diketahui selepas kawasan dibuka.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 220 / kaki persegi**
- Keluasan, tinggi dan saiz panel.
- Spesifikasi kaca, bingkai dan kemasan.
- Pintu, lock, closer dan access control.
- Filem, perincian akustik, akses dan kelulusan.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Bebas Bocor & Perkakasan 12 Bulan**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma. Sahkan secara bertulis sama ada ia meliputi kerja ini, bahan pelanggan dan kecacatan sedia ada.

## Keselamatan, Akses dan Penjagaan

Jangan abaikan arahan pengeluar, syarat pengurusan bangunan atau akses selamat untuk menjimatkan masa. Simpan rujukan produk dan arahan penjagaan. Pembersihan berkala serta tindakan awal terhadap lembapan, pergerakan, karat atau hardware longgar memudahkan pembaikan setempat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Adakah tempered cukup untuk semua pejabat?
Tidak semestinya. Saiz panel, risiko impak, retensi, akustik dan reka bentuk menentukan pilihan.

### Boleh potong kaca selepas tempered?
Tidak. Lubang, notch dan dimensi mesti siap sebelum proses tempered.

### Adakah dinding kaca soundproof?
Prestasi bergantung pada binaan kaca, seal, pintu, jurang perimeter, ruang siling dan laluan sisi.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar foto sudut luas dan dekat, ukuran anggaran, jenis hartanah serta simptom atau hasil yang diperlukan. KL Servis Rumah boleh menilai skop di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor tanpa menganggap semua tapak memerlukan penyelesaian sama.
