会。如果我们正在湿区铺瓷砖，会涂刷防水层以防止未来漏水。

### 翻新需要多长时间？

单个浴室或厨房翻新通常需要几周，具体取决于范围和材料。

## 获取厨房与浴室翻新报价

让您的厨房和浴室焕然一新，无需全屋装修。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供专业翻新服务。WhatsApp联系我们获取免费咨询——[与我们的团队联系](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E5%8E%A8%E6%88%BF%E6%88%96%E6%B5%B4%E5%AE%A4%E7%BF%BB%E6%96%B0%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Kitchen Cabinet & Countertop Services in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Custom and modular kitchen cabinets with stone, solid surface or laminate countertops across KL & Selangor — design, supply and installation from RM 7,500.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Kitchen Cabinet & Countertop Services in KL
en.metaDesc: Modular and custom kitchen cabinets in KL & Selangor — Häfele/Blum hardware, plywood or melamine carcass, quartz or granite tops. From RM 7,500.
en.content:
A kitchen cabinet is the working furniture of a Malaysian home. It has to hold heavy crockery, survive daily cooking steam, and stay square in Klang Valley humidity. KL Servis Rumah designs, supplies and installs kitchen cabinets and countertops across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, from a 10 ft modular L-shape to a full custom plywood kitchen.

**Direct answer:** Most landed and condo kitchens in KL are fitted as either a modular system (faster, lower cost, standard boxes) or a custom plywood kitchen (built to the exact wall, ceiling and pipe positions). Both can use laminate, acrylic or spray-painted doors, with quartz or granite tops. Published starting prices begin at **RM 7,500** for a modular 10 ft L-shape.

This guide explains the options, what actually lasts in Malaysian kitchens, and how a professional install is done.

## Kitchen cabinet services we provide

- **[Modular kitchen cabinet (10 ft L-shape)](/services/kitchen-cabinet/modular-kitchen-cabinet-10ft-l-shape)** — Häfele or Blum hardware with an 18 mm melamine carcass and laminate, acrylic or spray-painted doors. From RM 7,500.
- **[Custom plywood kitchen](/services/kitchen-cabinet/custom-plywood-kitchen)** — built-to-fit plywood carcass with soft-close hardware, custom doors and full-height pantry units. From RM 11,000.
- **[Quartz / granite countertop](/services/kitchen-cabinet/quartz-granite-countertop)** — Caesarstone, Silestone or local granite with undermount sink cutout and sealed joins. From RM 220 / linier ft.
- **Kitchen makeover (doors & hardware only)** — new doors, drawer fronts, handles, hinges and runners on an existing carcass. From RM 4,200.

If you are also changing tiles, plumbing or the room layout, a [kitchen and bathroom makeover](/services/house-renovation/kitchen-and-bathroom-makeover) or a [full house renovation](/services/house-renovation) may be the cleaner path.

## Modular vs custom plywood — which kitchen is right?

| | Modular | Custom plywood |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Standard L, U or straight kitchens | Odd corners, low beams, full-height pantry, unusual pipe positions |
| Carcass | 18 mm melamine boxes | Moisture-resistant plywood, cut to the wall |
| Lead time | Shorter once the design is locked | Longer — typically 3–4 weeks in the workshop |
| Install | Often about 1 day for a standard run | 1–2 days plus countertop templating |
| Starting price | From RM 7,500 (10 ft L-shape) | From RM 11,000 |
| Strength | Consistent factory quality | Better screw-holding and repairability over 10+ years |

Neither option is “cheap kitchen” versus “luxury kitchen”. A well-specified modular kitchen with Blum hinges and a quartz top will outlast a poorly built plywood kitchen with no edge banding and no soft-close. The decision is about fit, access and how long you plan to stay.

For a material-by-material comparison of carcass and door boards, read our [kitchen cabinet material guide for Malaysian homes](/blog/kitchen-cabinet-material-guide-malaysia).

## What lasts in a Malaysian kitchen

Klang Valley kitchens fail in predictable ways: swollen carcass edges near the sink, peeling door film next to the hob, sagging hinges, and countertops that stain or crack at the sink cutout.

Professionals normally specify:

- **Moisture-resistant carcass** near the sink, dishwasher and hob — not raw particleboard with exposed edges.
- **Soft-close hinges and runners** (Häfele or Blum are the usual specification on our quotes) so doors do not slam and drawers stay aligned.
- **Proper edge banding** on every exposed board edge. Unbanded edges absorb steam first.
- **A heat gap and filler panel** beside the oven or hob so the door finish does not cook.
- **A countertop that matches how you cook** — granite for high heat and unique stone; engineered quartz for a non-porous, consistent colour.

If cabinet doors already sit crooked or will not close, that is usually hardware or a swollen box, not “the kitchen is finished”. See our guide on a [misaligned kitchen cabinet door](/problems/kitchen-cabinet-door-misaligned).

## When to replace the kitchen — and when a door makeover is enough

Replace the full kitchen when:

- The carcass is swollen, delaminated or infested.
- You need a new layout, taller units, or a full-height pantry.
- Plumbing or electrical points must move with the cabinets.
- You want a new countertop that the old boxes cannot support.

A **doors-and-hardware makeover** (from RM 4,200) is enough when the boxes are still square, dry and firmly fixed. New doors, soft-close hinges and runners can make a 10-year-old kitchen look current without a full demolition.

## How a kitchen cabinet job is done

1. **Site measurement and design brief** — we measure walls, ceiling height, window, pipes, gas point and electrical points. You confirm layout (L, U, island, straight), storage needs and finish.
2. **Design and quotation** — you receive an itemised quote: carcass, doors, hardware brand, countertop, sink cutout, and any plumbing or electrical work.
3. **Manufacturing** — modular boxes are ordered or assembled to the locked design. Custom plywood is cut and edged in the workshop (typically 3–4 weeks).
4. **Demolition and prep** — old units come out, services are isolated, and the wall line is checked. Waterproofing or tiling in the wet zone is completed first if it is in scope.
5. **Installation and handover** — cabinets are levelled, scribed to the wall, hardware is adjusted, the countertop is templated and fitted, and you walk through every door and drawer.

Typical design-to-handover time for a full kitchen is **6 to 10 weeks**, depending on countertop lead time and whether plumbing or electrical points move.

## How much do kitchen cabinets cost in KL & Selangor?

| Service | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Modular kitchen cabinet (10 ft L-shape) | From RM 7,500 |
| Custom plywood kitchen | From RM 11,000 |
| Quartz / granite countertop | From RM 220 / linier ft |
| Kitchen makeover (doors & hardware only) | From RM 4,200 |

The final figure depends on run length, door finish (laminate vs acrylic vs spray paint), hardware grade, countertop stone, and whether we must relocate the sink, hob or hood. We quote a fixed, itemised price before manufacturing starts. Cabinet structure is covered by a **5-year structure warranty**.

## What we check on site before quoting

- Wall plumb and floor level — out-of-square walls need scribing or a filler strategy.
- Existing water, gas and electrical points — moving them is a separate, written variation.
- Condo management rules — work hours, lift booking and debris disposal.
- Hood and hob clearances so the new run does not block a window or breaker.
- Whether the existing carcass can be reused for a door-only makeover.

Related trades we coordinate when needed: [plumbing](/services/plumbing) for sink and dishwasher points, [electrical](/services/electrical) for hob, hood and under-cabinet lighting, and [tiling](/services/tiling) for a new splashback.

## Common mistakes we see

- Ordering cabinets from a photo without measuring the actual pipe and window positions.
- Choosing a high-gloss door next to a wok burner with no heat shield.
- Skipping a countertop template and cutting the sink hole on site “by eye”.
- Replacing doors on a swollen carcass — the new doors will still sit out of line.
- Leaving the old silicone line under a new top, which traps water at the back splash.

## Frequently asked questions

### Modular or custom plywood — which should I choose?

Choose modular if your kitchen is a standard L, U or straight run and you want a faster, lower starting price. Choose custom plywood if walls are out of square, you need full-height pantry units, or you want the carcass built around existing pipes and beams.

### What countertop is most common in Malaysian homes?

Local granite is still widely used because it handles heat well. Engineered quartz (Caesarstone, Silestone) is the usual premium choice when you want a non-porous, consistent colour and a cleaner undermount sink.

### Can you keep my existing boxes and only change the doors?

Yes, if the carcass is still dry and square. That is the door-and-hardware makeover, from RM 4,200.

### How long does a full kitchen take?

Usually 6 to 10 weeks from design lock to handover: design, manufacturing, demolition, cabinet install, then countertop template and fit.

### Do you work in condos?

Yes. We follow management work hours, protect the lift, and remove debris. Measurement and install are planned around your building’s booking slots.

## Get a kitchen cabinet quote

If your kitchen is swollen, outdated, or no longer fits how you cook, KL Servis Rumah can measure the space and quote a modular or custom kitchen for homes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us with photos and an approximate run length — [request a kitchen cabinet quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20kitchen%20cabinets.).

ms.title: Perkhidmatan Kabinet Dapur & Permukaan Kaunter di Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Kabinet dapur modular dan kustom dengan permukaan kaunter batu, solid surface atau laminate di seluruh KL & Selangor — reka bentuk, bekalan dan pemasangan dari RM 7,500.
ms.metaTitle: Kabinet Dapur & Kaunter di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Kabinet dapur modular dan kustom di KL & Selangor — perkakasan Häfele/Blum, badan melamin atau papan lapis, kaunter kuarza atau granit. Dari RM 7,500.
ms.content:
Kabinet dapur ialah perabot yang paling kerap digunakan di rumah Malaysia. Ia perlu menanggung pinggan mangkuk berat, wap masakan harian, dan kekal lurus dalam kelembapan Lembah Klang. KL Servis Rumah mereka, membekal dan memasang kabinet dapur serta permukaan kaunter di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor.

**Jawapan terus:** Kebanyakan dapur rumah teres dan kondominium di KL dipasang sebagai sistem **modular** (lebih pantas, harga permulaan lebih rendah) atau **dapur papan lapis kustom** (dibina mengikut dinding, siling dan kedudukan paip sebenar). Kedua-duanya boleh guna pintu laminate, akrilik atau cat sembur, dengan kaunter kuarza atau granit. Harga permulaan rasmi bermula **RM 7,500** untuk L-shape modular 10 kaki.

## Perkhidmatan kabinet dapur yang kami sediakan

- **[Kabinet dapur modular (L-shape 10 kaki)](/ms/services/kitchen-cabinet/modular-kitchen-cabinet-10ft-l-shape)** — perkakasan Häfele atau Blum, badan melamin 18 mm, pintu laminate, akrilik atau cat sembur. Dari RM 7,500.
- **[Dapur papan lapis kustom](/ms/services/kitchen-cabinet/custom-plywood-kitchen)** — badan papan lapis ikut ukuran, perkakasan soft-close, pintu kustom dan unit pantry penuh tinggi. Dari RM 11,000.
- **[Permukaan kaunter kuarza / granit](/ms/services/kitchen-cabinet/quartz-granite-countertop)** — Caesarstone, Silestone atau granit tempatan dengan potongan sinki undermount. Dari RM 220 / kaki linier.
- **Makeover dapur (pintu & perkakasan sahaja)** — pintu, hadapan laci, pemegang, engsel dan runner baharu pada badan sedia ada. Dari RM 4,200.

Jika anda juga menukar jubin, paip atau susun atur bilik, lihat [makeover dapur dan bilik mandi](/ms/services/house-renovation/kitchen-and-bathroom-makeover) atau [pengubahsuaian rumah penuh](/ms/services/house-renovation).

## Modular lawan papan lapis kustom

| | Modular | Papan lapis kustom |
|---|---|---|
| Sesuai untuk | Dapur L, U atau lurus yang standard | Sudut ganjil, rasuk rendah, pantry penuh tinggi |
| Badan | Kotak melamin 18 mm | Papan lapis kalis lembapan, potong ikut dinding |
| Masa siap | Lebih singkat selepas reka bentuk dikunci | Biasanya 3–4 minggu di bengkel |
| Harga mula | Dari RM 7,500 (L-shape 10 kaki) | Dari RM 11,000 |

Kabinet modular yang baik dengan engsel Blum dan kaunter kuarza boleh lebih tahan daripada dapur “kustom” yang tepi papan tidak diband dan tiada soft-close. Keputusan bergantung pada bentuk bilik dan berapa lama anda mahu tinggal.

Untuk perbandingan bahan badan dan pintu, baca [panduan bahan kabinet dapur Malaysia](/ms/blog/panduan-bahan-kabinet-dapur-malaysia).

## Apa yang tahan di dapur Malaysia

Dapur Lembah Klang biasanya rosak begini: tepi badan menggelembung dekat sinki, filem pintu mengelupas dekat dapur gas, engsel kendur, dan kaunter retak di potongan sinki.

Spesifikasi yang biasanya kami tetapkan:

- Badan tahan lembapan dekat sinki, mesin basuh pinggan dan dapur gas.
- Engsel dan runner soft-close Häfele atau Blum.
- Edge banding lengkap pada setiap tepi papan.
- Jurang haba dan panel pengisi di sisi ketuhar atau hob.
- Kaunter yang sepadan dengan cara anda memasak — granit untuk haba tinggi; kuarza untuk permukaan tidak berliang.

Jika pintu kabinet sudah senget atau tidak tutup, itu biasanya perkakasan atau kotak menggelembung — lihat [pintu kabinet dapur tidak sejajar](/ms/problems/kitchen-cabinet-door-misaligned).

## Bila perlu tukar dapur penuh — dan bila makeover pintu cukup

Tukar dapur penuh jika badan sudah menggelembung atau terkelupas, susun atur perlu berubah, atau paip/elektrik mesti berpindah bersama kabinet.

**Makeover pintu dan perkakasan** (dari RM 4,200) cukup jika kotak masih lurus, kering dan terpasang kukuh.

## Cara kerja pemasangan kabinet dapur

1. **Ukur tapak dan brief reka bentuk** — dinding, tinggi siling, tingkap, paip, gas dan titik elektrik.
2. **Reka bentuk dan sebut harga** — badan, pintu, jenama perkakasan, kaunter, potongan sinki, dan sebarang kerja paip atau elektrik.
3. **Pembuatan** — kotak modular disediakan; papan lapis kustom dipotong di bengkel (biasanya 3–4 minggu).
4. **Roboh dan sediakan** — unit lama dikeluarkan; kalis air atau jubin zon basah siap dahulu jika termasuk skop.
5. **Pemasangan dan serahan** — kabinet diratakan, discribe ke dinding, perkakasan dilaras, kaunter dittemplat dan dipasang.

Tempoh biasa dari reka bentuk hingga serahan ialah **6 hingga 10 minggu**.

## Berapa kos kabinet dapur di KL & Selangor?

| Perkhidmatan | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Kabinet dapur modular (L-shape 10 kaki) | Dari RM 7,500 |
| Dapur papan lapis kustom | Dari RM 11,000 |
| Permukaan kaunter kuarza / granit | Dari RM 220 / kaki linier |
| Makeover pintu & perkakasan | Dari RM 4,200 |

Angka akhir bergantung pada panjang larian, kemasan pintu, gred perkakasan, batu kaunter, dan sama ada sinki, hob atau hood perlu dipindah. Harga tetap dan terperinci sebelum pembuatan. Struktur kabinet dilindungi **jaminan struktur 5 tahun**.

## Apa yang kami periksa di tapak

- Dinding lurus dan lantai rata.
- Titik air, gas dan elektrik sedia ada — pemindahan ialah variasi bertulis.
- Peraturan pengurusan kondominium — waktu kerja, tempahan lif, serpihan.
- Jarak hood dan hob supaya larian baharu tidak menutup tingkap atau papan suis.

Perdagangan berkaitan: [paip](/ms/services/plumbing), [elektrik](/ms/services/electrical), dan [jubin](/ms/services/tiling) untuk backsplash.

## Soalan lazim

### Modular atau papan lapis kustom — mana patut saya pilih?

Pilih modular jika dapur anda L, U atau lurus yang biasa dan anda mahu harga mula lebih rendah. Pilih papan lapis kustom jika dinding tidak lurus, ada rasuk, atau anda mahu pantry penuh tinggi.

### Kaunter apa paling biasa di rumah Malaysia?

Granit tempatan masih banyak digunakan kerana tahan haba. Kuarza kejuruteraan (Caesarstone, Silestone) biasa dipilih jika anda mahu warna sekata dan sinki undermount yang kemas.

### Boleh kekalkan kotak lama dan tukar pintu sahaja?

Boleh, jika badan masih kering dan lurus. Itu makeover pintu dan perkakasan, dari RM 4,200.

### Adakah anda kerja di kondominium?

Ya. Kami ikut waktu kerja pengurusan, melindungi lif, dan mengangkut serpihan.

## Dapatkan sebut harga kabinet dapur

Jika dapur anda menggelembung, ketinggalan zaman, atau tidak lagi sesuai cara anda memasak, KL Servis Rumah boleh mengukur dan memberi sebut harga di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor. WhatsApp gambar dan anggaran panjang larian — [minta sebut harga kabinet dapur](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20mahu%20sebut%20harga%20kabinet%20dapur.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪厨房橱柜与台面服务
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪的模块化与定制厨房橱柜，配石材、实体面材或防火板台面——设计、供应与安装，从 RM 7,500 起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪厨房橱柜与台面
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪模块化与定制厨房橱柜——Häfele/Blum 五金、防火板或胶合板柜体、石英或花岗岩台面。从 RM 7,500 起。
zh.content:
厨房橱柜是马来西亚家里用得最狠的家具。它要承受沉重餐具、每天炒菜的蒸汽，还要在巴生谷的湿度里保持方正。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供厨房橱柜与台面的设计、供应与安装。

**直接回答：** 吉隆坡多数排屋与公寓厨房，会做成**模块化系统**（更快、起步价更低）或**定制胶合板厨房**（按实际墙面、天花与管道位置制作）。两种都可以配防火板、亚克力或喷漆门板，台面用石英石或花岗岩。公布的起步价为 10 英尺 L 型模块化厨房 **RM 7,500 起**。

## 我们提供的厨房橱柜服务

- **[模块化厨房橱柜（10 英尺 L 型）](/zh/services/kitchen-cabinet/modular-kitchen-cabinet-10ft-l-shape)** — Häfele 或 Blum 五金、18 mm 防火板柜体，门板可选防火板、亚克力或喷漆。从 RM 7,500 起。
- **[定制胶合板厨房](/zh/services/kitchen-cabinet/custom-plywood-kitchen)** — 按尺寸制作的胶合板柜体、阻尼五金、定制门板与通顶储物柜。从 RM 11,000 起。
- **[石英石 / 花岗岩台面](/zh/services/kitchen-cabinet/quartz-granite-countertop)** — Caesarstone、Silestone 或本地花岗岩，含台下盆开孔。从 RM 220 / 延英尺起。
- **厨房翻新（仅门板与五金）** — 在现有柜体上更换门板、抽面、拉手、铰链与滑轨。从 RM 4,200 起。

如果还要改瓷砖、水管或房间布局，请看 [厨房与卫生间翻新](/zh/services/house-renovation/kitchen-and-bathroom-makeover) 或 [全屋翻新](/zh/services/house-renovation)。

## 模块化还是定制胶合板

| | 模块化 | 定制胶合板 |
|---|---|---|
| 适合 | 标准 L、U 或一字型厨房 | 异形转角、低梁、通顶储物 |
| 柜体 | 18 mm 防火板箱体 | 防潮胶合板，按墙裁切 |
| 工期 | 设计锁定后更快 | 车间通常 3–4 周 |
| 起步价 | 从 RM 7,500（10 英尺 L 型） | 从 RM 11,000 |

一套五金到位、台面用石英石的模块化厨房，往往比封边不到位、没有阻尼的“定制厨房”更耐用。材料对比见 [马来西亚厨房柜体材料指南](/zh/bo-ke/ma-lai-xi-ya-chu-fang-gui-ban-cai-liao-zhi-nan)。

## 马来西亚厨房里真正耐用的做法

巴生谷厨房常见损坏：水槽旁柜体涨边、炉灶旁门板膜脱落、铰链下垂、水槽开孔处台面开裂。

我们通常会规定：

- 水槽、洗碗机与炉灶旁使用防潮柜体。
- Häfele 或 Blum 阻尼铰链与滑轨。
- 所有板边完整封边。
- 烤箱或炉灶旁留隔热缝与填充板。
- 台面按烹饪方式选择——耐热选花岗岩；要致密、颜色均匀选石英石。

柜门已经歪斜或关不严，多半是五金或箱体受潮。见 [厨房柜门错位](/zh/problems/kitchen-cabinet-door-misaligned)。

## 何时整厨更换，何时只换门就够

柜体已涨、脱层，或布局、水电必须跟着柜子走，就整厨更换。

箱体仍方正、干燥、固定牢固时，**门板与五金翻新**（从 RM 4,200 起）通常就够。

## 厨房橱柜怎么做

1. **现场测量与设计简报** — 墙、层高、窗、水管、煤气与电点。
2. **设计与报价** — 柜体、门板、五金品牌、台面、水槽开孔及任何水电改动。
3. **制作** — 模块化箱体备货；定制胶合板在车间裁切（通常 3–4 周）。
4. **拆除与基层** — 旧柜拆除；湿区防水或瓷砖如在范围内先完成。
5. **安装与交付** — 找平、靠墙修边、调五金、台面取模安装。

从设计到交付一般 **6 到 10 周**。

## 吉隆坡与雪兰莪厨房橱柜多少钱？

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 模块化厨房橱柜（10 英尺 L 型） | 从 RM 7,500 起 |
| 定制胶合板厨房 | 从 RM 11,000 起 |
| 石英石 / 花岗岩台面 | 从 RM 220 / 延英尺起 |
| 门板与五金翻新 | 从 RM 4,200 起 |

最终价格取决于柜体长度、门板饰面、五金等级、台面石材，以及水槽、炉灶或烟机是否移位。开工制作前给出固定分项报价。柜体结构享有 **5 年结构保修**。

相关工种：[水管](/zh/services/plumbing)、[电工](/zh/services/electrical)、[瓷砖](/zh/services/tiling)。

## 常见问题

### 模块化和定制胶合板怎么选？

房间是常规 L、U 或一字型、想要更低起步价，选模块化。墙不方、有梁、或要通顶储物，选定制胶合板。

### 马来西亚家里最常见的台面？

本地花岗岩仍很常见，因为耐热。工程石英石（Caesarstone、Silestone）适合要颜色均匀和台下盆的业主。

### 可以只换门、留旧柜体吗？

可以，只要柜体仍干燥方正。这就是门板与五金翻新，从 RM 4,200 起。

### 公寓能做吗？

可以。我们遵守管理处工时、保护电梯并清运废料。

## 获取厨房橱柜报价

如果厨房已经涨柜、过时，或不再符合您的烹饪方式，KL Servis Rumah 可在吉隆坡与雪兰莪上门测量报价。WhatsApp 照片与大约柜长 — [索取厨房橱柜报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我想咨询厨房橱柜报价。).

en.title: Kitchen Makeover: Doors and Hardware Only in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Replacing doors, drawer fronts, handles, hinges and runners is sensible only when the existing cabinet carcasses are dry, square and firmly fixed. Swollen boards, active sink leaks, termite damage or badly distorted boxes require repair or replacement before refacing.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Kitchen Door & Hardware Makeover Service in KL
en.metaDesc: Practical guide to kitchen makeover: doors and hardware only: suitability, site checks, work steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for KL and Selangor properties.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** Replacing doors, drawer fronts, handles, hinges and runners is sensible only when the existing cabinet carcasses are dry, square and firmly fixed. Swollen boards, active sink leaks, termite damage or badly distorted boxes require repair or replacement before refacing.

This guide explains the [Kitchen Makeover: Doors and Hardware Only](/services/kitchen-cabinet/kitchen-makeover-doors-and-hardware-only) scope under [kitchen cabinet services](/services/kitchen-cabinet). The published starting price is **RM 4,200**. A site-specific quotation should confirm measurements, preparation, materials, access and related repairs rather than treating the starting rate as a fixed total.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The service is appropriate when inspection confirms that the existing property and surrounding construction can support the proposed work. Visible symptoms alone do not prove the cause. In Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, occupied areas, parking or loading access, condominium management rules and permitted working hours may affect planning and scheduling.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Swelling, delamination and musty odour below the sink.**
- **Cabinet boxes are square and securely fixed.**
- **Hinge cup positions and compatibility with new doors.**
- **Drawer box condition, runner length and clearances.**

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **Reface doors/hardware** | carcasses are sound and layout already works. |
| **Repair then reface** | damage is isolated and can be structurally restored. |
| **Replace cabinets** | swelling, pests or distortion is widespread. |

Choosing the least expensive option without checking its limits can cause repeat work. The quotation should explain why the selected approach suits the substrate, dimensions and intended use.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Inventory every door, drawer and hardware type**.
2. **Confirm carcass condition and stop moisture sources**.
3. **Approve door sample, colour, edge and handle position**.
4. **Fabricate and label fronts before removing the old set**.
5. **Install, align gaps and test hinges and runners under load**.

Preparation and sequencing matter. Existing defects, unstable supports, incompatible materials or damaged substrates should be corrected before they are concealed. Protect occupied rooms, common corridors and completed finishes throughout the work. At handover, test operation and inspect edges, fixings, joints and access points—not appearance alone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Refacing over water-damaged particleboard.
- Reusing worn hinges with heavier new doors.
- Choosing colour from a phone screen instead of a physical sample.
- Changing handles without checking old hole spacing.

A competent inspection should distinguish a serviceable component from a system that has reached the point of replacement. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written down, especially where concealed conditions cannot be confirmed until work opens the area.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 4,200**
- Door and drawer count and dimensions.
- Finish, edge profile and handle specification.
- Hinge and runner quantity and grade.
- Carcass repairs, removal and disposal.

The parent service publishes a **5-Year Cabinet Structure Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms. Confirm in writing whether it applies to this exact work, materials supplied by the customer and pre-existing defects.

## Safety, Access and Maintenance

Do not bypass manufacturer instructions, building management requirements or safe access arrangements to save time. Keep product references and care instructions after handover. Routine cleaning and early attention to movement, moisture, corrosion or loose hardware usually make local repairs simpler.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can the countertop stay?
Usually yes when it and the base cabinets are sound; the survey must confirm that door and drawer work will not disturb its support.

### Will new doors hide swollen cabinets?
They may hide the appearance briefly but will not restore strength or stop moisture. The cause and damaged board need attention.

### Can soft-close be added?
Often yes if hinge geometry and drawer clearances are compatible; it should be specified after measuring the existing boxes.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send wide-angle and close-up photos, approximate measurements, property type and the symptom or outcome required. KL Servis Rumah can assess the scope for properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor without assuming that every site needs the same solution.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quotation%20for%20Kitchen%20Makeover%3A%20Doors%20and%20Hardware%20Only.).

**Jawapan ringkas:** Mengganti pintu, muka laci, pemegang, engsel dan runner berbaloi hanya apabila carcass sedia ada kering, tepat dan kukuh. Papan kembang, bocor singki aktif, kerosakan anai-anai atau kotak berubah bentuk perlu dibaiki atau diganti dahulu.

Panduan ini menerangkan skop [Makeover Dapur: Pintu dan Perkakasan Sahaja](/ms/services/kitchen-cabinet/kitchen-makeover-doors-and-hardware-only) di bawah [perkhidmatan kabinet dapur](/ms/services/kitchen-cabinet). Harga permulaan yang diterbitkan ialah **RM 4,200**. Sebut harga khusus tapak perlu mengesahkan ukuran, persediaan, bahan, akses dan pembaikan berkaitan; harga mula bukan jumlah tetap untuk semua rumah.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Servis ini sesuai apabila pemeriksaan mengesahkan hartanah dan binaan sekeliling boleh menerima kerja yang dicadangkan. Simptom yang nampak tidak semestinya membuktikan punca. Ruang yang didiami, akses parkir atau memunggah, peraturan pengurusan kondominium dan waktu kerja di KL dan Selangor boleh mempengaruhi perancangan.

## Semakan Sebelum Kerja

- **Kembang, nyahlamina dan bau hapak bawah singki.**
- **Kotak kabinet tepat dan terikat kukuh.**
- **Posisi cup engsel dan keserasian pintu baharu.**
- **Keadaan kotak laci, panjang runner dan ruang.**

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Tukar pintu/perkakasan** | carcass kukuh dan susun atur sesuai. |
| **Baiki kemudian tukar** | kerosakan setempat boleh dipulihkan. |
| **Ganti kabinet** | kembang, perosak atau herotan meluas. |

Pilihan termurah tidak semestinya menjimatkan jika hadnya tidak diperiksa. Sebut harga patut menerangkan sebab kaedah dipilih mengikut substrat, dimensi dan kegunaan.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Senaraikan setiap pintu, laci dan jenis perkakasan**.
2. **Sahkan carcass dan hentikan punca lembapan**.
3. **Lulus sampel pintu, warna, tepi dan posisi pemegang**.
4. **Fabrikasi dan label muka sebelum buka set lama**.
5. **Pasang, laras jurang dan uji engsel serta runner**.

Urutan dan persediaan penting. Kecacatan sedia ada, sokongan lemah, bahan tidak serasi atau substrat rosak perlu dibaiki sebelum ditutup. Lindungi ruang didiami, koridor bersama dan kemasan siap. Semasa serahan, uji fungsi serta periksa tepi, pengikat, sambungan dan titik akses—bukan rupa sahaja.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Menukar muka di atas particleboard rosak air.
- Guna engsel haus dengan pintu baharu lebih berat.
- Pilih warna dari skrin telefon sahaja.
- Tukar pemegang tanpa semak jarak lubang lama.

Pemeriksaan yang baik membezakan komponen yang masih boleh dibaiki daripada sistem yang patut diganti. Minta andaian dan pengecualian ditulis, khususnya untuk keadaan tersembunyi yang hanya diketahui selepas kawasan dibuka.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 4,200**
- Bilangan serta dimensi pintu dan laci.
- Kemasan, profil tepi dan spesifikasi pemegang.
- Kuantiti serta gred engsel dan runner.
- Pembaikan carcass, buka dan pelupusan.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Struktur Kabinet 5 Tahun**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma. Sahkan secara bertulis sama ada ia meliputi kerja ini, bahan pelanggan dan kecacatan sedia ada.

## Keselamatan, Akses dan Penjagaan

Jangan abaikan arahan pengeluar, syarat pengurusan bangunan atau akses selamat untuk menjimatkan masa. Simpan rujukan produk dan arahan penjagaan. Pembersihan berkala serta tindakan awal terhadap lembapan, pergerakan, karat atau hardware longgar memudahkan pembaikan setempat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Boleh kekalkan kaunter?
Biasanya boleh jika kaunter dan kabinet bawah kukuh; tinjauan perlu sahkan kerja tidak mengganggu sokongan.

### Adakah pintu baharu menutup kabinet kembang?
Ia mungkin menutup rupa sementara tetapi tidak memulihkan kekuatan atau menghentikan lembapan.

### Boleh tambah soft-close?
Selalunya boleh jika geometri engsel dan ruang laci serasi; tentukan selepas ukuran.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar foto sudut luas dan dekat, ukuran anggaran, jenis hartanah serta simptom atau hasil yang diperlukan. KL Servis Rumah boleh menilai skop di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor tanpa menganggap semua tapak memerlukan penyelesaian sama.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hai%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20Makeover%20Dapur%3A%20Pintu%20dan%20Perkakasan%20Sahaja.).

zh.title: 厨房翻新：仅更换门板与五金：吉隆坡与雪兰莪指南
zh.excerpt: 只有旧柜体干燥、方正且固定牢靠时，更换门板、抽屉面、把手、铰链和滑轨才划算。板材泡胀、水槽仍漏水、白蚁损坏或柜箱严重变形时，应先维修或更换柜体。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪厨房翻新：仅更换门板与五金
zh.metaDesc: 了解厨房翻新：仅更换门板与五金的适用条件、现场检查、施工步骤、常见错误与报价因素，适合吉隆坡及雪兰莪住宅和商业物业。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**只有旧柜体干燥、方正且固定牢靠时，更换门板、抽屉面、把手、铰链和滑轨才划算。板材泡胀、水槽仍漏水、白蚁损坏或柜箱严重变形时，应先维修或更换柜体。

本文说明[厨房翻新：仅更换门板与五金](/zh/services/kitchen-cabinet/kitchen-makeover-doors-and-hardware-only)子服务，属于[厨房橱柜服务](/zh/services/kitchen-cabinet)。已公布起价为 **RM 4,200**。现场报价应明确尺寸、基层处理、材料、施工通道和相关维修；起价不是每个物业的固定总价。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

只有检查确认物业及周边构造能够承受拟议工程时，这项服务才适合；肉眼看到的症状不一定就是根因。吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的入住情况、停车与卸货通道、公寓管理规定及施工时段，都可能影响规划和排期。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **水槽下方是否泡胀、脱层或有霉味。**
- **柜箱是否方正并固定牢靠。**
- **铰杯位置及新门板兼容性。**
- **抽屉箱、滑轨长度及净空。**

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **换门板五金** | 柜体完好且布局合用。 |
| **先修后换** | 局部损坏可可靠修复。 |
| **更换柜体** | 泡胀、虫害或变形范围广。 |

若不先了解限制，最便宜的方案可能造成重复施工。报价应说明选定方法为何适合现场基层、尺寸和实际用途。

## 常见施工流程

1. **逐一记录门板、抽屉及五金类型**。
2. **确认柜体状况并解决潮气来源**。
3. **确认门板样品、颜色、封边及把手位置**。
4. **新面板制作编号后再拆旧件**。
5. **安装调缝，并在负载下测试铰链滑轨**。

基层准备和工序先后很重要。原有缺陷、薄弱支撑、不兼容材料或损坏基层，应在封闭前处理。施工期间保护已入住空间、公共走廊及已完成饰面。验收不能只看外观，还要测试功能，并检查边缘、固定件、接缝和检修点。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 在泡水刨花板上直接翻新。
- 重门板继续使用磨损铰链。
- 仅看手机屏幕选色。
- 换把手前不核对旧孔距。

合适的检查应区分“仍可维修的部件”与“已应更换的系统”。对于只有拆开后才能确认的隐藏状况，应要求把报价假设和不包含项目写清楚。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 4,200**
- 门板抽屉数量及尺寸。
- 饰面、边型及把手规格。
- 铰链滑轨数量及等级。
- 柜体维修、拆除及清运。

其主服务公布 **5 年柜体结构保修**，具体按适用范围和条款执行。请书面确认是否涵盖本次工程、客户自购材料及原有缺陷。

## 安全、进场与保养

不要为了省时而绕过厂家说明、管理处规定或安全通道安排。完工后保留产品资料和护理说明。定期清洁，并及早处理潮气、位移、锈蚀或五金松动，通常能让局部维修更简单。

## 常见问题

### 台面可以保留吗？
若台面和地柜都完好，通常可以；勘察须确认换门抽不会影响承托。

### 新门板能遮住泡胀柜体吗？
只能暂时遮丑，不能恢复强度或阻止潮气；必须处理原因和受损板材。

### 可以升级缓冲五金吗？
若铰链结构和抽屉净空兼容，通常可以；应实测旧柜箱后确定。

## 获取针对现场的报价

发送广角与近照、估算尺寸、物业类型，以及遇到的症状或希望达到的效果。KL Servis Rumah 可评估吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的实际范围，不会假定每个现场都需要同一方案。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%8E%A8%E6%88%BF%E7%BF%BB%E6%96%B0%EF%BC%9A%E4%BB%85%E6%9B%B4%E6%8D%A2%E9%97%A8%E6%9D%BF%E4%B8%8E%E4%BA%94%E9%87%91%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Laminate Door Installation Cost Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: HDF-skin engineered laminate doors in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor — a stable, modern bedroom and condo door. Supply and hang from RM 250.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Laminate Door Installation Cost Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Engineered laminate doors for condos and homes in KL & Selangor. Smooth HDF-skin finish, hung and lock-fitted from RM 250.
en.content:
A laminate door (engineered door with an HDF skin and laminate face) is the usual bedroom and store-room leaf in Malaysian condos. It is lighter than solid meranti, stays more stable in air-conditioning, and gives a flat modern face that matches white or wood-look interiors.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah supplies and hangs laminate doors from **RM 250**, including fitting to the existing frame where it is sound, hinge work, and lining up the lock.

Choose a [solid timber door](/services/door/solid-timber-door-installation) when you want mass, a refinishable face, or a main-door feel. See the full [door repair and installation](/services/door) range for planing and fire-rated leaves.

## What you get at the starting price

From RM 250 typically covers:

- An HDF-skin engineered leaf with a laminate face, sized to the measured rebate.
- Hanging on the existing frame when the frame is reusable.
- Hinges and alignment to a consistent reveal.
- Lock and latch lined up with the existing strike where possible.

A new frame, architrave, glass insert, or a new lockset is quoted on top. Fire-rated openings need a certified fire door, not a laminate bedroom leaf.

## Why laminate doors suit condos

Klang Valley condos are air-conditioned by day and humid when the AC is off. Solid interior timber can swell and scrape. An engineered laminate leaf:

- Moves less across the seasons.
- Wipes clean — useful in kids’ rooms.
- Comes in consistent colours for a whole corridor of bedrooms.

The trade-off: you cannot sand the face like solid timber. A deep knock is a door replacement or a careful filler, not a full refinish.

## When not to use a laminate bedroom door

- **Wet bathrooms** with poor exhaust — edges can swell if water sits on the bottom rail.
- **Fire-rated openings** — kitchen / escape doors that must be a certified set.
- **Main entrance** if you want a solid security leaf and a deep mortice for a [deadbolt or smart lock](/services/locksmith).

If the only problem is scraping after new [flooring](/services/flooring), start with [door planing](/services/door) from RM 120, not a new leaf. Read [door scraping the floor](/problems/door-scraping-floor).

## How we install a laminate door

1. Measure the rebate, thickness and lock height.
2. Confirm colour and whether the existing frame and architrave stay.
3. Trim the leaf if needed (factory doors are often slightly oversize).
4. Hang on three hinges for a full-height leaf.
5. Fit or reuse the lock; test latch and privacy turn.
6. Check clearance over the finished floor.

## Cost

| Service | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Laminate door installation | From RM 250 |
| Solid timber door | From RM 550 |
| Door planing only | From RM 120 |

Several bedrooms in one visit is more efficient than one door a month. We quote a package when you send the count.

## Common mistakes

- Buying a 30-inch “standard” door for a condo rebate that is not standard.
- Two hinges on a tall leaf, then blaming the door for sag.
- Planing the laminate edge without resealing, then watching it swell.
- Replacing the leaf when only the hinge screws have stripped the frame.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I keep my old frame and lock?

Usually yes. We measure the lock case. If the new leaf is a different thickness, the latch may need a different strike or a new lock.

### Are laminate doors hollow?

Many engineered doors have a honeycomb or tubular core with a solid lock block. They are not solid timber. That is why they are lighter and cheaper.

### How long does it take?

One or two doors on existing frames are often done in a single visit once the leaves are on site.

### Can you match an existing colour?

We match to common white and wood-look laminates with samples. An exact discontinued colour may not exist.

## Book laminate door hanging

If you want consistent, easy-care bedroom doors in a KL or Selangor condo or landed house, WhatsApp the opening count and photos — [request a laminate door quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20laminate%20door%20installation.).

ms.title: Panduan Kos & Proses: Pemasangan Pintu Laminate di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Pintu engineered kulit HDF berlamina di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor — pintu bilik tidur dan kondominium yang stabil dan moden. Bekalan dan gantung dari RM 250.
ms.metaTitle: Panduan Kos: Pemasangan Pintu Laminate di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Pintu laminate engineered untuk kondominium dan rumah di KL & Selangor. Kemasan kulit HDF licin, digantung dan dikunci dari RM 250.
ms.content:
Pintu laminate (pintu engineered dengan kulit HDF dan muka laminate) ialah daun bilik tidur dan stor yang biasa di kondominium Malaysia. Ia lebih ringan daripada meranti pepejal, lebih stabil dalam penghawa dingin, dan memberi muka rata moden.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah membekal dan menggantung pintu laminate dari **RM 250**, termasuk pemasangan pada rangka sedia ada jika rangka elok, kerja engsel, dan penjajaran kunci.

Pilih [pintu kayu pepejal](/ms/services/door/solid-timber-door-installation) jika anda mahu jisim dan muka yang boleh dikemas semula. Lihat julat [pembaikan dan pemasangan pintu](/ms/services/door) untuk ketam dan daun tahan api.

## Apa yang anda dapat pada harga mula

Dari RM 250 biasanya merangkumi:

- Daun engineered kulit HDF dengan muka laminate, saiz mengikut rebate yang diukur.
- Gantung pada rangka sedia ada jika rangka boleh digunakan semula.
- Engsel dan penjajaran reveal yang konsisten.
- Kunci dan selak dijajarkan dengan strike sedia ada jika boleh.

Rangka baharu, arkitrave, sisipan kaca atau kunci baharu disebut harga tambahan. Bukaan tahan api perlukan pintu api bertauliah, bukan daun bilik tidur laminate.

## Kenapa pintu laminate sesuai kondominium

Kondominium Lembah Klang berpenghawa dingin pada siang hari dan lembap apabila AC ditutup. Kayu interior pepejal boleh mengembang dan menggesel. Daun laminate engineered:

- Kurang bergerak merentas musim.
- Mudah lap — berguna di bilik kanak-kanak.
- Warna konsisten untuk seluruh koridor bilik tidur.

Kompromi: anda tidak boleh mengampelas muka seperti kayu pepejal.

## Bila jangan guna pintu laminate bilik tidur

- **Bilik air basah** dengan ekzos lemah — tepi boleh menggelembung jika air duduk pada rel bawah.
- **Bukaan tahan api** — dapur / laluan kecemasan yang mesti set bertauliah.
- **Pintu masuk utama** jika anda mahu daun keselamatan pepejal dan mortice dalam untuk [deadbolt atau kunci pintar](/ms/services/locksmith).

Jika satu-satunya masalah ialah menggesel selepas [lantai baharu](/ms/services/flooring), mulakan dengan ketam pintu dari RM 120. Baca [pintu menggesel lantai](/ms/problems/door-scraping-floor).

## Cara kami pasang

1. Ukur rebate, ketebalan dan tinggi kunci.
2. Sahkan warna dan sama ada rangka serta arkitrave kekal.
3. Potong daun jika perlu (pintu kilang kerap sedikit oversized).
4. Gantung pada tiga engsel untuk daun penuh tinggi.
5. Pasang atau guna semula kunci; uji selak dan putaran privasi.
6. Semak jarak di atas lantai siap.

## Kos

| Perkhidmatan | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Pemasangan pintu laminate | Dari RM 250 |
| Pintu kayu pepejal | Dari RM 550 |
| Ketam pintu sahaja | Dari RM 120 |

Beberapa bilik tidur dalam satu lawatan lebih cekap daripada satu pintu sebulan.

## Soalan lazim

### Boleh kekalkan rangka dan kunci lama?

Biasanya boleh. Kami ukur kotak kunci. Jika daun baharu berbeza ketebalan, selak mungkin perlukan strike atau kunci berbeza.

### Adakah pintu laminate berongga?

Ramai pintu engineered ada teras sarang lebah atau tiub dengan blok kunci pepejal. Ia bukan kayu pepejal. Itulah sebabnya ia lebih ringan dan lebih murah.

### Berapa lama?

Satu atau dua pintu pada rangka sedia ada kerap siap dalam satu lawatan setelah daun tiba di tapak.

## Tempah gantung pintu laminate

WhatsApp bilangan bukaan dan foto — [minta sebut harga pintu laminate](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20mahu%20sebut%20harga%20pemasangan%20pintu%20laminate.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪防火板门安装：费用与流程指南（2026）
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪 HDF 表皮工程木防火板门——稳定、现代的卧室与公寓门。供应安装从 RM 250 起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪防火板门安装｜费用指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪公寓与住宅工程木防火板门。平滑 HDF 表皮，悬挂配锁从 RM 250 起。
zh.content:
防火板门（HDF 表皮工程木门，表面贴防火板）是马来西亚公寓里常见的卧室和储物间门扇。它比实心柳安轻，在空调房里尺寸更稳定，能做出平整现代的门面。

说明：这里的“防火板”指 laminate / HPL 饰面，**不是**认证防火门。认证防火门是另一项。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 供应并悬挂防火板门，从 **RM 250** 起，门框完好时可装在现有框上，含铰链作业与锁具对齐。

要质量和可翻新表面，选 [实木门](/zh/services/door/solid-timber-door-installation)。刨修与防火等级见 [门维修与安装](/zh/services/door)。

## 起步价包含什么

从 RM 250 起通常包括：

- 按测得企口尺寸的 HDF 表皮工程木门扇，防火板面。
- 门框可再利用时挂在现有框上。
- 铰链与均匀缝隙调校。
- 尽可能与现有锁扣板对齐锁舌。

新门框、套线、玻璃插芯或新锁另计。防火洞口需要认证防火门，不是卧室防火板门扇。

## 为什么防火板门适合公寓

巴生谷公寓白天开空调，关空调后又潮湿。实木室内门会涨、会刮。工程木防火板门扇：

- 季节间变形更小。
- 好擦 — 儿童房实用。
- 颜色一致，整条卧室走廊统一。

代价：表面不能像实木那样打磨翻新。

## 什么时候不要用卧室防火板门

- **排气差的湿卫生间** — 水积在下挺，边缘会涨。
- **防火洞口** — 厨房 / 逃生门必须是认证套装。
- **大门** 如果您要实心防盗扇和深锁体装 [呆锁或智能锁](/zh/services/locksmith)。

如果唯一问题是新铺 [地板](/zh/services/flooring) 后刮地，先做从 RM 120 起的刨门。见 [门刮地板](/zh/problems/door-scraping-floor)。

## 我们怎么装

1. 测量企口、厚度和锁高。
2. 确认颜色，以及现有门框套线是否保留。
3. 需要时修门扇（出厂门往往略大）。
4. 整扇门用三只铰链悬挂。
5. 安装或复用锁；测试锁舌与反锁。
6. 检查完成地面净空。

## 费用

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 防火板门安装 | 从 RM 250 起 |
| 实木门 | 从 RM 550 起 |
| 仅刨门 | 从 RM 120 起 |

一次做几间卧室比一个月换一扇更有效率。

## 常见问题

### 能留旧框旧锁吗？

通常可以。我们量锁体。新门厚度不同时，锁舌可能需要不同锁扣板或新锁。

### 防火板门是空心的吗？

许多工程木门是蜂窝或管状芯，锁位有实木锁块。不是实木，所以更轻更便宜。

### 要多久？

旧框上换一两扇，门到场后常常一次上门完成。

en.title: Landed House PoE CCTV in KL (8 Cameras)
en.excerpt: An 8-camera wired PoE CCTV system for terrace, semi-D and bungalow homes in KL & Selangor: 4MP bullet cameras, NVR with 2TB, full cabling. From RM 4,200.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Landed House PoE CCTV in KL & Selangor RM 4,200
en.metaDesc: 8-camera PoE CCTV for landed homes in KL & Selangor. 4MP bullet cameras, 8-channel NVR with 2TB, continuous recording, full cabling. From RM 4,200.
en.content:
A landed house has a perimeter, and a perimeter is what wireless systems handle worst. Gates, side lanes, back yards and car porches are exactly the places where Wi-Fi weakens and where you need footage that was still recording at 3am. A wired PoE system is built for that.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah installs an 8-camera PoE CCTV system for landed homes in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor from **RM 4,200**. It includes 4MP PoE bullet cameras, an 8-channel NVR with a 2TB hard disk giving roughly one week of continuous recording, and full cabling. Covered by a **12-month camera and installation warranty**.

## Why PoE for a landed home

| | PoE (wired) | Wi-Fi (wireless) |
|---|---|---|
| Power and data | One CAT6 cable per camera | Mains socket per camera + Wi-Fi |
| Recording | 24/7 continuous to local NVR | Usually event clips to cloud |
| Reliability outdoors | Not affected by Wi-Fi range | Drops out at gates and rear boundary |
| Ongoing cost | None mandatory | Cloud plan usually needed |
| Retention | ~1 week on 2TB, expandable | Depends on plan |
| Install effort | Higher — cable routing | Lower |

Continuous recording is the practical difference. Motion-triggered clips routinely miss the two seconds before something happens, which is often the part you need.

## Typical 8-camera layout

| Camera | Position | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Main gate, facing in | Faces and plate numbers at the entry point |
| 2 | Car porch | Vehicles, and the most common approach path |
| 3 | Front door | Anyone at the door, close range |
| 4 | Left side lane | Boundary access |
| 5 | Right side lane | Boundary access |
| 6 | Rear door or back yard | The most common forced entry point |
| 7 | Rear boundary or back gate | Early warning before the yard |
| 8 | Interior — stairs or living hall | Movement inside if the perimeter is passed |

A single-storey terrace often needs 4–6 cameras rather than 8. A semi-D or bungalow with a larger perimeter may need more. The site survey sets the count; we quote what the property needs, not a fixed number.

## What the RM 4,200 start includes

- 8× 4MP PoE bullet cameras
- 8-channel NVR with a 2TB hard disk
- CAT6 cabling to every camera, routed through ceiling voids, trunking or conduit
- Cable termination, testing and labelling at the NVR
- NVR positioned in a discreet, ventilated spot and configured
- Recording schedule, overwrite policy and motion zones set
- Mobile app on iOS and Android, remote viewing tested at handover
- Camera position photos, admin passwords, app instructions and written warranty

Extra cameras, longer cable runs, external trunking on finished walls, larger hard disks and additional power points are quoted on top.

## How the installation runs

1. **Site survey and camera plan.** We walk the perimeter, agree positions and identify cable routes. Free of charge.
2. **Transparent quote.** Itemised — cameras, NVR, cabling, mounting and any extras.
3. **Cable routing.** CAT6 pulled through ceiling voids, trunking or conduit. Neatness here is what separates a professional job from a visible mess of white cable.
4. **Camera mounting and configuration.** Brackets fixed, angles set with someone watching the live feed, focus and night mode checked after dark where needed.
5. **Documentation and handover.** Position photos, passwords, app walkthrough and warranty.

Most 8-camera installations are completed in a single day. Older houses with sealed ceilings or awkward runs can take longer.

## What affects the price

- **Camera count and resolution.** 4MP is the practical baseline; higher resolution costs more per camera and per TB of storage.
- **Cable run length and difficulty.** A rear boundary camera 30 metres from the NVR costs more than one above the front door.
- **Ceiling access.** Plaster ceilings with no access hatch mean external trunking or opening and patching — see [ceiling](/services/ceiling) work if patching is needed.
- **Storage.** 2TB gives roughly a week at 8 channels. Longer retention needs a larger disk.
- **Power availability.** The NVR needs a dedicated point; adding one is [electrical](/services/electrical) work.

| Option | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Landed house PoE CCTV (8 cameras) | From RM 4,200 |
| Condo Wi-Fi CCTV package (4 cameras) | From RM 2,200 |
| Single camera add-on | From RM 420 |
| System health check and relocation | From RM 220 |

## Mistakes that cost you footage

- **Mounting cameras too high.** At 4 metres you record the top of everyone's head. Around 2.5–3 metres captures faces.
- **One wide shot instead of one identification shot.** An overview camera tells you something happened; a tighter camera at the gate tells you who.
- **No camera on the NVR itself.** If the recorder is taken, so is the evidence. Keep it out of sight and ideally in view of a camera.
- **Never checking playback.** Test it monthly. A disk that failed six months ago looks identical to a working system on live view.
- **Letting the disk fill without overwrite set correctly** — see [CCTV not recording because storage is full](/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full).
- **Ignoring a camera that has gone offline** — see [CCTV not recording](/problems/cctv-not-recording).

## Frequently asked questions

### How long does 2TB store?

Roughly one week of continuous recording across 8 channels at 4MP. Bitrate settings and scene activity move that figure either way. A larger disk extends it.

### Do the cameras work at night?

Yes. 4MP bullet cameras have infrared night vision. Existing porch and boundary lighting improves colour detail, and we check night performance during commissioning.

### Can I view the cameras from overseas?

Yes, through the mobile app on iOS or Android. We test remote viewing on your phone at handover rather than leaving you to set it up.

### Is there a monthly fee?

No. Recording is local to the NVR. Cloud backup is optional if you want it.

### Can this be installed in a house that is already renovated?

Yes. Where ceiling voids are sealed, we use surface trunking or conduit routed along skirting or ceiling lines to keep it tidy.

### What if I want cameras covering the road outside?

Cameras that capture the public road or a neighbour's property raise privacy considerations. We angle to keep coverage on your own boundary wherever possible.

### Can I mix PoE and Wi-Fi cameras?

Yes, where a position has no practical cable route. Wired remains the default for perimeter cameras.

## Book a site survey

Tell us your house type, how many entry points you want covered and whether the ceiling is already finished. We will confirm the camera count and send an itemised quote. [Message us on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20landed%20house%20PoE%20CCTV%20quote.).

ms.title: CCTV PoE Rumah Landed di KL (8 Kamera)
ms.excerpt: Sistem CCTV PoE berwayar 8 kamera untuk rumah teres, berkembar dan banglo di KL & Selangor: kamera bullet 4MP, NVR 2TB, pendawaian penuh. Dari RM 4,200.
ms.metaTitle: CCTV PoE Rumah Landed di KL dari RM 4,200
ms.metaDesc: CCTV PoE 8 kamera untuk rumah landed di KL & Selangor. Kamera bullet 4MP, NVR 8 saluran 2TB, rakaman berterusan, pendawaian penuh. Dari RM 4,200.
ms.content:
Rumah landed mempunyai perimeter, dan perimeter inilah kelemahan terbesar sistem tanpa wayar. Pagar, lorong tepi, halaman belakang dan porch kereta ialah tempat isyarat Wi-Fi paling lemah — sekali gus tempat anda paling perlukan rakaman yang masih berjalan pada pukul 3 pagi. Sistem PoE berwayar dibina untuk keadaan itu.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah memasang sistem CCTV PoE 8 kamera untuk rumah landed di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor dari **RM 4,200**. Termasuk kamera bullet PoE 4MP, NVR 8 saluran dengan cakera keras 2TB (sekitar seminggu rakaman berterusan) dan pendawaian penuh. Disertai **jaminan kamera dan pemasangan 12 bulan**.

## Kenapa PoE untuk rumah landed

| | PoE (berwayar) | Wi-Fi (tanpa wayar) |
|---|---|---|
| Kuasa dan data | Satu kabel CAT6 sekamera | Soket kuasa sekamera + Wi-Fi |
| Rakaman | 24/7 berterusan ke NVR tempatan | Klip pergerakan ke awan |
| Kebolehpercayaan luar | Tidak terjejas julat Wi-Fi | Terputus di pagar dan sempadan belakang |
| Kos berulang | Tiada yang wajib | Pelan awan lazimnya diperlukan |
| Simpanan | ~seminggu pada 2TB, boleh dinaik taraf | Bergantung pelan |
| Usaha pemasangan | Lebih tinggi — laluan kabel | Rendah |

Rakaman berterusan itulah perbezaan praktikalnya. Klip yang dicetuskan pergerakan kerap terlepas dua saat sebelum kejadian — bahagian yang selalunya paling diperlukan.

## Susun atur lazim 8 kamera

| Kamera | Kedudukan | Tujuan |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pagar utama, menghadap ke dalam | Wajah dan nombor pendaftaran di pintu masuk |
| 2 | Porch kereta | Kenderaan dan laluan menghampiri |
| 3 | Pintu hadapan | Sesiapa di muka pintu, jarak dekat |
| 4 | Lorong tepi kiri | Akses sempadan |
| 5 | Lorong tepi kanan | Akses sempadan |
| 6 | Pintu belakang atau halaman | Titik pecah masuk paling lazim |
| 7 | Sempadan atau pagar belakang | Amaran awal sebelum halaman |
| 8 | Dalaman — tangga atau ruang tamu | Pergerakan dalam rumah |

Rumah teres setingkat selalunya cukup dengan 4–6 kamera. Rumah berkembar atau banglo berperimeter besar mungkin perlukan lebih. Tinjauan tapak menentukan jumlahnya.

## Apa yang termasuk pada RM 4,200

- 8× kamera bullet PoE 4MP
- NVR 8 saluran dengan cakera keras 2TB
- Pendawaian CAT6 ke setiap kamera melalui rongga siling, saluran atau konduit
- Penamatan, ujian dan pelabelan kabel di NVR
- NVR diletak di lokasi tersembunyi dan berpengudaraan, serta dikonfigurasi
- Jadual rakaman, dasar tulis ganti dan zon pergerakan ditetapkan
- Aplikasi mudah alih iOS dan Android, tontonan jauh diuji semasa serahan
- Foto kedudukan kamera, kata laluan admin, panduan aplikasi dan jaminan bertulis

Kamera tambahan, laluan kabel panjang, saluran luaran pada dinding siap, cakera lebih besar dan titik kuasa baharu disebut harga tambahan.

## Cara pemasangan berjalan

1. **Tinjauan tapak dan pelan kamera.** Kami mengelilingi perimeter, menetapkan kedudukan dan laluan kabel. Percuma.
2. **Sebut harga telus.** Terperinci — kamera, NVR, pendawaian, pemasangan dan sebarang tambahan.
3. **Laluan kabel.** CAT6 ditarik melalui rongga siling, saluran atau konduit.
4. **Pemasangan dan konfigurasi kamera.** Pendakap dipasang, sudut ditetapkan sambil memerhati suapan langsung, mod malam disemak selepas gelap.
5. **Dokumentasi dan serahan.** Foto kedudukan, kata laluan, panduan aplikasi dan jaminan.

Kebanyakan pemasangan 8 kamera siap dalam sehari. Rumah lama dengan siling tertutup mungkin mengambil masa lebih lama.

## Apa yang mempengaruhi harga

- **Bilangan dan resolusi kamera.** 4MP asas praktikal; resolusi lebih tinggi menambah kos kamera dan storan.
- **Panjang dan kesukaran laluan kabel.** Kamera sempadan belakang 30 meter dari NVR lebih mahal daripada kamera di atas pintu hadapan.
- **Akses siling.** Siling plaster tanpa lubang akses bermakna saluran luaran atau kerja tampalan — lihat kerja [siling](/ms/services/ceiling).
- **Storan.** 2TB memberi sekitar seminggu untuk 8 saluran.
- **Bekalan kuasa.** NVR perlukan titik khusus — kerja [elektrik](/ms/services/electrical).

| Pilihan | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| CCTV PoE rumah landed (8 kamera) | Dari RM 4,200 |
| Pakej CCTV Wi-Fi kondominium (4 kamera) | Dari RM 2,200 |
| Tambahan satu kamera | Dari RM 420 |
| Pemeriksaan kesihatan dan pemindahan | Dari RM 220 |

## Kesilapan yang merugikan rakaman

- **Memasang kamera terlalu tinggi.** Pada 4 meter anda hanya merakam bahagian atas kepala. Sekitar 2.5–3 meter menangkap wajah.
- **Satu syot luas tanpa syot pengenalan.** Kamera gambaran keseluruhan memberitahu sesuatu berlaku; kamera lebih dekat di pagar memberitahu siapa.
- **NVR tidak dilindungi kamera.** Jika perakam diambil, bukti turut hilang.
- **Tidak pernah menyemak main semula.** Uji setiap bulan; cakera rosak kelihatan normal pada tontonan langsung.
- **Tulis ganti tidak ditetapkan** — lihat [CCTV tidak merakam kerana storan penuh](/ms/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full).
- **Mengabaikan kamera luar talian** — lihat [CCTV tidak merakam](/ms/problems/cctv-not-recording).

## Soalan lazim

### Berapa lama 2TB boleh menyimpan?

Sekitar seminggu rakaman berterusan untuk 8 saluran pada 4MP. Tetapan bitrate dan tahap aktiviti mengubah angka ini.

### Adakah kamera berfungsi waktu malam?

Ya. Kamera bullet 4MP mempunyai penglihatan malam inframerah. Lampu porch dan sempadan sedia ada meningkatkan perincian warna.

### Boleh tonton dari luar negara?

Boleh, melalui aplikasi mudah alih iOS atau Android. Kami menguji tontonan jauh pada telefon anda semasa serahan.

### Ada yuran bulanan?

Tiada. Rakaman disimpan secara tempatan pada NVR. Sandaran awan adalah pilihan.

### Boleh dipasang di rumah yang sudah siap diubah suai?

Boleh. Jika rongga siling tertutup, kami guna saluran permukaan atau konduit sepanjang garisan siling supaya kemas.

### Bagaimana jika saya mahu meliputi jalan di luar?

Kamera yang merakam jalan awam atau harta jiran melibatkan pertimbangan privasi. Kami menyudutkan kamera supaya kekal dalam sempadan anda.

## Tempah tinjauan tapak

Beritahu jenis rumah, bilangan titik masuk yang perlu diliputi dan sama ada siling sudah siap — [hubungi kami di WhatsApp](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20mahu%20sebut%20harga%20CCTV%20PoE%20rumah%20landed.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡有地住宅 PoE 监控（8 台）
zh.excerpt: 面向吉隆坡与雪兰莪排屋、半独立与洋房的 8 台有线 PoE 监控：4MP 枪机、2TB 录像主机、全程布线。RM 4,200 起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡有地住宅 PoE 监控 RM 4,200 起
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪有地住宅 8 台 PoE 监控：4MP 枪机、8 路 NVR 配 2TB、24 小时连续录像、全程布线。RM 4,200 起。
zh.content:
有地住宅有周界，而周界正是无线系统最吃力的地方。大门、侧巷、后院和车棚，恰好是 Wi-Fi 最弱的位置，也恰好是你最需要凌晨三点仍在录的位置。有线 PoE 就是为这种场景设计的。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪为有地住宅安装 8 台 PoE 监控系统，**RM 4,200 起**。包含 4MP PoE 枪机、8 路 NVR 配 2TB 硬盘（约一周连续录像）与全程布线。享 **12 个月摄像头与安装保修**。

## 有地住宅为何选 PoE

| | PoE（有线） | Wi-Fi（无线） |
|---|---|---|
| 供电与数据 | 每台一条 CAT6 | 每台一个插座 + Wi-Fi |
| 录像方式 | 本地 NVR 24/7 连续 | 多为云端事件片段 |
| 户外可靠性 | 不受 Wi-Fi 距离影响 | 大门与后界常掉线 |
| 持续费用 | 无强制费用 | 通常需要云端方案 |
| 保存时长 | 2TB 约一周，可扩容 | 取决于方案 |
| 施工量 | 较大 — 需布线 | 较小 |

连续录像是实际差别所在。移动触发的片段经常漏掉事发前那两秒，而那两秒往往才是关键。

## 典型 8 机位布局

| 机位 | 位置 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 大门，朝内 | 入口处的面孔与车牌 |
| 2 | 车棚 | 车辆与最常见的接近路径 |
| 3 | 前门 | 门口近距离人脸 |
| 4 | 左侧巷 | 周界进出 |
| 5 | 右侧巷 | 周界进出 |
| 6 | 后门或后院 | 最常见的破门位置 |
| 7 | 后界或后门 | 进入后院前的预警 |
| 8 | 室内 — 楼梯或客厅 | 周界被突破后的室内动向 |

单层排屋往往 4–6 台就够，不必八台。半独立或洋房周界更长，可能需要更多。数量以现场勘察为准 — 我们按房子实际需要报价。

## RM 4,200 起价包含什么

- 8 台 4MP PoE 枪机
- 8 路 NVR 配 2TB 硬盘
- 每台摄像头的 CAT6 布线，走吊顶空腔、线槽或穿管
- 线缆端接、测试与主机端标号
- NVR 安置于隐蔽通风位置并完成配置
- 录像计划、循环覆盖策略与侦测区域设置
- iOS 与 Android App，交付时实测远程查看
- 机位照片、管理员密码、App 使用说明与书面保修

加装摄像头、超长线路、成品墙面的明装线槽、更大硬盘与新增电源另行报价。

## 安装流程

1. **现场勘察与机位规划。** 我们绕周界一圈，确定点位与走线路径。免费。
2. **透明报价。** 逐项列出摄像头、NVR、布线、安装与额外项目。
3. **布线。** CAT6 穿吊顶空腔、线槽或 PVC 管。走线是否规整，是专业与业余的分水岭。
4. **上机与调试。** 固定支架，边看实时画面边定角度，必要时天黑后复核夜视与对焦。
5. **文档与交付。** 机位照片、密码、App 讲解与保修。

多数 8 机位安装可当天完成。老房子吊顶封死或走线困难时会需要更久。

## 影响价格的因素

- **摄像头数量与分辨率。** 4MP 是实用基准；更高分辨率意味着更贵的机器和更多存储。
- **走线长度与难度。** 离主机 30 米的后界机位，成本高于前门上方那一台。
- **吊顶可否进人。** 石膏吊顶没有检修口，就得明装线槽或开孔修补 — 需要修补时见 [天花](/zh/services/ceiling) 工程。
- **存储容量。** 2TB 在 8 路下约一周，想存更久就换更大硬盘。
- **电源条件。** NVR 需要专用电位，新增属于 [电气](/zh/services/electrical) 工程。

| 选项 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 有地住宅 PoE 监控（8 台） | RM 4,200 起 |
| 公寓 Wi-Fi 监控套餐（4 台） | RM 2,200 起 |
| 单台加装 | RM 420 起 |
| 系统健康检查与移机 | RM 220 起 |

## 会让你丢失关键画面的错误

- **装得太高。** 装到 4 米，录到的全是头顶。2.5–3 米才拍得到脸。
- **只有全景，没有识别机位。** 全景告诉你发生了事，大门口那台近景才告诉你是谁。
- **主机自身没人看着。** 录像机被搬走，证据也一起没了。放隐蔽处，最好在某台摄像头视野内。
- **从不回放检查。** 每月测一次。硬盘半年前就坏了，实时画面看起来照样正常。
- **循环覆盖没设对，硬盘写满** — 见 [存储已满导致不录像](/zh/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full)。
- **摄像头掉线却没人管** — 见 [监控不录像](/zh/problems/cctv-not-recording)。

## 常见问题

### 2TB 能存多久？

8 路 4MP 连续录像约一周。码率设置与画面活动量会让这个数字上下浮动，换更大硬盘可延长。

### 夜间能用吗？

能。4MP 枪机配红外夜视。车棚与围墙原有照明能提升色彩细节，我们在调试阶段会检查夜间表现。

### 人在国外能看吗？

能，通过 iOS 或 Android App。交付时我们会在你手机上实测远程查看，不会丢给你自己摸索。

### 有月费吗？

没有。录像存在本地 NVR。云端备份可选。

### 已经装修好的房子还能装吗？

能。吊顶封死的位置，我们沿踢脚线或吊顶线走明装线槽或穿管，尽量保持整齐。

### 想拍到屋外马路可以吗？

拍到公共道路或邻居产业涉及隐私考量。我们会尽量调整角度，把覆盖保持在自家边界内。

### 能混用 PoE 和 Wi-Fi 摄像头吗？

可以，用在确实无法布线的点位。周界机位仍以有线为默认。

## 预约现场勘察

en.content:
**Direct answer:** Large-format tiles need a flatter substrate, fuller adhesive coverage and more controlled handling than standard tiles. Levelling clips can align neighbouring edges, but they cannot correct a wavy floor or replace correct trowelling, back-buttering, movement joints and safe slab lifting.

The service includes site checks, safe installation, setup and functional testing for the agreed points. This article explains the [What Makes Large-Format Tiling Different?](/services/tiling/large-format-slab-tiling) scope under [tiling services](/services/tiling), with a published starting price of **RM 26 / sq ft**.

## What Must Be Checked First

### substrate flatness and strength
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### tile dimensions and layout
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### adhesive coverage and open time
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### movement joints edges and access
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.


## Practical Planning Notes

A quotation should define the measured work area or number of points, the preparation included, who supplies the finish product or equipment, and how concealed defects will be handled. Product names alone are not a complete specification: model, dimensions, colour or output, compatible accessories and installation method all affect the result. For **large-format slab tiling in kl & selangor**, the survey should record substrate flatness and strength, tile dimensions and layout, adhesive coverage and open time, and movement joints edges and access.

Sequence matters when several trades share the area. Complete leak repairs and wet work before sensitive finishes; coordinate framing, wiring, pipework and access panels before surfaces are closed; and protect completed work from following trades. A sample, layout drawing or one-point trial is useful when appearance, alignment, brightness, texture or control behaviour cannot be judged from a catalogue.

The handover should be functional, not visual only. The installer should inspect fixing or adhesion, edges and penetrations, operation under normal use, and any serviceable components. Keep the product model, colour or batch reference and care instructions. These records make future replacement or local repair more accurate.


## How the Work Is Carried Out

1. **Survey and dry-plan cuts** — survey and dry-plan cuts. Record the finding before materials are ordered.

2. **Level or repair substrate** — level or repair substrate. Protect adjacent finishes and keep the work area controlled.

3. **Mix approved adhesive** — mix approved adhesive. Check alignment, coverage, support or connections as the work progresses.

4. **Lift place and tune lippage** — lift place and tune lippage. Do not conceal the stage until the responsible person has inspected it.

5. **Cure grout and protect** — cure grout and protect. Test under normal use and record any care or cure-time restriction.


## Choosing the Right Approach

| Option | When it fits |
|---|---|

| large slab |  fewer joints and continuous visual finish |

| standard tile |  easier handling and local repair |

| feature slab |  focused impact with fewer difficult cuts |


## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Laying slabs over an uneven screed

- Dot-and-dab adhesive leaving voids

- Starting without planning cuts at doors and drains

- Walking or grouting before adhesive cures


Do not bypass structural, electrical, waterproofing or product requirements to save preparation time. Stop work if hidden moisture, unsafe wiring, weak support or moving cracks are discovered; diagnose these conditions before covering them.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 26 / sq ft**
- **Published workmanship cover: 12-Month Tile Adhesion & Grout Warranty**, subject to the published terms.

The final quotation depends on site condition, quantity or area, access, materials, preparation and any related repair identified during inspection. A starting rate is not a fixed total for every property.

For homes and commercial properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, access rules, working hours, lift protection and management approval can affect scheduling. Confirm these requirements before materials and labour are booked.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Why do large tiles crack or sound hollow?
Voids, movement, weak substrate or inadequate coverage can leave unsupported areas. Diagnosis should distinguish bond failure from substrate cracking.


### Are levelling clips enough?
No. They reduce edge lippage between adjacent tiles but do not flatten the substrate.


### Can large slabs be installed in a bathroom?
Yes, with suitable waterproofing, falls, drainage cuts and slip-conscious tile selection.

空隙、位移、基层薄弱或胶浆覆盖不足都会形成无支撑区，应判断是粘结失败还是基层开裂。

en.title: LED Downlight Installation Cost Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: LED downlight installation starts from RM 120 per point in KL & Selangor — clean cut-outs, driver placement, proper heat management and flicker-free wiring.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: LED Downlight Installation Cost in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: LED downlight installation in KL & Selangor from RM 120/point — clean ceiling cut-outs, drivers, heat management and flicker-free wiring by KL Servis Rumah.
en.content:
LED downlight installation in Kuala Lumpur or Selangor starts from RM 120 per point, including the ceiling cut-out, wiring, driver placement, and installation of the fitting. KL Servis Rumah installs COB LED downlights, panel lights, and adjustable models in homes, offices, and shops.

Downlights are the most popular recessed lighting choice in Malaysian interiors — they give a clean, modern ceiling and distribute light evenly. This guide covers the types available, what installation involves, and how to avoid the common problems that cause flickering and early failure.

## Types of LED Downlights

- **COB downlights** — a single LED chip behind a lens; even, flicker-free light with a defined beam. The most common choice for living rooms and corridors.
- **Panel lights** — a flat square or round panel; even diffused light, popular for kitchens and offices.
- **Adjustable/gimbal downlights** — the light direction can be tilted, useful for feature walls and artwork.
- **Smart downlights** — dimmable and app-controlled via Wi-Fi or Zigbee (e.g., Tuya-based devices).

When choosing, check the **colour temperature** (warm 3000K for bedrooms, neutral 4000K for kitchens and bathrooms) and the **CRI** (colour rendering) if colour accuracy matters — for example, in a dressing area or shop.

## What Installation Includes

1. **Position marking** — the installer confirms the layout, avoiding ceiling joists and existing wiring.
2. **Cut-out** — a clean hole is cut in the ceiling board (gypsum, plasterboard, or concrete with a chase for wiring).
3. **Wiring** — the point is wired to the lighting circuit with a secure connection; new points are run from the nearest circuit.
4. **Driver placement** — the LED driver is mounted in the ceiling void with room for heat to escape, and concealed.
5. **Fitting** — the downlight is clipped in, the trim seated flush, and the light tested.

For gypsum and plaster ceilings, cut-outs are made cleanly; for concrete ceilings, surface-mounted or recessed boxes are used with the wiring chased or trunked.

## Why Downlights Fail Early (and How to Prevent It)

- **Poor heat management** — LED drivers hate trapped heat. A downlight in an unventilated void runs hot and fails early; choosing quality drivers and allowing airflow extends life.
- **Incompatible dimmers** — not all dimmers work with LED. Using a trailing-edge dimmer designed for LEDs prevents buzzing and flicker.
- **Cheap drivers** — the driver is the most likely part to fail. Quality drivers and proper installation reduce early failures.
- **Overloaded circuits** — adding many downlights to an existing circuit can exceed its capacity; the installer checks the load.

If your existing lights flicker, our guide on [flickering downlights](/problems/downlight-flickering) explains the causes — from driver issues to loose connections.

## Cost of LED Downlight Installation

| Item | Starting price |
|---|---|
| LED downlight installation (per point) | From RM 120 |
| New lighting point from existing circuit | From RM 120 / point |
| Downlight supply (per fitting) | Varies by brand and type |

Doing several downlights in one visit reduces the per-point price. A typical living room installation of 6–8 points is usually completed within a day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How many downlights do I need for a living room?

A common rule of thumb is one downlight per 8–12 square feet of ceiling, but the right number depends on the beam angle, ceiling height, and how bright you want the room. During a site visit, we can recommend a layout.

### Can downlights be installed in a concrete ceiling?

Yes. For concrete ceilings, surface-mounted downlight boxes are used with wiring in trunking or chased into the concrete. It is more labour-intensive, so the price is slightly higher than a plaster ceiling installation.

### Do downlights work with existing dimmer switches?

Only if the dimmer is LED-compatible. Standard dimmers designed for incandescent bulbs can cause buzzing and flicker with LEDs. We replace incompatible dimmers as part of the job where needed.

### How long does a downlight installation take?

Each point takes roughly 30–45 minutes on a plaster ceiling. A six-point living room installation is typically a half-day job.

### Do you supply downlights?

Yes, we supply and install quality COB downlights and can quote fixtures and installation together.

## Book a Downlight Installation

KL Servis Rumah installs LED downlights across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor with clean cut-outs, proper drivers, and a 12-month warranty. WhatsApp us for a quote — [message the team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20to%20get%20a%20quote%20for%20lighting%20installation%20service%20for%20my%20property.).
