en.metaDesc: Professional house painting in KL & Selangor using Nippon, Dulux and Jotun. Interior, exterior and wall repair with full preparation. From RM 450 per room.
en.content:
If you are looking for a fresh, even paint finish that lasts in Malaysia's hot and humid climate, KL Servis Rumah provides house painting services across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. We cover interior walls, exterior facades, commercial spaces, and wall repairs, using premium paints from Nippon Paint, Dulux, and Jotun.

Malaysia's tropical weather — intense UV, monsoon rain, and high humidity — is hard on paint. A good paint job starts long before the first coat, with proper surface preparation and the right coating for each area. This guide explains what our painting service includes, what affects the cost, and how we keep the result lasting.

## What Our Painting Service Covers

Our painters handle residential and commercial properties across the Klang Valley:

- **[Interior house painting](/services/painting/interior-house-painting)** — living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, and ceilings with low-odour, washable paint.
- **Exterior house painting** — weatherproof, anti-fungal, and UV-resistant coatings for facades, fences, and car porch areas.
- **Commercial and office painting** — shopfronts, offices, and retail spaces on a schedule that keeps disruption to a minimum.
- **Wall crack and moisture repair** — sanding, skim coating, crack filling, and sealing damp masonry before painting.

Every job uses premium genuine paints based on your budget, not cheap low-grade paint that chalks and fades within months.

## Why Surface Preparation Matters in Malaysia

Skipping preparation is the most common reason paint fails in Malaysian homes. Before we paint, we:

1. **Protect and mask** — furniture, floors, switches, and windows are covered with drop sheets and quality masking tape for a zero-mess handover.
2. **Prepare the surface** — cracks, nail holes, and indents are filled with high-grade plaster and sanded smooth.
3. **Prime and seal** — a premium sealer or undercoat protects against moisture seepage and ensures the topcoat adheres.
4. **Apply two topcoats** — two coats of premium Nippon Paint or Dulux for rich, even coverage.
5. **Inspect and clean** — we remove all covers, vacuum the space, and do a joint inspection with you.

This is why a professional finish lasts years longer than a quick repaint over an unprepared wall.

## How Much Does Painting Cost in KL & Selangor?

| Service | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Interior wall painting | From RM 450 / room |
| Exterior house painting | From RM 2,200 |
| Wall crack & moisture repair | From RM 180 |
| Commercial & office painting | On quote |

The final price depends on the size of the area, the number of coats, wall condition, and access (for example, scaffolding on upper floors). A free site visit gives you an accurate fixed quote before work begins.

## Signs Your Walls Need Repainting

- **Fading or chalking** — rubbing the wall leaves white powder on your hand.
- **Peeling or bubbling** — often caused by moisture behind the paint.
- **Cracks and flaking** — especially near windows, skirting, and bathroom edges.
- **Mould or mildew spots** — common in bathrooms, kitchens, and near air-conditioners.
- **Stains and marks** — that do not wash off with normal cleaning.

If you can see any of these, a repaint will not fix the cause unless the underlying surface is repaired and sealed first. Our [peeling paint repair guide](/problems/peeling-paint-malaysia) explains the common causes and the correct fix.

## Choosing the Right Paint for Malaysian Weather

- **Interior:** low-odour, low-VOC washable paints (e.g. Nippon Odour-less, Nippon Spot-less, Dulux EasyClean) are easy to clean and dry quickly in high humidity.
- **Exterior:** weatherproof, anti-fungal, and UV-resistant coatings (e.g. Nippon Weatherbond, Dulux Weathershield, Jotun) handle sun and rain best.
- **Colour:** light neutral tones brighten compact spaces, while dark shades on west-facing walls fade faster under direct sun.

Our team brings colour catalogues to your site inspection so you can choose with confidence.

## Tips to Make Your Paint Job Last

- Fix moisture problems before painting — paint will not stop a leaking pipe or rising damp.
- Allow enough drying time between coats, especially in humid weather.
- Clean walls gently with a damp cloth; avoid harsh scrubbing on matte finishes.
- Touch up small scratches early to prevent them from spreading.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which paint brands do you use?

We primarily recommend Nippon Paint, Dulux, or Jotun. For interiors we use their premium washable ranges; for exteriors we use durable weatherproof coatings. We never use cheap low-grade chalky paints.

### How long does it take to paint a 3-bedroom home?

A standard 3-bedroom apartment of about 1,000 sq ft typically takes 2–3 days including preparation and drying time between coats. A single room can usually be finished in one day.

### Do you provide colour consultation?

Yes. Our project managers bring official colour catalogues to your site inspection and can advise on modern schemes, light reflection, and washable finishes.

### Is wall repair included in the painting quote?

Basic hairline crack patching, plaster touch-ups, and nail-hole filling are included. Major structural cracking, heavy peeling, or water-damaged plaster is quoted as a separate transparent repair fee.

### Is exterior painting available for two-storey homes?

Yes. We paint exterior walls of all heights, coordinating access and safety for upper-floor work.

## Get a Painting Quote in KL & Selangor

Whether you need one room repainted or a full interior and exterior repaint, KL Servis Rumah provides professional painting with premium paints, full surface preparation, and up to a 2-year warranty against peeling and premature chalking. We serve Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, including Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Cheras, Ampang, and Klang.

WhatsApp us photos of your walls for a quick estimate — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20to%20get%20a%20quote%20for%20house%20painting%20for%20my%20property.).

ms.title: Perkhidmatan Mengecat Rumah di Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Perkhidmatan mengecat dalaman, luaran dan pembaikan dinding profesional di seluruh KL & Selangor — cat premium (Nippon, Dulux, Jotun), persediaan permukaan penuh, penyamaran tanpa kotor dan serahan bersih, dari RM 450 setiap bilik.
ms.metaTitle: Perkhidmatan Mengecat Rumah di Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Perkhidmatan mengecat rumah di KL & Selangor dengan cat Nippon, Dulux atau Jotun. Merangkumi dalaman, luaran, pembaikan dinding dan persediaan permukaan. Dari RM 450/bilik.
ms.content:
Jika anda mahukan kemasan cat yang segar dan sekata yang tahan dalam cuaca panas dan lembap Malaysia, KL Servis Rumah menyediakan perkhidmatan mengecat rumah di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor. Kami meliputi dinding dalaman, fasad luaran, ruang komersial, dan pembaikan dinding, menggunakan cat premium daripada Nippon Paint, Dulux, dan Jotun.

Cuaca tropika Malaysia — UV yang kuat, hujan monsun, dan kelembapan tinggi — sangat mencabar cat. Kerja cat yang baik bermula jauh sebelum lapisan pertama, dengan persediaan permukaan yang betul dan salutan yang sesuai untuk setiap kawasan. Panduan ini menerangkan perkhidmatan mengecat kami, apa yang mempengaruhi kos, dan cara kami memastikan hasil yang tahan lama.

## Apa yang Diliputi oleh Perkhidmatan Mengecat Kami

Pasukan pengecat kami mengendalikan harta kediaman dan komersial di seluruh Lembah Klang:

- **[Pengecatan rumah dalaman](/ms/services/painting/interior-house-painting)** — ruang tamu, bilik tidur, koridor, dan siling dengan cat boleh cuci berbau rendah.
- **Pengecatan rumah luaran** — salutan tahan cuaca, anti-kulat, dan tahan UV untuk fasad, pagar, dan kawasan car porch.
- **Pengecatan komersial dan pejabat** — kedai depan, pejabat, dan ruang runcit mengikut jadual yang meminimumkan gangguan.
- **Pembaikan retak dan lembapan dinding** — pengamplasan, skim coating, pengisian retakan, dan penyekatan masonri lembap sebelum mengecat.

Setiap kerja menggunakan cat asli premium mengikut bajet anda, bukan cat murah gred rendah yang berkapur dan pudar dalam beberapa bulan.

## Mengapa Persediaan Permukaan Penting di Malaysia

Melangkau persediaan adalah punca paling biasa cat gagal di rumah Malaysia. Sebelum mengecat, kami:

1. **Lindungi dan samar** — perabot, lantai, suis, dan tingkap ditutup dengan kain penutup dan pita pelekat berkualiti untuk serahan tanpa kotor.
2. **Sediakan permukaan** — retakan, lubang paku, dan lekuk diisi dengan plaster gred tinggi dan diamplas licin.
3. **Primer dan penyekat** — sealer atau undercoat premium melindungi daripada rembesan lembapan dan memastikan topcoat melekat.
4. **Sapukan dua topcoat** — dua lapisan cat premium Nippon Paint atau Dulux untuk liputan kaya dan sekata.
5. **Periksa dan bersihkan** — kami menanggalkan semua penutup, menyedut ruang, dan membuat pemeriksaan bersama anda.

Inilah sebabnya kemasan profesional bertahan bertahun-tahun lebih lama daripada cat semula pantas ke atas dinding yang tidak disediakan.

## Berapa Kos Mengecat di KL & Selangor?

| Perkhidmatan | Harga permulaan |
|---|---|
| Pengecatan dinding dalaman | Dari RM 450 / bilik |
| Pengecatan rumah luaran | Dari RM 2,200 |
| Pembaikan retak & lembapan dinding | Dari RM 180 |
| Pengecatan komersial & pejabat | Atas sebut harga |

Harga akhir bergantung pada saiz kawasan, bilangan lapisan, keadaan dinding, dan akses (contohnya perancah di tingkat atas). Lawatan tapak percuma memberi anda sebut harga tetap yang tepat sebelum kerja bermula.

## Tanda Dinding Anda Perlu Dicat Semula

- **Pudar atau berkapur** — menggosok dinding meninggalkan serbuk putih di tangan.
- **Mengelupas atau berbuih** — selalunya disebabkan lembapan di belakang cat.
- **Retak dan bersisik** — terutamanya berhampiran tingkap, skirting, dan tepi bilik air.
- **Tompok kulat atau cendawan** — biasa di bilik air, dapur, dan berhampiran penghawa dingin.
- **Kesan dan tanda** — yang tidak hilang dengan pembersihan biasa.

Jika anda melihat mana-mana tanda ini, cat semula sahaja tidak akan menyelesaikan punca melainkan permukaan dibaiki dan disekat terlebih dahulu. Panduan [pembaikan cat mengelupas](/ms/problems/peeling-paint-malaysia) kami menerangkan punca biasa dan pembetulan yang betul.

## Memilih Cat yang Tepat untuk Cuaca Malaysia

- **Dalaman:** cat boleh cuci berbau rendah, VOC rendah (cth. Nippon Odour-less, Nippon Spot-less, Dulux EasyClean) mudah dibersihkan dan cepat kering dalam kelembapan tinggi.
- **Luaran:** salutan tahan cuaca, anti-kulat, dan tahan UV (cth. Nippon Weatherbond, Dulux Weathershield, Jotun) paling tahan terhadap matahari dan hujan.
- **Warna:** nada neutral cerah mencerahkan ruang padat, manakala warna gelap di dinding menghadap barat pudar lebih cepat di bawah matahari langsung.

Pasukan kami membawa katalog warna ke pemeriksaan tapak anda supaya anda boleh memilih dengan yakin.

## Petua Agar Kerja Cat Tahan Lama

- Baiki masalah lembapan sebelum mengecat — cat tidak akan menghentikan paip bocor atau kelembapan menaik.
- Beri masa pengeringan yang mencukupi antara lapisan, terutamanya dalam cuaca lembap.
- Bersihkan dinding dengan lembut menggunakan kain lembap; elakkan gosokan kasar pada kemasan matte.
- Sentuh calar kecil awal supaya tidak merebak.

## Soalan Lazim

### Jenama cat apa yang anda gunakan?

Kami terutamanya mengesyorkan Nippon Paint, Dulux, atau Jotun. Untuk dalaman kami gunakan julat boleh cuci premium mereka; untuk luaran kami gunakan salutan tahan cuaca yang tahan lama. Kami tidak pernah menggunakan cat berkapur murah gred rendah.

### Berapa lama masa mengecat rumah 3 bilik?

Apartmen 3 bilik standard kira-kira 1,000 kaki persegi biasanya mengambil 2–3 hari termasuk persediaan dan masa pengeringan antara lapisan. Bilik tunggal biasanya boleh siap dalam satu hari.

### Adakah anda menyediakan konsultasi warna?

Ya. Pengurus projek kami membawa katalog warna rasmi ke pemeriksaan tapak anda dan boleh menasihati tentang skema moden, pantulan cahaya, dan kemasan boleh cuci.

### Adakah pembaikan dinding termasuk dalam sebut harga mengecat?

Tampalan retak rambut asas, sentuhan plaster, dan pengisian lubang paku termasuk. Keretakan struktur besar, pengelupasan teruk, atau plaster rosak air ditawarkan sebagai fi pembaikan berasingan yang telus.

### Adakah pengecatan luaran tersedia untuk rumah dua tingkat?

Ya. Kami mengecat dinding luaran semua ketinggian, menyelaras akses dan keselamatan untuk kerja tingkat atas.

## Dapatkan Sebut Harga Mengecat di KL & Selangor

Sama ada anda perlu mengecat satu bilik atau pengecatan semula dalaman dan luaran penuh, KL Servis Rumah menyediakan pengecatan profesional dengan cat premium, persediaan permukaan penuh, dan jaminan sehingga 2 tahun terhadap pengelupasan dan pengapuran pramatang. Kami berkhidmat di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, termasuk Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Cheras, Ampang, dan Klang.

WhatsApp kami foto dinding anda untuk anggaran pantas — [sembang dengan pasukan kami](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Salam%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20ingin%20mendapatkan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20mengecat%20rumah%20saya.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪房屋油漆服务
zh.excerpt: 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供专业的室内外墙面油漆与墙壁修补服务——使用Nippon、Dulux、Jotun等优质涂料，完整的表面处理、无尘遮蔽和干净交付，每房RM 450起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡房屋油漆颜色选择与施工规划指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪专业房屋油漆服务，使用Nippon、Dulux与Jotun。室内外及墙壁修补，完整表面处理，无尘施工，最长2年保修。每房RM 450起。
zh.content:
如果您希望获得在马来西亚炎热潮湿气候下持久均匀的油漆效果，KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供房屋油漆服务。我们涵盖室内墙面、室外立面、商业空间和墙壁修补，使用Nippon Paint、Dulux和Jotun等优质涂料。

马来西亚的热带气候——强烈的紫外线、季风降雨和高湿度——对油漆非常严苛。好的油漆工程从第一遍涂刷之前就开始了，需要正确的表面处理和适合每个区域的涂层。本指南将介绍我们的油漆服务范围、影响价格的因素，以及我们如何确保持久的效果。

## 我们的油漆服务范围

我们的油漆团队服务覆盖巴生谷的住宅与商业物业：

- **[室内房屋油漆](/zh/services/painting/interior-house-painting)** — 客厅、卧室、走廊和天花板，使用低气味可水洗涂料。
- **室外房屋油漆** — 用于外立面、围栏和停车棚区域的防风雨、防霉菌、抗紫外线涂层。
- **商业与办公室油漆** — 店面和办公室，以将业务干扰降至最低的进度施工。
- **墙面裂缝与防潮修补** — 涂刷前进行打磨、批灰、裂缝填补和潮湿砖体密封。

每个工程都根据您的预算使用优质正品涂料，绝不使用几个月内就会粉化和褪色的廉价低质涂料。

## 为什么表面处理在马来西亚如此重要

跳过表面处理是马来西亚房屋油漆失败的最常见原因。涂刷之前，我们：

1. **保护与遮蔽** — 用防护布和优质遮蔽胶带覆盖家具、地板、开关和窗户，确保交付时零污损。
2. **表面处理** — 裂缝、钉孔和凹陷用高级石膏填补并打磨平整。
3. **底漆与密封** — 优质底漆或密封剂防止潮气渗透，确保面漆附着。
4. **两遍面漆** — 两遍优质Nippon Paint或Dulux涂料，带来饱满均匀的覆盖。
5. **检查与清洁** — 我们移除所有防护罩、吸尘清扫，并与您共同验收。

这就是专业完工比在未处理墙面上快速重涂能多坚持几年的原因。

## 吉隆坡与雪兰莪油漆费用

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 室内墙面油漆 | 每房 RM 450 起 |
| 室外房屋油漆 | RM 2,200 起 |
| 墙面裂缝与防潮修补 | RM 180 起 |
| 商业与办公室油漆 | 依报价 |

最终价格取决于面积、涂刷遍数、墙面状况以及施工条件（例如楼上需要脚手架）。免费现场勘察后即可获得准确的固定报价。

## 墙面需要重新油漆的迹象

- **褪色或粉化** — 用手揉墙面会在手上留下白色粉末。
- **剥落或起泡** — 通常由漆后的潮气引起。
- **开裂和起屑** — 尤其出现在窗户、踢脚线和浴室边缘附近。
- **霉斑或发霉** — 常见于浴室、厨房和空调附近。
- **污渍和痕迹** — 普通清洁无法去除。

如果您看到以上任何迹象，若不先修复并密封墙面基层，仅重涂无法解决根本原因。我们的[油漆剥落修补指南](/zh/problems/peeling-paint-malaysia)解释了常见原因和正确的处理方法。

## 为马来西亚气候选择正确的涂料

- **室内：** 低气味、低VOC可水洗涂料（如Nippon Odour-less、Nippon Spot-less、Dulux EasyClean）在高湿度下干得快，且易于擦拭清洁。
- **室外：** 防风雨、防霉菌、抗紫外线涂层（如Nippon Weatherbond、Dulux Weathershield、Jotun）最能应对阳光和雨水。
- **颜色：** 浅中性色调让紧凑空间更明亮，而朝西墙面上的深色在阳光直射下褪色更快。

我们的团队会在现场勘察时携带色卡，让您放心选择。

## 让油漆工程更持久的贴士

- 涂刷前先解决潮气问题——油漆无法阻止漏水管或墙体返潮。
- 尤其是在潮湿天气，确保各层之间有足够的干燥时间。
- 用湿布轻轻清洁墙面；哑光饰面避免用力擦洗。
- 及早补漆小划痕，防止扩散。

## 常见问题

### 你们使用哪些涂料品牌？

我们主要推荐Nippon Paint、Dulux或Jotun。室内使用优质可水洗系列；室外使用耐用的防风雨涂层。我们绝不使用廉价的低质粉化涂料。

### 粉刷一套三房住宅需要多长时间？

一套标准的三房公寓（约1,000平方英尺）通常需要2–3天，包括表面处理和层间干燥时间。单个房间通常一天内完成。

### 你们提供颜色咨询吗？

提供。我们的项目经理会在现场勘察时携带官方色卡，并针对现代配色、光线反射和可水洗饰面提供建议。

### 墙面修补包含在油漆报价里吗？

基本发丝裂缝修补、批灰修补和钉孔填补包含在内。结构性大裂缝、严重剥落或受潮石膏将作为一项透明的单独修补费用报价。

### 两层住宅可以做室外油漆吗？

可以。我们承接各种高度的外墙油漆，并为高层施工协调施工条件和安全措施。

## 获取吉隆坡与雪兰莪油漆报价

无论您是需要重涂一个房间还是全面的室内外重涂，KL Servis Rumah 都能提供专业油漆服务，使用优质涂料、完整的表面处理，并提供最长2年针对剥落和过早粉化的保修。我们服务吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地，包括八打灵再也、梳邦再也、莎阿南、蒲种、蕉赖、安邦和巴生。

WhatsApp发送您墙面的照片以获得快速估价——[与我们的团队联系](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E6%88%BF%E5%B1%8B%E6%B2%B9%E6%BC%86%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Pendant & Chandelier Installation in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Pendant and chandelier installation starts from RM 180 in KL & Selangor — reinforced ceiling hooks, safety cables, and clean wiring for heavy statement fixtures.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Pendant & Chandelier Installation Cost in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Pendant & chandelier installation in KL & Selangor from RM 180 — reinforced hooks, safety cables and clean wiring for heavy decorative fixtures.
en.content:
Pendant and chandelier installation in Kuala Lumpur or Selangor starts from RM 180, including reinforced ceiling mounting, safety cables for heavy fixtures, and clean wiring. KL Servis Rumah installs single pendants, cluster pendants, and chandeliers in homes, restaurants, and shops.

A statement light over a dining table, kitchen island, or entryway instantly changes a room. But pendants and chandeliers are heavy, and the ceiling mounting must carry both the weight and the strain of the fixture. This guide explains what a safe installation includes and what to consider before buying.

## What Counts as a Pendant or Chandelier?

- **Pendants** — a single light suspended from the ceiling on a cord or rod. Available as one fixture or in clusters of three, five, or more.
- **Chandeliers** — multi-arm decorative fixtures, ranging from lightweight crystal styles to heavy brass or iron designs.
- **Linear lights** — long horizontal fixtures, popular over kitchen islands and dining tables.
- **Globe/bubble lights** — rounded glass designs that diffuse light softly.

## Installation: What's Included

1. **Weight assessment** — the installer checks the fixture's weight and the ceiling type (concrete, plaster, or gypsum false ceiling).
2. **Reinforced hook** — for anything heavier than a lightweight shade, a reinforced ceiling hook is installed and anchored to the structure above. For gypsum false ceilings (common in condominiums), a steel support frame is fixed to the concrete slab, then the hook attaches to it.
3. **Safety cable** — heavy fixtures are fitted with a secondary safety cable, so even if the primary hook ever failed, the fixture would not fall.
4. **Wiring** — the fixture is wired to the ceiling point with correct polarity and a secure connection, concealed inside the canopy.
5. **Level & alignment** — the fixture is hung level and aligned over the table or island, at the right height.
6. **Testing** — all bulbs and circuits are tested before handover.

Installation carries a 12-month lighting installation warranty.

## How High Should a Pendant Hang?

- **Dining table** — the bottom of the fixture should hang about 70–80 cm above the tabletop.
- **Kitchen island** — 80–90 cm above the counter.
- **Entryway** — high enough to clear the tallest person; fixtures with chains can be adjusted.
- **Bedside** — just above eye level when sitting.

These are starting points — the installer will position the fixture to suit your ceiling height and room layout.

## Choosing the Right Fixture

- **Size** — a common guide: add the room's length and width in feet, and that number (in inches) is a reasonable fixture diameter. For example, a 12 × 10 ft dining room suits a fixture around 22 inches wide.
- **Weight** — check the manufacturer's weight; anything above a few kilograms needs the reinforced mounting described above.
- **Bulb type and brightness** — LED bulbs are the sensible choice in Malaysia; confirm the fixture accepts them and the wattage suits the space.
- **Ceiling height** — low ceilings suit compact pendants or flush-mount options; high ceilings allow dramatic multi-tier fixtures.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does it cost to install a pendant light in Malaysia?

Installation starts from RM 180 in KL and Selangor, including the hook, wiring, and fitting. Heavy chandeliers or fixtures needing a new ceiling support are quoted after a site check.

### Can a chandelier be installed on a gypsum false ceiling?

Yes, but never directly into the gypsum board. The fixture must be supported by a steel frame anchored to the concrete slab above, with a safety cable. This is standard practice for condominium installations.

### What is a safety cable for?

A safety cable is a secondary steel wire connecting the fixture to the structure. If the primary hook ever failed, the cable would catch the fixture and prevent it from falling — an important safeguard for heavy or expensive lights.

### Do you install fixtures the customer provides?

Yes. We install fixtures from any retailer. If the ceiling point or wiring needs adjustment, we quote this separately before starting.

### Can a pendant be installed where there is no existing ceiling point?

Yes, we can run a new lighting point from the nearest circuit. This is combined with the installation for one visit.

## Book a Pendant or Chandelier Installation

KL Servis Rumah installs pendants and chandeliers across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor with reinforced mounting, safety cables, and clean wiring — backed by a 12-month warranty. WhatsApp us for a quote — [message the team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20to%20get%20a%20quote%20for%20lighting%20installation%20service%20for%20my%20property.).

ms.title: Pemasangan Lampu Gantung & Candelier di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Pemasangan lampu gantung dan candelier bermula dari RM 180 di KL & Selangor — cangkuk siling diperkukuh, kabel keselamatan, dan pendawaian kemas untuk kelengkapan berat.
ms.metaTitle: Kos Pemasangan Lampu Gantung & Candelier di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Pemasangan lampu gantung & candelier di KL & Selangor dari RM 180 — cangkuk diperkukuh, kabel keselamatan dan pendawaian kemas untuk kelengkapan hiasan berat.
ms.content:
Pemasangan lampu gantung dan candelier di Kuala Lumpur atau Selangor bermula dari RM 180, termasuk pelekap siling diperkukuh, kabel keselamatan untuk kelengkapan berat, dan pendawaian kemas. KL Servis Rumah memasang pendant tunggal, pendant kluster, dan candelier di rumah, restoran, dan kedai.

Lampu pernyataan di atas meja makan, pulau dapur, atau ruang masuk serta-merta mengubah bilik. Tetapi pendant dan candelier berat, dan pelekap siling mesti menanggung kedua-dua berat dan tekanan kelengkapan. Panduan ini menerangkan apa yang termasuk dalam pemasangan selamat dan apa yang perlu dipertimbangkan sebelum membeli.

## Apa yang Dikira Sebagai Pendant atau Candelier?

- **Pendant** — satu lampu digantung dari siling pada kord atau rod. Tersedia sebagai satu kelengkapan atau dalam kluster tiga, lima, atau lebih.
- **Candelier** — kelengkapan hiasan berbilang lengan, dari gaya kristal ringan hingga reka bentuk loyang atau besi berat.
- **Lampu linear** — kelengkapan mendatar panjang, popular di atas pulau dapur dan meja makan.
- **Lampu glob/gelembung** — reka bentuk kaca bulat yang menyebarkan cahaya lembut.

## Pemasangan: Apa yang Termasuk

1. **Penilaian berat** — pemasang memeriksa berat kelengkapan dan jenis siling (konkrit, plaster, atau siling palsu gypsum).
2. **Cangkuk diperkukuh** — untuk apa-apa yang lebih berat daripada tudung ringan, cangkuk siling diperkukuh dipasang dan berlabuh pada struktur di atas. Untuk siling palsu gypsum (biasa di kondominium), rangka sokongan keluli dipasang pada papak konkrit, kemudian cangkuk melekat padanya.
3. **Kabel keselamatan** — kelengkapan berat dipasang dengan kabel keselamatan sekunder, supaya walaupun cangkuk utama gagal, kelengkapan tidak akan jatuh.
4. **Pendawaian** — kelengkapan didawaikan ke titik siling dengan kekutuban betul dan sambungan selamat, disembunyikan di dalam kanopi.
5. **Aras & jajaran** — kelengkapan digantung rata dan dijajarkan di atas meja atau pulau, pada ketinggian yang betul.
6. **Ujian** — semua mentol dan litar diuji sebelum penyerahan.

Pemasangan disertakan jaminan pemasangan pencahayaan 12 bulan.

## Berapa Tinggi Pendant Patut Digantung?

- **Meja makan** — bahagian bawah kelengkapan patut menggantung kira-kira 70–80 cm di atas permukaan meja.
- **Pulau dapur** — 80–90 cm di atas kaunter.
- **Ruang masuk** — cukup tinggi untuk membersihkan orang paling tinggi; kelengkapan dengan rantai boleh dilaraskan.
- **Tepi katil** — hanya di atas paras mata apabila duduk.

Ini titik permulaan — pemasang akan meletakkan kelengkapan mengikut ketinggian siling dan susun atur bilik anda.

## Memilih Kelengkapan yang Tepat

- **Saiz** — panduan biasa: tambah panjang dan lebar bilik dalam kaki, dan nombor itu (dalam inci) ialah diameter kelengkapan yang munasabah. Contohnya, ruang makan 12 × 10 kaki sesuai dengan kelengkapan sekitar 22 inci lebar.
- **Berat** — semak berat pengilang; apa-apa melebihi beberapa kilogram memerlukan pelekap diperkukuh seperti yang diterangkan di atas.
- **Jenis mentol dan kecerahan** — mentol LED adalah pilihan bijak di Malaysia; sahkan kelengkapan menerimanya dan watt sesuai dengan ruang.
- **Ketinggian siling** — siling rendah sesuai dengan pendant padat atau pilihan pelekap rata; siling tinggi membolehkan kelengkapan bertingkat yang dramatik.

## Soalan Lazim

### Berapa kos memasang lampu gantung di Malaysia?

Pemasangan bermula dari RM 180 di KL dan Selangor, termasuk cangkuk, pendawaian, dan pemasangan. Candelier berat atau kelengkapan yang memerlukan sokongan siling baharu disebut harga selepas semakan tapak.

### Bolehkah candelier dipasang pada siling palsu gypsum?

Ya, tetapi tidak pernah terus ke papan gypsum. Kelengkapan mesti disokong oleh rangka keluli yang berlabuh pada papak konkrit di atas, dengan kabel keselamatan. Ini amalan standard untuk pemasangan kondominium.

### Apa itu kabel keselamatan?

Kabel keselamatan ialah wayar keluli sekunder yang menyambungkan kelengkapan ke struktur. Jika cangkuk utama gagal, kabel akan menangkap kelengkapan dan menghalangnya daripada jatuh — perlindungan penting untuk lampu berat atau mahal.

### Adakah anda memasang kelengkapan yang dibekalkan pelanggan?

Ya. Kami memasang kelengkapan dari mana-mana peruncit. Jika titik siling atau pendawaian perlu pelarasan, kami sebut harga ini berasingan sebelum memulakan.

### Bolehkah pendant dipasang di mana tiada titik siling sedia ada?

Ya, kami boleh menjalankan titik lampu baharu dari litar terdekat. Ini digabungkan dengan pemasangan untuk satu lawatan.

## Tempah Pemasangan Pendant atau Candelier

KL Servis Rumah memasang pendant dan candelier di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor dengan pelekap diperkukuh, kabel keselamatan, dan pendawaian kemas — disokong jaminan 12 bulan. WhatsApp kami untuk sebut harga — [hantar mesej kepada pasukan](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Salam%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20ingin%20mendapatkan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20perkhidmatan%20pemasangan%20lampu%20untuk%20harta%20saya.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪吊灯与水晶灯安装
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪吊灯与水晶灯安装RM 180起——加固天花板吊钩、安全绳和整洁布线，胜任重型装饰灯具。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪吊灯与水晶灯安装费用
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪吊灯与水晶灯安装RM 180起——加固吊钩、安全绳与整洁布线，胜任重型装饰灯具。
zh.content:
在吉隆坡或雪兰莪安装吊灯和水晶灯，起步价RM 180，包含加固天花板安装、重型灯具安全绳和整洁布线。KL Servis Rumah 为住宅、餐厅和商店安装单头吊灯、组合吊灯和水晶灯。

餐桌、厨房中岛或门厅上方的焦点灯具能瞬间改变房间气质。但吊灯和水晶灯很重，天花板安装必须同时承受灯具的重量和受力。本指南介绍安全安装包含哪些内容，以及购买前需要考虑什么。

## 什么算吊灯或水晶灯？

- **吊灯** — 通过电线或吊杆悬挂在天花板上的单盏灯具。有单头或三头、五头及以上的组合款式。
- **水晶灯** — 多臂装饰灯具，从轻盈的水晶风格到厚重的黄铜或铁艺设计。
- **线性灯** — 长条形水平灯具，常用于厨房中岛和餐桌上。
- **球形/泡泡灯** — 柔和散射光线的圆形玻璃设计。

## 安装包含哪些内容

1. **重量评估** — 安装师傅检查灯具重量和天花板类型（混凝土、批灰或石膏板吊顶）。
2. **加固吊钩** — 任何比轻质灯罩更重的灯具，都要安装锚固在上方结构的加固天花板吊钩。对于石膏板吊顶（公寓常见），先在混凝土楼板固定钢制支撑框架，再连接吊钩。
3. **安全绳** — 重型灯具加装辅助安全绳，即使主吊钩万一失效，灯具也不会坠落。
4. **布线** — 灯具以正确极性接入天花板点位，连接牢固，隐藏在罩盖内。
5. **水平与对中** — 灯具水平悬挂，并正对餐桌或中岛，高度合适。
6. **测试** — 交付前测试所有灯泡和回路。

安装附带12个月照明安装保修。

## 吊灯应挂多高？

- **餐桌** — 灯具底部应距桌面约70–80厘米。
- **厨房中岛** — 距台面80–90厘米。
- **门厅** — 高到足以让最高的人通过；带链条的灯具可以调节。
- **床头** — 坐姿时略高于视线。

这些是起点——安装师傅会根据您的天花板高度和房间布局调整灯具位置。

## 选择合适的灯具

- **尺寸** — 常用参考：把房间的长和宽（英尺）相加，得到的数字（英寸）就是合理的灯具直径。例如，12×10英尺的餐厅适合约22英寸宽的灯具。
- **重量** — 查看厂家重量；超过几公斤的灯具都需要上述加固安装。
- **灯泡类型与亮度** — LED灯泡是马来西亚的明智选择；确认灯具支持LED以及功率适合空间。
- **天花板高度** — 低天花板适合紧凑吊灯或平装选项；高天花板可容纳引人注目的多层灯具。

## 常见问题

### 在马来西亚安装一盏吊灯多少钱？

吉隆坡和雪兰莪安装起步价RM 180，包含吊钩、布线和安装。重型水晶灯或需要新天花板支撑的灯具在勘察后报价。

### 石膏板吊顶能装水晶灯吗？

可以，但绝不能直接装在石膏板上。灯具必须由锚固在上方混凝土楼板的钢制框架支撑，并配安全绳。这是公寓安装的标准做法。

### 什么是安全绳？

安全绳是连接灯具与结构的辅助钢丝。如果主吊钩万一失效，安全绳会接住灯具防止坠落——对重型或昂贵的灯具是重要的安全保障。

### 你们安装客户自购的灯具吗？

安装。我们安装任何零售商购买的灯具。如果天花板点位或布线需要调整，我们会在开工前单独报价。

### 没有现有天花点位能装吊灯吗？

可以，我们可以从最近回路新开灯光点位。这会与安装合并为一次上门。

## 预约吊灯或水晶灯安装

KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地安装吊灯和水晶灯，提供加固安装、安全绳和整洁布线——附12个月保修。WhatsApp联系我们获取报价——[给团队发消息](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E7%81%AF%E5%85%89%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Plaster Ceiling Installation Cost & Process Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Install a smooth flat, tiered or L-box plaster ceiling with concealed lighting. Professional plaster ceiling installation across KL & Selangor, from RM 10 per sq ft.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Plaster Ceiling Installation: KL Planning Guide
en.metaDesc: Install a smooth flat, tiered or L-box plaster ceiling with concealed lighting. Professional plaster ceiling installation across KL & Selangor, from RM 10 per sq ft.
en.content:
A plaster ceiling gives a home a clean, modern finish while hiding wiring, ducts, and pipes. Whether you want a simple flat ceiling or a tiered L-box design with concealed lighting, KL Servis Rumah provides professional plaster ceiling installation across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, from RM 10 per sq ft.

This guide explains the plaster ceiling options available, the installation process, and what affects the cost.

## Plaster Ceiling Options

- **Flat plaster ceiling** — a clean, smooth ceiling for a minimalist look.
- **Tiered & L-box ceiling** — layered designs that add depth and often include a concealed light trough.
- **Cove & curved ceiling** — softer, curved transitions for a premium feel.
- **Ceiling repair & re-skim** — resurfacing existing ceilings that are cracked or worn.

We work with gypsum board and plaster to create smooth, even surfaces ready for painting.

## The Installation Process

1. **Design and measurement** — we measure the area and finalise the design with you.
2. **Framework** — metal framing is installed at the correct level and spacing.
3. **Board installation** — gypsum boards are fixed to the framework.
4. **Jointing and skim** — joints are taped, filled, and skimmed smooth.
5. **Sanding and finishing** — the surface is sanded for a smooth paint-ready finish.
6. **Concealed lighting (optional)** — light troughs and wiring are prepared as required.

## What Affects the Cost?

| Ceiling type | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Flat plaster ceiling | From RM 10 / sq ft |
| Tiered & L-box ceiling | From RM 14 / sq ft |
| Cove & curved ceiling | From RM 22 / sq ft |
| Ceiling repair & re-skim | From RM 8 / sq ft |

The final cost depends on ceiling area, design complexity, and site condition. A site visit gives you an accurate fixed quote.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the difference between a flat and L-box ceiling?

A flat ceiling is one smooth surface. An L-box (or tiered) ceiling has stepped layers, usually with a concealed trough for indirect lighting, adding depth and a modern look.

### Do you install the concealed lighting too?

We prepare the ceiling structure and troughs for concealed lighting. Electrical wiring for the lights is done by our licensed electrical team — see our [lighting design and installation](/services/lighting) service.

### How long does a plaster ceiling take to install?

A standard living-room ceiling is usually completed within a few days, depending on area and design. Drying and finishing times depend on humidity.

### Can a plaster ceiling hide wiring and pipes?

Yes. One of the main advantages is concealing wiring, ducts, and plumbing above the ceiling while keeping access points where needed.

## Get a Plaster Ceiling Quote

Whether you want a simple flat ceiling or a modern L-box design with concealed lighting, KL Servis Rumah provides professional plaster ceiling installation across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a free quote — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20a%20plaster%20ceiling%20for%20my%20property.).

ms.metaTitle: Panduan Kos: Pemasangan Siling Plaster di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Pasang siling plaster rata, bertingkat atau L-box dengan lampu tersembunyi. Pemasangan siling plaster profesional di seluruh KL & Selangor, dari RM 10 / kaki persegi.
ms.content:
Siling plaster memberikan rumah kemasan bersih dan moden sambil menyembunyikan pendawaian, saluran, dan paip. Sama ada anda mahukan siling rata yang ringkas atau reka bentuk L-box bertingkat dengan lampu tersembunyi, KL Servis Rumah menyediakan pemasangan siling plaster profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, dari RM 10 / kaki persegi.

Panduan ini menerangkan pilihan siling plaster yang tersedia, proses pemasangan, dan apa yang mempengaruhi kos.

## Pilihan Siling Plaster

- **Siling plaster rata** — siling licin dan bersih untuk rupa minimalis.
- **Siling bertingkat & L-box** — reka bentuk berlapis yang menambah kedalaman dan selalunya termasuk ceruk lampu tersembunyi.
- **Siling cekung & melengkung** — peralihan melengkung lembut untuk rasa premium.
- **Pembaikan & re-skim siling** — permukaan semula siling sedia ada yang retak atau haus.

Kami bekerja dengan gypsum board dan plaster untuk mencipta permukaan licin dan sekata sedia dicat.

## Proses Pemasangan

1. **Reka bentuk dan ukuran** — kami mengukur kawasan dan memuktamadkan reka bentuk dengan anda.
2. **Rangka** — rangka logam dipasang pada aras dan jarak yang betul.
3. **Pemasangan papan** — gypsum board dipasang pada rangka.
4. **Sambungan dan skim** — sambungan ditampal, diisi, dan di-skim licin.
5. **Pengamplasan dan kemasan** — permukaan diamplas untuk kemasan sedia cat yang licin.
6. **Lampu tersembunyi (pilihan)** — ceruk lampu dan pendawaian disediakan seperti diperlukan.

## Apa yang Mempengaruhi Kos?

| Jenis siling | Harga permulaan |
|---|---|
| Siling plaster rata | Dari RM 10 / kaki persegi |
| Siling bertingkat & L-box | Dari RM 14 / kaki persegi |
| Siling cekung & melengkung | Dari RM 22 / kaki persegi |
| Pembaikan & re-skim siling | Dari RM 8 / kaki persegi |

Kos akhir bergantung pada luas siling, kerumitan reka bentuk, dan keadaan tapak. Lawatan tapak memberi anda sebut harga tetap yang tepat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Apa perbezaan antara siling rata dan L-box?

Siling rata ialah satu permukaan licin. Siling L-box (atau bertingkat) mempunyai lapisan bertingkat, biasanya dengan ceruk untuk pencahayaan tidak langsung, menambah kedalaman dan rupa moden.

### Adakah anda memasang lampu tersembunyi juga?

Kami menyediakan struktur siling dan ceruk untuk lampu tersembunyi. Pendawaian elektrik untuk lampu dilakukan oleh pasukan elektrik berlesen kami — lihat perkhidmatan [reka bentuk & pemasangan lampu](/ms/services/lighting) kami.

### Berapa lama pemasangan siling plaster?

Siling ruang tamu standard biasanya siap dalam beberapa hari, bergantung pada kawasan dan reka bentuk. Masa pengeringan dan kemasan bergantung pada kelembapan.

### Bolehkah siling plaster menyembunyikan pendawaian dan paip?

Ya. Salah satu kelebihan utamanya ialah menyembunyikan pendawaian, saluran, dan paip di atas siling sambil mengekalkan titik akses di mana perlu.

## Dapatkan Sebut Harga Siling Plaster

Sama ada anda mahukan siling rata ringkas atau reka bentuk L-box moden dengan lampu tersembunyi, KL Servis Rumah menyediakan pemasangan siling plaster profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor. zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪石膏板天花板安装｜费用指南
zh.metaDesc: 安装平滑的平面、阶梯式或L形石膏板吊顶，带隐藏式照明。专业石膏板天花板安装，每平方英尺RM 10起。
zh.content:
石膏板天花板为住宅带来干净、现代的外观，同时隐藏电线、管道和管线。无论您想要简单的平面天花板，还是带隐藏式照明的阶梯式L形设计，KL Servis Rumah 都能在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供专业石膏板天花板安装服务，每平方英尺RM 10起。

本指南介绍可用的石膏板天花板选项、安装流程，以及影响价格的因素。

## 石膏板天花板选项

- **平面石膏板天花板** — 简约风格的干净平滑天花板。

## 常见问题

### 平面天花板和L形吊顶有什么区别？

平面天花板是单一平滑表面。L形（或阶梯式）吊顶具有分层结构，通常带用于间接照明的隐藏槽，增加深度和现代感。

标准客厅天花板通常几天内完成，具体取决于面积和设计。干燥和收尾时间取决于湿度。

### 石膏板天花板能隐藏电线和管道吗？

能。其主要优势之一是在天花板上方隐藏电线、管道和管线，同时保留需要的检修点。

en.metaDesc: Plumbing and leak repair in KL & Selangor, including leak diagnosis, fixture installation, drain unclogging, water heaters and pumps. Request a clear quote.
en.content:
Plumbing problems — leaking pipes, blocked drains, low water pressure, and failing taps — are some of the most common and urgent issues in Malaysian homes. KL Servis Rumah provides professional plumbing and leak repair services across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, covering everything from a dripping tap to a burst pipe emergency.

This guide explains the plumbing services we provide, the common problems we fix, and when you should call a plumber instead of attempting a DIY fix.

## Plumbing Services We Provide

Our plumbers handle residential and light commercial plumbing across the Klang Valley:

- **[Water leakage diagnosis & repair](/services/plumbing/water-leakage-diagnosis-and-repair)** — finding and fixing hidden leaks without unnecessary hacking of floors and walls.
- **[Toilet, tap & sink installation](/services/plumbing/toilet-tap-and-sink-installation)** — replacing or installing sanitary fittings in bathrooms and kitchens.
- **Drain unclogging & cleaning** — clearing blocked sinks, toilets, and floor drains.
- **Water heater & pump installation** — installing and setting up water heaters and pressure pumps.

Every job starts with a clear diagnosis and a fixed, itemised quote before any work begins.

## Common Plumbing Problems in Malaysian Homes

- **Dripping or leaking taps** — wastes water and raises your bill.
- **Blocked sinks and toilets** — caused by hair, grease, and foreign objects.
- **Low water pressure** — often a blocked pipe, faulty pump, or pressure issue.
- **Hidden pipe leaks** — a sudden jump in your water bill is a common sign.
- **Leaking bathroom floors** — water seeping through to the floor below.
- **Burst pipes** — an emergency that needs immediate attention.

If your water bill has spiked but you cannot see a leak, the water may be escaping from a hidden pipe. Our [hidden leak detection guide](/blog/hidden-water-leak-detection-kl) explains how this is found without tearing up your home.

## When to Call a Plumber

Some small fixes (like replacing a tap washer) are DIY-friendly. Call a professional when:

- Water is leaking into walls, ceilings, or the floor below.
- Your water pressure suddenly drops.
- Drains are repeatedly blocked.
- There is a smell of sewage or signs of damp.
- A pipe has burst and water is escaping.

Attempting major repairs without the right tools can cause more damage and cost more in the long run.

## How a Plumbing Job Works

1. **Diagnosis** — we inspect the issue and identify the cause.
2. **Fixed quote** — you receive a clear, itemised price before work starts.
3. **Repair or installation** — the work is carried out cleanly and safely.
4. **Testing** — taps, seals, and connections are tested for leaks.
5. **Clean handover** — the area is cleaned and we confirm the job is done.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a plumber cost in KL & Selangor?

Water leakage diagnosis starts from RM 220, toilet/tap/sink installation from RM 150, and drain unclogging from RM 180. The final quote depends on the job and site condition, confirmed before work begins.

### Can a leaking toilet be fixed without replacing it?

Often yes. Many leaks are caused by a worn valve, seal, or washer that can be replaced cheaply. If the ceramic or mechanism is damaged, replacement may be the better option.

### Why is my water pressure suddenly low?

Common causes include a blocked pipe or filter, a faulty pressure pump, a partially closed valve, or a hidden leak. A plumber can test the system and identify the cause.

### Do you handle emergency plumbing?

Yes. Burst pipes and major leaks receive priority dispatch. Contact us by WhatsApp with your location and the situation for the fastest response.

## Get a Plumbing Quote in KL & Selangor

From a dripping tap to a hidden leak, KL Servis Rumah provides professional plumbing services with fixed quotes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a free assessment — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20to%20get%20a%20quote%20for%20plumbing%20service%20for%20my%20property.).

Masalah paip — paip bocor, longkang tersumbat, tekanan air rendah, dan tap rosak — ialah antara isu paling biasa dan mendesak di rumah Malaysia. KL Servis Rumah menyediakan perkhidmatan paip dan pembaikan bocor profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, merangkumi segala-galanya daripada tap menitis hingga kecemasan paip pecah.

- **Pembersihan longkang tersumbat** — membersihkan sink, tandas, dan longkang lantai tersumbat.

Setiap kerja bermula dengan diagnosis yang jelas dan sebut harga tetap yang terperinci sebelum sebarang kerja bermula.

## Masalah Paip Biasa di Rumah Malaysia

- **Tap menitis atau bocor** — membazir air dan menaikkan bil.
- **Sink dan tandas tersumbat** — disebabkan rambut, gris, dan objek asing.
- **Tekanan air rendah** — selalunya paip tersumbat, pam rosak, atau isu tekanan.
- **Bocor paip tersembunyi** — kenaikan mendadak bil air ialah tanda biasa.
- **Lantai bilik air bocor** — air meresap ke lantai di bawah.
- **Paip pecah** — kecemasan yang memerlukan perhatian segera.

Jika bil air anda melonjak tetapi anda tidak nampak bocor, air mungkin keluar daripada paip tersembunyi. Panduan [pengesanan bocor tersembunyi](/ms/blog/pengesanan-kebocoran-air-tersembunyi-kl) kami menerangkan cara ia ditemui tanpa merosakkan rumah anda.

Sesetengah pembaikan kecil (seperti menukar washer tap) boleh DIY. Hubungi profesional apabila:

- Air bocor ke dinding, siling, atau lantai di bawah.
- Tekanan air anda tiba-tiba menurun.
- Longkang berulang kali tersumbat.
- Ada bau kumbahan atau tanda lembap.
- Paip pecah dan air keluar.

Mencuba pembaikan besar tanpa alat yang betul boleh menyebabkan lebih banyak kerosakan dan kos yang lebih tinggi.

## Cara Kerja Paip Dijalankan

1. **Diagnosis** — kami memeriksa isu dan mengenal pasti puncanya.
2. **Sebut harga tetap** — anda menerima harga yang jelas dan terperinci sebelum kerja bermula.
3. **Pembaikan atau pemasangan** — kerja dijalankan dengan bersih dan selamat.
4. **Ujian** — tap, pengedap, dan sambungan diuji untuk kebocoran.
5. **Serahan bersih** — kawasan dibersihkan dan kami sahkan kerja selesai.

## Soalan Lazim

Diagnosis bocor air bermula dari RM 220, pemasangan tandas/tap/sink dari RM 150, dan pembersihan longkang dari RM 180. Sebut harga akhir bergantung pada kerja dan keadaan tapak, disahkan sebelum kerja bermula.

### Bolehkah tandas bocor dibaiki tanpa menggantikannya?

Selalunya ya. Banyak kebocoran disebabkan injap, pengedap, atau washer haus yang boleh diganti dengan murah. Jika seramik atau mekanisme rosak, penggantian mungkin pilihan yang lebih baik.

### Kenapa tekanan air saya tiba-tiba rendah?

Punca biasa termasuk paip atau penapis tersumbat, pam tekanan rosak, injap tertutup separa, atau bocor tersembunyi. Tukang paip boleh menguji sistem dan mengenal pasti puncanya.

### Adakah anda mengendalikan paip kecemasan?

Ya. Paip pecah dan bocor besar menerima penghantaran keutamaan. Hubungi kami melalui WhatsApp dengan lokasi dan keadaan anda untuk respons terpantas.

- **[马桶、水龙头与洗手盆安装](/zh/services/plumbing/toilet-tap-and-sink-installation)** — 在浴室和厨房更换或安装卫生洁具。

每个工程都从明确的诊断和固定、分项的报价开始，然后才开始施工。

- **滴水或漏水的水龙头** — 浪费水并推高账单。
- **堵塞的水槽和马桶** — 由毛发、油脂和异物引起。
- **水压过低** — 通常是管道堵塞、泵故障或压力问题。
- **隐藏管道漏水** — 水费突然上涨是常见迹象。

如果您的水费激增但看不到漏水，水可能正从隐藏管道中流失。我们的[隐藏漏水检测指南](/zh/bo-ke/ji-long-po-cang-an-lou-shui-jian-ce)介绍了如何无需拆毁您的家就能找到它。

- 水正渗入墙壁、天花板或下层地板。
- 水压突然下降。
- 排水管反复堵塞。
- 有下水道气味或潮湿迹象。
- 管道爆裂，水正在流失。

4. **测试** — 水龙头、密封件和连接件经过漏水测试。
5. **干净交付** — 区域被清理干净，我们确认工程已完成。

漏水诊断RM 220起，马桶/水龙头/水槽安装RM 150起，疏通排水管RM 180起。最终报价取决于工程和现场状况，施工前确认。

### 为什么我的水压突然很低？

常见原因包括管道或过滤器堵塞、增压泵故障、阀门半开或隐藏漏水。水管工可以测试系统并确定原因。

en.title: Autogate Not Closing or Motor Running Continuously
en.excerpt: A gate that opens but won't close, or a motor that never stops, is usually a limit switch, sensor or capacitor. Learn how to tell them apart.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Autogate Not Closing in KL: Causes & Repair
en.metaDesc: Autogate opens but won't close, or the motor keeps running? Learn the limit switch, sensor and capacitor causes, and what repair costs in KL & Selangor.
en.content:
**Question:** My auto gate opens normally but will not close, or the motor keeps running without stopping. Sometimes it reverses halfway. Is the motor dying?

**Answer:** Not necessarily — and a gate that opens but will not close is usually a control or safety issue rather than a worn-out motor. The four most common causes are a faulty limit switch that no longer tells the motor where to stop, a blocked or misaligned obstruction sensor that keeps tripping the safety reverse, a failing motor capacitor that cannot drive the gate closed, or a remote or control-board fault sending the wrong signal. The fix is to test and replace the faulty component — often a small, inexpensive part — rather than replace the whole motor.

## Why an Autogate Stops Closing

| Cause | Typical clue |
|---|---|
| Faulty limit switch | Motor runs past the stop point, or never stops |
| Blocked obstruction sensor | Gate reverses as if something is in the way |
| Motor capacitor failure | Motor hums but lacks power to close |
| Remote or board fault | Gate ignores the close command intermittently |
| Misaligned safety beam | Gate reverses at the same point every time |

## What to Check Before You Call

1. **Look at the safety sensors** (photobeams) on either side of the gate. Dirt, spider webs or a knocked-out alignment will make the gate refuse to close.
2. **Listen to the motor.** A hum without movement, or slow travel, points to the capacitor.
3. **Try the manual release** so the gate can be opened and closed by hand while the fault is fixed — important for security.
4. **Note whether it happens every time or only sometimes** — intermittent faults often point to a board or remote.

## What a Technician Does

An autogate technician will typically:

- Test and replace the limit switch so the motor stops at the correct points.
- Clean and realign the safety sensors and photobeams.
- Test and replace the motor capacitor where the motor is weak.
- Reprogram or replace the control board if it is sending faulty signals.
- Service the motor and track, and check the hinges and wheels run freely.

KL Servis Rumah repairs and services common autogate brands and can also fit a battery backup so the gate still works during power cuts. Autogate work carries the published 12-Month Motor & Installation Warranty.

## Costs in KL and Selangor

Published guidance for this problem is **RM 250 to RM 1,200+**, depending on motor or sensor replacement. KL Servis Rumah publishes [autogate motor replacement and service](/services/autogate/autogate-motor-replacement-and-service) from **RM 950**, and [single swing autogate](/services/autogate/single-swing-autogate) installation from **RM 2,200** where a new system is needed. A limit-switch or sensor repair is typically at the lower end of the range.

## Related Problems

- [Auto gate remote not working](/problems/autogate-remote-not-working) — the remote side of autogate trouble.
- [Loose or sagging metal gate hinges](/problems/loose-metal-gate-hinges) — when the gate itself, not the motor, is binding.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can you repair existing autogate motors?
Yes. We repair and service common autogate brands, including Autogate 2000, Nice and FAAC, plus many others.

### Do you install battery backup?
Yes. We recommend and install battery backup so the gate keeps operating during power outages.

### Why does my gate reverse when nothing is there?
Usually the safety sensors or photobeams are dirty, misaligned or failing, making the gate think something is in the way.

### Is it dangerous if the motor keeps running?
Yes — a motor that does not stop can overheat and damage itself or strain the gate. It should be switched off and checked promptly.

### Should I replace the motor or just the part?
Most "not closing" faults are a limit switch, sensor or capacitor — far cheaper than a motor. The motor is only replaced when it has genuinely failed.

## Get the Gate Closing Again

The useful first step is knowing whether the fault is a switch, a sensor or the motor. KL Servis Rumah provides [autogate services](/services/autogate) across Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Cheras and Klang.

Tell us whether the gate opens, and whether it reverses or just keeps running — [WhatsApp our autogate team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20My%20autogate%20won%27t%20close.).
