zh.title: 鞋柜与玄关收纳：吉隆坡与雪兰莪指南
zh.excerpt: 鞋柜需要通风、足够内深和安全通行空间。翻斗柜适合浅玄关，但未必容纳所有鞋码；空间允许时层板更灵活。不得遮挡大门、配电箱或逃生路线。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪鞋柜与玄关收纳
zh.metaDesc: 了解鞋柜与玄关收纳的适用条件、现场检查、施工步骤、常见错误与报价因素，适合吉隆坡及雪兰莪住宅和商业物业。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**鞋柜需要通风、足够内深和安全通行空间。翻斗柜适合浅玄关，但未必容纳所有鞋码；空间允许时层板更灵活。不得遮挡大门、配电箱或逃生路线。

本文说明[鞋柜与玄关收纳](/zh/services/carpentry/shoe-cabinet-and-entry-storage)子服务，属于[木工服务](/zh/services/carpentry)。已公布起价为 **RM 1,800**。现场报价应明确尺寸、基层处理、材料、施工通道和相关维修；起价不是每个物业的固定总价。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

只有检查确认物业及周边构造能够承受拟议工程时，这项服务才适合；肉眼看到的症状不一定就是根因。吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的入住情况、停车与卸货通道、公寓管理规定及施工时段，都可能影响规划和排期。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **大门完全开启后的通道净宽。**
- **最大鞋码及家庭容量需求。**
- **潮湿、湿雨伞及通风路径。**
- **配电箱、对讲机、插座及踢脚线冲突。**

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **翻斗鞋柜** | 玄关很浅且以低帮鞋为主。 |
| **可调层板** | 鞋型多且深度足够。 |
| **换鞋凳加开放格** | 日常鞋需快取及散湿。 |

若不先了解限制，最便宜的方案可能造成重复施工。报价应说明选定方法为何适合现场基层、尺寸和实际用途。

## 常见施工流程

1. **测量门扇、走道及固定设施**。
2. **统计鞋型并分配层板或翻斗**。
3. **确认立面、通风、材料及固定方式**。
4. **制作模块并加强耐潮封边**。
5. **安装并固定高柜，测试柜门、灯光及通行**。

基层准备和工序先后很重要。原有缺陷、薄弱支撑、不兼容材料或损坏基层，应在封闭前处理。施工期间保护已入住空间、公共走廊及已完成饰面。验收不能只看外观，还要测试功能，并检查边缘、固定件、接缝和检修点。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 湿鞋存放在完全密闭柜内。
- 层板只适合现有单一鞋型。
- 高而窄的柜体未锚固。
- 遮挡配电箱或逃生通道。

合适的检查应区分“仍可维修的部件”与“已应更换的系统”。对于只有拆开后才能确认的隐藏状况，应要求把报价假设和不包含项目写清楚。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 1,800**
- 宽、高、深及内部容量。
- 层板、翻斗、换鞋凳、镜子及灯光组合。
- 材料、饰面、通风及五金。
- 墙况、固定及插座移位。

其主服务公布 **5 年柜体结构保修**，具体按适用范围和条款执行。请书面确认是否涵盖本次工程、客户自购材料及原有缺陷。

## 安全、进场与保养

不要为了省时而绕过厂家说明、管理处规定或安全通道安排。完工后保留产品资料和护理说明。定期清洁，并及早处理潮气、位移、锈蚀或五金松动，通常能让局部维修更简单。

## 常见问题

### 鞋柜要多深？
取决于最大鞋型和收纳方式。应实测鞋子；浅翻斗与全深层板的空间需求不同。

### 如何减少异味？
设置通风孔，湿鞋晾干后再入柜，并使用可取出清洗的接水托盘。

### 柜门装镜子安全吗？
可以，但镜片、背板、磨边及固定方式须与门板和位置匹配。

## 获取针对现场的报价

发送广角与近照、估算尺寸、物业类型，以及遇到的症状或希望达到的效果。KL Servis Rumah 可评估吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的实际范围，不会假定每个现场都需要同一方案。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E9%9E%8B%E6%9F%9C%E4%B8%8E%E7%8E%84%E5%85%B3%E6%94%B6%E7%BA%B3%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Single CCTV Camera Add-On in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Adding one camera to an existing CCTV system starts from RM 420 including cable, mounting and app pairing — provided the recorder has a spare channel or the app ecosystem accepts another device. Compatibility is checked before any drilling.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Single CCTV Camera Add-On in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Add one camera to your existing CCTV system in KL & Selangor — cable, mounting and app pairing from RM 420. Compatibility checks before drilling.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** A single camera add-on adds one more camera to a CCTV system you already own, covering a blind spot such as a side gate, back lane or new room. The published starting price is **from RM 420**, including cabling, mounting and app pairing — subject to the existing system having a spare channel or the app accepting another device.

This guide explains the [Single Camera Add-On](/services/cctv/single-camera-add-on) scope under [CCTV and security camera installation](/services/cctv). Compatibility decides everything on this job, so the existing brand and recorder are identified before any wall is drilled.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The add-on suits owners whose system basically works but leaves a gap — a blind side of the house, a newly extended kitchen, a staircase landing, or a parking spot outside the original camera angles. It works with the common ecosystems the team already services (published scope: Hikvision, Dahua, Ezviz and Tapo).

It is not the right fix when the recorder itself is faulty, footage is missing, or you want a ground-up design — that is a [system health check](/services/cctv/cctv-system-health-check-and-relocation) or a new package such as the [Condo Wi-Fi CCTV Package](/services/cctv/condo-wi-fi-cctv-package-4-cameras) or [Landed House PoE CCTV](/services/cctv/landed-house-poe-cctv-8-cameras). The [CCTV buying guide for Kuala Lumpur](/blog/cctv-installation-buying-guide-kl) explains package-level decisions.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Recorder spare channels** — a 4-channel NVR with 4 cameras fitted has no room; an upgrade path is quoted honestly instead of forcing it.
- **System brand and format** — cameras are matched to the recorder's ecosystem and resolution support.
- **Cable route or Wi-Fi signal** — PoE add-ons need a cable run; Wi-Fi add-ons need reliable signal at the exact mounting point.
- **Power availability** — PoE draws from the recorder or switch; Wi-Fi cameras need a nearby socket.
- **Storage impact** — an extra camera shares the same hard disk, shortening total retention; see [CCTV not recording when storage is full](/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full).
- **App access** — pairing requires the admin account, not just a shared view login.
- **Mounting surface and weather exposure** — outdoor points get weather-sealed housings and drip loops.

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **PoE camera add-on** | recorder has a spare channel/port; reliable wired quality wanted. |
| **Wi-Fi camera add-on** | same app ecosystem, easy pairing, no long cable run possible. |
| **Recorder/channel upgrade** | no spare channel — quoted openly rather than jury-rigged. |

## Typical Work Process

1. **Identify recorder model, free channels and app ecosystem.**
2. **Agree the camera position** — sightlines, height, tamper reach and light at night.
3. **Run cable or verify Wi-Fi at the exact point** before mounting.
4. **Mount, weather-seal and connect** the camera.
5. **Assign the channel or pair in the app**, then verify live view, recording and motion notifications from the owner's phone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Buying a cheap mismatched camera first and discovering the recorder will not register it.
- Mounting before testing Wi-Fi signal at the exact spot — signal at the window is not signal at the soffit.
- Covering a new blind spot while creating glare into a bright light at night.
- Forgetting the hard disk: retention drops when another camera joins, and nobody checks until evidence is missing.
- Drilling through concealed wiring or into a weak substrate that will not hold screws long-term.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: from RM 420** including cabling, mounting and app pairing.
- Camera model and resolution chosen to match the system.
- Cable length and routing difficulty, conduit needs and height.
- Any storage upgrade advised to preserve retention.

The parent service publishes a **12-Month Camera & Installation Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms — confirm in writing how it applies to the added camera and workmanship.

## Safety, Privacy and Maintenance

The camera should watch your property, not your neighbour's windows — positioning is part of the site discussion, and condo common areas require management approval. After installation, add the lens to your periodic wipe-down list and verify in the app that the new channel records continuously, not only on motion, if that is the setting you expect.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can a different brand camera be added to my recorder?
Sometimes, when the recorder and camera share a compatible standard and app pathway. It is verified against your exact model first — the honest answer can be no, and that is better than a camera that never records.

### How much retention will I lose by adding a camera?
Retention is total disk space divided by all cameras' recording load. One extra camera on an 8-camera system trims retention modestly; on a nearly full disk it can matter. The estimate on site uses your actual disk size and settings.

### Can I view the new camera in the same app?
Yes when it joins the same ecosystem — that is the point of matching the system. If your current setup already mixes brands awkwardly, the visit will flag it.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send the recorder brand/model, a photo of the current camera positions and the blind spot you want covered. KL Servis Rumah handles single camera add-ons across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor — and will tell you upfront if your recorder genuinely has room for one more.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quotation%20for%20Single%20Camera%20Add-On.).

ms.title: Tambahan Kamera CCTV Tunggal di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor
ms.excerpt: Menambah satu kamera pada sistem CCTV sedia ada bermula RM 420 termasuk kabel, pemasangan dan pemasangan aplikasi — dengan syarat perakam mempunyai saluran kosong atau ekosistem aplikasi menerima peranti baharu. Keserasian diperiksa sebelum sebarang penggerudian.
ms.metaTitle: Tambahan Kamera CCTV Tunggal di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Tambah satu kamera pada sistem CCTV sedia ada di KL & Selangor — kabel, pemasangan dan penetapan aplikasi dari RM 420. Keserasian diperiksa dahulu.
ms.content:
**Jawapan ringkas:** Tambahan kamera tunggal menambah satu lagi kamera pada sistem CCTV yang anda sudah miliki, menutup titik buta seperti pagar sisi, lorong belakang atau bilik baharu. Harga permulaan yang diterbitkan ialah **dari RM 420**, termasuk pendawaian, pemasangan dan penetapan aplikasi — tertakluk pada sistem sedia ada mempunyai saluran kosong atau aplikasi yang menerima peranti baharu.

Panduan ini menerangkan skop [Tambahan Kamera Tunggal](/ms/services/cctv/single-camera-add-on) di bawah [pemasangan CCTV dan kamera keselamatan](/ms/services/cctv). Keserasian menentukan segalanya pada kerja ini, jadi jenama dan perakam sedia ada dikenal pasti sebelum mana-mana dinding digerudi.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Tambahan ini sesuai untuk pemilik yang sistemnya pada asasnya berfungsi tetapi meninggalkan jurang — sisi buta rumah, dapur lanjutan baharu, ruang tangga atau petak parkir di luar sudut kamera asal. Ia berfungsi dengan ekosistem biasa yang pasukan sudah servis (skop diterbitkan: Hikvision, Dahua, Ezviz dan Tapo).

Ia bukan penyelesaian yang betul apabila perakam itu sendiri rosak, rakaman hilang atau anda mahukan reka bentuk dari awal — itu adalah [pemeriksaan kesihatan sistem](/ms/services/cctv/cctv-system-health-check-and-relocation) atau pakej baharu seperti [Pakej CCTV Wi-Fi Kondominium](/ms/services/cctv/condo-wi-fi-cctv-package-4-cameras) atau [CCTV PoE Rumah Landed](/ms/services/cctv/landed-house-poe-cctv-8-cameras). [Panduan membeli CCTV untuk Kuala Lumpur](/ms/blog/panduan-beli-pasang-cctv-kl) menerangkan keputusan peringkat pakej.

## Perkara Diperiksa Sebelum Kerja

- **Saluran kosong perakam** — NVR 4 saluran dengan 4 kamera dipasang tiada ruang; laluan naik taraf disebut harga secara jujur dan bukannya dipaksa.
- **Jenama dan format sistem** — kamera dipadankan dengan ekosistem perakam dan sokongan resolusinya.
- **Laluan kabel atau isyarat Wi-Fi** — tambahan PoE memerlukan laluan kabel; tambahan Wi-Fi memerlukan isyarat stabil di titik pemasangan tepat.
- **Ketersediaan kuasa** — PoE mengambil daripada perakam atau suis; kamera Wi-Fi memerlukan soket berdekatan.
- **Kesan storan** — kamera tambahan berkongi cakera keras yang sama, memendekkan jumlah pengekalan; lihat [CCTV tidak merakam apabila storan penuh](/ms/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full).
- **Akses aplikasi** — pemasangan memerlukan akaun admin, bukan sekadar log masuk paparan kongsi.
- **Permukaan pemasangan dan pendedahan cuaca** — titik luar mendapat housing tertutup cuaca dan gelung titisan air.

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Tambahan kamera PoE** | perakam mempunyai saluran/port kosong; kualiti berwayar stabil dikehendaki. |
| **Tambahan kamera Wi-Fi** | ekosistem aplikasi sama, pemasangan mudah, laluan kabel panjang tidak mungkin. |
| **Naik taraf perakam/saluran** | tiada saluran kosong — disebut harga secara terbuka dan bukannya dipinda sesuka hati. |

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Kenal pasti model perakam, saluran kosong dan ekosistem aplikasi.**
2. **Persetujui kedudukan kamera** — garis pandang, ketinggian, capaian vandal dan cahaya pada waktu malam.
3. **Tarik kabel atau sahkan Wi-Fi di titik tepat** sebelum pemasangan.
4. **Pasang, tutup cuaca dan sambungkan** kamera.
5. **Tetapkan saluran atau pasangkan dalam aplikasi**, kemudian sahkan paparan langsung, rakaman dan notifikasi gerakan daripada telefon pemilik.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Membeli kamera murah tidak sepadan dahulu dan mendapati perakam tidak dapat mendaftarkannya.
- Memasang sebelum menguji isyarat Wi-Fi di tempat tepat — isyarat di tingkap bukan isyarat di sofit.
- Menutup titik buta baharu tetapi terkena silau lampu terang pada waktu malam.
- Melupakan cakera keras: pengekalan menurun apabila kamera lain menyertai, dan tiada siapa menyemak sehingga bukti hilang.
- Mengerudi melalui pendawaian tersembunyi atau ke dalam substrat lemah yang tidak akan memegang skru lama.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: dari RM 420** termasuk pendawaian, pemasangan dan penetapan aplikasi.
- Model dan resolusi kamera dipilih untuk memadankan sistem.
- Panjang kabel dan kesukaran laluan, keperluan konduit serta ketinggian.
- Sebarang naik taraf storan yang dinasihatkan untuk mengekalkan pengekalan.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Kamera & Pemasangan 12 Bulan**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma yang dinyatakan — sahkan secara bertulis bagaimana ia terpakai pada kamera tambahan dan mutu kerja.

## Keselamatan, Privasi dan Penjagaan

Kamera sepatutnya mengawasi hartanah anda, bukan tingkap jiran — penentuan kedudukan adalah sebahagian daripada perbincangan tapak, dan kawasan bersama kondominium memerlukan kelulusan pengurusan. Selepas pemasangan, masukkan kanta ke dalam senarai lap berkala anda dan sahkan dalam aplikasi bahawa saluran baharu merakam secara berterusan, bukan hanya pada gerakan, jika itu tetapan yang anda jangkakan.

## Soalan Lazim

### Bolehkah kamera jenama lain ditambah pada perakam saya?
Kadangkala, apabila perakam dan kamera berkongsi standard serasi dan laluan aplikasi. Ia disahkan terhadap model tepat anda dahulu — jawapan jujur boleh jadi tidak, dan itu lebih baik daripada kamera yang tidak pernah merakam.

### Berapa banyak pengekalan yang akan hilang dengan menambah kamera?
Pengekalan ialah jumlah ruang cakera dibahagi dengan beban rakaman semua kamera. Satu kamera tambahan pada sistem 8 kamera memangkas pengekalan sedikit; pada cakera hampir penuh ia boleh memberi kesan. Anggaran di tapak menggunakan saiz cakera dan tetapan sebenar anda.

### Bolehkah saya melihat kamera baharu dalam aplikasi yang sama?
Ya apabila ia menyertai ekosistem yang sama — itulah tujuan memadankan sistem. Jika persediaan semasa anda sudah mencampur jenama dengan canggung, lawatan akan memaklumkannya.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar jenama/model perakam, foto kedudukan kamera semasa dan titik buta yang anda mahu tutup. KL Servis Rumah mengendalikan tambahan kamera tunggal di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor — dan akan memberitahu terlebih dahulu jika perakam anda benar-benar mempunyai ruang untuk satu lagi.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hai%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20Tambahan%20Kamera%20Tunggal%20CCTV.).

本文说明[单台加装摄像头](/zh/services/cctv/single-camera-add-on)子服务，属于[CCTV 与监控摄像头安装](/zh/services/cctv)。这项工程由兼容性决定成败，因此在任何钻孔之前，都会先确认现有设备的品牌与录像机型号。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

加装适合系统基本正常、但留有缺口的业主——房子一侧的盲区、新扩建的厨房、楼梯平台，或原有摄像角度照不到的车位。团队已有的服务范围涵盖常见生态（已公布范围：Hikvision、Dahua、Ezviz 与 Tapo）。

以下情况不在本服务范围：录像机本身故障、录像丢失，或您需要从头设计——那属于[系统健康检查与移机](/zh/services/cctv/cctv-system-health-check-and-relocation)或新装套餐，如[公寓 Wi-Fi 监控套餐](/zh/services/cctv/condo-wi-fi-cctv-package-4-cameras)或[有地住宅 PoE 监控](/zh/services/cctv/landed-house-poe-cctv-8-cameras)。套餐级决策可参考[吉隆坡监控选购指南](/zh/bo-ke/ji-long-cctv-an-zhuang-gou-mai-zhi-nan)。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **录像机空余通道**——4 路 NVR 已插满 4 台就没有空间；此时会如实报出升级路径，而非硬塞。
- **系统品牌与制式**——摄像头要与录像机的生态和支持的分辨率匹配。
- **走线或 Wi-Fi 信号**——PoE 加装需要布一条线缆；Wi-Fi 加装需要在实际安装点有稳定信号。
- **供电条件**——PoE 由录像机或交换机供电；Wi-Fi 摄像头需要附近有插座。
- **对存储的影响**——新增摄像头共用同一块硬盘，总存储天数会缩短；可参考[录像存储满就不录像](/zh/problems/cctv-not-recording-storage-full)。
- **App 权限**——配对需要管理员账号，而不是仅有查看权限的分享账号。
- **安装面与户外暴露**——室外点位配防雨外壳并留滴水弧。

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **PoE 加装** | 录像机有空余通道/接口，希望走线稳定可靠。 |
| **Wi-Fi 加装** | 同一 App 生态、配对方便，且无法长距离走线。 |
| **录像机/通道升级** | 没有空余通道——明码实价报升级，而非凑合转接。 |

## 常见施工流程

1. **确认录像机型号、空余通道与 App 生态**。
2. **商定机位**——视野、高度、防破坏触及范围与夜间光线。
3. **先布好线缆，或在实际点位验证 Wi-Fi**，再安装。
4. **安装、做防雨密封并接通**摄像头。
5. **分配通道或在 App 中配对**，随后在业主手机上验证实时画面、录像与移动侦测通知。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 先贪便宜买回不匹配的摄像头，才发现录像机无法注册它。
- 没在实际点位测 Wi-Fi 就装机——窗边有信号不代表屋檐下有信号。
- 补了一个盲区，却在夜里正对强光源，画面一片炫光。
- 忘了硬盘：多一台摄像头存储天数就缩水，直到要调录像时才发现。
- 钻孔打到隐藏线管，或打进握不住螺丝的松软基层。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 420 起**，含布线、安装与 App 配对。
- 为匹配系统所选的摄像头型号与分辨率。
- 线缆长度与敷设难度、线管需求与作业高度。
- 为保住存储天数而建议的硬盘升级。

其主服务公布 **12 个月摄像头与安装保修**，按适用范围和条款执行——请书面确认它如何适用于新加装摄像头与施工质量。

## 安全、隐私与日常维护

摄像头应照看的是您的物业，而不是邻居的窗户——机位本就是现场确认的一部分，公寓公共区域还需管理处批准。安装后，把镜头纳入定期擦拭清单，并在 App 里确认新通道按您期望的方式连续录像，而不是仅移动侦测（若您要的是连续录像）。

## 常见问题

### 我的录像机能加装其他品牌的摄像头吗？
有时可以，前提是录像机与摄像头遵循兼容标准且 App 路径相通。会先核实您的具体型号——诚实的答案有时就是"不行"，这总好过装一台永远录不上的摄像头。

### 加装一台会损失多少存储天数？
存储天数=硬盘总容量÷所有摄像头的录像负载。8 路系统多加一台，缩短有限；而本来就快满的硬盘上再加，影响就很实在。现场估算会按您的实际硬盘容量与设置计算。

### 新摄像头能在同一个 App 里看吗？
可以，只要它加入的是同一生态——这正是匹配系统的意义所在。如果您现在的组合已经混用得很勉强，上门时会如实指出。

## 获取针对现场的报价

请提供录像机品牌/型号、现有摄像头位置照片，以及希望覆盖的盲区。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪办理单台加装——若您的录像机确实没有多余空间，也会提前直说。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%8D%95%E5%8F%B0%E5%8A%A0%E8%A3%85%E7%9B%91%E6%8E%A7%E6%91%84%E5%83%8F%E5%A4%B4%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Single Swing Autogate Installation in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Single swing autogate arm motor installation for terrace houses in KL & Selangor. Includes 2 remotes, safety sensor, backup battery. From RM 2,200.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Single Swing Autogate Installation KL | From RM 2,200
en.metaDesc: Single swing autogate arm motor installation for terrace houses in KL & Selangor. Includes 2 remotes, safety sensor, backup battery. From RM 2,200.
en.content:
Single swing gates are a practical choice for Malaysian terrace houses with narrower driveways or dedicated pedestrian/vehicle side entrances. Unlike dual-motor setups, a single swing motor automates a single leaf with lower mechanical complexity and lower ongoing maintenance requirements, while delivering full automated convenience.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah provides complete supply and installation of single swing autogates across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor from **RM 2,200**. Each package includes an electro-mechanical or DC arm actuator, weatherproof control board, 2 wireless remote transmitters, infrared safety sensor beam, 12V backup battery, and a **12-month parts and workmanship warranty**.

## Why Choose a Single Swing Autogate?

- **Space-Efficient:** Perfect for homes with a single car porch bay or asymmetric gate layout (e.g. 1 large motorized leaf + 1 small manual pedestrian gate).
- **Lower Upfront & Maintenance Cost:** With only one motor arm, replacement and service costs are substantially lower than dual-leaf systems.
- **Smooth & Silent Operation:** Modern 24V DC screw-drive motors operate with minimal mechanical vibration compared to older AC systems.
- **Reliable Emergency Power:** The DC actuator operates efficiently on a 12V 7AH backup battery during TNB blackouts.

## Single Swing vs Double Swing Comparison

| Feature | Single Swing System | Double Swing System |
|---|---|---|
| **Motor Arms Required** | 1 linear actuator | 2 linear actuators (synchronized) |
| **Typical Gate Leaf Width** | Up to 12–14 feet | 6–8 feet per leaf |
| **Starting Price** | From RM 2,200 | From RM 3,200 |
| **Installation Time** | 3–4 hours | 4–6 hours |
| **Pillar Load** | High load on one hinge pillar | Distributed across two pillars |

## What Is Included in Our Single Swing Package

1. **Heavy-Duty Linear Arm Motor:** 24V DC electro-mechanical actuator with stainless steel shaft and sealed planetary gearbox rated for gates up to 350kg.
2. **Microprocessor Control Unit:** Electronic control board featuring adjustable soft-start, electronic braking, and automatic timer closing options inside an IP65 enclosure.
3. **Backup Battery System:** 12V 7AH rechargeable battery with trickle charger ensuring 10–15 emergency operations during power outages.
4. **Infrared Photocell Safety Beam:** Non-contact optical safety barrier preventing accidental closure against entering cars or pedestrians.
5. **Remote Controls:** 2x 433MHz / 330MHz high-security code hopping remote transmitters with extended 30-meter range.
6. **Manual Override Keys:** 2x mechanical clutch release keys for manual gate operation during extended maintenance.

## Common Issues with Single Swing Gates

Because a single wide gate leaf concentrates all torque on one pillar, proper installation is critical:

- **Hinge Sagging:** Wide single leaves exert heavy leverage. If the pillar hinge weakens, the gate drags on the floor. Our team reinforces hinge brackets with [welding services](/services/welding).
- **Motor Overload:** Incorrect motor arm bracket geometry causes strain on the linear screw. We calculate exact mounting pivot geometry before drilling.
- **Sensor Misalignment:** Rain or garden growth blocking optical sensors. Check our guide on [autogate not closing](/problems/autogate-not-closing) for quick troubleshooting.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can a single swing motor push a 12-foot iron gate?
Yes, our heavy-duty 24V DC arm motors are rated to handle single gate leaves up to 14 feet wide and 350kg in weight, provided the gate hinges are aligned with smooth ball-bearing movement.

### How long does installation take?
A standard single swing autogate installation takes approximately 3 to 4 hours, including motor mounting, conduit wiring, control board setup, and safety sensor calibration.

### What if my wall pillar has no electrical point?
Our technicians can pull a new dedicated 230V AC electrical point from your distribution board (DB) or porch lighting circuit, equipped with an outdoor weatherproof isolator switch.

## Schedule Your Single Swing Autogate Installation

Upgrade your home entrance with a dependable single swing autogate. We serve all areas in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor including PJ, Subang, Puchong, Shah Alam, Damansara, Cheras, and Klang.

WhatsApp our team today for a free quotation — [chat on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20am%20interested%20in%20single%20swing%20autogate%20installation.).

ms.content:
Pintu pagar swing satu daun (single swing) adalah pilihan yang sangat praktikal bagi rumah teres dengan ruang garaj sederhana atau laluan masuk tunggal. Berbanding sistem dua daun, autogate swing tunggal menggunakan satu motor lengan sahaja, mengurangkan kos perkakasan serta memudahkan penyelenggaraan berkala.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah menyediakan perkhidmatan membekal dan memasang autogate swing tunggal di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor **bermula dari RM 2,200**. Pakej ini lengkap dengan 1 motor lengan DC, kotak kawalan kalis air, 2 alat kawalan jauh, sensor keselamatan inframerah, bateri sandaran 12V dan **waranti 12 bulan**.

## Kelebihan Autogate Swing Tunggal

- **Jimat Kos & Komponen:** Hanya satu unit motor lengan diperlukan, menjadikan kos permulaan dan penggantian alat ganti lebih berpatutan.
- **Sesuai Untuk Ruang Terhad:** Pilihan terbaik untuk pintu pagar jenis satu daun besar atau konfigurasi pintu pagar tidak simetri (1 daun automatik + 1 pintu kecil pejalan kaki).
- **Pergerakan Senyap & Lancar:** Motor DC 24V moden dengan mekanisma skru pemacu bergerak senyap tanpa gegaran kuat.
- **Kalis Gangguan Elektrik:** Dilengkapi bateri sandaran 12V 7AH untuk operasi buka/tutup semasa bekalan elektrik TNB terputus.

## Perbandingan: Swing Tunggal vs Swing Dua Daun

| Ciri | Swing Tunggal | Swing Dua Daun |
|---|---|---|
| **Jumlah Motor** | 1 unit motor lengan linear | 2 unit motor lengan linear |
| **Lebar Daun Pintu Sesuai** | Sehingga 12–14 kaki | 6–8 kaki setiap daun |
| **Harga Pakej Pemasangan** | Dari RM 2,200 | Dari RM 3,200 |
| **Masa Pemasangan** | 3–4 jam | 4–6 jam |
| **Beban Tiang** | Beban tertumpu pada 1 tiang engsel | Beban diagihkan pada 2 tiang |

## Pakej Lengkap Autogate Swing Tunggal Kami

1. **Motor Lengan DC Lasak:** Motor DC 24V bertaraf industri dengan aci keluli tahan karat (stainless steel) yang mampu menampung beban pintu sehingga 350kg.
2. **Papan Litar Mikroprosesor:** Dilengkapi fungsi henti-perlahan (soft-stop) bagi mengurangkan hentakan pada tiang pagar serta kotak perlindungan kalis cuaca IP65.
3. **Bateri Sandaran (Backup Battery):** Bateri 12V 7AH yang dicas secara automatik bagi memastikan pagar boleh dibuka 10–15 kali semasa tiada elektrik.
4. **Sensor Keselamatan Inframerah:** Mengesan halangan kereta atau orang di laluan pintu pagar untuk mengelakkan perlanggaran tidak sengaja.
5. **Alat Kawalan Jauh (Remote Control):** 2 unit remote frekuensi 433MHz/330MHz dengan jarak kawalan sehingga 30 meter.
6. **Kunci Manual Kecemasan:** 2 kunci mekanikal untuk membuka kunci klac motor secara manual sekiranya berlaku kecemasan.

## Isu Biasa Pintu Swing Tunggal

Disebabkan satu daun pintu yang lebar menumpukan beban pada satu tiang, pemasangan yang betul sangat penting:
- **Pintu Menggeser Lantai:** Engsel tiang longgar kerana beban berat. Pasukan kami boleh melakukan pengukuhan kimpalan melalui [servis kimpalan besi](/ms/services/welding).
- **Pintu Tidak Mahu Tutup:** Kerap berpunca daripada kanta sensor terlindung habuk atau daun. Rujuk panduan [autogate tidak boleh tutup](/ms/problems/autogate-not-closing) untuk maklumat lanjut.

## Soalan Lazim (FAQ)

### Bolehkah motor swing tunggal menolak pintu pagar besi 12 kaki?
Boleh. Motor DC 24V kami direka khas untuk menggerakkan daun pintu pagar tunggal sehingga 14 kaki lebar dan berat sehingga 350kg dengan pergerakan yang stabil.

### Berapa lama masa yang diambil untuk pasang?
Pemasangan lengkap autogate swing tunggal mengambil masa kira-kira 3 hingga 4 jam termasuk pendawaian kabel, pemasangan kotak kawalan dan pengujian sensor.

## Tempah Pemasangan Autogate Swing Tunggal

Hubungi KL Servis Rumah untuk pemasangan autogate swing tunggal berkualiti di seluruh Lembah Klang termasuk Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Cheras dan Klang.

zh.content:
对于单车位排屋、独栋侧门或采用不对称门扇设计（即一扇大自动门加一扇小手动行人门）的住宅而言，单扇平开自动门（Single Swing Autogate）是兼顾实用与经济的理想方案。单电机配置不仅结构精简、安装迅速，还能显著降低日后的配件更换与维保成本。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供单扇平开自动门的全套供应与安装服务，**全包套餐 RM 2,200起**。包含单台高扭矩直流电机臂、防水微电脑控制箱、2只无线遥控器、红外防夹电眼、12V备用电池及 **12个月整机与施工保修**。

## 为什么选择单扇平开自动门？

- **经济实用：** 相比双开门减少了一台电机与同步控制模块，采购与后期维护成本大幅降低。
- **空间利用率高：** 适合紧凑型车库或门口只有单侧可以旋转开门的户型。
- **低噪音平稳运行：** 采用 24V 直流滚珠丝杆驱动，启闭过程柔和静音，减少对立柱的震动冲击。
- **停电无忧：** 内置 12V 7AH 蓄电池，遭遇 TNB 停电时仍可正常电动开闭 10–15 次。

## 单扇平开与双扇平开自动门对比

| 对比项目 | 单扇平开系统 | 双扇平开系统 |
|---|---|---|
| **电机数量** | 1台直线推杆电机 | 2台同步直线推杆电机 |
| **适用门体宽度** | 单扇宽度可达 12–14 尺 | 单扇 6–8 尺（总宽12–16尺） |
| **套餐参考价格** | RM 2,200起 | RM 3,200起 |
| **标准施工时长** | 3–4 小时 | 4–6 小时 |
| **立柱受力特点** | 受力集中于单侧立柱与铰链 | 门体自重分摊在两侧立柱 |

## 单扇平开自动门全包套餐内容

1. **工业级 24V 直流推杆电机：** 不锈钢伸缩杆与全封闭减速齿轮箱，额定承重达 350kg，防水防尘等级达 IP55。
2. **智能微电脑控制箱：** IP65 户外防水外壳，支持慢速启动、软停缓冲及自动关门延时设定。
3. **停电应急蓄电池：** 12V 7AH 铅酸免维护电池配合智能浮充电路，停电时自动无缝切换。
4. **对射式红外防夹传感器：** 门口遇车辆、小孩或宠物穿过时瞬间停止或反弹，确保通行安全。
5. **高保密遥控器：** 2只 433MHz 跳码遥控器，开阔地遥控距离可达 30 米。
6. **手动离合钥匙：** 2把专用机械离合释放钥匙，遇极端电路故障可轻松手动推开大门。

## 常见注意事项

由于单扇大门力臂较长，对铰链与立柱的牢固度要求极高。如果大门出现下垂或刮地，我们的[铁工焊接加固团队](/zh/services/welding)可在安装电机前进行铰链调平加固。若遇到自动门无法正常关合，可参考[自动门无法关门排查指南](/zh/problems/autogate-not-closing)。

## 常见问题解答 (FAQ)

### 单电机能推动 12 尺宽的实心铁门吗？
完全可以。我们的重型 24V DC 推杆电机专为大尺寸单门设计，只要铰链轴承开合顺畅无严重锈蚀，即可轻松驱动 12 至 14 尺的铁艺或木纹门扇。

### 现场安装需要多长时间？
标准单扇平开自动门安装通常需要 3 至 4 小时，包括电机支架焊接固定、穿管布线、控制箱调试及红外对光校准。

## 预约吉隆坡单扇平开自动门安装

KL Servis Rumah 服务覆盖吉隆坡、八打灵、梳邦、蒲种、莎阿南及巴生等地区。

欢迎通过 WhatsApp 发送您的门面照片获取免费方案与精准报价 — [立即联系我们](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20am%20interested%20in%20single%20swing%20autogate.).

en.title: Skirting & Transition Strip Fitting in KL
en.excerpt: Skirting hides the perimeter expansion gap and protects the lower wall; transition strips bridge changes in material, height or movement between rooms. They should be selected with the flooring system, door clearance and expected foot or trolley traffic in mind.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Skirting & Transition Strip Fitting in KL
en.metaDesc: Guide to skirting & transition strip fitting in kl: suitability, site checks, installation steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for properties in KL and Selangor.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** Skirting hides the perimeter expansion gap and protects the lower wall; transition strips bridge changes in material, height or movement between rooms. They should be selected with the flooring system, door clearance and expected foot or trolley traffic in mind.

The assessment checks the substrate, moisture or movement, edge details and access before the repair method is agreed. This article explains the [Finishing Floor Edges with Skirting and Transitions](/services/flooring/skirting-and-transition-strip-fitting) scope under [flooring services](/services/flooring), with a published starting price of **RM 8 / linier ft**.

## What Must Be Checked First

### Existing condition
Identify weak, loose, wet or contaminated areas rather than covering them.

### Interfaces
Check doors, drains, joints, walls, fittings and adjacent finishes.

### Materials
Match the repair system to the substrate and intended use.

### Access and protection
Plan dust control, curing time and protection of occupied areas.


## Practical Planning Notes

A quotation should define the measured work area or number of points, the preparation included, who supplies the finish product or equipment, and how concealed defects will be handled. Product names alone are not a complete specification: model, dimensions, colour or output, compatible accessories and installation method all affect the result. For **skirting & transition strip fitting in kl**, the survey should record existing condition, interfaces, materials, and access and protection.

Sequence matters when several trades share the area. Complete leak repairs and wet work before sensitive finishes; coordinate framing, wiring, pipework and access panels before surfaces are closed; and protect completed work from following trades. A sample, layout drawing or one-point trial is useful when appearance, alignment, brightness, texture or control behaviour cannot be judged from a catalogue.

The handover should be functional, not visual only. The installer should inspect fixing or adhesion, edges and penetrations, operation under normal use, and any serviceable components. Keep the product model, colour or batch reference and care instructions. These records make future replacement or local repair more accurate.


## How the Work Is Carried Out

1. **Inspect** — Mark affected areas and identify the underlying cause.. Record the finding before materials are ordered.

2. **Prepare** — Remove unsound material and create a clean, stable substrate.. Protect adjacent finishes and keep the work area controlled.

3. **Repair** — Apply the specified compatible system at the required thickness.. Check alignment, coverage, support or connections as the work progresses.

4. **Finish** — Align edges, smooth or texture the surface as the design requires.. Do not conceal the stage until the responsible person has inspected it.

5. **Cure and inspect** — Keep traffic off until ready, then check adhesion and finish.. Test under normal use and record any care or cure-time restriction.


## Choosing the Right Approach

| Option | When it fits |
|---|---|

| Local repair | Suitable when damage is isolated and the surrounding finish remains sound. |

| Full treatment | Better when defects are widespread or a consistent new finish is required. |

| Investigate first | Necessary when moisture, structural movement or repeated failure is present. |


## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Covering a defect before stopping its cause.

- Skipping removal of loose or contaminated material.

- Using one product for every substrate and crack type.

- Rushing curing or reopening the area to traffic too early.


Do not bypass structural, electrical, waterproofing or product requirements to save preparation time. Stop work if hidden moisture, unsafe wiring, weak support or moving cracks are discovered; diagnose these conditions before covering them.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 8 / linier ft**
- **Published workmanship cover: 5-Year Installation Workmanship Warranty**, subject to the published terms.

The final quotation depends on site condition, quantity or area, access, materials, preparation and any related repair identified during inspection. A starting rate is not a fixed total for every property.

For homes and commercial properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, access rules, working hours, lift protection and management approval can affect scheduling. Confirm these requirements before materials and labour are booked.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Can the work be limited to one area?
Yes when damage is genuinely isolated, although colour or texture matching may remain visible.


### How long before the area can be used?
It depends on the product, thickness and site conditions. Follow the stated cure window, not only whether the surface feels dry.


### Will the defect return?
A repair lasts only when its cause, substrate and movement are properly addressed. Active leaks or movement must be solved first.


## Get a Site-Specific Quotation

Send clear close-up and wide-angle photos so the affected area and surrounding conditions can be assessed. KL Servis Rumah can inspect the conditions and explain the suitable scope before work begins.

**Jawapan ringkas:** Skirting menutup jurang pengembangan perimeter dan melindungi bawah dinding; jalur peralihan menghubungkan perubahan bahan, aras atau pergerakan antara ruang. Pilihan perlu mengambil kira sistem lantai, kelegaan pintu dan trafik.

Penilaian menyemak substrat, lembapan atau pergerakan, perincian tepi dan akses sebelum kaedah dipersetujui. Artikel ini menerangkan skop [Menyiapkan Tepi Lantai dengan Skirting dan Jalur Peralihan](/ms/services/flooring/skirting-and-transition-strip-fitting) di bawah [perkhidmatan lantai](/ms/services/flooring), dengan harga permulaan diterbitkan **RM 8 / linier ft**.

## Perkara yang Mesti Disemak Dahulu

### Keadaan sedia ada
Kenal pasti kawasan lemah, longgar, basah atau tercemar, bukan menutupnya.

### Pertemuan bahan
Semak pintu, drain, joint, dinding, kelengkapan dan kemasan bersebelahan.

### Bahan
Padankan sistem pembaikan dengan substrat dan kegunaan.

### Akses dan perlindungan
Rancang kawalan habuk, masa matang dan perlindungan ruang dihuni.


## Nota Perancangan Praktikal

Sebut harga perlu menyatakan keluasan atau bilangan titik, persediaan yang termasuk, pihak yang membekalkan produk atau peralatan dan cara kecacatan tersembunyi diurus. Nama produk sahaja bukan spesifikasi lengkap: model, dimensi, warna atau output, aksesori serasi dan kaedah pemasangan mempengaruhi hasil. Untuk **pemasangan skirting & jalur peralihan di kl**, tinjauan patut merekod keadaan sedia ada, pertemuan bahan, bahan, dan akses dan perlindungan.

Urutan kerja penting apabila beberapa tukang berkongsi ruang. Selesaikan kebocoran dan kerja basah sebelum kemasan sensitif; selaras rangka, pendawaian, paip dan panel akses sebelum permukaan ditutup; dan lindungi kerja siap daripada kerja seterusnya. Sampel, lukisan susun atur atau percubaan satu titik berguna apabila rupa, penjajaran, kecerahan, tekstur atau kawalan tidak boleh dinilai daripada katalog.

Serahan perlu menguji fungsi, bukan rupa sahaja. Periksa pengikat atau lekatan, tepi dan penembusan, operasi penggunaan biasa serta komponen yang perlu diservis. Simpan model produk, rujukan warna atau kelompok dan arahan penjagaan supaya penggantian atau pembaikan setempat pada masa depan lebih tepat.


## Cara Kerja Dilaksanakan

1. **Periksa** — Tanda kawasan terjejas dan kenal pasti punca.. Rekod dapatan sebelum bahan ditempah.

2. **Sedia** — Buang bahan tidak kukuh dan hasilkan substrat stabil.. Lindungi kemasan bersebelahan dan kawal kawasan kerja.

3. **Baiki** — Gunakan sistem serasi pada ketebalan diperlukan.. Semak penjajaran, liputan, sokongan atau sambungan ketika kerja berjalan.

4. **Kemaskan** — Selaraskan tepi dan kemasan mengikut reka bentuk.. Jangan tutup peringkat ini sebelum ia diperiksa.

5. **Matang dan periksa** — Halang trafik sehingga sedia, kemudian semak lekatan.. Uji dalam penggunaan biasa dan rekod sekatan penjagaan atau masa matang.


## Memilih Pendekatan yang Betul

| Pilihan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|

| Pembaikan setempat | Sesuai apabila kerosakan terpencil dan sekeliling masih kukuh. |

| Rawatan penuh | Lebih baik apabila kecacatan meluas atau kemasan seragam diperlukan. |

| Siasat dahulu | Perlu apabila ada lembapan, pergerakan struktur atau kegagalan berulang. |


## Kesilapan Lazim yang Perlu Dielakkan

- Menutup kecacatan sebelum menghentikan punca.

- Tidak membuang bahan longgar atau tercemar.

- Menggunakan satu produk untuk semua substrat dan retak.

- Mempercepat masa matang atau membuka trafik terlalu awal.


Jangan abaikan keperluan struktur, elektrik, kalis air atau produk untuk menjimatkan masa persediaan. Hentikan kerja jika ditemui lembapan tersembunyi, pendawaian tidak selamat, sokongan lemah atau retak bergerak; diagnosis sebelum menutupnya.

- **Perlindungan mutu kerja diterbitkan: Jaminan Kerja Pemasangan 5 Tahun**，tertakluk pada terma diterbitkan.

Bagi rumah dan premis komersial di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, peraturan akses, waktu kerja, perlindungan lif dan kelulusan pengurusan boleh mempengaruhi jadual. Sahkan keperluan ini sebelum bahan dan tenaga kerja ditempah.

## Soalan Lazim


### Bolehkah baiki satu kawasan sahaja?
Boleh jika kerosakan benar-benar terpencil, tetapi padanan warna atau tekstur mungkin kelihatan.


### Berapa lama sebelum boleh digunakan?
Bergantung pada produk, ketebalan dan keadaan tapak. Ikut tempoh matang, bukan sekadar permukaan terasa kering.


### Adakah kecacatan akan kembali?
Pembaikan tahan apabila punca, substrat dan pergerakan ditangani. Kebocoran atau pergerakan aktif mesti diselesaikan dahulu.

zh.title: 吉隆坡踢脚线与地板收边条安装
zh.excerpt: 踢脚线遮盖周边伸缩缝并保护墙脚；过渡条连接房间之间不同材料、高度或位移区。选择时要同时考虑地板系统、门扇净距和人流或推车荷载。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡踢脚线与地板收边条安装
zh.metaDesc: 了解用踢脚线与收边条完成地板边缘：施工前检查、正确流程、方案比较、常见错误和报价因素，适用于吉隆坡与雪兰莪住宅及商业场所。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**踢脚线遮盖周边伸缩缝并保护墙脚；过渡条连接房间之间不同材料、高度或位移区。选择时要同时考虑地板系统、门扇净距和人流或推车荷载。

确定方案前，应检查基层、潮气或位移、边缘细节和施工通道。本文说明[用踢脚线与收边条完成地板边缘](/zh/services/flooring/skirting-and-transition-strip-fitting)子服务；它属于[地板服务](/zh/services/flooring)，已公布起价为 **RM 8 / linier ft**。

## 施工前必须检查什么

### 现有状况
找出薄弱、松动、潮湿或污染范围，不能直接覆盖。

### 交接位置
检查门口、排水口、接缝、墙体、设备和相邻饰面。

### 材料
修复系统要匹配基层和实际用途。

### 通道与保护
规划粉尘控制、养护时间和已入住空间保护。


## 实用规划要点

报价应列明实测面积或点位数量、包含哪些基层准备、成品或设备由谁提供，以及发现隐藏缺陷时如何处理。只有产品名称并不构成完整规格；型号、尺寸、颜色或输出、兼容配件和安装方法都会影响结果。针对**吉隆坡踢脚线与地板收边条安装**，勘察记录应包括现有状况、交接位置、材料、通道与保护。

多个工种共用区域时，施工顺序很重要。漏水和湿作业应在敏感饰面之前完成；封闭表面前要协调骨架、线路、管路和检修口；完工面也要防止被后续工序损坏。如外观、对齐、亮度、纹理或控制效果无法从目录判断，应先制作样板、排版图或试装一个点位。

交付不能只看外观，还要检查固定或粘结、边缘与穿孔、正常使用下的功能，以及可维修部件。保存产品型号、颜色或批次编号和保养说明，有助于日后准确更换或局部维修。


## 标准施工步骤

1. **检查** — 标出受影响范围并找出根本原因。. 订购材料前记录勘察结果。

2. **基层处理** — 清除不牢材料，形成清洁稳定基层。. 保护相邻饰面并控制施工区域。

3. **修复** — 以规定厚度施工兼容系统。. 施工期间同步检查对齐、覆盖、支撑或连接。

4. **收面** — 按设计调整边缘、平整度或纹理。. 负责人检查前不要封闭这一工序。

5. **养护验收** — 养护完成前禁止通行，之后检查粘结与外观。. 按正常使用方式测试，并记录保养或养护限制。


## 如何选择合适方案

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|

| 局部维修 | 损坏确实集中且周围饰面仍牢固时适用。 |

| 整体处理 | 缺陷分布广或需要一致新表面时更合适。 |

| 先调查 | 存在潮气、结构位移或反复失效时必须先查原因。 |


## 应避免的常见错误

- 没有解决原因就把缺陷盖住。

- 跳过松动物或污染层的清除。

- 所有基层和裂缝都使用同一种产品。

- 缩短养护时间或过早恢复通行。


不要为了缩短准备时间而绕过结构、电气、防水或产品要求。如发现隐藏潮气、不安全线路、薄弱支撑或活动裂缝，应暂停并先诊断，不能直接覆盖。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价: RM 8 / linier ft**
- **已公布工艺保障: 5 年安装工艺保修**（按已公布条款执行）。

最终报价取决于现场状况、数量或面积、施工通道、材料、基层处理，以及检查发现的相关维修。起价并不代表每个物业的固定总价。

吉隆坡与雪兰莪的住宅及商业场所可能有进场时段、电梯保护、施工时间和管理处批准要求，这些都会影响排期。预订材料和人手前应先确认。

## 常见问题


### 能只修一个区域吗？
如损坏确实局部，可以；但新旧颜色或纹理可能仍看得出。


### 多久后可以使用？
取决于产品、厚度和现场条件。应遵守养护时间，而不是只看表面是否干。


### 问题会再出现吗？
只有原因、基层和位移都妥善处理，修复才耐久；活动漏水或位移必须先解决。


## 获取针对现场的报价

发送清晰近照和广角照片，以便同时判断损坏范围和周围状况。 KL Servis Rumah 可在动工前检查现场并说明合适范围。

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%94%A8%E8%B8%A2%E8%84%9A%E7%BA%BF%E4%B8%8E%E6%94%B6%E8%BE%B9%E6%9D%A1%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%E5%9C%B0%E6%9D%BF%E8%BE%B9%E7%BC%98%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Sliding Autogate Installation & Track Repair in KL
en.excerpt: Heavy-duty sliding autogate motor, steel gear rack & ground track installation in KL & Selangor. Ideal for limited driveway space. From RM 3,800.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Sliding Autogate Installation & Repair KL | From RM 3,800
en.metaDesc: Heavy-duty sliding autogate motor, steel gear rack & ground track installation in KL & Selangor. Ideal for limited driveway space. From RM 3,800.
en.content:
For properties with wide driveway openings, steep driveway slopes, or short parking bays where swing gates would hit parked cars, a sliding autogate (sliding autogate) is the ultimate solution. A sliding gate travels horizontally along a ground track or cantilever system, preserving 100% of your usable driveway depth.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah supplies, installs, and repairs heavy-duty sliding autogate systems across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor from **RM 3,800**. Packages include an oil-bath or heavy grease rack-and-pinion sliding motor (600kg to 1,200kg rating), steel gear rack tracks, limit switches, 2 wireless remote controls, infrared safety beams, and a **12-month warranty**.

## Advantages of a Sliding Autogate System

- **Zero Driveway Intrusion:** Gate moves sideways along the fence line, allowing you to park cars right behind the gate line without obstruction.
- **Superior Wind & Weight Resistance:** Heavy sliding gates resist strong gusty monsoon winds far better than swing arms because the gate is firmly anchored in ground rails and top guide rollers.
- **High Security:** The heavy-duty pinion gear locks into the steel rack when stopped, making it virtually impossible for intruders to force open by hand.
- **Handles Heavy Gates:** Ideal for wide, heavy mild steel or wrought iron gates weighing upwards of 600kg to 1,000kg.

## Sliding Autogate vs Swing Autogate

| Feature | Sliding Autogate | Swing Autogate |
|---|---|---|
| **Driveway Space Required** | Zero depth space needed (needs side clearance) | Requires full swing arc inside car porch |
| **Track & Rail** | Requires level ground rail & guide rollers | No floor rail needed (hinged on pillar) |
| **Motor Mechanism** | Rotary pinion gear with steel rack | Linear telescopic or articulated arm |
| **Starting Package Price** | From RM 3,800 | From RM 2,200 (single) / RM 3,200 (double) |
| **Best For** | Short car porches, wide openings, heavy gates | Standard landed terrace driveways |

## What Our Sliding Autogate Installation Includes

1. **Heavy-Duty Sliding Motor:** High-torque motor unit featuring oil-bath lubrication for continuous thermal dissipation, rated from 600kg up to 1,200kg.
2. **Steel Gear Rack Installation:** Industrial-grade zinc-plated steel gear racks bolted directly along the lower gate frame for positive gear mesh.
3. **Ground Track & Roller Check:** Laser-level alignment check of the ground V-groove or round rail to guarantee zero binding across the entire travel span.
4. **Top Guide Roller Bracket:** Anti-derailment double guide rollers with nylon bushings to keep the gate upright and prevent rattling.
5. **Magnetic / Mechanical Limit Switches:** Precision limit stops that signal the motor to slow down and lock smoothly at exact open and closed boundaries.
6. **Safety Sensor & Remote Programming:** Dual photocell safety beams across the entrance line and 2 hopping-code remote controls.

## Common Sliding Autogate Problems We Repair

- **Gate Stops Midway:** Debris, sand, or stones wedged inside the ground rail; worn roller bearings; or magnetic limit switch misalignment.
- **Loud Grinding Noise:** Gear rack out of pitch alignment with the motor pinion gear, causing tooth binding.
- **Motor Runs But Gate Does Not Move:** Manual clutch key is unlocked, or internal motor drive pin is sheared from high impact.
- **Remote Failure:** Module receiver failure from water ingress. Learn more at [autogate remote not working](/problems/autogate-remote-not-working).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What happens if small stones get stuck in the sliding track?
Stones can cause the gate rollers to jam or trigger the motor's anti-crush safety sensor to stop. We recommend sweeping the floor rail periodically. For low-maintenance setups, we can install protective rubber scraper flaps on gate ends.

### Can a sliding gate work if my driveway is on a slight slope?
Yes, but motor sizing and mechanical brake strength must be calculated carefully to prevent runaway sliding under gravity. Our technicians calculate slope forces during the site survey.

### Do you replace worn sliding gate wheels and rollers?
Yes, we provide on-site roller replacement using heavy-duty stainless steel bearing wheels to eliminate squeaking and ensure effortless rolling.

## Get a Quote for Sliding Autogate in KL & Selangor

Looking to install a brand new sliding autogate or replace an old, noisy motor? KL Servis Rumah provides complete site assessments and professional installation across Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Klang, Cheras, and Seri Kembangan.

Send us your gate photos on WhatsApp for an immediate assessment — [WhatsApp our autogate team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20a%20sliding%20autogate%20quotation.).

## Kelebihan Sistem Autogate Gelongsor (Sliding)

- **Menjimatkan Ruang Garaj:** Pintu menggelongsor ke tepi pagar, membolehkan kereta diparkir rapat di belakang pintu pagar tanpa risiko terlanggar semasa pagar dibuka.
- **Tahan Angin Kencang:** Struktur sliding yang dipandu roda bawah dan roller atas sangat kukuh, tidak mudah bergegar akibat tiupan angin ribut tropika.
- **Keselamatan Maksimum:** Gear motor yang bercantum rapat dengan gear rack besi menghalang pintu daripada dipaksa tolak secara manual oleh penceroboh.
- **Kapasiti Beban Berat:** Mampu menolak pintu pagar besi mild steel atau wrought iron yang sangat berat dengan lancar.

## Perbandingan: Pintu Sliding vs Pintu Swing

|---|---|---|
| **Keluasan Garaj Diperlukan** | Sifar ruang bukaan ke dalam (hanya perlu ruang tepi) | Memerlukan ruang lengkokan hayunan pintu di dalam garaj |
| **Landasan Trek** | Memerlukan rel besi rata di atas lantai | Tiada rel lantai (bergantung pada tiang engsel) |
| **Mekanisma Motor** | Motor gear pinion berputar bersama rack keluli | Motor lengan linear menolak/menarik |
| **Harga Pakej Permulaan** | Dari RM 3,800 | Dari RM 2,200 (tunggal) / RM 3,200 (dua daun) |

## Apa Yang Termasuk Dalam Pemasangan Kami

1. **Motor Sliding Berkuasa Tinggi:** Motor jenis rendaman minyak (oil-bath) atau gris tahan haba dengan kuasa menolak pintu 600kg–1200kg.
2. **Pemasangan Gear Rack Besi:** Gear rack keluli bersalut zink anti-karat diskru kemas di sepanjang palang bawah pintu pagar.
3. **Penyelarasan Rel & Roda Lantai:** Pemeriksaan aras laser bagi memastikan roda bergerak lancar di atas trek tanpa tersangkut.
4. **Roller Pemandu Atas (Top Guide Roller):** Mengelakkan pintu bergoyang atau terkeluar dari landasan apabila ditiup angin.
5. **Suis Had Magnetik / Mekanikal (Limit Switch):** Menghentikan motor dengan tepat pada posisi buka dan tutup penuh secara automatik.
6. **Sensor Keselamatan & Remote Control:** Sensor photocell anti-himpit dan 2 alat kawalan jauh frekuensi tinggi.

## Masalah Biasa Autogate Sliding & Pembaikan

- **Pagar Tersangkut di Tengah Jalan:** Pasir, batu kecil atau karat terkumpul pada rel lantai; roda bearing pecah; atau suis had tersasar.
- **Bunyi Geseran Bising:** Jarak antara gear rack dan motor tidak selari, menyebabkan gigi gear bergesel kasar.
- **Motor Berpusing Tetapi Pagar Tidak Bergerak:** Klac manual terbuka atau pin transmisi dalaman patah.

## Soalan Lazim (FAQ)

### Adakah batu kecil pada rel lantai boleh merosakkan autogate sliding?
Batu kecil boleh menyebabkan roda tersangkut atau motor berhenti secara automatik kerana sensor keselamatan. Kami mengesyorkan membersihkan rel lantai sekali-sekala. Kami juga boleh memasang getah pelindung pada hujung roda.

### Bolehkah autogate sliding dipasang jika laluan masuk bercerun sedikit?
Boleh, tetapi kekuatan motor dan kuasa brek mekanikal mesti dikira dengan teliti agar pintu tidak menggelongsor laju akibat graviti. Pasukan kami akan mengukur kecerunan semasa tinjauan tapak.

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪平移自动门安装与轨道维修
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪平移自动门（Sliding Autogate）马达安装与齿条轨道调校。重型承重、节省车道空间，RM 3,800起，12个月保修。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡平移自动门安装与维修 RM 3,800起
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪平移自动门（Sliding Autogate）马达安装与齿条轨道调校。重型承重、节省车道空间，RM 3,800起，12个月保修。
zh.content:
对于车库进深较短、大门跨度较大，或者开门弧线会刮碰到停放车辆的住宅，平移自动门（Sliding Autogate）是最佳的解决方案。平移门沿着围墙侧向滑动开启，完全不占用车库内部的停车深度，能够最大化利用停车空间。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供重型平移自动门（Sliding Autogate）供应、安装及轨道调校服务，**全套安装 RM 3,800起**。包含高承重油浸式/齿轮减速平移马达（额定 600kg 至 1,200kg）、镀锌钢齿条、限位开关、2个无线遥控器、红外安全防夹传感器及 **12个月保修**。

## 平移自动门的核心优势

- **零车库空间占用：** 门体向侧边横向平移，车辆可直接停在门内侧边缘，无需预留扇门向内旋转的半径空间。
- **卓越的抗风与承重性能：** 地面轨道与顶部导向轮双重固定，在遭遇热带季风暴雨时稳固不晃动，特别适合数百公斤重的实心铁艺或铝合金大门。
- **极高的防撬安全性：** 电机自带自锁齿轮与钢制齿条紧密啮合，门关闭后外人无法通过人力强行推开。
- **适合超宽大门：** 单扇门宽可达 16 至 24 尺，是宽门面有地住宅的首选。

## 平移自动门与平开自动门对比

| 功能特性 | 平移自动门 (Sliding) | 平开自动门 (Swing) |
|---|---|---|
| **车库进深要求** | 完全不需要进深（需侧边有滑动空间） | 必须预留扇门向内开合的弧形空间 |
| **地面轨道要求** | 需安装水平地面导轨与滑轮 | 无需地面导轨（依靠立柱铰链支撑） |
| **驱动方式** | 齿轮齿条水平啮合驱动 | 伸缩推杆或铰接臂拉伸驱动 |
| **标准套餐起步价** | RM 3,800起 | RM 2,200起（单开）/ RM 3,200起（双开） |

## 平移自动门标准安装内容

1. **重型平移马达主机：** 油浸润滑散热马达，适配 600kg 至 1,200kg 门重，支持高频次连续启闭。
2. **加厚镀锌钢齿条：** 工业级精密齿距钢齿条，牢固螺栓固定于大门底部横梁，咬合精准无跳齿。
3. **水平地轨与滑轮校准：** 激光水平仪校准地面 V型/圆弧导轨，确保门扇在全行程内滑行顺滑无阻。
4. **防倾倒顶部导向轮：** 尼龙包胶双导向轮支架，消除门扇开合晃动与风噪。
5. **高精度限位开关：** 磁感应或机械限位器，控制开门与关门极限位置自动软停减速。
6. **红外安全对射光眼与遥控：** 门洞防夹光眼，配 2 只高频跳码无线遥控。

## 常见平移自动门故障与维修

- **门开到一半卡住：** 地轨夹入石子砂砾、滑轮轴承锈蚀破裂或限位磁铁移位。
- **马达转动但大门不动：** 手动离合旋钮未锁紧，或内部传动销断裂。
- **开门异响严重：** 齿条与电机齿轮间隙不当导致啃齿，需重新调校高度间隙。
- **遥控失灵：** 接收模块受潮氧化。详情可查阅[自动门遥控器失灵排查](/zh/problems/autogate-remote-not-working)。

## 常见问题解答 (FAQ)

### 地面导轨进小石子会导致马达烧坏吗？
现代平移门马达均内置过载与遇阻保护，遇到严重阻滞会自动停机反弹，不会直接烧坏马达。但长期卡阻会磨损齿轮，建议定期清理地轨碎石。

### 门面车道有坡度可以装平移自动门吗？
可以，但必须准确计算坡度下滑重力，选用具备强力机械自锁刹车的高扭矩电机，并在现场做好防冲缓冲装置。

## 预约吉隆坡平移自动门安装与维修

KL Servis Rumah 专业服务覆盖雪隆全境，包括八打灵再也、梳邦、莎阿南、蒲种、蕉赖、甲洞、巴生等。

欢迎通过 WhatsApp 发送大门与车库照片 — [联系平移自动门技术团队](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20a%20sliding%20autogate%20quote.)。

en.title: Sliding Window Roller Replacement in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: Worn rollers commonly make a sliding window heavy, noisy or tilted. Replacement helps when the track and frame remain sound; a bent track, loose frame, damaged interlock or accumulated debris must also be corrected.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Sliding Window Roller Replacement Service in KL
en.metaDesc: Practical guide to sliding window roller replacement: suitability, site checks, work steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for KL and Selangor properties.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** Worn rollers commonly make a sliding window heavy, noisy or tilted. Replacement helps when the track and frame remain sound; a bent track, loose frame, damaged interlock or accumulated debris must also be corrected.

This guide explains the [Sliding Window Roller Replacement](/services/window-repair/sliding-window-roller-replacement) scope under [window repair services](/services/window-repair). The published starting price is **RM 150**. A site-specific quotation should confirm measurements, preparation, materials, access and related repairs rather than treating the starting rate as a fixed total.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The service is appropriate when inspection confirms that the existing property and surrounding construction can support the proposed work. Visible symptoms alone do not prove the cause. In Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, occupied areas, parking or loading access, condominium management rules and permitted working hours may affect planning and scheduling.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Sash weight, roller quantity and adjustment range.**
- **Track wear, dents, dirt and drainage holes.**
- **Interlock, latch and weatherstrip condition.**
- **Safe removal space and glass condition.**

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **Clean/adjust** | rollers and track are intact but dirty or out of level. |
| **Replace rollers** | wheels are flat, seized, cracked or worn. |
| **Repair track/frame** | new rollers cannot run on a damaged base. |

Choosing the least expensive option without checking its limits can cause repeat work. The quotation should explain why the selected approach suits the substrate, dimensions and intended use.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Inspect and measure the existing roller before sourcing**.
2. **Remove the sash with safe support for the glass**.
3. **Clean tracks, drainage paths and roller pockets**.
4. **Fit compatible rollers and set equal height**.
5. **Reinstall and test travel, interlock, latch and drainage**.

Preparation and sequencing matter. Existing defects, unstable supports, incompatible materials or damaged substrates should be corrected before they are concealed. Protect occupied rooms, common corridors and completed finishes throughout the work. At handover, test operation and inspect edges, fixings, joints and access points—not appearance alone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Spraying oil that attracts grit into the track.
- Installing unmatched rollers on one sash.
- Adjusting the sash so high that the interlock no longer engages.
- Lifting a large glazed sash without safe support.

A competent inspection should distinguish a serviceable component from a system that has reached the point of replacement. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written down, especially where concealed conditions cannot be confirmed until work opens the area.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 150**
- Roller type, size and number.
- Sash size, weight and glass condition.
- Track, lock and weatherstrip repair.
- Height and removal access.

The parent service publishes a **12-Month Hardware & Seal Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms. Confirm in writing whether it applies to this exact work, materials supplied by the customer and pre-existing defects.

## Safety, Access and Maintenance

Do not bypass manufacturer instructions, building management requirements or safe access arrangements to save time. Keep product references and care instructions after handover. Routine cleaning and early attention to movement, moisture, corrosion or loose hardware usually make local repairs simpler.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do both rollers need replacement?
Replacing a matched pair is often sensible when both have the same age and wear, but inspection determines the actual scope.

### Why is the window still hard after new rollers?
The track may be dented, dirty or out of line, or the sash may rub at the interlock. Rollers are only one part of the system.

### Should tracks be greased?
Follow the roller and frame guidance. Keeping tracks clean is usually more important than applying a lubricant that traps grit.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send wide-angle and close-up photos, approximate measurements, property type and the symptom or outcome required. KL Servis Rumah can assess the scope for properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor without assuming that every site needs the same solution.

Sebut harga khusus tapak perlu mengesahkan ukuran, persediaan, bahan, akses dan pembaikan berkaitan; harga mula bukan jumlah tetap untuk semua rumah.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Servis ini sesuai apabila pemeriksaan mengesahkan hartanah dan binaan sekeliling boleh menerima kerja yang dicadangkan. Simptom yang nampak tidak semestinya membuktikan punca. Ruang yang didiami, akses parkir atau memunggah, peraturan pengurusan kondominium dan waktu kerja di KL dan Selangor boleh mempengaruhi perancangan.

## Semakan Sebelum Kerja

- **Berat sash, bilangan roller dan julat pelarasan.**
- **Trek haus, kemik, kotor dan lubang saliran.**
- **Keadaan interlock, latch dan weatherstrip.**
- **Ruang buka selamat dan keadaan kaca.**

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Bersih/laras** | roller dan trek masih baik tetapi kotor. |
| **Ganti roller** | roda leper, tersekat, retak atau haus. |
| **Baiki trek/bingkai** | roller baharu tidak boleh berjalan pada asas rosak. |

Pilihan termurah tidak semestinya menjimatkan jika hadnya tidak diperiksa. Sebut harga patut menerangkan sebab kaedah dipilih mengikut substrat, dimensi dan kegunaan.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Periksa dan ukur roller lama sebelum cari ganti**.
2. **Keluarkan sash dengan sokongan kaca selamat**.
3. **Bersihkan trek, saliran dan ruang roller**.
4. **Pasang roller serasi dan tetapkan tinggi sama**.
5. **Pasang semula dan uji gelongsor, interlock, latch serta saliran**.

Urutan dan persediaan penting. Kecacatan sedia ada, sokongan lemah, bahan tidak serasi atau substrat rosak perlu dibaiki sebelum ditutup. Lindungi ruang didiami, koridor bersama dan kemasan siap. Semasa serahan, uji fungsi serta periksa tepi, pengikat, sambungan dan titik akses—bukan rupa sahaja.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Menyembur minyak yang menarik pasir ke trek.
- Memasang roller tidak sepadan pada satu sash.
- Melaras terlalu tinggi hingga interlock tidak bertemu.
- Mengangkat sash kaca besar tanpa sokongan.

Pemeriksaan yang baik membezakan komponen yang masih boleh dibaiki daripada sistem yang patut diganti. Minta andaian dan pengecualian ditulis, khususnya untuk keadaan tersembunyi yang hanya diketahui selepas kawasan dibuka.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 150**
- Jenis, saiz dan bilangan roller.
- Saiz, berat sash dan keadaan kaca.
- Pembaikan trek, kunci dan weatherstrip.
- Ketinggian dan akses membuka.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Perkakasan & Pengedap 12 Bulan**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma. Sahkan secara bertulis sama ada ia meliputi kerja ini, bahan pelanggan dan kecacatan sedia ada.

## Keselamatan, Akses dan Penjagaan

Jangan abaikan arahan pengeluar, syarat pengurusan bangunan atau akses selamat untuk menjimatkan masa. Simpan rujukan produk dan arahan penjagaan. Pembersihan berkala serta tindakan awal terhadap lembapan, pergerakan, karat atau hardware longgar memudahkan pembaikan setempat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Perlu ganti kedua-dua roller?
Mengganti pasangan selalunya wajar jika umur dan haus sama, tetapi pemeriksaan menentukan skop.

### Mengapa masih berat selepas ganti roller?
Trek mungkin kemik, kotor atau tidak sejajar, atau sash bergesel di interlock.

### Perlukah trek digris?
Ikut panduan roller dan bingkai. Trek bersih biasanya lebih penting daripada pelincir yang memerangkap pasir.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar foto sudut luas dan dekat, ukuran anggaran, jenis hartanah serta simptom atau hasil yang diperlukan. KL Servis Rumah boleh menilai skop di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor tanpa menganggap semua tapak memerlukan penyelesaian sama.

zh.title: 推拉窗滑轮更换：吉隆坡与雪兰莪指南
zh.excerpt: 滑轮磨损常使推拉窗沉重、异响或倾斜。窗轨和窗框完好时更换滑轮有效；轨道变形、框体松动、勾企损坏或积尘也须同时处理。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪推拉窗滑轮更换
zh.metaDesc: 了解推拉窗滑轮更换的适用条件、现场检查、施工步骤、常见错误与报价因素，适合吉隆坡及雪兰莪住宅和商业物业。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**滑轮磨损常使推拉窗沉重、异响或倾斜。窗轨和窗框完好时更换滑轮有效；轨道变形、框体松动、勾企损坏或积尘也须同时处理。

本文说明[推拉窗滑轮更换](/zh/services/window-repair/sliding-window-roller-replacement)子服务，属于[窗户维修服务](/zh/services/window-repair)。已公布起价为 **RM 150**。现场报价应明确尺寸、基层处理、材料、施工通道和相关维修；起价不是每个物业的固定总价。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

只有检查确认物业及周边构造能够承受拟议工程时，这项服务才适合；肉眼看到的症状不一定就是根因。吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的入住情况、停车与卸货通道、公寓管理规定及施工时段，都可能影响规划和排期。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **窗扇重量、滑轮数量及调节范围。**
- **轨道磨损、凹陷、污垢及排水孔。**
- **勾企、锁扣及毛条状况。**
- **安全拆扇空间及玻璃状况。**

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **清洁调校** | 滑轮轨道完好但脏污或失调。 |
| **更换滑轮** | 轮体磨平、卡死、开裂或磨损。 |
| **维修轨框** | 新滑轮无法在损坏轨道上正常运行。 |

若不先了解限制，最便宜的方案可能造成重复施工。报价应说明选定方法为何适合现场基层、尺寸和实际用途。

## 常见施工流程

1. **采购前检查并测量旧滑轮**。
2. **安全承托玻璃后拆下窗扇**。
3. **清洁轨道、排水通道及滑轮槽**。
4. **安装兼容滑轮并调至同高**。
5. **复装并测试推拉、勾企、锁扣及排水**。

基层准备和工序先后很重要。原有缺陷、薄弱支撑、不兼容材料或损坏基层，应在封闭前处理。施工期间保护已入住空间、公共走廊及已完成饰面。验收不能只看外观，还要测试功能，并检查边缘、固定件、接缝和检修点。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 在轨道喷易粘灰的油。
- 同一窗扇混装不同滑轮。
- 把窗扇调太高导致勾企无法咬合。
- 无安全承托搬抬大玻璃窗扇。

合适的检查应区分“仍可维修的部件”与“已应更换的系统”。对于只有拆开后才能确认的隐藏状况，应要求把报价假设和不包含项目写清楚。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 150**
- 滑轮类型、尺寸及数量。
- 窗扇尺寸、重量及玻璃状况。
- 轨道、锁扣及毛条维修。
- 高度及拆扇通道。

其主服务公布 **12 个月五金与密封保修**，具体按适用范围和条款执行。请书面确认是否涵盖本次工程、客户自购材料及原有缺陷。

## 安全、进场与保养

不要为了省时而绕过厂家说明、管理处规定或安全通道安排。完工后保留产品资料和护理说明。定期清洁，并及早处理潮气、位移、锈蚀或五金松动，通常能让局部维修更简单。

## 常见问题

### 两个滑轮都要换吗？
若同龄同磨损，成对更换通常合理；最终以检查结果为准。

### 换滑轮后为何仍然沉重？
轨道可能凹陷、脏污或错位，窗扇也可能在勾企处摩擦；滑轮只是系统一部分。

### 轨道要涂油吗？
应遵循滑轮和窗框指引。保持轨道清洁通常比使用会粘砂的润滑剂更重要。

## 获取针对现场的报价

en.metaDesc: Guide to smart lighting & dimmer retrofit in kl: suitability, site checks, installation steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for properties in KL and Selangor.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** A reliable smart-lighting retrofit starts with electrical compatibility, not the app. The technician must identify whether a neutral conductor is present, confirm lamp and driver dimmability, check minimum load and select a Wi-Fi, Zigbee or other control system that still works sensibly when the internet is unavailable.

The service includes site checks, safe installation, setup and functional testing for the agreed points. This article explains the [Retrofitting Smart Lighting Without Creating Flicker](/services/lighting/smart-lighting-and-dimmer-retrofit) scope under [lighting services](/services/lighting), with a published starting price of **RM 250 / point**.

## What Must Be Checked First

### existing switch wiring
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### lamp and driver compatibility
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### hub and Wi-Fi requirements
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.

### manual override and household access
Confirm condition, compatibility and constraints during the site survey.


## Practical Planning Notes

A quotation should define the measured work area or number of points, the preparation included, who supplies the finish product or equipment, and how concealed defects will be handled. Product names alone are not a complete specification: model, dimensions, colour or output, compatible accessories and installation method all affect the result. For **smart lighting & dimmer retrofit in kl**, the survey should record existing switch wiring, lamp and driver compatibility, hub and wi-fi requirements, and manual override and household access.

Sequence matters when several trades share the area. Complete leak repairs and wet work before sensitive finishes; coordinate framing, wiring, pipework and access panels before surfaces are closed; and protect completed work from following trades. A sample, layout drawing or one-point trial is useful when appearance, alignment, brightness, texture or control behaviour cannot be judged from a catalogue.

The handover should be functional, not visual only. The installer should inspect fixing or adhesion, edges and penetrations, operation under normal use, and any serviceable components. Keep the product model, colour or batch reference and care instructions. These records make future replacement or local repair more accurate.


## How the Work Is Carried Out

1. **Isolate and identify conductors** — isolate and identify conductors. Record the finding before materials are ordered.

2. **Confirm dimming range on one point** — confirm dimming range on one point. Protect adjacent finishes and keep the work area controlled.

3. **Fit correctly rated control** — fit correctly rated control. Check alignment, coverage, support or connections as the work progresses.

4. **Pair and name rooms** — pair and name rooms. Do not conceal the stage until the responsible person has inspected it.

5. **Test power recovery and manual control** — test power recovery and manual control. Test under normal use and record any care or cure-time restriction.


## Choosing the Right Approach

| Option | When it fits |
|---|---|

| smart switch |  on/off automation |

| smart dimmer |  adjustable compatible lamps |

| smart bulb |  simple individual lamp control |


## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Installing a dimmer on a non-dimmable LED

- Assuming every switch box has a neutral

- Overloading a smart module

- Making all basic lighting depend on one phone account


Do not bypass structural, electrical, waterproofing or product requirements to save preparation time. Stop work if hidden moisture, unsafe wiring, weak support or moving cracks are discovered; diagnose these conditions before covering them.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 250 / point**
- **Published workmanship cover: 12-Month Lighting Installation Warranty**, subject to the published terms.

The final quotation depends on site condition, quantity or area, access, materials, preparation and any related repair identified during inspection. A starting rate is not a fixed total for every property.

For homes and commercial properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, access rules, working hours, lift protection and management approval can affect scheduling. Confirm these requirements before materials and labour are booked.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Will any LED work with a smart dimmer?
No. The lamp and driver must explicitly support dimming and the dimmer type and load range must match.


### Do I need a hub?
Wi-Fi devices may not, while Zigbee and other systems commonly do. A hub can improve multi-device reliability.


### What happens after a power cut?
Behaviour is model-specific. Commissioning should test reconnection and the chosen power-restoration state.


## Get a Site-Specific Quotation

Share photos, product details and the number of points for a focused quotation. KL Servis Rumah can inspect the conditions and explain the suitable scope before work begins.

## 施工前必须检查什么

### 现有开关布线

在现场勘察时确认状态、兼容性和限制。


## 实用规划要点

报价应列明实测面积或点位数量、包含哪些基层准备、成品或设备由谁提供，以及发现隐藏缺陷时如何处理。只有产品名称并不构成完整规格；型号、尺寸、颜色或输出、兼容配件和安装方法都会影响结果。针对**吉隆坡智能照明与调光改造**，勘察记录应包括现有开关布线、灯具和驱动兼容性、网关与 Wi-Fi 要求、手动控制和家庭成员权限。

多个工种共用区域时，施工顺序很重要。漏水和湿作业应在敏感饰面之前完成；封闭表面前要协调骨架、线路、管路和检修口；完工面也要防止被后续工序损坏。如外观、对齐、亮度、纹理或控制效果无法从目录判断，应先制作样板、排版图或试装一个点位。

交付不能只看外观，还要检查固定或粘结、边缘与穿孔、正常使用下的功能，以及可维修部件。保存产品型号、颜色或批次编号和保养说明，有助于日后准确更换或局部维修。


## 标准施工步骤

1. **断电辨认导线** — 断电辨认导线. 订购材料前记录勘察结果。

2. **先在一个点测试调光范围** — 先在一个点测试调光范围. 保护相邻饰面并控制施工区域。

3. **安装额定值正确的控制器** — 安装额定值正确的控制器. 施工期间同步检查对齐、覆盖、支撑或连接。

4. **配对并命名房间** — 配对并命名房间. 负责人检查前不要封闭这一工序。

5. **测试断电恢复与手动操作** — 测试断电恢复与手动操作. 按正常使用方式测试，并记录保养或养护限制。


## 如何选择合适方案

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|

| 智能开关 | 开关自动化 |

| 智能调光器 | 调节兼容灯具 |

| 智能灯泡 | 单独控制一盏灯 |


## 应避免的常见错误

- 给不可调光 LED 安装调光器

- 假设每个开关盒都有中性线

- 智能模块过载

- 让基本照明完全依赖一个手机账户


不要为了缩短准备时间而绕过结构、电气、防水或产品要求。如发现隐藏潮气、不安全线路、薄弱支撑或活动裂缝，应暂停并先诊断，不能直接覆盖。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价: RM 250 / point**
- **已公布工艺保障: 12 个月灯具安装保修**（按已公布条款执行）。

最终报价取决于现场状况、数量或面积、施工通道、材料、基层处理，以及检查发现的相关维修。起价并不代表每个物业的固定总价。

吉隆坡与雪兰莪的住宅及商业场所可能有进场时段、电梯保护、施工时间和管理处批准要求，这些都会影响排期。预订材料和人手前应先确认。

## 常见问题


### 任何 LED 都能配智能调光器吗？
不能。灯具和驱动必须明确支持调光，并匹配调光器类型和负载范围。


### 需要网关吗？
Wi-Fi 设备可能不需要，Zigbee 等通常需要；网关可改善多设备稳定性。


### 停电后会怎样？
各型号不同。调试时应测试重新连接和恢复供电后的默认状态。

en.title: Smart Lock Installation Cost & Buying Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Professional smart lock installation in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor — keypad, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or fingerprint, with app pairing. From RM 420.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Smart Lock Installation Cost & Buying Guide | KL
en.metaDesc: Keypad, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and fingerprint smart locks installed in KL & Selangor. App pairing and user setup from RM 420.
en.content:
A smart lock only works if the door latches, the mortice fits the stile, and the users are actually registered before the installer leaves. KL Servis Rumah supplies and installs digital keypad, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and fingerprint locks on landed houses and condos across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

**Direct answer:** Smart lock installation starts from **RM 420**, including pairing the app and registering users. We commonly fit Samsung, Yale, Igloohome, Solity, Häfele, Kaiser and Philips models that match the door.

This page is about **installation**. Brand comparison and feature lists live in the [smart lock buying guide for Malaysian homes (2026)](/blog/smart-lock-buying-guide-malaysia-2026). Other lock work is on [locksmith services](/services/locksmith).

## What the installation includes

- Check door type, thickness, stile width and existing hole.
- Supply (or fit your) lock.
- Remove the old lock and prepare the door.
- Fit, align and test the latch and deadbolt.
- App pairing, admin setup, fingerprint or PIN registration.
- Walkthrough of mechanical key override and battery warnings.

It does not include rebuilding a warped door. If the leaf does not meet the strike, we fix that first or we refuse to “force” the lock.

## Will my door take a smart lock?

Most Malaysian main doors will, with one of these paths:

- **Existing hole matches** — common on condos (Solity / Häfele style cutouts). 30–60 minutes.
- **New mortice** — we cut a pocket in a timber stile. 1.5–2 hours.
- **Metal door** — possible with the right kit; quoted after we see the leaf.

Hollow light bedroom doors and very narrow stiles are a poor fit. We will say so.

If a lock already on the door is dead, see [smart lock not working](/problems/smart-lock-not-working) before you buy another unit — the cause is often batteries or alignment, not the brand.

## What we check so the lock lasts

- **Door alignment.** A dropped hinge makes a fingerprint lock fight the strike every time. Related: [loose door hinge](/problems/loose-door-hinge).
- **Latch direction and backset.**
- **Power.** Fresh batteries, USB emergency supply if the model has one.
- **Wi-Fi or hub** only if you actually bought a connected model — many “app” locks are Bluetooth only at the door.
- **Mechanical override keys** handed to you, not left in the factory bag on the kitchen counter.

## Cost

| Item | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Smart lock installation | From RM 420 |
| Mortice / deadbolt (mechanical) | From RM 220 |
| Key cutting / re-key | From RM 30 |

The lock body is the large variable. A basic digital lock and a Wi-Fi fingerprint mortice are not the same product. We itemise supply vs labour if you already bought the lock.

## Common install mistakes we correct

- Lock bought for a 45 mm US door on a 40 mm local leaf.
- App never set up, so the owner only has one PIN written on a sticker.
- Old user fingerprints left on a second-hand lock.
- Strike plate on 15 mm screws in a soft frame.
- Installed on a door that scrapes — planing belongs with [door services](/services/door).

## Frequently asked questions

### Can you install a lock I bought online?

Yes, if it physically fits. We will not warranty the lock body if it is a no-name unit that fails internally, but we will warranty our workmanship.

### Do I need Wi-Fi?

Only for remote unlock and some notifications. Fingerprint and PIN work without it on most models.

### What happens when the batteries die?

Use the mechanical key or the model’s USB emergency pad. We show you both before we leave.

### How long does it take?

30–60 minutes on a matching hole; up to about 2 hours for a new mortice.

### Condo management approval?

Inside your own unit, a main-door lock change is normally fine. Common-area or fire-door hardware is a different rule — we will not convert a certified fire door into a non-compliant leaf.

## Book smart lock installation

If you want a keypad or fingerprint lock fitted and set up properly, KL Servis Rumah installs smart locks across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp the door photo and lock model if you already have one — [request a smart lock install](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20to%20install%20a%20smart%20lock.).
