zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪热水器安装与维修
zh.excerpt: 即热式、储水式或热泵热水器——在吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地供应、安装、更换和维修，涵盖 Joven、Rheem、Rinnai、Alpha、Faber 和 Mitsubishi Electric 等主要品牌。
zh.metaTitle: 热水器安装、维修还是更换？判断指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪热水器安装、更换和维修，涵盖 Joven、Rheem、Rinnai、Alpha、Faber 与 Mitsubishi。ST持牌布线，RM 180起。
zh.content:
KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地供应、安装、更换和维修热水器，覆盖马来西亚市场所有主要品牌——Joven、Rheem、Rinnai、Alpha、Faber 和 Mitsubishi Electric。即热式热水器安装RM 250起，储水式安装RM 420起，维修或除垢RM 180起。

热水器是家中少数将市电与流动水结合在一起的电器之一，因此安装必须包含正确接地、RCCB保护回路和防水隔离。本指南介绍可用的热水器类型、安装包含哪些内容，以及何时维修比更换更划算。

## 马来西亚家庭的热水器类型

### 即热式（单点）热水器

马来西亚最常见的类型，直接安装在花洒或面盆水龙头上方。水流经机体时被即时加热。

- 即开即热——无需等待储水。
- 体积小巧、壁挂安装，适合公寓和单卫生间。
- 适合一个花洒点位；同时开多个出水口会降低水温。
- 功率较大（通常3.5kW–4.5kW），需要专用回路。

### 储水式（水箱）热水器

15L–50L保温水箱加热并储存热水，可为家中多个点位供水。

- 为两个或更多卫生间、或厨房提供稳定的热水。
- 水箱用完后需要时间重新加热。
- 需要牢固的墙体安装——50L水箱注满水后非常重。
- 负载比即热式低，适合布线较旧的房子——但仍需正确回路。

### 热泵热水器

适合有地住宅的节能系统：热泵从室外空气中吸取热量来加热水，用电量约为电阻式加热器的三分之一。

- 前期投入较高，运行成本低得多。
- 需要室外或通风良好的空间放置室外机。
- 最适合每天大量使用热水的家庭。

## 安装：专业工程包含哪些内容

安装热水器同时涉及电气和管道工作。一次正确的安装包括：

1. **现场检查** — 确认墙体类型（机体必须安装牢固）、最近的电源点和水压。
2. **专用回路** — 大多数热水器需要带隔离器的专用20A–32A点位，绝不与其他电器共用回路。
3. **RCCB保护** — 回路必须由漏电保护装置保护；这对涉水电器是不可妥协的要求。
4. **防水安装** — 防溅安装和符合SIRIM标准的管道，确保水永远不会接触到带电部件。
5. **测试** — 交付前验证接地连续性、极性和RCCB功能。

所有布线由ST注册电工完成，安装附带12个月工艺保修。

## 热水器维修与保养

我们修复的常见问题：

- **不加热或加热慢** — 通常是加热元件、温控器或热断路器故障。请参阅[热水器不加热](/zh/problems/water-heater-not-heating)。
- **热水器开启时RCCB跳闸** — 通常是元件漏电或电线损坏的迹象；必须立即修复。
- **机体漏水** — 储水式的箱体腐蚀，或即热式的加热腔开裂。
- **水温忽高忽低** — 温控器失效或水垢沉积。
- **加热时有噪音** — 隆隆声或嘶嘶声通常意味着箱内积垢。

**除垢** — 马来西亚许多地区（巴生、莎阿南和吉隆坡部分地区）水质较硬，水垢会在热水器和花洒头内积聚。每1–2年除垢可延长元件寿命并恢复加热速度。储水式还应检查阳极棒，因为它保护水箱免受腐蚀。

## 热水器费用参考（吉隆坡与雪兰莪）

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 即热式热水器安装 | RM 250 起 |
| 储水式热水器安装 | RM 420 起 |
| 热水器维修与除垢 | RM 180 起 |
| 热泵热水器安装 | RM 2,200 起 |

热水器本身的供应价格另计，视品牌和型号而定。如果热水器已无法修复，我们可以更换——多数情况下可当天更换，让您不会长时间没有热水。

## 常见问题

### 马来西亚哪个热水器品牌最好？

最佳品牌取决于您的需求。Joven 和 Alpha 是马来西亚市面上受欢迎且价格实惠的选择。Rheem 和 Rinnai 是可靠的中端选择，Mitsubishi Electric 则为有地住宅提供高效热泵系统。这些品牌我们都能安装和维护。

### 可以自己安装热水器吗？

不可以。热水器安装将电气与管道工程结合在一起。没有正确接地、RCCB保护和防水安装，DIY安装可能致命。马来西亚法规要求电气工程由注册电工完成。

### 热水器能用多久？

普通即热式热水器可使用5–8年；阳极棒保养得当的储水式水箱可使用8–12年。定期除垢和检查可延长两者寿命。

### 厨房能共用同一个热水器吗？

即热式是单点的——只服务一个花洒或面盆。若要多个点位（厨房+卫生间），储水式或热泵系统才是正确选择。

### 你们是卖热水器还是只负责安装？

两者都做。我们供应各大品牌的热水器，可提供供应与安装一体报价，也可安装您自行购买的机器。

## 预约热水器安装或维修

KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪各地安装和维修热水器——从满家乐的公寓到梳邦再也和莎阿南的排屋。ST持牌布线、SIRIM管道，附12个月工艺保修。

WhatsApp联系我们获取报价——[与我们的团队联系](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E7%83%AD%E6%B0%B4%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Water Heater Repair & Descaling in KL and Selangor
en.excerpt: No hot water, slow heating, a leaking tank or an RCCB that trips when the heater runs — most water heater faults come down to elements, thermostats, valves or limescale. Here is how repair and descaling works, and when replacement makes more sense.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Water Heater Repair & Descaling: Troubleshooting Guide
en.metaDesc: No hot water, slow heating, leaks or RCCB trips? Water heater fault diagnosis, element repair, tank descaling and anode checks in KL & Selangor, from RM 180.
en.content:
**Question:** Why is my water heater taking longer and longer to heat?

**Answer:** In most cases it is **limescale**. Mineral deposits in the water harden onto the heating element every heating cycle, slowly insulating it from the water it is supposed to heat. The heater then runs longer to deliver the same temperature — using more electricity, overheating the element itself, and often making popping or crackling noises as water boils through the scale layer. Descaling plus a check of the element, thermostat and (on storage tanks) the sacrificial anode rod usually restores normal behaviour without replacing the unit.

This article covers the **water heater repair & descaling** sub-service under the [water heater service](/services/water-heater), starting from **RM 180**. Related scopes: [instant water heater installation](/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation), [storage tank heater installation](/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation), [heat pump water heater install](/services/water-heater/heat-pump-water-heater-install) and [water heater & pump installation](/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation). If your heater has stopped completely, see [water heater not heating](/problems/water-heater-not-heating); if it trips the power, see [RCCB keeps tripping](/problems/rccb-tripping-kl).

## Fault Map: Symptom to Cause

| Symptom | Most likely causes |
|---|---|
| No hot water at all | Dead element, failed thermostat, tripped breaker, faulty on/off switch |
| Slow heating or lukewarm water | Limescale on the element, failing element, wrong thermostat setting |
| Popping/crackling noises | Scale layer on element or tank bottom boiling trapped water |
| Water leaking from the unit | Failed gasket or valve, corroded tank (replacement usually) |
| RCCB trips when heating | Earth leakage in a failing element, moisture inside the terminal box |
| Hot water runs out fast | Scaled element, broken dip tube, undersized tank for the household |

## What Repair & Descaling Includes

The published scope starts at **RM 180** and covers diagnosis plus the common remedial work:

1. **Fault diagnosis** — element continuity, thermostat operation, wiring and connection points are tested before anything is opened.
2. **Descaling** — mineral buildup is removed from the element and (for storage tanks) flushed from the tank interior.
3. **Anode rod check** — storage tanks carry a sacrificial anode that corrodes so the tank doesn't; a consumed anode is noted and replacement advised before the tank itself starts rusting.
4. **Component repair/replacement** — elements, thermostats, gaskets, valves and switches replaced where diagnosed faulty.
5. **Electrical safety checks** — earthing verified, terminal box sealed, RCCB behaviour tested after work.
6. **Leak source assessment** — if the leak traces to a corroded tank body rather than a fitting, you are told plainly: fittings are repairable, tanks are not.

## Instant vs Storage: What Breaks Differently

- **Instant (tankless) heaters** fail mostly at the element, flow sensor and pressure activator — and are very sensitive to inlet conditions. If your pressure is marginal, a heater may cut out even with nothing wrong inside it; check [low water pressure](/problems/low-water-pressure) symptoms or consider [pump installation](/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation).
- **Storage heaters** fail gradually: scale builds up, the anode is consumed, then the tank corrodes. Regular descaling and anode checks are what separates a tank that lasts from one that leaks onto your ceiling.

## Repair or Replace?

- **Element, thermostat, valve or gasket fault:** repair is usually economical — these are wear parts.
- **Scaled but otherwise healthy heater:** descale first; replacement can wait.
- **Corroded storage tank leaking from the body:** replace the unit — tank repairs do not hold.
- **Unit still failing after multiple repairs:** at some point a new [storage heater installation](/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation) (from **RM 420**) or [instant heater installation](/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation) (from **RM 250**) beats chasing faults on an aged unit.

Honest advice on this call is part of the diagnosis visit — you should never pay repair prices for a heater at the end of its life.

## Cost Factors

The repair & descaling sub-service starts at **RM 180**; the [water heater service](/services/water-heater) starts at **RM 180** overall. Final cost depends on:

- Instant vs storage unit and ease of access to the tank.
- Whether the job is diagnosis-only, descaling, or parts replacement.
- Part prices for elements/thermostats (model-dependent).
- Anode rod replacement on storage tanks.
- Whether any plumbing or electrical rework is needed alongside.

Workmanship on installation and repair carries a published **12-Month Installation Workmanship Warranty** within its terms.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How often should a storage water heater be descaled and checked?
It depends on water conditions and usage, but scale builds continuously with each heating cycle, so periodic descaling with an anode check is standard maintenance for storage tanks. If you hear popping noises or heating time has stretched noticeably, that is your schedule arriving early.

### Can I flush or descale the tank myself?
A basic flush through the drain point is possible on many tanks, but effective descaling of the element and an anode inspection requires draining, opening and electrical isolation of the unit — a job that combines plumbing and electrical safety. Getting it wrong beside 240V and hot water is how people get hurt.

### Why did my RCCB start tripping right after my heater problem started?
A failing element often develops small cracks that let moisture reach live parts — the RCCB detects that leakage current and trips, exactly as designed. This is a repair-trigger warning, not an electrical nuisance: see [RCCB keeps tripping](/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) and have the heater checked before continuing to rearm the breaker.

## Hot Water, Back On Schedule

A diagnosed, descaled and safety-checked heater outlasts an ignored one by years. KL Servis Rumah repairs and services water heaters across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

Describe the symptom, the unit type and its approximate age — [WhatsApp the water heater team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20I%20need%20a%20quote%20for%20water%20heater%20repair%20and%20descaling.).

ms.title: Pembaikan & Nyahkerak Pemanas Air di KL dan Selangor
ms.excerpt: Tiada air panas, pemanasan perlahan, tangki bocor atau RCCB yang trip apabila pemanas berfungsi — kebanyakan kerosakan pemanas air berpunca daripada elemen, termostat, injap atau kerak. Begini cara pembaikan dan nyahkerak berfungsi, dan bila penggantian lebih masuk akal.
ms.metaTitle: Pembaikan & Nyahkerak Pemanas Air di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Tiada air panas, pemanasan perlahan, bocor atau RCCB trip? Diagnosis kerosakan, pembaikan elemen dan nyahkerak tangki di KL & Selangor, dari RM 180.
ms.content:
**Soalan:** Kenapa pemanas air saya mengambil masa semakin lama untuk memanaskan?

**Jawapan:** Dalam kebanyakan kes ia adalah **kerak (limescale)**. Mendakan mineral dalam air mengeras ke atas elemen pemanasan setiap kitaran pemanasan, perlahan-lahan menebatkannya daripada air yang sepatutnya dipanaskan. Pemanas kemudian berfungsi lebih lama untuk menyampaikan suhu yang sama — menggunakan lebih banyak elektrik, terlalu panas elemen itu sendiri, dan selalunya menghasilkan bunyi letusan atau keretak apabila air mendidih melalui lapisan kerak. Nyahkerak ditambah semakan elemen, termostat dan (pada tangki simpanan) rod anod pengorbanan biasanya memulihkan tingkah laku normal tanpa menggantikan unit.

Artikel ini merangkumi sub-perkhidmatan **pembaikan & nyahkerak pemanas air** di bawah [perkhidmatan pemanas air](/ms/services/water-heater), bermula **RM 180**. Skop berkaitan: [pemasangan pemanas air segera](/ms/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation), [pemasangan pemanas tangki simpanan](/ms/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation), [pemasangan pemanas air pam haba](/ms/services/water-heater/heat-pump-water-heater-install) dan [pemasangan pemanas air & pam](/ms/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation). Jika pemanas anda berhenti sepenuhnya, lihat [pemanas air tidak panas](/ms/problems/water-heater-not-heating); jika ia trip kuasa, lihat [RCCB kerap trip](/ms/problems/rccb-tripping-kl).

## Peta Kerosakan: Gejala ke Punca

| Gejala | Punca paling mungkin |
|---|---|
| Tiada air panas langsung | Elemen mati, termostat gagal, pemutus trip, suis hidup/mati rosak |
| Pemanasan perlahan atau air suam | Kerak pada elemen, elemen gagal, tetapan termostat salah |
| Bunyi letusan/keretak | Lapisan kerak pada elemen atau dasar tangki mendidihkan air terperangkap |
| Air bocor dari unit | Gasket atau injap gagal, tangki berkarat (penggantian biasanya) |
| RCCB trip semasa pemanasan | Bocor bumi dalam elemen gagal, lembapan dalam kotak terminal |
| Air panas cepat habis | Elemen berkerak, tiub celup rosak, tangki kurang saiz untuk isi rumah |

## Apa Yang Termasuk Pembaikan & Nyahkerak

Skop diterbitkan bermula **RM 180** dan merangkumi diagnosis ditambah kerja pemulihan biasa:

1. **Diagnosis kerosakan** — kesinambungan elemen, operasi termostat, pendawaian dan titik sambungan diuji sebelum apa-apa dibuka.
2. **Nyahkerak** — terkumpul mineral disingkirkan daripada elemen dan (untuk tangki simpanan) dibilas daripada bahagian dalam tangki.
3. **Semakan rod anod** — tangki simpanan membawa anod pengorbanan yang berkarat supaya tangki tidak; anod yang habis dicatat dan penggantian dinasihatkan sebelum tangki itu sendiri mula berkarat.
4. **Pembaikan/penggantian komponen** — elemen, termostat, gasket, injap dan suis diganti di mana didiagnosis rosak.
5. **Semakan keselamatan elektrik** — pembumian disahkan, kotak terminal dimeterai, tingkah laku RCCB diuji selepas kerja.
6. **Penilaian punca bocor** — jika bocor disusuri ke badan tangki berkarat dan bukannya kelengkapan, anda diberitahu secara jelas: kelengkapan boleh dibaiki, tangki tidak.

## Segera vs Simpanan: Apa Yang Rosak Secara Berbeza

- **Pemanas segera (tanpa tangki)** gagal kebanyakannya pada elemen, sensor aliran dan pengaktif tekanan — dan sangat sensitif kepada keadaan masuk. Jika tekanan anda marginal, pemanas mungkin terpadam walaupun tiada apa yang salah di dalamnya; semak gejala [tekanan air rendah](/ms/problems/low-water-pressure) atau pertimbangkan [pemasangan pam](/ms/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation).
- **Pemanas simpanan** gagal secara beransur-ansur: kerak terkumpul, anod dimakan, kemudian tangki berkarat. Nyahkerak berkala dan semakan anod ialah apa yang membezakan tangki yang tahan daripada yang bocor ke siling anda.

## Baiki atau Ganti?

- **Kerosakan elemen, termostat, injap atau gasket:** pembaikan biasanya ekonomi — ini adalah bahagian haus.
- **Berkerak tetapi pemanas sihat selainnya:** nyahkerak dahulu; penggantian boleh menunggu.
- **Tangki simpanan berkarat bocor dari badan:** ganti unit — pembaikan tangki tidak bertahan.
- **Unit masih gagal selepas berbilang pembaikan:** pada satu ketika [pemasangan pemanas simpanan](/ms/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation) baharu (dari **RM 420**) atau [pemasangan pemanas segera](/ms/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation) (dari **RM 250**) mengalahkan mengejar kerosakan pada unit usang.

Nasihat jujur mengenai panggilan ini ialah sebahagian daripada lawatan diagnosis — anda tidak sepatutnya membayar harga pembaikan untuk pemanas di penghujung hayatnya.

## Faktor Kos

Sub-perkhidmatan pembaikan & nyahkerak bermula **RM 180**; [perkhidmatan pemanas air](/ms/services/water-heater) bermula **RM 180** keseluruhan. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Unit segera berbanding simpanan dan kemudahan akses ke tangki.
- Sama ada kerja diagnosis sahaja, nyahkerak, atau penggantian bahagian.
- Harga bahagian untuk elemen/termostat (bergantung model).
- Penggantian rod anod pada tangki simpanan.
- Sama ada sebarang kerja semula paip atau elektrik diperlukan bersama.

Mutu kerja pemasangan dan pembaikan membawa **Jaminan Kerja Pemasangan 12 Bulan** yang diterbitkan mengikut termanya.

## Soalan Lazim

### Berapa kerap pemanas air simpanan patut dinyahkerak dan disemak?
Ia bergantung pada keadaan air dan penggunaan, tetapi kerak terbina berterusan dengan setiap kitaran pemanasan, jadi nyahkerak berkala dengan semakan anod ialah penyelenggaraan standard untuk tangki simpanan. Jika anda mendengar bunyi letusan atau masa pemanasan telah memanjang dengan ketara, itulah jadual anda tiba awal.

### Bolehkah saya membilas atau nyahkerak tangki sendiri?
Bilasan asas melalui titik parit adalah mungkin pada banyak tangki, tetapi nyahkerak berkesan elemen dan pemeriksaan anod memerlukan pengurasan, pembukaan dan pengasingan elektrik unit — kerja yang menggabungkan keselamatan paip dan elektrik. Tersilap di sebelah 240V dan air panas ialah cara orang cedera.

### Kenapa RCCB saya mula trip sebaik sahaja masalah pemanas saya bermula?
Elemen yang gagal selalunya membina retakan kecil yang membenarkan lembapan mencapai bahagian hidup — RCCB mengesan arus bocor itu dan trip, tepat seperti direka. Ini adalah amaran pencetus-pembaikan, bukan gangguan elektrik: lihat [RCCB kerap trip](/ms/problems/rccb-tripping-kl) dan periksa pemanas sebelum terus memasang semula pemutus.

## Air Panas, Kembali Mengikut Jadual

Pemanas yang didiagnosis, dinyahkerak dan disemak keselamatan bertahan bertahun lebih lama daripada yang diabaikan. KL Servis Rumah membaiki dan menyervis pemanas air di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor.

Huraikan gejala, jenis unit dan anggaran usianya — [WhatsApp pasukan pemanas air](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlu%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20pembaikan%20dan%20nyahkerak%20pemanas%20air.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪热水器维修与除垢
zh.excerpt: 没热水、加热变慢、水箱漏水，或一开热水器就跳闸——多数热水器故障都出在加热体、温控器、阀门或水垢上。本文说明维修与除垢的做法，以及何时换新更划算。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪热水器维修除垢
zh.metaDesc: 没热水、加热慢、漏水或漏电开关跳闸？热水器故障诊断、加热体维修、水箱除垢与阳极棒检查，从 RM 180 起。
zh.content:
**问题：**为什么热水器加热越来越慢？

**答案：**多数情况是**水垢**。水中的矿物质每加热一次就在加热体上硬结一层，逐渐把加热体与它本该加热的水隔离开。于是热水器要花更长时间烧出同样的温度——耗电更多、加热体自身过热，水穿过垢层沸腾时还常常发出噼啪爆裂声。除垢，加上检查加热体、温控器，以及（储水式）检查牺牲阳极棒，通常就能恢复正常，无需整机更换。

本文介绍[热水器服务](/zh/services/water-heater)下的**热水器维修与除垢**子服务，从 **RM 180** 起。相关范围：[即热式热水器安装](/zh/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation)、[储水式热水器安装](/zh/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation)、[热泵热水器安装](/zh/services/water-heater/heat-pump-water-heater-install)与[热水器与水泵安装](/zh/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation)。热水器完全不出热水请参考[热水器不加热](/zh/problems/water-heater-not-heating)；一开就跳闸请参考[RCCB 频繁跳闸](/zh/problems/rccb-tripping-kl)。

## 故障对照：症状到原因

| 症状 | 最可能的原因 |
|---|---|
| 完全没热水 | 加热体烧毁、温控器失效、断路器跳闸、开关损坏 |
| 加热慢或水不够热 | 加热体结垢、加热体老化、温控设定不对 |
| 噼啪/爆裂声 | 加热体或箱底的水垢层把困住的水烧开 |
| 机身漏水 | 密封垫或阀门失效、箱体锈蚀（通常需换新） |
| 加热时 RCCB 跳闸 | 老化加热体漏电、接线盒内受潮 |
| 热水很快用完 | 加热体结垢、进水管（dip tube）断裂、水箱容量与家庭不匹配 |

## 维修与除垢包含什么

已公布范围从 **RM 180** 起，涵盖诊断加常见修复作业：

1. **故障诊断** —— 拆机前先测试加热体通断、温控器动作、线路与连接点；
2. **除垢** —— 清除加热体上的矿物质积垢，（储水式）冲洗水箱内部；
3. **阳极棒检查** —— 储水水箱装有牺牲阳极，它先锈蚀从而保护箱体；阳极耗尽会记录在案，并建议在箱体锈蚀前更换；
4. **部件维修/更换** —— 诊断出故障的加热体、温控器、密封垫、阀门与开关予以更换；
5. **电气安全检查** —— 验证接地、密封接线盒、作业后测试 RCCB 动作；
6. **漏水源判定** —— 如果漏水追到锈蚀的箱体而非接口配件，会明确告知：配件能修，箱体不能。

## 即热与储水：损坏方式不同

- **即热式（无水箱）** 的故障多在加热体、流量传感器与水压启动器——而且对进水条件非常敏感。水压本来就勉强时，即使机体无恙也会中途熄火；请核对[低水压](/zh/problems/low-water-pressure)的症状，或考虑[加装水泵](/zh/services/plumbing/water-heater-and-pump-installation)；
- **储水式** 是渐进的损坏：水垢越积越多、阳极被耗尽、然后箱体锈蚀。定期除垢与检查阳极，正是水箱能用长久与漏到天花之间的分水岭。

## 修还是换？

- **加热体、温控器、阀门或密封垫故障：** 维修通常划算——这些都属于易损件；
- **结垢但机体健康：** 先除垢；更换可以缓一缓；
- **储水箱体锈蚀、从箱体渗水：** 直接换新——箱体修不住；
- **多次维修后故障不断：** 到了某个时点，做一次新的[储水式安装](/zh/services/water-heater/storage-tank-heater-installation)（**RM 420** 起）或[即热式安装](/zh/services/water-heater/instant-water-heater-installation)（**RM 250** 起），比在老机上追故障更值。

在诊断上门时就该给出这样的坦白建议——绝不应该让您为一台寿命将尽的热水器花维修的钱。

## 费用因素

维修与除垢子服务从 **RM 180** 起；[热水器服务](/zh/services/water-heater)整体从 **RM 180** 起。最终费用取决于：

- 即热式与储水式之别，以及水箱的可作业性；
- 仅诊断、除垢，还是更换部件；
- 加热体/温控器的配件价（视型号而定）;
- 储水机的阳极棒更换；
- 是否需要同步的水电改造。

安装与维修的工艺附带已公布的 **12 个月安装工艺保修**（按条款执行）。

## 常见问题

### 储水式热水器应该多久除垢、检查一次？
取决于水质与用量，但每加热一次水垢就在积累，所以定期除垢并检查阳极是储水箱的标准保养。如果已经听到噼啪声或加热时间明显拉长，那就是保养周期提前到了。

### 可以自己冲洗或给水箱除垢吗？
很多水箱可以通过排污口做基础冲洗，但要有效清除加热体水垢、检查阳极，需要排水、开盖并做电气隔离——水电安全交织的作业。在 240V 和热水旁边操作失误，正是人受伤的原因。

### 为什么热水器一出问题 RCCB 就开始跳？
老化加热体常会产生细小裂缝，让潮气接触带电部分——RCCB 检测到这个泄漏电流就会跳闸，这正是它的设计作用。这是“该修了”的警告，而不是电气毛病：参考[RCCB 频繁跳闸](/zh/problems/rccb-tripping-kl)，在反复合闸之前先检查热水器。

## 让热水按点归来

经过诊断、除垢与安全检查的热水器，比放着不管的多用几年。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪维修与保养热水器。

说明症状、机型与大致使用年限——[WhatsApp 热水器团队](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%83%AD%E6%B0%B4%E5%99%A8%E7%BB%B4%E4%BF%AE%E4%B8%8E%E9%99%A4%E5%9E%A2%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.content:
Question: How do I find a hidden water leak without tearing up my house?

Answer: A professional leak detection service uses pressure testing, acoustic listening, thermal imaging, and dye testing to locate the leak precisely, then repairs only the affected area — minimising damage.

A hidden water leak is one of the most frustrating and damaging problems in a home. It can rot timber, stain ceilings, encourage mould, and cause a sudden spike in your water bill. KL Servis Rumah provides water leakage diagnosis and repair across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, from RM 220.

## Signs You Have a Hidden Water Leak

- **Higher water bill** — a sudden jump with no change in usage.
- **Damp or stained patches** on walls, ceilings, or floors.
- **Mould or a musty smell** in a specific area.
- **Water meter spinning** when all taps are off.
- **Peeling paint or bubbling wallpaper** near pipes.
- **Cracks in the floor** or a sagging area near a water line.

If you notice any of these, the sooner the leak is found, the less damage it causes.

## How Hidden Leaks Are Found Without Hacking

Modern leak detection avoids unnecessary damage:

1. **Pressure testing** — the system is pressurised to confirm a leak exists and isolate which zone it is in.
2. **Acoustic detection** — sensitive listening devices pick up the sound of water escaping through a pipe.
3. **Thermal imaging** — a thermal camera shows the cooler, damp area created by the leak.
4. **Dye testing** — for specific fixtures (toilets, overflow pipes), a safe dye confirms the source.
5. **Tracer gas** — in some cases, a trace gas is used to pinpoint the exact point.

Only after the location is confirmed do we open the affected area — keeping damage to the minimum.

## Repair Options

Once the leak is located, the repair depends on the cause:

- **Pinhole leak in a pipe** — the damaged section is cut out and replaced.
- **Leaking joint** — the joint is re-sealed or replaced.
- **Cracked pipe** — the cracked section is replaced.
- **Waterproofing failure** — the affected waterproofing layer is repaired or reapplied.

Related problem: water leaks also often come from the roof. If your leak appears near the ceiling after rain, see our [ceiling leak guide](/problems/ceiling-leak-after-rain) — the cause may be roofing rather than plumbing.

## How Much Does Leak Detection Cost?

Water leakage diagnosis and repair starts from **RM 220**. The final cost depends on:

- Where the leak is located and how it is accessed
- The extent of the repair (pipe section, joint, or waterproofing)
- Whether flooring, tiles, or walls need restoration after the repair

You receive a fixed quote after the diagnosis, before any work begins.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why is my water bill high but I can't find a leak?

This is a classic sign of a hidden leak in the private pipework between the meter and your fixtures. Turn off all taps and check if the meter still moves; if it does, water is escaping somewhere in your system.

### Does finding a leak require breaking floors and walls?

Not usually. Modern detection methods locate the leak precisely first, so we only open the smallest area needed. This is the main advantage of professional detection over guess-and-dig.

### Can a leak damage the structure of my home?

Yes. Left untreated, water can rot timber, weaken plaster, encourage mould, and damage electrical fittings. Fixing leaks early saves money and protects your home.

### How long does leak detection take?

A straightforward leak can be located within a few hours. Repairs depend on the extent of the leak and access.

## Get Help Finding a Hidden Leak

If you suspect a hidden water leak, early detection protects your home and your bill. KL Servis Rumah provides professional leak detection and repair across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a free assessment — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20suspect%20a%20water%20leak%20and%20need%20help%20finding%20it.).

ms.content:
Soalan: Bagaimana mencari bocor air tersembunyi tanpa merobohkan rumah?

Jawapan: Perkhidmatan pengesanan bocor profesional menggunakan ujian tekanan, pendengaran akustik, pengimejan terma, dan ujian pewarna untuk mencari lokasi bocor dengan tepat, kemudian membaiki hanya kawasan terjejas — meminimumkan kerosakan.

Bocor air tersembunyi ialah salah satu masalah paling mengecewakan dan merosakkan dalam rumah. Ia boleh mereputkan kayu, mengotorkan siling, menggalakkan kulat, dan menyebabkan lonjakan mendadak bil air. KL Servis Rumah menyediakan diagnosis dan pembaikan bocor air di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor, dari RM 220.

## Tanda Anda Mempunyai Bocor Air Tersembunyi

- **Bil air lebih tinggi** — lonjakan mendadak tanpa perubahan penggunaan.
- **Tompok lembap atau bernoda** di dinding, siling, atau lantai.
- **Kulat atau bau hapak** di kawasan tertentu.
- **Meter air berputar** apabila semua tap ditutup.
- **Cat mengelupas atau kertas dinding berbuih** berhampiran paip.
- **Retak di lantai** atau kawasan mendap berhampiran saluran air.

Jika anda melihat mana-mana tanda ini, semakin cepat bocor ditemui, semakin kurang kerosakan.

## Cara Bocor Tersembunyi Ditemui Tanpa Memecahkan

Pengesanan bocor moden mengelakkan kerosakan yang tidak perlu:

1. **Ujian tekanan** — sistem diberi tekanan untuk mengesahkan wujud bocor dan mengasingkan zon.
2. **Pengesanan akustik** — peranti pendengaran sensitif mengesan bunyi air keluar daripada paip.
3. **Pengimejan terma** — kamera terma menunjukkan kawasan lembap dan sejuk yang dicipta oleh bocor.
4. **Ujian pewarna** — untuk kelengkapan tertentu (tandas, paip limpah), pewarna selamat mengesahkan punca.
5. **Gas pengesan** — dalam sesetengah kes, gas pengesan digunakan untuk mengenal pasti titik tepat.

Hanya selepas lokasi disahkan barulah kami membuka kawasan terjejas — memastikan kerosakan minimum.

## Pilihan Pembaikan

Sebaik bocor dikenal pasti, pembaikan bergantung pada punca:

- **Bocor lubang jarum dalam paip** — bahagian rosak dipotong dan diganti.
- **Sambungan bocor** — sambungan disegel semula atau diganti.
- **Paip retak** — bahagian retak diganti.
- **Kegagalan kalis air** — lapisan kalis air yang terjejas dibaiki atau disapu semula.

Masalah berkaitan: bocor air juga selalunya datang daripada bumbung. Jika bocor anda muncul berhampiran siling selepas hujan, lihat panduan [bocor siling](/ms/problems/ceiling-leak-after-rain) kami — puncanya mungkin bumbung dan bukannya paip.

## Berapa Kos Pengesanan Bocor?

Diagnosis dan pembaikan bocor air bermula dari **RM 220**. Kos akhir bergantung pada:

- Lokasi bocor dan cara aksesnya
- Skop pembaikan (bahagian paip, sambungan, atau kalis air)
- Sama ada lantai, jubin, atau dinding perlu dipulihkan selepas pembaikan

Anda menerima sebut harga tetap selepas diagnosis, sebelum sebarang kerja bermula.

## Soalan Lazim

### Kenapa bil air saya tinggi tetapi tidak jumpa bocor?

Ini tanda klasik bocor tersembunyi dalam paip persendirian antara meter dan kelengkapan anda. Tutup semua tap dan periksa sama ada meter masih bergerak; jika ya, air keluar di suatu tempat dalam sistem anda.

### Adakah mencari bocor memerlukan memecahkan lantai dan dinding?

Biasanya tidak. Kaedah pengesanan moden mencari lokasi bocor dahulu, jadi kami hanya membuka kawasan paling kecil yang diperlukan. Ini kelebihan utama pengesanan profesional berbanding meneka dan mengorek.

### Bolehkah bocor merosakkan struktur rumah?

Ya. Jika tidak dirawat, air boleh mereputkan kayu, melemahkan plaster, menggalakkan kulat, dan merosakkan kelengkapan elektrik. Memperbaiki bocor awal menjimatkan wang dan melindungi rumah.

### Berapa lama pengesanan bocor mengambil masa?

Bocor yang mudah boleh dikenal pasti dalam beberapa jam. Pembaikan bergantung pada tahap bocor dan akses.

## Dapatkan Bantuan Mencari Bocor Tersembunyi

Jika anda mengesyaki bocor air tersembunyi, pengesanan awal melindungi rumah dan bil anda. KL Servis Rumah menyediakan pengesanan dan pembaikan bocor profesional di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor. WhatsApp kami untuk penilaian percuma — [sembang dengan pasukan kami](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Salam%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20mengesyaki%20kebocoran%20air%20dan%20memerlukan%20bantuan%20mencarinya.).

zh.metaDesc: 无需不必要地敲开墙壁、天花板或地板即可找到并修复隐藏漏水。专业漏水检测与维修，RM 220起。
zh.content:
问题：如何在不拆毁房屋的情况下找到隐藏漏水？

回答：专业漏水检测服务使用压力测试、声学听音、热成像和染料测试精确定位漏水位置，然后只修复受影响的区域——将损坏降至最低。

隐藏漏水是家中最令人沮丧和最具破坏性的问题之一。它会使木材腐烂、弄脏天花板、滋生霉菌，并导致水费突然激增。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供漏水诊断与维修服务，RM 220起。

## 隐藏漏水的迹象

- **水费上涨** — 使用量没变但费用突然增加。
- **墙壁、天花板或地板上出现潮湿或污渍斑块**。
- **特定区域发霉或有霉味**。
- **所有水龙头都关闭时水表仍在转动**。
- **管道附近油漆剥落或墙纸起泡**。
- **地板开裂或水管附近区域下陷**。

如果您注意到以上任何迹象，越早找到漏水，造成的损坏就越小。

## 无需敲墙如何找到隐藏漏水

现代漏水检测可避免不必要的损坏：

1. **压力测试** — 对系统加压以确认存在漏水并隔离其所在区域。
2. **声学检测** — 灵敏的听音设备捕捉水从管道流出的声音。
3. **热成像** — 热像仪显示漏水造成的较冷、潮湿区域。
4. **染料测试** — 针对特定洁具（马桶、溢流管），用安全染料确认源头。
5. **示踪气体** — 在某些情况下，用示踪气体精确定位漏点。

只有在位置确认后，我们才打开受影响区域——将损坏控制在最小。

## 维修选项

一旦定位漏水，维修取决于原因：

- **管道针孔泄漏** — 切断并更换损坏段。
- **连接处泄漏** — 重新密封或更换连接。
- **管道开裂** — 更换开裂段。
- **防水层失效** — 修复或重做受影响的防水层。

相关问题：漏水也常常来自屋顶。如果您的漏水在雨后出现在天花板附近，请参阅我们的[天花板漏水指南](/zh/problems/ceiling-leak-after-rain)——原因可能是屋顶而非管道。

## 漏水检测费用多少？

漏水诊断与维修**RM 220起**。最终费用取决于：

- 漏水位置及其检修方式
- 维修范围（管段、连接处或防水层）
- 维修后是否需要修复地板、瓷砖或墙壁

诊断后、施工前，您会收到固定报价。

## 常见问题

### 为什么水费很高但我找不到漏水？

这是水表和洁具之间私有管道存在隐藏漏水的典型迹象。关闭所有水龙头并检查水表是否仍在转动；如果是，说明系统的某个地方正在漏水。

### 查找漏水需要敲开地板和墙壁吗？

通常不需要。现代检测方法会先精确定位漏水，所以我们只打开所需的最小区域。这是专业检测相对于猜测式开挖的主要优势。

### 漏水会损坏房屋结构吗？

会。如果不处理，水会使木材腐烂、削弱灰泥、滋生霉菌并损坏电气设备。及早修复漏水能省钱并保护您的家。

### 漏水检测需要多长时间？

简单的漏水可以在几小时内定位。维修取决于漏水程度和检修条件。

## 获取寻找隐藏漏水的帮助

如果您怀疑有隐藏漏水，及早检测可保护您的家和您的账单。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供专业漏水检测与维修。WhatsApp联系我们获取免费评估——[与我们的团队联系](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%80%80%E7%96%91%E6%9C%89%E6%B0%B4%E6%BC%8F%EF%BC%8C%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%B8%AE%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%E5%AE%83%E3%80%82)。

en.metaTitle: Waterproofing & Leak Repair Services in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Waterproofing and leak repair in KL & Selangor, including PU injection, bathroom, roof and concrete slab waterproofing, plus damp wall repair.
en.content:
Water entering your home through walls, floors, bathrooms, or the roof is more than an inconvenience — it causes structural damage, mould, and rising repair costs. KL Servis Rumah provides professional waterproofing and leak repair services across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

This guide explains the waterproofing services we provide, the common water problems we fix, and when your home needs waterproofing.

## Waterproofing Services We Provide

- **[PU high-pressure injection grouting](/services/waterproofing/pu-high-pressure-injection-grouting)** — stopping active leaks in concrete walls, slabs, and basements by injecting polyurethane resin.
- **[Bathroom & wet area waterproofing](/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing)** — preventing water from leaking through bathroom floors and walls.
- **Roof & concrete slab waterproofing** — protecting roofs and slabs from water penetration.
- **Wall dampness & efflorescence repair** — treating damp walls and salt deposits.

Every job starts with a diagnosis to find where water is entering, then a fixed quote before work begins.

## Common Water Problems We Fix

- **Leaking bathrooms** — water seeping through to the room below.
- **Damp or stained walls** — rising damp or water penetration.
- **Efflorescence** — white salt crystals on concrete or brick walls.
- **Roof leaks** — water entering through damaged roof surfaces.
- **Basement or car park leaks** — water seeping through concrete.

## Why Waterproofing Matters in Malaysia

Malaysia's heavy rain and high humidity make waterproofing essential. Without it:

- Water damages concrete and masonry over time.
- Mould and mildew thrive in damp areas, affecting health.
- Structural cracks widen as moisture weakens the material.
- Repair costs grow the longer a leak is ignored.

## What to Expect from a Waterproofing Job

1. **Diagnosis** — we identify where and how water is entering.
2. **Fixed quote** — you receive a clear price for the recommended work.
3. **Preparation** — the surface is cleaned and prepared.
4. **Application** — the appropriate waterproofing system is applied (grout, membrane, or coating).
5. **Testing** — the repair is checked, and the area is left clean.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does waterproofing cost in KL & Selangor?

PU injection grouting starts from RM 300 per point, bathroom & wet area waterproofing from RM 1,000, and wall dampness repair from RM 350. Final pricing depends on the area and method.

### What is PU injection grouting?

It is a method of stopping active water leaks in concrete by injecting polyurethane resin into the crack or joint under pressure. The resin expands and seals the leak from inside.

### Can you waterproof an existing bathroom without breaking tiles?

In many cases, leaks can be stopped with injection grouting or surface waterproofing without removing tiles. The best method depends on where the water is coming from.

### Do you also fix the source of the leak?

Yes. Waterproofing and leak repair go together — we find where the water enters and apply the correct system to stop it.

## Get a Waterproofing Quote in KL & Selangor

Whether water is leaking through a bathroom, wall, or roof, KL Servis Rumah provides professional waterproofing and leak repair across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp us for a free assessment — [chat with our team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20waterproofing%20for%20my%20property.).

水通过墙壁、地板、浴室或屋顶进入您的家，不仅带来不便——还会造成结构性损坏、发霉和不断上升的维修成本。KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供专业防水与漏水维修服务。

本指南介绍我们提供的防水服务、我们修复的常见水患问题，以及您的家何时需要防水。

## 我们提供的防水服务

- **[PU高压注浆](/zh/services/waterproofing/pu-high-pressure-injection-grouting)** — 通过注入聚氨酯树脂，阻止混凝土墙壁、楼板和地下室的活动性漏水。
- **[浴室与湿区防水](/zh/services/waterproofing/bathroom-and-wet-area-waterproofing)** — 防止水渗过浴室地面和墙壁。
- **屋顶与混凝土楼板防水** — 保护屋顶和楼板免受渗水。
- **墙面返潮与泛碱修复** — 处理潮湿墙壁和盐分沉积。

每个工程都从诊断以确定水从何处进入开始，然后在施工前提供固定报价。

## 我们修复的常见水患问题

- **浴室漏水** — 水渗到下层房间。
- **墙壁潮湿或污渍** — 返潮或渗水。
- **泛碱** — 混凝土或砖墙上出现白色盐晶体。
- **屋顶漏水** — 水通过损坏的屋顶表面渗入。
- **地下室或停车场漏水** — 水渗过混凝土。

## 为什么防水在马来西亚很重要

马来西亚的大雨和高湿度使防水至关重要。否则：

- 水会随时间损坏混凝土和砖石。
- 霉菌在潮湿区域滋生，影响健康。
- 湿气削弱材料，结构性裂缝加宽。
- 漏水被忽视得越久，维修成本越高。

## 防水工程包含什么

1. **诊断** — 我们确定水从何处、如何进入。
2. **固定报价** — 您会收到建议工作的清晰价格。
3. **准备** — 表面被清洁并做好施工准备。
4. **施工** — 应用合适的防水系统（注浆、卷材或涂层）。
5. **测试** — 检查修复效果，并保持区域清洁。

PU注浆每点位RM 300起，浴室与湿区防水RM 1,000起，墙面返潮修复RM 350起。最终价格取决于面积和方法。

### 什么是PU注浆？

这是一种通过压力将聚氨酯树脂注入混凝土裂缝或接缝以阻止活动性漏水的施工方法。树脂膨胀并从内部密封漏水。

### 你们能防水现有浴室而不撬开瓷砖吗？

在许多情况下，漏水可以通过注浆或表面防水来阻止，而无需撬开瓷砖。最佳方法取决于水从何处来。

### 你们也修复漏水源头吗？

是的。防水和漏水维修相辅相成——我们找到水从哪里进入，并应用正确的系统来阻止它。

## 获取吉隆坡与雪兰莪防水报价

无论水是从浴室、墙壁还是屋顶漏水，KL Servis Rumah 都能在吉隆坡和雪兰莪全境提供专业防水与漏水维修。WhatsApp联系我们获取免费评估——[与我们的团队联系](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E6%82%A8%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%81%E6%88%91%E6%83%B3%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E9%98%B2%E6%B0%B4%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Welding & Metal Fabrication Services in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Custom gates, window grilles, staircase stringers & on-site welding repair across KL & Selangor. Certified welders, anti-rust coatings. From RM 280.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team

en.metaDesc: Custom gates, window grilles, staircase stringers & on-site welding repair across KL & Selangor. Certified welders, anti-rust coatings. From RM 280.
en.content:
Whether reinforcing a rusted driveway gate, installing custom window security grilles, fabricating a modern metal staircase, or conducting emergency structural welding repairs, quality metalwork requires experienced welding technicians, precise measurements, and thorough anti-rust surface treatment. In Malaysia's high-humidity tropical environment, unprotected steel corrodes rapidly, leading to structural failures and cosmetic rust stains.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah delivers on-site welding repairs and workshop custom metal fabrication across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, **starting from RM 280** for on-site repairs, **RM 42 / sq ft** for [custom window grilles](/services/welding/custom-window-grille), and **RM 2,800** for [custom main gate fabrication](/services/welding/main-gate-fabrication). We work with mild steel, stainless steel (grade 304), and aluminium with anti-rust priming and powder coating finishes.

## Our Metal Fabrication & Welding Services

| Service | Materials Used | Typical Applications | Starting Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[On-Site Welding Repair](/services/welding/on-site-welding-repair)** | Mild steel, stainless steel, cast iron | Broken gate hinges, fence repairs, railing re-anchoring, cracked steel frames | From RM 280 |
| **[Custom Window Grilles](/services/welding/custom-window-grille)** | Wrought iron, mild steel, stainless steel | Security window grilles with emergency escape hatches, balcony grilles | From RM 42 / sq ft |
| **[Main Gate Fabrication](/services/welding/main-gate-fabrication)** | Galvanized mild steel, stainless 304, composite | Swing, sliding, and folding driveway gates ready for [autogate motors](/services/autogate) | From RM 2,800 |
| **Staircase Stringers & Railings** | Heavy C-channel, structural tubing | Interior loft stairs, outdoor spiral fire escapes, safety handrails | From RM 420 / lin ft |
| **Structural Steel Reinforcement** | I-beams, steel lintels, posts | Wall removal support beams, car porch roof extension beams | Based on site survey |

## On-Site vs Workshop Fabrication

1. **On-Site Mobile Welding:** Our technicians arrive equipped with portable inverter MIG and MMA arc welding machines, metal cut-off tools, and anti-rust coatings for rapid fixes to gates, railings, and security grilles.
2. **Workshop Fabrication:** Large projects like complete driveway gates, roof trusses, and staircase stringers are fabricated in a controlled workshop with laser cutting, precision jig alignment, and full-immersion hot-dip galvanising or high-bake powder coating before on-site installation.

## Anti-Corrosion Protection for Malaysian Weather

Raw steel exposed to rain and humidity in KL will rust within weeks. Every metal fabrication project we handle includes a 3-layer anti-corrosion protection standard:

- **Surface De-scaling & Grinding:** Mechanical wire-brushing and grinding of all weld spatter, scale, and surface oxidation.
- **Zinc Phosphate / Epoxy Primer:** Application of high-solid zinc chromate or 2-part epoxy anti-corrosion primer to chemically seal the steel.
- **Industrial Topcoat or Powder Coating:** Factory-cured architectural polyester powder coat (matte black, bronze, white, anthracite) or 2 coats of weather-resistant gloss enamel.

## Common Welding Issues We Solve

- **Rusted Gate Hinges & Sagging Doors:** Broken hinge pins repaired with heavy-duty ball-bearing barrel hinges. See our guide on [loose metal gate hinges](/problems/loose-metal-gate-hinges).
- **[Rusting Window Grilles](/problems/rusting-window-grille):** Grinding off surface rust, welding rusted bottom bars, and resealing with moisture barrier coatings.
- **Detached Balcony Railings:** Unsafe masonry anchors re-welded with base plate chemical anchors for condominium and terrace home safety.

## Pricing Guide for Welding Services

| Service Type | Scope & Specifications | Estimated Price |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile Welding Callout & Minor Repair | Hinge welding, bracket fixing, re-anchoring (up to 2 hours) | From RM 280 |
| Window Security Grille (Mild Steel) | Powder-coated geometric or horizontal bar design | From RM 42 / sq ft |
| Window Security Grille (Stainless 304) | Grade 304 polished or matte stainless steel | From RM 75 / sq ft |
| Custom Mild Steel Driveway Gate | 14ft swing/sliding gate, zinc primed + powder-coated | From RM 2,800 |
| Custom Stainless Steel Gate | Grade 304 frame with modern horizontal slats | From RM 4,800 |
| Staircase Stringer Fabrication | Heavy steel channel frame primed and painted | From RM 420 / lin ft |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can you weld broken gate hinges on the same day?
Yes, for emergency gate hinge repairs where the gate is detached or posing a safety hazard, we prioritize same-day mobile welding service across KL and Selangor.

### What is the difference between mild steel and stainless steel grilles?
Mild steel is cost-effective and highly customizable in color via powder coating, but requires proper anti-rust priming. Stainless steel (Grade 304) contains chromium and nickel, making it naturally impervious to rust without paint, though at a higher material cost.

### Do your custom window grilles include emergency fire escape hatches?
Yes, Malaysian fire safety guidelines recommend at least one hinged emergency escape hatch with a padlock bracket in each bedroom window grille. We include fire escape hatches in our window grille designs.

## Book Your Welding & Metalwork Service in KL & Selangor

From emergency hinge welding to full house window grille and gate fabrication, KL Servis Rumah provides reliable, high-precision metalwork across Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Cheras, and Klang.

Send us photos and dimensions of your welding requirement via WhatsApp — [chat with our welding team](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20welding%20or%20metal%20fabrication%20services.).

zh.content:
无论是有地住宅庭院大门铰链断裂抢修、全屋防盗窗花（铁花）定制、钢结构阁楼楼梯焊接，还是阳台铁栏杆加固，优质的铁工与金属加工都需要经验丰富的专业焊工、精准的现场量尺以及彻底的防锈表面处理。在马来西亚常年高温多雨的湿热气候下，若钢材未做防锈处理，极易快速生锈腐蚀，造成结构性安全隐患。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪提供专业的上门现场焊接维修与工厂定制金属加工服务。**现场应急焊接维修 RM 280起**，**[定制防盗窗花](/zh/services/welding/custom-window-grille) 每平方尺RM 42起**，**[定制庭院大门制作](/zh/services/welding/main-gate-fabrication) RM 2,800起**。我们熟练加工碳钢（Mild Steel）、304不锈钢及铝合金，并提供环氧防锈底漆与高温粉末喷涂（Powder Coating）工艺。

## 金属加工与焊接服务范围

| 服务类别 | 使用材质 | 常见应用场景 | 起步价格参考 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[现场紧急焊接维修](/zh/services/welding/on-site-welding-repair)** | 碳钢、不锈钢、铸铁 | 大门合页脱落、围栏断裂、铁门拖地加固、开裂钢梁抢修 | RM 280起 |
| **[定制防盗窗花 (铁花)](/zh/services/welding/custom-window-grille)** | 锻铁、碳钢方管、不锈钢 | 现代简约/经典防盗窗花，带消防逃生小门 | 每平方尺RM 42起 |
| **[庭院大门定制加工](/zh/services/welding/main-gate-fabrication)** | 热镀锌钢、304不锈钢、木塑复合板 | 平开门、推拉移门、折叠门，匹配[自动门马达安装](/zh/services/autogate) | RM 2,800起 |
| **钢结构楼梯与安全栏杆** | 重型槽钢、工字钢、钢管 | 跃层阁楼直梯、旋转消防梯、阳台防跌落扶手 | 每延尺RM 420起 |

## 严谨的防腐防锈工艺标准

裸露钢材在吉隆坡暴雨曝晒下会在数周内泛黄生锈。我们严格执行三道防腐工艺：

1. **焊缝打磨与表面除锈：** 彻底打磨焊渣与氧化皮，消除死角毛刺。
2. **富锌/环氧防锈封闭底漆：** 涂刷高固含防锈底漆，化学隔绝空气与水汽侵蚀。
3. **户外耐候粉末喷涂 (Powder Coating)：** 工厂高温固化烤漆，附着力强、耐紫外线抗划伤，提供哑光黑、白、深灰、古铜等多种现代色调。

## 常见铁工故障与维修

- **大门合页断裂与门扇下垂：** 拆除锈死旧铰链，换装重型轴承铰链并加固立柱焊点。参见[金属大门铰链松动维修](/zh/problems/loose-metal-gate-hinges)。
- **[窗花生锈腐蚀](/zh/problems/rusting-window-grille)：** 铲除表层锈斑，补焊蚀空钢管，重新喷涂防锈耐候漆。
- **阳台护栏松动摇晃：** 重新加固护栏底板，植入化学膨胀螺栓并满焊锁定。

## 常见问题解答 (FAQ)

### 大门合页断了可以当天上门抢修吗？
可以。针对大门合页脱落导致大门无法关上或存在倒塌危险的紧急情况，我们提供雪隆区同日紧急移动上门电焊抢修服务。

### 窗花是否配有消防逃生小门？
是的。根据消防安全建议，卧房防盗窗花应至少设置一处带挂锁耳的活动逃生小门，以便在紧急情况下安全撤离。我们在制作窗花时均可免费定制逃生门。

en.title: Window Handle and Hinge Repair in Kuala Lumpur & Selangor
en.excerpt: A stiff handle is often a symptom, not the only fault. Misaligned locking points, corroded friction stays, a dropped sash or dirt can overload the handle. The complete operating path should be checked before replacing parts.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Window Handle & Hinge Repair in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Practical guide to window handle and hinge repair: suitability, site checks, work steps, common mistakes and quotation factors for KL and Selangor properties.
en.content:
**Direct answer:** A stiff handle is often a symptom, not the only fault. Misaligned locking points, corroded friction stays, a dropped sash or dirt can overload the handle. The complete operating path should be checked before replacing parts.

This guide explains the [Window Handle and Hinge Repair](/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair) scope under [window repair services](/services/window-repair). The published starting price is **RM 120**. A site-specific quotation should confirm measurements, preparation, materials, access and related repairs rather than treating the starting rate as a fixed total.

## When This Service Is the Right Choice

The service is appropriate when inspection confirms that the existing property and surrounding construction can support the proposed work. Visible symptoms alone do not prove the cause. In Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, occupied areas, parking or loading access, condominium management rules and permitted working hours may affect planning and scheduling.

## What Should Be Checked Before Work

- **Window type, opening direction and hardware system.**
- **Handle spindle, gearbox and locking points.**
- **Hinge or stay corrosion and sash alignment.**
- **Seal compression, drainage and frame condition.**

## Compare the Available Approaches

| Approach | When it makes sense |
|---|---|
| **Adjust and lubricate** | hardware is sound but misaligned or dry. |
| **Replace hardware** | handle, stay, hinge or gearbox is worn. |
| **Replace window section** | frame or sash is badly distorted or corroded. |

Choosing the least expensive option without checking its limits can cause repeat work. The quotation should explain why the selected approach suits the substrate, dimensions and intended use.

## Typical Work Process

1. **Identify system and inspect all moving parts**.
2. **Support the sash and test alignment without forcing the handle**.
3. **Source compatible dimensions and fixing centres**.
4. **Replace or adjust hardware and clean contact surfaces**.
5. **Test locking, opening restriction, seals and safe closure**.

Preparation and sequencing matter. Existing defects, unstable supports, incompatible materials or damaged substrates should be corrected before they are concealed. Protect occupied rooms, common corridors and completed finishes throughout the work. At handover, test operation and inspect edges, fixings, joints and access points—not appearance alone.

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Forcing a handle until the gearbox breaks.
- Replacing only the handle while lock points remain misaligned.
- Removing a stay without supporting the sash.
- Using the wrong screw or drilling into glass edges.

A competent inspection should distinguish a serviceable component from a system that has reached the point of replacement. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written down, especially where concealed conditions cannot be confirmed until work opens the area.

## Cost and Quotation Factors

- **Published starting price: RM 120**
- Window type and number of affected units.
- Hardware model and availability.
- Adjustment only versus component replacement.
- Height, access and frame repairs.

The parent service publishes a **12-Month Hardware & Seal Warranty**, subject to its stated scope and terms. Confirm in writing whether it applies to this exact work, materials supplied by the customer and pre-existing defects.

## Safety, Access and Maintenance

Do not bypass manufacturer instructions, building management requirements or safe access arrangements to save time. Keep product references and care instructions after handover. Routine cleaning and early attention to movement, moisture, corrosion or loose hardware usually make local repairs simpler.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why does the handle close only when the window is open?
The sash or locking points are likely misaligned under frame compression. Do not force it; alignment and hinges need checking.

### Can corroded hinges be repaired?
Light corrosion may be cleaned and adjusted; pitted, weak or seized parts should be replaced with compatible hardware.

### Does new hardware stop rain leaks?
Only when leakage is caused by poor sash compression. Failed seals, drainage or wall joints require separate repair.

## Request a Site-Specific Quotation

Send wide-angle and close-up photos, approximate measurements, property type and the symptom or outcome required. KL Servis Rumah can assess the scope for properties in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor without assuming that every site needs the same solution.

ms.title: Pembaikan Pemegang dan Engsel Tingkap di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor
ms.excerpt: Pemegang keras selalunya simptom, bukan satu-satunya kerosakan. Titik kunci tidak sejajar, friction stay berkarat, sash jatuh atau kotoran membebankan pemegang. Seluruh mekanisme perlu diperiksa sebelum ganti alat.

ms.metaDesc: Panduan pembaikan pemegang dan engsel tingkap: kesesuaian, semakan tapak, langkah kerja, kesilapan lazim dan faktor sebut harga untuk hartanah KL dan Selangor.
ms.content:
**Jawapan ringkas:** Pemegang keras selalunya simptom, bukan satu-satunya kerosakan. Titik kunci tidak sejajar, friction stay berkarat, sash jatuh atau kotoran membebankan pemegang. Seluruh mekanisme perlu diperiksa sebelum ganti alat.

Panduan ini menerangkan skop [Pembaikan Pemegang dan Engsel Tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair) di bawah [perkhidmatan pembaikan tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair). Harga permulaan yang diterbitkan ialah **RM 120**. Sebut harga khusus tapak perlu mengesahkan ukuran, persediaan, bahan, akses dan pembaikan berkaitan; harga mula bukan jumlah tetap untuk semua rumah.

## Bilakah Servis Ini Sesuai

Servis ini sesuai apabila pemeriksaan mengesahkan hartanah dan binaan sekeliling boleh menerima kerja yang dicadangkan. Simptom yang nampak tidak semestinya membuktikan punca. Ruang yang didiami, akses parkir atau memunggah, peraturan pengurusan kondominium dan waktu kerja di KL dan Selangor boleh mempengaruhi perancangan.

## Semakan Sebelum Kerja

- **Jenis tingkap, arah bukaan dan sistem perkakasan.**
- **Spindle pemegang, gearbox dan titik kunci.**
- **Karat engsel atau stay dan penjajaran sash.**
- **Tekanan seal, saliran dan keadaan bingkai.**

## Bandingkan Pendekatan

| Pendekatan | Bila sesuai |
|---|---|
| **Laras dan pelincir** | perkakasan kukuh tetapi tidak sejajar atau kering. |
| **Ganti perkakasan** | pemegang, stay, engsel atau gearbox haus. |
| **Ganti bahagian tingkap** | bingkai atau sash herot atau berkarat teruk. |

Pilihan termurah tidak semestinya menjimatkan jika hadnya tidak diperiksa. Sebut harga patut menerangkan sebab kaedah dipilih mengikut substrat, dimensi dan kegunaan.

## Proses Kerja Lazim

1. **Kenal pasti sistem dan periksa semua bahagian bergerak**.
2. **Sokong sash dan uji penjajaran tanpa paksa pemegang**.
3. **Dapatkan dimensi dan pusat pengikat serasi**.
4. **Ganti atau laras perkakasan dan bersih permukaan**.
5. **Uji kunci, had bukaan, seal dan penutupan selamat**.

Urutan dan persediaan penting. Kecacatan sedia ada, sokongan lemah, bahan tidak serasi atau substrat rosak perlu dibaiki sebelum ditutup. Lindungi ruang didiami, koridor bersama dan kemasan siap. Semasa serahan, uji fungsi serta periksa tepi, pengikat, sambungan dan titik akses—bukan rupa sahaja.

## Kesilapan Lazim

- Memaksa pemegang hingga gearbox pecah.
- Ganti pemegang sahaja tetapi titik kunci masih salah.
- Buka stay tanpa menyokong sash.
- Guna skru salah atau drilling dekat tepi kaca.

Pemeriksaan yang baik membezakan komponen yang masih boleh dibaiki daripada sistem yang patut diganti. Minta andaian dan pengecualian ditulis, khususnya untuk keadaan tersembunyi yang hanya diketahui selepas kawasan dibuka.

## Faktor Kos dan Sebut Harga

- **Harga permulaan diterbitkan: RM 120**
- Jenis dan bilangan tingkap.
- Model perkakasan dan ketersediaan.
- Pelarasan sahaja atau penggantian komponen.
- Ketinggian, akses dan pembaikan bingkai.

Perkhidmatan induk menerbitkan **Jaminan Perkakasan & Pengedap 12 Bulan**, tertakluk pada skop dan terma. Sahkan secara bertulis sama ada ia meliputi kerja ini, bahan pelanggan dan kecacatan sedia ada.

## Keselamatan, Akses dan Penjagaan

Jangan abaikan arahan pengeluar, syarat pengurusan bangunan atau akses selamat untuk menjimatkan masa. Simpan rujukan produk dan arahan penjagaan. Pembersihan berkala serta tindakan awal terhadap lembapan, pergerakan, karat atau hardware longgar memudahkan pembaikan setempat.

## Soalan Lazim

### Mengapa pemegang hanya tutup ketika tingkap terbuka?
Sash atau titik kunci mungkin tidak sejajar apabila ditekan ke bingkai. Jangan paksa; periksa alignment dan engsel.

### Boleh baiki engsel berkarat?
Karat ringan boleh dibersih dan dilaras; bahagian lemah atau tersekat perlu diganti.

### Adakah perkakasan baharu hentikan bocor hujan?
Hanya jika puncanya tekanan sash lemah. Seal, saliran atau sambungan dinding rosak perlu pembaikan lain.

## Minta Sebut Harga Khusus Tapak

Hantar foto sudut luas dan dekat, ukuran anggaran, jenis hartanah serta simptom atau hasil yang diperlukan. KL Servis Rumah boleh menilai skop di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor tanpa menganggap semua tapak memerlukan penyelesaian sama.

[WhatsApp KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hai%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%2C%20saya%20perlukan%20sebut%20harga%20untuk%20Pembaikan%20Pemegang%20dan%20Engsel%20Tingkap.).

zh.title: 窗户执手与铰链维修：吉隆坡与雪兰莪指南
zh.excerpt: 执手卡涩常只是症状。锁点错位、摩擦撑腐蚀、窗扇下垂或污垢都会使执手过载；更换零件前应检查整套开闭路径。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户执手与铰链维修
zh.metaDesc: 了解窗户执手与铰链维修的适用条件、现场检查、施工步骤、常见错误与报价因素，适合吉隆坡及雪兰莪住宅和商业物业。
zh.content:
**直接答案：**执手卡涩常只是症状。锁点错位、摩擦撑腐蚀、窗扇下垂或污垢都会使执手过载；更换零件前应检查整套开闭路径。

本文说明[窗户执手与铰链维修](/zh/services/window-repair/window-handle-and-hinge-repair)子服务，属于[窗户维修服务](/zh/services/window-repair)。已公布起价为 **RM 120**。现场报价应明确尺寸、基层处理、材料、施工通道和相关维修；起价不是每个物业的固定总价。

## 何时适合采用这项服务

只有检查确认物业及周边构造能够承受拟议工程时，这项服务才适合；肉眼看到的症状不一定就是根因。吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的入住情况、停车与卸货通道、公寓管理规定及施工时段，都可能影响规划和排期。

## 动工前要检查什么

- **窗型、开启方向及五金系统。**
- **执手方轴、传动器及锁点。**
- **铰链/撑挡腐蚀及窗扇对齐。**
- **密封压紧、排水及窗框状况。**

## 方案比较

| 方案 | 适用情况 |
|---|---|
| **调校润滑** | 五金完好但错位或干涩。 |
| **更换五金** | 执手、撑挡、铰链或传动器磨损。 |
| **更换窗体** | 框扇严重变形或腐蚀。 |

若不先了解限制，最便宜的方案可能造成重复施工。报价应说明选定方法为何适合现场基层、尺寸和实际用途。

## 常见施工流程

1. **识别系统并检查所有活动件**。
2. **托住窗扇测试对齐，不强扭执手**。
3. **匹配尺寸及安装孔距**。
4. **更换或调校五金并清洁接触面**。
5. **测试锁闭、限位、密封及安全关闭**。

基层准备和工序先后很重要。原有缺陷、薄弱支撑、不兼容材料或损坏基层，应在封闭前处理。施工期间保护已入住空间、公共走廊及已完成饰面。验收不能只看外观，还要测试功能，并检查边缘、固定件、接缝和检修点。

## 应避免的常见错误

- 强扭执手导致传动器断裂。
- 只换执手而锁点仍错位。
- 未托住窗扇便拆撑挡。
- 使用错误螺丝或靠近玻璃边缘钻孔。

合适的检查应区分“仍可维修的部件”与“已应更换的系统”。对于只有拆开后才能确认的隐藏状况，应要求把报价假设和不包含项目写清楚。

## 费用与报价因素

- **已公布起价：RM 120**
- 窗型及数量。
- 五金型号及供应情况。
- 仅调校或更换部件。
- 高度、通道及窗框维修。

其主服务公布 **12 个月五金与密封保修**，具体按适用范围和条款执行。请书面确认是否涵盖本次工程、客户自购材料及原有缺陷。

## 安全、进场与保养

不要为了省时而绕过厂家说明、管理处规定或安全通道安排。完工后保留产品资料和护理说明。定期清洁，并及早处理潮气、位移、锈蚀或五金松动，通常能让局部维修更简单。

## 常见问题

### 为什么开窗时执手能转，关窗却不能？
窗扇压入框时可能与锁点错位。不要强扭，应检查对齐和铰链。

### 生锈铰链能修吗？
轻微锈蚀可清洁调校；已点蚀、变弱或卡死的部件应换兼容五金。

### 新五金能解决雨漏吗？
仅当漏雨来自窗扇压紧不足时有效；密封条、排水或墙框接缝问题需另修。

## 获取针对现场的报价

发送广角与近照、估算尺寸、物业类型，以及遇到的症状或希望达到的效果。KL Servis Rumah 可评估吉隆坡与雪兰莪物业的实际范围，不会假定每个现场都需要同一方案。

[WhatsApp 联系 KL Servis Rumah](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=%E4%BD%A0%E5%A5%BD%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah%EF%BC%8C%E6%88%91%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%AA%97%E6%88%B7%E6%89%A7%E6%89%8B%E4%B8%8E%E9%93%B0%E9%93%BE%E7%BB%B4%E4%BF%AE%E7%9A%84%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E3%80%82)。

en.title: Window Repair & Glass Replacement in KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Casement, sliding, top-hung and awning window repair across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor — glass, seals, handles, hinges and rollers. From RM 200.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Window Repair & Glass Replacement in KL & Selangor
en.metaDesc: Window glass, seal, handle and roller repair in KL & Selangor. Casement and sliding windows from RM 200. Same-day boarding for broken glass.
en.content:
Most window problems in the Klang Valley are not “the whole window is finished”. Glass cracks, EPDM seals harden in the sun, sliding rollers flatten, and casement handles seize. Replacing the glass or the seal is usually enough if the aluminium or timber frame is still sound.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah repairs casement, sliding, top-hung and awning windows across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. Glass replacement starts from **RM 200**, seal replacement from **RM 30 / linier ft**, handle and hinge repair from **RM 120**, and sliding-window roller replacement from **RM 150**. Hardware and seals carry a **12-month warranty**.

If the frame is rotten, corroded through, or you want a new aluminium unit, that becomes a fabrication job under [glass and aluminium](/services/glass-aluminium).

## Window services we provide

- **[Glass replacement](/services/window-repair/glass-replacement)** — remove cracked or broken glass and fit new clear, tinted, frosted or tempered glass to the same size. From RM 200.
- **[Window seal replacement](/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement)** — new EPDM rubber to stop rain ingress and draughts. From RM 30 / linier ft.
- **Window handle and hinge repair** — stiff, broken or corroded handles, stays and locks. From RM 120.
- **Sliding window roller replacement** — new nylon or steel rollers and a cleaned track. From RM 150.

Stuck sliders are often rollers and dirt, not a new window. See [sliding window stuck](/problems/sliding-window-stuck). A jammed lock is covered in [stuck window lock](/problems/stuck-window-lock).

## Glass, seal, hardware — which is failing?

| Symptom | Likely cause | Typical first fix |
|---|---|---|
| Cracked or shattered pane | Impact, stress, or tempered glass nick | Glass replacement |
| Rain water on the inner sill | Failed seal, clogged weep holes, or warped sash | Seal replacement + clear weeps |
| Fog between double-glazed panes | Failed insulated-unit seal | New glass unit, not a wipe |
| Hard to slide | Flat rollers or dirty track | Rollers + clean |
| Handle spins or will not lock | Worn gearbox or misaligned keep | Handle / lock repair |

Do not silicone the whole sash shut to “stop the leak”. That traps water in the frame and hides a seal you could have replaced.

## Window types we work on

- **Casement** — side-hung, common on landed houses.
- **Sliding** — two or more sashes in a track; very common in condos.
- **Top-hung / awning** — hinged at the top; used for rain ventilation.
- **Louvre** — slats and clips; glass slats can be replaced individually.

We repair the window you have. A full redesign (new profile, new mosquito mesh, new colour) is quoted as aluminium fabrication.

## Safety: broken glass in a home

Broken window glass is both a weather and a safety problem — especially on upper floors and near children.

- For landed houses we can often replace **common 4 mm / 5 mm clear or tinted** sizes on the same visit.
- Custom sizes, **tempered** glass and double-glazed units are measured, boarded if needed, and fitted in about **2–5 working days**.
- Wet-area and door-adjacent glass should be tempered or laminated safety glass, not ordinary annealed glass.

Do not leave a taped star-crack on a high window through a storm weekend.

## How a window repair visit works

1. **Inspect** — frame condition, glass type, seal hardness, rollers, locks, weep holes.
2. **Quote** — written scope: glass only, seals, hardware, or a mix.
3. **Safe removal** — glass is taped, lifted, and carried out; not smashed in the room.
4. **Install** — new glass on setting blocks, new seals seated, hardware tested.
5. **Water check** — weeps open; casement closes on the new seal without forcing the handle.

## How much does window repair cost?

| Service | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Glass replacement | From RM 200 |
| Window seal replacement | From RM 30 / linier ft |
| Handle & hinge repair | From RM 120 |
| Sliding roller replacement | From RM 150 |

Tempered glass, tinted or frosted upgrades, high-access (external upper floors) and after-hours boarding are quoted on site. We do not invent a “per condo” package price.

## What we check before quoting a full window change

- Is the frame still rigid and square?
- Is the leak the glass gasket or the wall-to-frame silicone?
- For wall damp around a window, the issue may be [waterproofing](/services/waterproofing), not the pane.
- Can the sash be adjusted, or is the track bent from a previous forced close?

## Common mistakes

- Replacing glass but leaving the old hardened gasket.
- Painting shut a timber casement, then breaking the stay.
- Oiling a sliding track that is full of sand — it becomes grinding paste.
- Using annealed glass where tempered is required.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can you replace just the glass?

Yes, when the frame is sound. That is the usual and cheaper path.

### Do you offer same-day glass replacement?

For landed houses with common thicknesses and sizes, often yes. Custom and tempered glass is boarded first, then fitted when the pane is ready.

### My sliding window is heavy and stuck. New window?

Usually no. Rollers and a clean track restore most sliders. See [sliding window stuck](/problems/sliding-window-stuck).

### Can you upgrade to tinted or frosted glass?

Yes, in the same opening, subject to thickness and frame depth.

## Get a window inspected

If your window leaks, sticks, or the glass is cracked, KL Servis Rumah can repair it across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp a photo of the sash and the problem — [request a window repair quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20would%20like%20a%20quote%20for%20window%20repair.).

ms.title: Pembaikan Tingkap & Penggantian Kaca di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Pembaikan tingkap casement, gelangsar, top-hung dan awning di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor — kaca, pengedap, pemegang, engsel dan roller. Dari RM 200.
ms.metaTitle: Pembaikan Tingkap & Penggantian Kaca di KL
ms.metaDesc: Pembaikan kaca, pengedap, pemegang dan roller tingkap casement atau gelangsar di KL & Selangor. Pemeriksaan mengenal pasti komponen yang perlu dibaiki. Dari RM 200.
ms.content:
Kebanyakan masalah tingkap di Lembah Klang bukan “seluruh tingkap sudah tamat”. Kaca retak, pengedap EPDM mengeras dalam matahari, roller gelangsar kempes, dan pemegang casement macet. Mengganti kaca atau pengedap biasanya cukup jika rangka aluminium atau kayu masih kukuh.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah membaiki tingkap casement, gelangsar, top-hung dan awning di seluruh Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor. Penggantian kaca bermula **RM 200**, penggantian pengedap dari **RM 30 / kaki linier**, pembaikan pemegang dan engsel dari **RM 120**, dan penggantian roller tingkap gelangsar dari **RM 150**. Perkakasan dan pengedap dilindungi **jaminan 12 bulan**.

Jika rangka reput, berkarat tembus, atau anda mahu unit aluminium baharu, itu kerja fabrikasi di bawah [kaca dan aluminium](/ms/services/glass-aluminium).

## Perkhidmatan tingkap yang kami sediakan

- **[Penggantian kaca](/ms/services/window-repair/glass-replacement)** — tanggal kaca retak atau pecah dan pasang kaca jernih, tinted, frosted atau tempered saiz sama. Dari RM 200.
- **[Penggantian pengedap tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement)** — getah EPDM baharu untuk hentikan kemasukan hujan. Dari RM 30 / kaki linier.
- **Pembaikan pemegang dan engsel tingkap** — pemegang, stay dan kunci yang kaku, pecah atau berkarat. Dari RM 120.
- **Penggantian roller tingkap gelangsar** — roller nilon atau keluli baharu dan trek dibersihkan. Dari RM 150.

Gelangsar tersekat kerap roller dan kotoran, bukan tingkap baharu. Lihat [tingkap gelangsar tersekat](/ms/problems/sliding-window-stuck) dan [kunci tingkap tersekat](/ms/problems/stuck-window-lock).

## Kaca, pengedap, perkakasan — yang mana rosak?

| Simptom | Punca berkemungkinan | Baiki dahulu |
|---|---|---|
| Panel retak atau pecah | Hentaman atau nicks kaca tempered | Penggantian kaca |
| Air hujan pada ambang dalam | Pengedap gagal, lubang weep tersumbat | Pengedap + bersihkan weep |
| Kabus antara panel dwikaca | Pengedap unit gagal | Unit kaca baharu |
| Sukar digelangsarkan | Roller kempes atau trek kotor | Roller + cuci |
| Pemegang berputar atau tidak kunci | Gearbox haus atau keep tidak sejajar | Pembaikan pemegang / kunci |

Jangan silikon seluruh sash “untuk hentikan bocor”. Itu memerangkap air dalam rangka.

## Jenis tingkap yang kami kerja

- **Casement** — gantung sisi, biasa pada rumah landed.
- **Gelangsar** — dua atau lebih sash dalam trek; sangat biasa di kondominium.
- **Top-hung / awning** — engsel di atas; untuk pengudaraan semasa hujan.
- **Louvre** — slat kaca boleh diganti satu-satu.

## Keselamatan: kaca pecah di rumah

- Untuk rumah landed kami kerap boleh ganti saiz **4 mm / 5 mm jernih atau tinted** biasa pada lawatan sama.
- Saiz kustom, kaca **tempered** dan unit dwikaca diukur, dipapan jika perlu, dan dipasang dalam kira-kira **2–5 hari bekerja**.
- Kaca dekat kawasan basah dan pintu patut tempered atau laminated, bukan kaca annealed biasa.

## Cara lawatan pembaikan tingkap

1. Periksa keadaan rangka, jenis kaca, kekerasan pengedap, roller, kunci, lubang weep.
2. Sebut harga — kaca sahaja, pengedap, perkakasan, atau campuran.
3. Tanggal selamat — kaca ditampal, diangkat, dibawa keluar.
4. Pasang — kaca baharu pada setting block, pengedap baharu, perkakasan diuji.
5. Semak air — weep terbuka; casement menutup pada pengedap baharu tanpa memaksa pemegang.

## Kos

| Perkhidmatan | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Penggantian kaca | Dari RM 200 |
| Penggantian pengedap tingkap | Dari RM 30 / kaki linier |
| Pembaikan pemegang & engsel | Dari RM 120 |
| Penggantian roller gelangsar | Dari RM 150 |

Kaca tempered, naik taraf tinted atau frosted, akses tinggi dan papan kecemasan disebut harga di tapak.

Lembapan dinding di sekeliling tingkap kadang-kadang isu [kalis air](/ms/services/waterproofing), bukan panel kaca.

## Soalan lazim

### Boleh ganti kaca sahaja?

Boleh, jika rangka kukuh. Itu laluan biasa dan lebih murah.

### Ada penggantian kaca hari sama?

Untuk rumah landed dengan ketebalan dan saiz biasa, kerap ada. Kaca kustom dan tempered dipapan dahulu.

### Tingkap gelangsar saya berat dan tersekat. Perlu tingkap baharu?

Biasanya tidak. Roller dan trek bersih memulihkan kebanyakan gelangsar.

## Dapatkan tingkap diperiksa

WhatsApp foto sash dan masalah — [minta sebut harga pembaikan tingkap](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20mahu%20sebut%20harga%20pembaikan%20tingkap.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户维修与玻璃更换
zh.excerpt: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪平开、推拉、上悬与外开下悬窗维修——玻璃、密封条、执手、铰链与滑轮。从 RM 200 起。
zh.metaTitle: 窗户维修还是更换玻璃？吉隆坡判断指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户维修及玻璃更换服务，处理破裂玻璃、密封条、执手、铰链和滑轮问题，适用于平开窗与推拉窗。服务从 RM 200 起。
zh.content:
巴生谷多数窗户问题不是“整窗报废”。玻璃裂了、EPDM 密封条被晒硬、推拉滑轮磨扁、平开执手卡死。铝框或木框还好时，换玻璃或换胶条通常就够。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 在吉隆坡与雪兰莪维修平开、推拉、上悬与外开下悬窗。玻璃更换从 **RM 200** 起，密封条更换从 **RM 30 / 延英尺** 起，执手铰链维修从 **RM 120** 起，推拉窗滑轮更换从 **RM 150** 起。五金与密封条享有 **12 个月保修**。

门框腐烂、锈穿，或要整樘新铝合金，属于 [玻璃与铝业](/zh/services/glass-aluminium)。

## 我们提供的窗户服务

- **[玻璃更换](/zh/services/window-repair/glass-replacement)** — 拆除破裂玻璃，按原尺寸安装白玻、茶玻、磨砂或钢化玻璃。从 RM 200 起。
- **[窗户密封条更换](/zh/services/window-repair/window-seal-replacement)** — 新 EPDM 胶条，阻止雨水进入。从 RM 30 / 延英尺起。
- **窗户执手与铰链维修** — 卡滞、断裂或锈蚀的执手、风撑与锁点。从 RM 120 起。
- **推拉窗滑轮更换** — 新尼龙或钢滑轮并清洁轨道。从 RM 150 起。

推拉卡死常常是滑轮和脏污，不是整窗报废。见 [推拉窗卡住](/zh/problems/sliding-window-stuck) 与 [窗户锁卡住](/zh/problems/stuck-window-lock)。

## 玻璃、密封条、五金——坏的是哪一样？

| 现象 | 可能原因 | 先修什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 玻璃裂或碎 | 撞击或钢化玻璃崩边 | 换玻璃 |
| 内窗台有雨水 | 密封失效、排水孔堵塞 | 换胶条 + 通排水孔 |
| 中空玻璃夹层起雾 | 中空单元密封失效 | 换整块中空玻璃 |
| 很难推 | 滑轮磨平或轨道脏 | 换滑轮 + 清洁 |
| 执手空转或锁不上 | 齿轮磨损或锁点不对 | 修执手 / 锁 |

不要把整扇窗打满玻璃胶“防漏”。那会把水关在框里。

## 我们修哪些窗型

- **平开** — 侧挂，有地住宅常见。
- **推拉** — 轨道里两扇或多扇；公寓极常见。
- **上悬 / 外开下悬** — 上铰，下雨也能通风。
- **百叶** — 玻璃叶片可单片更换。

## 家里玻璃碎了怎么办

- 有地住宅常见 **4 mm / 5 mm 白玻或茶玻** 尺寸，常常当次能换。
- 定制尺寸、**钢化**和中空单元先测量，必要时封板，约 **2–5 个工作日** 再装。
- 湿区和门联玻璃应用钢化或夹层安全玻璃，不要普通退火玻璃。

## 上门维修怎么做

1. 检查框况、玻璃类型、胶条硬度、滑轮、锁、排水孔。
2. 报价 — 只换玻璃、换胶条、五金，或组合。
3. 安全拆除 — 玻璃贴膜后抬出，不在房间里砸碎。
4. 安装 — 新玻璃坐垫块、新胶条、试五金。
5. 淋水检查 — 排水孔畅通；平开窗靠新胶条能关上，不必硬扳执手。

## 费用

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 玻璃更换 | 从 RM 200 起 |
| 窗户密封条更换 | 从 RM 30 / 延英尺起 |
| 执手与铰链维修 | 从 RM 120 起 |
| 推拉滑轮更换 | 从 RM 150 起 |

钢化、茶玻或磨砂升级、高空作业和紧急封板按现场报价。窗边墙面潮湿有时是 [防水](/zh/services/waterproofing) 问题，不是玻璃。

## 常见问题

### 可以只换玻璃吗？

可以，框还好时。这是通常也更便宜的做法。

### 有当日换玻璃吗？

有地住宅、常见厚度尺寸常常可以。定制和钢化先封板。

### 推拉窗又重又卡，要换整窗吗？

通常不用。滑轮加干净轨道能恢复大多数推拉窗。

## 预约窗户检查

WhatsApp 窗扇照片和问题 — [索取窗户维修报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我想咨询窗户维修报价。).

en.title: Window Seal Replacement Cost & Process Guide (2026) — KL & Selangor
en.excerpt: Replace hardened or leaking EPDM window seals in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor to stop rain ingress and draughts. From RM 30 / linier ft.
en.author: KL Servis Rumah Editorial Team
en.metaTitle: Window Seal Replacement Cost & Process Guide | KL
en.metaDesc: Replace worn EPDM window seals in KL & Selangor to help stop rain leaks and draughts around casement or sliding windows. From RM 30 per linear ft.
en.content:
Window seals are the rubber (usually EPDM) gaskets that sit between glass and frame, and between sash and frame. In Malaysian sun they harden, shrink and crack. Once they do, rain rides the aluminium onto the inner sill even though the glass is intact.

**Direct answer:** KL Servis Rumah replaces worn or hardened window seals from **RM 30 / linier ft**, which stops most “my window leaks when it rains” complaints that are not actually cracked glass.

If the pane itself is broken, start with [glass replacement](/services/window-repair/glass-replacement). If the sash will not move, see [sliding window stuck](/problems/sliding-window-stuck) and the main [window repair](/services/window-repair) page.

## What a failed seal looks like

- Rubber that is flat, shiny-hard, or cracked when you press it.
- Gaps you can see at the corners of the sash.
- Water on the inner sill during driving rain, with no crack in the glass.
- A whistle or draught when the window is locked.
- Fog between double-glazed panes — that is a **unit** seal failure; the whole insulated glass unit is replaced, not just the outer gasket.

Black mould on the inner silicone line can also mean the **wall-to-frame** joint has failed. That is building sealant, not the sash gasket. We will say which one it is.

## Why seals fail quickly in the Klang Valley

West-facing aluminium windows cook in the afternoon. Cheap PVC gaskets go brittle. Dust and monsoon overflow sit in the track and keep the rubber wet. A sash that is slammed because the [lock is stiff](/problems/stuck-window-lock) also cuts the seal.

Replacing the rubber without clearing the **weep holes** (the small drain slots in the outer track) is a half job. Blocked weeps make a new seal look like it failed.

## What we replace

- Glass-to-frame gaskets (glazing seals).
- Sash-to-frame compression seals on casement and top-hung windows.
- Sliding-window pile or rubber weatherstrips.
- Corner joints that have opened.

We use EPDM or the profile that matches the existing channel. A “universal” fat silicone bead is not a seal replacement.

## How the work is done

1. Inspect glass, gasket channel, weeps and wall-to-frame silicone.
2. Quote by measured linear footage and profile type.
3. Pull the old gasket; clean the channel.
4. Seat the new seal without stretching it around corners (stretched EPDM shrinks back and opens a gap).
5. Clear weeps; close the sash and check compression.
6. If needed, adjust stays or rollers so the sash actually meets the seal.

## Cost

| Service | Starting price |
|---|---|
| Window seal replacement | From RM 30 / linier ft |
| Glass replacement | From RM 200 |
| Sliding roller replacement | From RM 150 |

A typical condo sliding panel is a few metres of seal, not a whole-house number. We measure. High-access external work is extra.

## When a new seal will not be enough

- Bent or corroded frame.
- Sash so out of square that it never compresses the rubber.
- Leak that is actually the wall, ceiling or [roof](/services/roof-repair) above the window.
- Double-glazed fog — needs a new glass unit.

## Common mistakes

- Running silicone over a dead gasket “to seal it”.
- Stretching new rubber to make a short roll reach.
- Ignoring blocked weeps.
- Replacing seals but leaving flat sliding rollers, so the sash still does not sit down.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I know it is the seal and not the glass?

If the pane is intact and water appears on the sill or at the corners in rain, start with seals and weeps. Cracks and holes are glass.

### Will a new seal make the room quieter?

A little, if the old gap was large. It is not the same as acoustic laminated glass.

### Can you do one leaking window only?

Yes. Many jobs are a single west-facing panel.

### How long does it take?

A single window is often done in one visit. A whole elevation of a landed house takes longer.

## Book seal replacement

If rain is coming in around an otherwise intact window, KL Servis Rumah can replace the seals on homes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. WhatsApp a close-up of the rubber and the wet sill — [request a window seal quote](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20I%20need%20window%20seal%20replacement.).

ms.title: Panduan Kos & Proses: Penggantian Pengedap Tingkap di KL & Selangor
ms.excerpt: Ganti pengedap tingkap EPDM yang keras atau bocor di Kuala Lumpur dan Selangor untuk hentikan kemasukan hujan dan draf. Dari RM 30 / kaki linier.
ms.metaTitle: Panduan Kos: Penggantian Pengedap Tingkap di KL & Selangor
ms.metaDesc: Ganti getah pengedap EPDM tingkap di KL & Selangor untuk membantu mengurangkan kebocoran hujan dan angin pada tingkap gelangsar atau casement. Dari RM 30/kaki linear.
ms.content:
Pengedap tingkap ialah getah (biasanya EPDM) yang duduk antara kaca dan rangka, serta antara sash dan rangka. Dalam matahari Malaysia ia mengeras, mengecut dan retak. Setelah itu, hujan menunggang aluminium ke ambang dalam walaupun kaca utuh.

**Jawapan terus:** KL Servis Rumah mengganti pengedap tingkap yang haus atau keras dari **RM 30 / kaki linier**, yang menghentikan kebanyakan aduan “tingkap saya bocor bila hujan” yang sebenarnya bukan kaca retak.

Jika panel pecah, mula dengan [penggantian kaca](/ms/services/window-repair/glass-replacement). Jika sash tidak bergerak, lihat [tingkap gelangsar tersekat](/ms/problems/sliding-window-stuck) dan [pembaikan tingkap](/ms/services/window-repair).

## Apa rupa pengedap yang gagal

- Getah rata, keras berkilat, atau retak apabila ditekan.
- Jurang nampak di sudut sash.
- Air pada ambang dalam semasa hujan pancang, tanpa retak pada kaca.
- Siulan atau draf apabila tingkap dikunci.
- Kabus antara panel dwikaca — itu kegagalan pengedap **unit**; seluruh unit kaca berpenebat diganti, bukan sekadar gasket luar.

Kulat hitam pada garisan silikon dalam juga boleh bermakna sendi **dinding-ke-rangka** gagal. Itu sealant bangunan, bukan gasket sash.

## Kenapa pengedap cepat gagal di Lembah Klang

Tingkap aluminium menghadap barat masak pada petang. Gasket PVC murah menjadi rapuh. Debu dan limpahan monsun duduk dalam trek. Sash yang dibanting kerana [kunci kaku](/ms/problems/stuck-window-lock) juga memotong pengedap.

Mengganti getah tanpa membersihkan **lubang weep** (slot saliran kecil pada trek luar) ialah kerja separuh. Weep tersumbat membuat pengedap baharu nampak gagal.

## Apa yang kami ganti

- Gasket kaca-ke-rangka (pengedap glazing).
- Pengedap mampatan sash-ke-rangka pada casement dan top-hung.
- Weatherstrip pile atau getah tingkap gelangsar.
- Sendi sudut yang sudah terbuka.

Kami guna EPDM atau profil yang sepadan saluran sedia ada. Manik silikon “universal” yang gemuk bukan penggantian pengedap.

## Cara kerja

1. Periksa kaca, saluran gasket, weep dan silikon dinding-ke-rangka.
2. Sebut harga mengikut kaki linier yang diukur dan jenis profil.
3. Tarik gasket lama; bersihkan saluran.
4. Dudukkan pengedap baharu tanpa meregangkannya di sudut (EPDM yang diregang mengecut semula dan membuka jurang).
5. Bersihkan weep; tutup sash dan semak mampatan.
6. Jika perlu, laras stay atau roller supaya sash benar-benar mengenai pengedap.

## Kos

| Perkhidmatan | Harga mula |
|---|---|
| Penggantian pengedap tingkap | Dari RM 30 / kaki linier |
| Penggantian kaca | Dari RM 200 |
| Penggantian roller gelangsar | Dari RM 150 |

Satu panel gelangsar kondominium biasa hanya beberapa meter pengedap, bukan nombor seluruh rumah. Kami ukur.

## Bila pengedap baharu tidak cukup

- Rangka bengkok atau berkarat.
- Sash begitu tidak lurus sehingga tidak pernah memampatkan getah.
- Bocor yang sebenarnya dinding, siling atau [bumbung](/ms/services/roof-repair) di atas tingkap.
- Kabus dwikaca — perlukan unit kaca baharu.

## Soalan lazim

### Bagaimana saya tahu ia pengedap, bukan kaca?

Jika panel utuh dan air muncul pada ambang atau sudut semasa hujan, mula dengan pengedap dan weep. Retak dan lubang ialah kaca.

### Boleh buat satu tingkap yang bocor sahaja?

Boleh. Ramai kerja ialah satu panel menghadap barat.

### Berapa lama?

Satu tingkap kerap siap dalam satu lawatan. Satu elevasi rumah landed mengambil masa lebih lama.

## Tempah penggantian pengedap

WhatsApp close-up getah dan ambang basah — [minta sebut harga pengedap tingkap](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20Saya%20perlukan%20penggantian%20pengedap%20tingkap.).

zh.title: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户密封条更换：费用与流程指南（2026）
zh.excerpt: 更换吉隆坡与雪兰莪硬化或渗漏的 EPDM 窗封条，阻止雨水进入和漏风。从 RM 30 / 延英尺起。
zh.metaTitle: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户密封条更换｜费用指南
zh.metaDesc: 吉隆坡与雪兰莪窗户密封条更换服务，替换老化或收缩的 EPDM 胶条，帮助减少雨水渗入、漏风和窗框异响。每直线英尺 RM 30 起。
zh.content:
窗封条是夹在玻璃与窗框、窗扇与窗框之间的橡胶（多为 EPDM）。马来西亚的太阳会把它晒硬、收缩、开裂。之后即使玻璃完好，雨水也会顺着铝材流到内窗台。

**直接回答：** KL Servis Rumah 更换老化或硬化的窗封条，从 **RM 30 / 延英尺** 起，能解决大部分“一下雨窗就漏”、其实玻璃并没裂的投诉。

玻璃碎了，先做 [玻璃更换](/zh/services/window-repair/glass-replacement)。窗扇推不动，见 [推拉窗卡住](/zh/problems/sliding-window-stuck) 与 [窗户维修](/zh/services/window-repair)。

## 失效密封条长什么样

- 胶条压下去又扁又硬发亮，或已经裂。
- 窗扇转角能看见缝。
- 暴雨时内窗台有水，玻璃没有裂纹。
- 锁好后仍有哨声或漏风。
- 中空玻璃夹层起雾 — 那是**单元**密封失效；要换整块中空玻璃，不是只换外圈胶条。

内侧硅胶线上的黑霉，也可能是**墙与窗框**接缝失效。那是建筑密封胶，不是窗扇胶条。

## 为什么巴生谷胶条坏得快

西晒铝合金窗下午很烫。廉价 PVC 胶条发脆。灰尘和雨季积水留在轨道里。因为 [锁卡住](/zh/problems/stuck-window-lock) 而摔窗，也会切断胶条。

换胶却不通 **排水孔**（外轨道上的小排水槽）只做了一半。孔堵着，新胶条看起来像没效果。

## 我们换什么

- 玻璃与框之间的镶嵌胶条。
- 平开、上悬窗扇与框之间的压缩密封。
- 推拉窗毛条或橡胶挡风雨条。
- 已经开口的转角接头。

我们用 EPDM 或匹配现有槽的截面。一条又粗又通用的玻璃胶不是换密封条。

## 怎么做

1. 检查玻璃、胶槽、排水孔和墙框硅胶。
2. 按测得延米和截面类型报价。
3. 抽出旧胶；清理槽。
4. 新胶就位，转角处不要拉长（拉长的 EPDM 会回缩开口）。
5. 疏通排水孔；关窗检查压缩。
6. 需要时调风撑或滑轮，让窗扇真正压到胶条上。

## 费用

| 服务 | 起步价 |
|---|---|
| 窗户密封条更换 | 从 RM 30 / 延英尺起 |
| 玻璃更换 | 从 RM 200 起 |
| 推拉滑轮更换 | 从 RM 150 起 |

一扇公寓推拉扇通常只有几米胶条，不是整栋的数字。我们现场量。

## 什么时候换胶条不够

- 窗框弯曲或锈蚀。
- 窗扇严重不方，永远压不紧橡胶。
- 漏水其实来自窗上方的墙、天花或 [屋顶](/zh/services/roof-repair)。
- 中空起雾 — 要换玻璃单元。

## 常见问题

### 怎么判断是胶条不是玻璃？

玻璃完整，雨天窗台或转角有水，先查胶条和排水孔。裂纹和破洞是玻璃。

### 可以只做一扇漏的窗吗？

可以。很多活就是一扇西晒窗。

### 要多久？

一扇窗常常一次上门完成。有地住宅整面外墙更久。

## 预约换密封条

WhatsApp 胶条特写和湿窗台照片 — [索取窗封条报价](https://wa.me/601116627349?text=Hi%20KL%20Servis%20Rumah!%20我需要更换窗户密封条。).
